AI.title_translation: 当更好的轮次无法造就更好的代理：诊断下一轮指标与工作流成功率之间的差距
AI.tldr: 大模型代理在单步预测评估中表现变好，并不意味着它们能更好地完成实际的端到端工作流。
AI.motivation: 调查模型在单步决策评估协议下的改进是否能够预测其在自主工作流执行中的改进。
AI.method: 在多轮客户支持工作流中，研究了4B和14B参数的预SFT和监督微调（SFT）Qwen3模型以及4B和12B参数的Gemma 3模型，对比了金标准历史评估下的单步成功率与自主工作流执行的效果。
AI.result: SFT一致地提升了文本轮次的成功率，但在金标准历史评估下整体单步成功率增加并没有转化为自主工作流执行的成功，所有四个SFT模型在整体工作流评估中均未成功，严格的轨迹完成率最高仅达到10.4%。
AI.conclusion: 下一轮评估不能可靠地替代工作流成功率，因此需要分别报告文本质量、局部动作正确性、工具执行和端到端任务完成情况。
AI.translation: 代理模型经常被逐个决策地进行评估，即模型根据黄金交互历史预测下一个动作，并与参考标准进行评分。我们研究了在此协议下的改进是否能预测自主工作流执行的改善。我们在多轮客户支持工作流上研究了4B和14B参数的预SFT和监督微调（SFT）Qwen3模型以及4B和12B参数的Gemma 3模型。我们发现，SFT一致地提高了文本轮次的成功率，并且在黄金历史评估下每个模型的整体下一轮成功率都有所增加。然而，这些改进并没有转移到自主工作流执行中。特定于工具的增益在不同的指标和模型之间也有所不同。四个SFT模型在整体工作流评估中均未成功，严格的轨迹完成率最高仅达到10.4%。我们的结果表明，下一轮评估并不是工作流成功的可靠代理，这促使我们需要分别报告文本质量、局部动作正确性、工具执行和端到端任务完成情况。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了AI代理模型中单步评估指标与实际工作流成功率之间的差距，发现监督微调带来的单步决策提升无法有效转化为自主端到端任务的成功，强调了建立多维度评估指标的必要性。
AI.keywords: 大模型代理, 单步评估, 工作流成功率, 监督微调, 评估基准
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了当前大语言模型代理评估中的一个重要误区：单步预测（Next-turn）性能的提升并不等于端到端工作流执行能力的提升。这对未来设计更真实、更有效的代理评估基准具有重要的指导意义。

title: SWE-Proof: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World Issues with Machine-Checked Proofs?
summary: Ensuring the correctness of LLM-generated code is a core challenge for modern software engineering. Benchmarks for agentic code generation check correctness with held-out test suites, which are inherently incomplete and increasingly susceptible to memorization. Formal verification avoids both problems, but existing work covers only standalone tasks whose specifications are given as input, not real issues, which touch large repositories and state intent in vague natural language. We present Benchproofer, a pipeline that turns a coding task with a known correct patch into a formally verified one: it writes a specification for the new code, summarizes the existing functions that code calls with axioms, and admits an instance only after mechanical and adversarial gates agree. Applying it to SWE-bench Verified yields SWE-Proof, 500 real issues whose correctness is formally verified rather than tested, and it extends to SWE-bench Pro. Across two frontier models, verification catches what tests miss: a quarter to a half of test-passing patches admit counterexamples, which a structured natural-language specification does not fix, while a correct formal one lifts resolution from 85% to 95% for Opus 4.8. Writing that specification is the hard part: models that must write their own gain nothing over an unaided baseline, and only 62% of their specifications pass our audit. The usual failure is faithfulness, a specification that constrains part of the required behavior and leaves the rest free. Specification quality still tracks the outcome, failing on 89% of unresolved instances against 47% of resolved ones, making faithful specification synthesis a concrete open problem.

AI.title_translation: SWE-Proof：语言模型能否通过机器检查的证明解决真实世界的软件问题？
AI.tldr: 本文构建了首个利用机器检查证明评估真实软件工程问题的基准SWE-Proof，发现传统测试集常漏掉错误，而自动编写形式化规范是当前大模型面临的核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于测试套件的代码生成基准存在不完整且易被记忆的问题，而现有的形式化验证工作仅涵盖输入中给出规范的独立任务，无法应对涉及大型仓库且意图模糊的真实软件问题。
AI.method: 提出了Benchproofer流水线，将带有已知正确补丁的编码任务转化为经过形式化验证的任务；通过编写规范、用公理总结被调用的现有函数，并通过机械和对抗性审核门槛。应用该方法构建了SWE-Proof基准（500个真实形式化验证问题）。
AI.result: 在SWE-Proof上应用表明，25%到50%通过测试的补丁存在反例；正确的形式化规范可将Opus 4.8的解决率从85%提升至95%；然而，模型自主编写规范表现不佳（仅62%通过审核），忠实度不足是主要失败原因。
AI.conclusion: 形式化验证比传统测试集更能严格保证LLM生成代码的正确性，但自动编写高质、忠实的规范仍然是当前AI软件工程的一大核心挑战。
AI.translation: 确保LLM生成代码的正确性是现代软件工程的核心挑战。代理式代码生成基准通过保留的测试套件检查正确性，这些测试套件本质上是不完整的，并且越来越容易受到记忆效应的影响。形式化验证避免了这两个问题，但现有工作仅涵盖规范作为输入给出的独立任务，而不是触及大型代码仓库且以模糊自然语言表达意图的真实问题。我们提出了Benchproofer，这是一个将具有已知正确补丁的编码任务转化为形式化验证任务的流水线：它为新代码编写规范，用公理总结该代码调用的现有函数，并且只有在机械和对抗性审核门槛一致通过后才接受其实例。将其应用于SWE-Proof Verified产生了SWE-Proof，这是一个包含500个经过形式化验证而非测试的真实问题，并且它延伸到了SWE-bench Pro。在两个前沿模型中，验证能够捕捉到测试遗漏的内容：四分之一到一半的通过测试的补丁存在反例，结构化自然语言规范无法解决这一问题，而正确的形式化规范将Opus 4.8的解决率从85%提升到95%。编写该规范是最困难的部分：必须自己编写规范的模型没有获得比无辅助基线更好的效果，且只有62%的规范通过了我们的审核。常见的失败原因是忠实度，即规范只约束了所需行为的一部分而让其余部分不受限制。规范的质量仍然与结果息息相关，在未解决的实例中89%失败，而在已解决的实例中为47%，这使得忠实的规范合成成为一个具体的开放性问题。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Benchproofer管道以及由此产生的SWE-Proof基准，用于将真实的软件工程问题转化为形式化验证任务。研究发现，虽然正确的形式化规范能显著提升代码正确率，但让大语言模型自主编写高质量、忠实的规范仍然是一个重大挑战。
AI.keywords: 形式化验证, 大语言模型, 软件工程, 自动代码生成, Benchproofer
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出了SWE-Proof基准，将真实世界的软件工程问题（SWE-bench）与形式化验证相结合，超越了传统基于测试集的评估方法。研究揭示了当前大语言模型在形式化规范（Specification）编写上的不足（如忠实度问题），为未来可靠的代码生成和形式化验证结合指明了方向。

title: AI-GRACE: A Use-Case Operationalization Framework for Agentic AI: From Organizational Objectives and Obligations to Deployment Capabilities and Architecture
summary: Organizations deploying agentic artificial intelligence must determine more than whether a model is trustworthy; they must establish what to validate, control, and observe for a use case to deliver its intended outcome while meeting applicable obligations. This paper proposes AI-GRACE (Agentic Intelligence-Governance, Risk, Assurance, Controls, and Evidence) as a use-case operationalization framework connecting organizational governance with technical implementation. The proposal draws on professional observations and a purposive synthesis of standards and literature, using design science to frame the method contribution and situational method engineering to guide contextual tailoring and reuse. The framework establishes objectives and obligations and then assesses risks in seven proposed domains, including mission and value realization. It derives requirements for assurance before deployment, runtime controls, and evidence, which guide capability qualification, gap assessment, and a logical architecture. An Agent Operating Envelope specifies permitted actions and escalation conditions, while Risk-Aligned Independence Levels (RAIL) summarize the authorized independence. A fictional retail banking application illustrates the method. The contribution is a traceable basis for deciding what an organization must implement, what it already supports, and what remains unresolved. Empirical evaluation must establish whether it improves deployment decisions, efficiency, and reuse.

AI.title_translation: AI-GRACE：面向代理式AI的用例操作化框架：从组织目标与义务到部署能力与架构
AI.tldr: 本文提出了AI-GRACE框架，连接了Agentic AI的组织治理与技术实现，用于指导企业安全、可追溯地部署Agent。
AI.motivation: 组织在部署Agentic AI时，不仅需要判断模型是否可信，还需要明确在特定用例中需要验证、控制和观察的内容，以确保实现预期结果并满足相关合规义务。目前缺乏一个将组织治理与技术实现连接起来的实用操作框架。
AI.method: 采用设计科学（design science）构建方法贡献，并利用情境化方法工程（situational method engineering）来指导上下文定制和复用。提出了涵盖七个领域的风险评估、部署前保证要求、运行时控制及证据导出方法，并引入了Agent操作包络（AOE）和风险对齐独立性级别（RAIL）。
AI.result: 提出了AI-GRACE框架，并通过一个虚构的零售银行业务应用进行了说明。该框架为决定组织必须实现什么、已经支持什么以及尚未解决的问题提供了可追溯的基础。
AI.conclusion: AI-GRACE框架为组织安全、合规、高效地部署Agentic AI提供了一条从目标到架构的可追溯路径，未来需要通过实证评估来进一步验证其有效性。
AI.translation: 部署代理式人工智能（Agentic AI）的组织不仅必须确定模型是否可信；它们还必须确定针对特定用例需要验证、控制和观察什么，以实现预期的结果并满足适用的义务。本文提出了AI-GRACE（代理智能-治理、风险、保证、控制和证据）作为一个将组织治理与技术实现连接起来的用例操作化框架。该提案借鉴了专业观察以及对标准和文献的有意综合，使用设计科学来构建方法贡献，并利用情境化方法工程来指导上下文定制和复用。该框架确立了目标和义务，然后在提出的七个领域（包括使命和价值实现）中评估风险。它为部署前的保证要求、运行时控制和证据推导出了需求，这些需求指导了能力资格认证、差距评估和逻辑架构。代理操作包络指定了允许的操作和升级条件，而风险对齐独立性级别（RAIL）总结了授权的独立性。一个虚构的零售银行业务应用说明了该方法。该贡献为决定组织必须实施什么、已经支持什么以及仍未解决的问题提供了一个可追溯的基础。实证评估必须确定它是否能改善部署决策、效率和复用。
AI.summary: 本文提出了AI-GRACE框架，这是一个将组织治理与技术实现相连接的用例操作化框架，旨在帮助组织在部署Agentic AI时建立目标、义务、风险评估、控制和证据收集机制，从而实现安全、合规的部署。
AI.keywords: Agentic AI, 治理, 风险管理, 架构设计, 框架 operationalization
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种开创性的框架，将组织治理与Agentic AI的技术实现紧密结合，填补了从高层战略目标到具体技术部署之间的空白，对于企业安全、合规地落地Agent具有重要的现实意义。

title: Your Programming Students' Cognition with ChatGPT: Higher Performance, Lower Retention, and Reduced Ownership
summary: Generative AI can improve students' programming performance, but successful task completion may not reflect what they retain. We examined performance, retention, cognitive load, and ownership in a controlled between-subjects experiment with 59 undergraduate computer science students, 55 were retained for analysis. Participants completed three introductory C programming tasks with access to ChatGPT-4.5 or conventional web search without generative AI. We measured task performance, self-reported mental effort and difficulty, pupillary responses, heart rate variability, and ownership, and assessed cued recall immediately and 48 hours later. ChatGPT-assisted students achieved higher coding scores (89% vs. 69%) but lower recall scores immediately (41% vs. 53%) and after 48 hours (39% vs. 52%). There was no significant difference in the loss of recall information over 48 hours between the groups. Self-reported mental effort increased less across tasks in the ChatGPT condition (Holm-adjusted p = .047), and students attributed less of the submitted code to themselves (45% vs. 81%). Confirmatory physiological tests did not detect significant differences in trajectories between conditions; substantial data loss limits their interpretation. These findings reveal a gap between assisted task performance and subsequent recall and sense of ownership in this setting. They motivate the need for assessment practices and AI learning tools that require students to explain, retrieve, and contribute to the work they submit as active participants in their education.

AI.title_translation: 你的编程学生在ChatGPT之下的认知：更高表现、更低保持与更少所有权
AI.tldr: ChatGPT能帮学生写出更高分的代码，但也导致他们的长期记忆保持和对代码的归属感显著下降。
AI.motivation: 尽管生成式AI能够提升学生的编程表现，但成功的任务完成并不一定反映学生真正掌握并内化了知识。因此需要研究AI对学生认知、长期记忆保持和知识归属感的影响。
AI.method: 采用受试者间实验设计，纳入55名本科计算机科学专业学生，分为ChatGPT-4.5辅助组和传统网络搜索组（无生成式AI），完成三项入门级C语言编程任务。测量了任务表现、自我报告的心理努力与难度、瞳孔反应、心率变异性、代码所有权，以及即时和48小时后的线索回忆测试。
AI.result: ChatGPT辅助组的代码得分更高（89%对69%），但即时回忆得分更低（41%对53%）且48小时后依然较低（39%对52%）。ChatGPT组的自我报告心理努力增加较少，且学生认为属于自己的代码比例更低（45%对81%）。生理测试未发现两组之间有显著轨迹差异。
AI.conclusion: 使用ChatGPT辅助编程虽能提高短期任务表现，但会损害知识保持和学生对代码的主体归属感，亟需开发能促进学生主动思考和解释的AI学习工具与考核方式。
AI.translation: 生成式人工智能可以提高学生的编程表现，但成功的任务完成可能并不反映他们保留了什么。我们在一个包含59名本科计算机科学学生（保留55名进行分析）的受试者间控制实验中，考察了表现、记忆保持、认知负荷和所有权。参与者在可以使用ChatGPT-4.5或无生成式人工智能的传统网络搜索的情况下，完成了三个入门级C语言编程任务。我们测量了任务表现、自我报告的心理努力和难度、瞳孔反应、心率变异性和所有权，并在立即和48小时后评估了线索回忆。ChatGPT辅助的学生获得了更高的编码分数（89%对69%），但即时回忆分数更低（41%对53%），48小时后也更低（39%对52%）。两组在48小时内回忆信息的丢失没有显著差异。在ChatGPT条件下，跨任务的自我报告心理努力增加较少（Holm调整后的p = .047），并且学生将较少提交的代码归功于自己（45%对81%）。确证性生理测试未检测到条件之间的轨迹有显著差异；大量的数据丢失限制了解释。这些发现揭示了辅助任务表现与随后的回忆和归属感之间的差距。它们促使我们需要评估实践和人工智能学习工具，这些工具要求学生作为教育的积极参与者来解释、检索和贡献他们提交的工作。
AI.summary: 本研究通过一项对照实验探讨了计算机科学学生在ChatGPT辅助下进行编程时的认知表现。结果表明，ChatGPT虽能提高短期编程成绩，却降低了知识保持率和对代码的主体归属感，凸显了改进教育工具与评估方法的必要性。
AI.keywords: 生成式AI, 编程教育, 认知负荷, 知识保持, 所有权
AI.comments: 该研究指出了生成式AI在教育应用中的“双刃剑”效应：虽然能短期内提高编程成绩和表现，但会导致记忆保持下降和所有权缺失。这为未来AI辅助教学工具的设计和考核方式改革提供了重要的警示和方向。

title: Reliability-Centered Evaluation of Sparse Longitudinal CT Lesion-Size Forecasting with Conformal Interval Calibration and Gompertz-Inspired Regularization
summary: Sparse longitudinal CT follow-up limits lesion-size forecasting when only a few prior observations are available. We constructed a five-visit DLT-derived same-lesion trajectory benchmark from DeepLesion and Deep Lesion Tracker (DLT), yielding 205 trajectories from 129 patients. We compared an exploratory conventional sparse-to-final analysis with a primary fixed visit-index horizon design predicting the common log change from T3 to T4 while progressively adding earlier observations, evaluating predictive accuracy, uncertainty reliability, post-hoc conformal interval calibration, subgroup performance, and Gompertz-inspired trajectory regularization. The evaluated methods showed partially overlapping point-prediction accuracy but distinct uncertainty behavior. Mean held-out RMSE across ten training seeds was 0.4726, 0.4305, 0.4499, and 0.4513 for m = 1, 2, 3, 4, indicating the lowest mean RMSE at m = 2; additional history did not improve RMSE. At m = 4, raw Cohort-Level Feature GP coverage was near the 95% nominal level, whereas MC Dropout, Deep Ensemble, and residual-scale intervals were conservative. Patient-level conformal calibration generally produced near-nominal or conservative coverage at the cost of wider intervals. Patient-grouped development cross-validation selected lambda* = 0 for the Gompertz-inspired term. A global population reference frequently opposed lesion-level change directions, and prediction difficulty varied across anatomical subgroups. Overall, additional historical observations provided limited predictive benefit once the prediction horizon was controlled, while predictive accuracy, uncertainty reliability, and trajectory consistency did not necessarily improve together, and should be evaluated jointly in sparse longitudinal imaging.

AI.title_translation: 基于共形区间校准与Gompertz启发式正则化的稀疏纵向CT病变大小预测的以可靠性为中心的评估
AI.tldr: 本文研究了稀疏纵向CT病变大小预测，发现增加历史观测数据对预测准确性的提升有限，并强调了联合评估预测准确性、不确定性和轨迹一致性的必要性。
AI.motivation: 仅有少量前期观测的稀疏纵向CT随访限制了病变大小的预测能力，且现有方法在不确定性可靠性、共形校准和轨迹一致性方面的联合评估尚显不足。
AI.method: 构建了五次访视的DLT衍生同病变轨迹基准（205条轨迹，129名患者）；对比了常规稀疏到最终分析与固定访视索引视界设计；应用了后验共形区间校准、Gompertz启发式正则化，并评估了多种不确定性估计方法（如MC Dropout、Deep Ensemble等）。
AI.result: m=2时的平均RMSE最低（0.4305），增加历史数据并未改善RMSE；在m=4时，Cohort-Level Feature GP的覆盖率接近95%的名义水平，而其他方法偏保守；患者级共形校准以更宽的区间为代价达到了接近名义或保守的覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 在稀疏纵向影像预测中，额外的历史观测数据在控制预测视界后提供的预测益处有限；预测准确性、不确定性可靠性和轨迹一致性应进行联合评估。
AI.translation: 稀疏的纵向CT随访在仅有少量前期观测时限制了病变大小的预测。我们从DeepLesion和Deep Lesion Tracker（DLT）构建了一个五次访视的同病变轨迹基准，产生了来自129名患者的205条轨迹。我们将探索性的常规稀疏到最终分析与主要固定访视索引视界设计进行了比较，该设计在逐步添加早期观测的同时预测从T3到T4的常见对数变化，并评估了预测准确性、不确定性可靠性、事后共形区间校准、子群性能以及Gompertz启发式的轨迹正则化。被评估的方法显示出部分重叠的点预测准确性，但具有不同的不确定性行为。在十个训练随机种子下，m = 1、2、3、4的平均留出RMSE分别为0.4726、0.4305、0.4499和0.4513，表明m = 2时的平均RMSE最低；增加历史记录并没有改善RMSE。在m = 4时，原始群组级特征GP覆盖率接近95%的名义水平，而MC Dropout、Deep Ensemble和残差尺度区间则较为保守。患者级共形区间校准通常以更宽的区间为代价产生接近名义或保守的覆盖率。全局总体参考经常与病变水平的变化方向相反，且预测难度在解剖子群之间有所不同。总体而言，一旦控制了预测视界，额外的历史观测只能提供有限的预测效益，同时预测准确性、不确定性可靠性和轨迹一致性并不一定同时改善，在稀疏纵向影像中应该对其进行联合评估。
AI.summary: 本文构建了一个稀疏纵向CT病变轨迹基准，并评估了不同历史观测数量对病变大小预测的影响。研究发现，增加历史数据并未持续改善预测误差（m=2时误差最低），且预测准确性、不确定性可靠性和轨迹一致性需要被联合评估。
AI.keywords: 纵向CT预测, 稀疏数据, 共形区间校准, 轨迹基准, 医疗影像分析
AI.comments: 该论文针对稀疏纵向CT病变大小预测问题，构建了基于DeepLesion的轨迹基准，并综合评估了预测准确性、不确定性可靠性、共形区间校准以及Gompertz启发式正则化。其创新点在于强调了历史数据并非越多越好（在控制预测视界时），且指出了准确性、不确定性和轨迹一致性并非同步提升，为医疗影像预测提供了重要的方法论参考。

title: OnomatoBridge: Onomatopoeia Translation and Rendering Pipeline in Manga
summary: Manga is a comic drawn by black and white paints gaining popularity around the world. Onomatopoeia in Manga specifically appeals to the audience with its unique visual styles, which convey sound, motion, and emotion. Visual onomatopoeia translation requires the clean replacement of Japanese onomatopoeia with onomatopoeia in the other language while preserving their visual style. Existing approaches often produce residual artifacts or style inconsistency when removing the Japanese onomatopoeia and rendering stylized English onomatopoeia. To approach these problems, we present OnomatoBridge, a filtering pipeline for visual onomatopoeia translation. We evaluate OnomatoBridge from Japanese to English on the Manga109 onomatopoeia dataset and compare it with baseline image editing models. Experimental results show that the filtered outputs by the proposed method outperform those of conventional methods. OnomatoBridge improves English text correctness by roughly 10 to 25 points and reduces residual Japanese text by about 20 to 50% in relative terms.

AI.title_translation: OnomatoBridge：漫画中的拟声词翻译与渲染流程
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为OnomatoBridge的漫画拟声词翻译与渲染流程，能有效去除日文拟声词残留并提升英文拟声词的翻译与渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 漫画中的拟声词具有独特的视觉风格以表达声音、动作和情感。然而，现有的视觉拟声词翻译方法在移除日文拟声词并渲染风格化的英文拟声词时，往往会产生残留伪影或风格不一致的问题。
AI.method: 提出了名为OnomatoBridge的过滤流程，用于漫画视觉拟声词的翻译，并在Manga109数据集上进行了评估与基线对比。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，OnomatoBridge的输出优于传统方法，将英文文本的正确率提高了约10到25个百分点，并将残留的日文文本相对减少了约20%到50%。
AI.conclusion: OnomatoBridge作为一个有效的过滤流程，显著提升了漫画中视觉拟声词的翻译质量、文本正确性，并减少了残留文本，优于现有的基准图像编辑模型。
AI.translation: 漫画是一种在全球广受欢迎的黑白绘画漫画。漫画中的拟声词以其独特的视觉风格吸引着读者，传达声音、运动和情感。视觉拟声词翻译需要将日文拟声词干净地替换为其他语言的拟声词，同时保留其视觉风格。现有的方法在移除日文拟声词和渲染风格化的英文拟声词时，经常产生残留伪影或风格不一致的问题。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了OnomatoBridge，这是一个用于视觉拟声词翻译的过滤流程。我们在Manga109拟声词数据集上评估了从日文到英文的OnomatoBridge，并将其与基线图像编辑模型进行了比较。实验结果表明，该方法过滤后的输出优于传统方法。OnomatoBridge将英文文本的正确率提高了大约10到25个百分点，并在相对基础上将残留的日文文本减少了约20%到50%。
AI.summary: 论文提出了OnomatoBridge，一个用于漫画中视觉拟声词翻译与渲染的过滤流程。针对现有方法在清除日文拟声词和渲染英文拟声词时产生的残留伪影与风格不一致问题，该方法在Manga109数据集上的实验表明，其在文本正确率和去除残留文本方面均显著优于传统图像编辑模型。
AI.keywords: Manga, Onomatopoeia Translation, Visual Rendering, Image Editing, Manga109
AI.comments: 该论文针对漫画中拟声词的翻译与渲染这一独特且具有挑战性的视觉任务，提出了OnomatoBridge过滤流程，有效解决了传统图像编辑模型在擦除和风格化渲染时的残留伪影与风格不一致问题，对漫画本地化具有较高的实用价值。

title: Embedding Drift in Code Vulnerability Models Under Intended Behaviour-Preserving Transformations
summary: Code edits that preserve program behaviour can shift frozen code embeddings across classifier decision boundaries, causing correctly detected vulnerabilities to be predicted as benign. Such instability is problematic because semantically neutral changes, including comment removal, insertion of unreachable code, variable renaming, and loop rewriting, should not alter a model's security judgment. We investigate this issue using 15,000 C/C++ functions organized as 7,500 vulnerable-patched pairs from the Big-Vul dataset. Four mutation tracks are applied to both vulnerable and benign samples: comment removal, unreachable code insertion, variable renaming, loop rewriting, and a combined setting that applies all transformations. Using frozen microsoft/codebert-base embeddings with six downstream classifiers, we evaluate the robustness of vulnerability predictions and introduce a train-only defence that projects clean and mutated representations closer together while preserving vulnerability-class information. Under combined mutations, the baseline Vulnerable Flip Rate (VFR) ranges from 35.55% to 42.15%. The proposed defence reduces the mean common-set VFR from 22.60% to 11.32% and improves mean mutated accuracy from 55.33% to 57.10%. For Logistic Regression, VFR decreases by 17.29 percentage points, although benign-to-vulnerable flips increase by 11.95 percentage points. These results indicate that the defence improves robustness to semantics-preserving code transformations but introduces a false-positive trade-off and does not fully eliminate prediction instability.

AI.title_translation: 意图保持行为变换下代码漏洞模型中的嵌入漂移
AI.tldr: 保持语义的代码修改会导致代码漏洞检测模型失效，本文评估了这种嵌入漂移现象并提出了一种能够提高鲁棒性但存在误报权衡的防御方法。
AI.motivation: 保持程序行为的代码编辑会跨越分类器的决策边界，导致正确检测到的漏洞被预测为良性。这种不稳定性是有问题的，因为语义中立的变化不应该改变模型的安全判断。
AI.method: 使用来自Big-Vul数据集的15,000个C/C++函数（7,500对），应用四种突变轨道（删除注释、插入不可达代码、变量重命名、循环重写及组合设置），基于microsoft/codebert-base嵌入和六个下游分类器进行评估，并引入了一种仅限训练的防御方法，将干净和突变的表示投影得更近。
AI.result: 在组合突变下，基线漏洞翻转率（VFR）在35.55%到42.15%之间。提出的防御方法将平均公共集VFR从22.60%降低到11.32%，并将平均突变准确率从55.33%提高到57.10%，但逻辑回归的误报（良性转为漏洞）增加了11.95个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 语义保持变换会导致代码漏洞检测模型产生显著的嵌入漂移和预测不稳定。提出的训练阶段防御方法能有效提高鲁棒性，但仍存在误报增加的权衡，未能完全消除不稳定性。
AI.translation: 保持程序行为的代码编辑可以使冻结的代码嵌入跨越分类器的决策边界，导致正确检测到的漏洞被预测为良性。这种不稳定性是有问题的，因为语义中立的变化（包括注释删除、插入不可达代码、变量重命名和循环重写）不应该改变模型的安全判断。我们使用来自Big-Vul数据集的15,000个C/C++函数（组织为7,500个漏洞-补丁对）来研究这个问题。四种突变轨道被应用于漏洞和良性样本：注释删除、不可达代码插入、变量重命名、循环重写以及应用所有变换的组合设置。使用带有六个下游分类器的冻结microsoft/codebert-base嵌入，我们评估了漏洞预测的鲁棒性，并引入了一种仅在训练阶段的防御方法，该方法将干净和突变的表示投影得更近，同时保留漏洞类信息。在组合突变下，基线漏洞翻转率（VFR）从35.55%到42.15%不等。所提出的防御将平均公共集VFR从22.60%降低到11.32%，并将平均突变准确率从55.33%提高到57.10%。对于逻辑回归，VFR下降了17.29个百分点，尽管良性到漏洞的翻转增加了11.95个百分点。这些结果表明，该防御提高了对保持语义的代码变换的鲁棒性，但引入了假阳性权衡，并且没有完全消除预测的不稳定性。
AI.summary: 论文研究了在保持行为的代码变换下代码漏洞模型中的嵌入漂移问题。作者通过对Big-Vul数据集应用多种突变，发现基线模型预测极不稳定，随后提出了一种训练阶段的防御方法，在提升模型鲁棒性的同时带来了误报率的权衡。
AI.keywords: 代码漏洞, 嵌入漂移, 语义保持变换, 鲁棒性, 代码大模型
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了代码漏洞检测模型对保持语义的变换（如变量重命名、加注释等）非常脆弱，并提出了一种仅在训练阶段使用的防御方法，有效降低了漏洞翻转率，但同时也带来了一定的误报率权衡。研究具有较强的安全应用价值。

title: Human Driver Temperament and the Safety Impact of a C-V2X Denial-of-Service Flooding Attack in Mixed-Autonomy Traffic
comments: 12 pages, 6 figures, Submitted to AHFE Hawaii International Conference
summary: Cooperative and connected automated vehicles (CAVs) rely on Signal Phase and Timing (SPaT) messages to cross signalized intersections; a denial-of-service (DoS) flood that blocks SPaT forces CAVs into a fail-safe mode. Because human-driven vehicles share the intersection, the safety consequence depends not only on the attack and the CAV fail-safe policy, but on how the surrounding human drivers behave. We investigate this human-factors dimension with a coupled OMNeT++/INET (5G NR-V2X) and SUMO microsimulation of a signalized corridor, sweeping CAV market penetration (10-90%), four calibrated driver temperaments (cautious to aggressive) and two standards-based fail-safe policies, a minimal-risk maneuver (MRM) and an adaptive cruise control (ACC) keep-driving fallback, with each attack arm differenced against its policy-matched no-attack baseline. Temperament's effect on the attack is specific and modest rather than a blanket amplification. Aggressive surroundings worsen one metric, the hard-braking a keep-driving fail-safe forces on nearby drivers (p = 0.03), rising from near zero to +8 episodes/1000 veh-s. They appear to dampen rear-end conflicts, but only because the flood clears the queues aggressive drivers build, so the gain is in flow, not safety. On the attack's primary signatures, CAV red-light running and crossing conflicts, temperament has no detectable effect. It instead dominates baseline risk, producing a 13- to 18-fold cautious-to-aggressive gradient far larger than the attack itself, which acts through a channel already congested by CAV adoption. Human driver populations determine how dangerous the intersection is but do not systematically amplify this attack, so fail-safe design cannot assume a cautious test population bounds the risk.
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, Submitted to AHFE Hawaii International Conference

AI.title_translation: 混合自治交通中人类驾驶员气质对C-V2X拒绝服务泛洪攻击安全影响的研究
AI.tldr: 研究表明人类驾驶员的气质（谨慎或激进）会极大地影响交通基线风险，但并不会系统性地放大C-V2X拒绝服务攻击带来的安全危害。
AI.motivation: 协同连接自动驾驶车辆（CAV）依赖SPaT消息通过信号交叉口，拒绝服务（DoS）泛洪攻击会迫使CAV进入失效保护模式。由于人类驾驶员与CAV共享交叉口，安全后果不仅取决于攻击和CAV的失效保护策略，还取决于周围人类驾驶员的行为。因此，需要研究这一人为因素维度。
AI.method: 通过将OMNeT++/INET（5G NR-V2X）与SUMO微观仿真相结合，对信号化走廊进行联合仿真。研究了不同的CAV市场渗透率（10-90%）、四种校准的驾驶员气质（从谨慎到激进）以及两种基于标准的失效保护策略（MRM和ACC保持驾驶后备）。
AI.result: 激进的驾驶环境会使保持驾驶失效保护对附近司机造成的急刹车次数增加（每1000车·秒增加8次）；在CAV闯红灯和交叉冲突等攻击主要特征上，驾驶员气质没有可检测到的影响；相反，气质主导了基线风险，产生了13到18倍的谨慎-激进梯度，远大于攻击本身的影响。
AI.conclusion: 人类驾驶员的气质决定了交叉口的基线风险，但不会系统性地放大C-V2X拒绝服务攻击的危害。因此，在进行自动驾驶汽车失效保护设计时，不能假设仅通过谨慎的测试人群就能界定全部风险。
AI.translation: 合作式智能网联汽车（CAV）依靠信号灯相位和定时（SPaT）消息通过信号交叉口；阻断SPaT的拒绝服务（DoS）泛洪攻击会迫使CAV进入失效保护模式。由于有人驾驶车辆与交叉口共享，安全后果不仅取决于攻击和CAV的失效保护策略，还取决于周围人类驾驶员的行为。我们通过OMNeT++/INET（5G NR-V2X）与SUMO微观仿真相结合的方法研究了这一人为因素维度，仿真了一个信号化走廊，涵盖了不同的CAV市场渗透率（10-90%）、四种校准的驾驶员气质（从谨慎到激进）以及两种基于标准的失效保护策略（最小风险机动（MRM）和自适应巡航控制（ACC）保持驾驶后备），并将每个攻击组与无攻击的基线策略进行对比。气质对攻击的影响是具体且适度的，而不是全面的放大。激进的周边环境会恶化一个指标，即保持驾驶失效保护对附近驾驶员强加的急刹车（p = 0.03），从接近零上升到每1000车·秒+8次。它们似乎减少了追尾冲突，但这只是因为泛洪攻击清除驾驶员造成的排队，因此收益在于流量而非安全性。在攻击的主要特征（CAV闯红灯和交叉冲突）上，气质没有可检测到的影响。相反，它主导了基线风险，产生了13到18倍的谨慎-激进梯度，远远大于攻击本身的作用（攻击是通过已经被CAV普及所拥堵的渠道起作用的）。人类驾驶员群体决定了交叉口的危险程度，但并不会系统性地放大这种攻击，因此失效保护设计不能假设谨慎的测试群体能够界定风险。
AI.summary: 该论文利用OMNeT++/INET和SUMO的联合仿真，研究了人类驾驶员气质对C-V2X拒绝服务泛洪攻击在混合交通交叉口安全影响的调节作用。研究发现，驾驶员气质显著影响基线交通风险，但不会系统性地放大C-V2X攻击的负面安全后果。
AI.keywords: C-V2X, 拒绝服务攻击, 混合交通, 人类驾驶员气质, 交通仿真
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将人类驾驶员的气质（从谨慎到激进）引入到C-V2X网络攻击（拒绝服务泛洪攻击）的安全影响评估中。研究表明，人类驾驶员的气质主要决定了基线风险，而不会系统性地放大攻击效果，这对未来混合交通流下的自动驾驶安全冗余和失效保护设计具有重要的警示意义。

title: Hand-Aware Transition Modeling for Bimanual Procedural Anomaly Detection
summary: Procedural anomaly detection in bimanual assembly requires judging each hand action against the execution so far. A corrective action may look unusual in isolation, while a visually plausible action can violate the order of the procedure. We present HACT, a transition model over predicted per-hand events. A role-preserving history keeps the concurrent responsibilities of both hands, and a marked temporal point process assigns each observed transition a semantic and temporal surprisal. A supervised evidence head and a two-state filter convert these surprisals into per-hand anomaly posteriors. A recovery-aware protocol on predicted events and participant-disjoint folds reports the recovery false-positive rate at an operating point selected on validation participants. On two bimanual power-tool procedures HACT has the highest AUPRC and F1 among the compared methods and the fewest recovery alarms. Applied without retraining to a different assembly order of the same product, it retains the highest AUPRC and F1. The source code is available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/HACT.

AI.title_translation: 用于双手程序异常检测的双手感知转换建模
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为HACT的双手感知转换模型，通过结合角色保持历史与标记时间点过程，实现了双手法兰装配过程中高精度的异常检测。
AI.motivation: 在双手装配中进行过程异常检测需要评估每只手相对于当前执行的动作。孤立看可能正常的纠正动作或视觉上合理但破坏操作顺序的动作很难被传统方法有效识别，因此需要一种能够捕捉双手事件转换及时间规律的新模型。
AI.method: 提出HACT（Hand-Aware Transition Modeling）模型，包含一个用于保持双手并发职责的角色保持历史机制、一个为每个观察到的转换分配语义和时间惊奇度的标记时间点过程、一个监督证据头以及一个双状态滤波器。
AI.result: 在两个双手法兰/动力工具装配数据集上，HACT相比于对比方法取得了最高的AUPRC和F1分数，并且产生的恢复误报最少；在无需重新训练的情况下应用于同一产品的不同装配顺序时，仍能保持最高的AUPRC和F1。
AI.conclusion: HACT模型通过对双手事件转换进行精确建模和惊奇度评估，在双手法兰/动力工具装配异常检测任务中取得了最优的性能，且具备良好的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 双手法兰装配中的程序异常检测需要对照目前的执行情况来判断每个手的动作。孤立地看，一个纠正性动作可能显得不寻常，而一个视觉上合理的动作则可能违反程序的顺序。我们提出了HACT，一个基于预测的每只手事件的转换模型。角色保持历史保留了两只手的并发职责，标记的时间点过程为每个观察到的转换分配语义和时间惊奇度。一个监督证据头和一个双状态滤波器将这些惊奇度转换为每只手的异常后验概率。在预测事件和参与者不相交的数据集上采用恢复感知协议，报告了在验证参与者上选择的操作点处的恢复误报率。在两个双手法力工具装配程序中，HACT在比较的方法中具有最高的AUPRC和F1，并且恢复警报最少。在无需重新训练的情况下应用于同一产品的不同装配顺序时，它仍保持最高的AUPRC和F1。源代码可在 https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/HACT 获取。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了HACT，一种用于双手法兰/动力工具装配中程序异常检测的双手感知转换模型。通过角色保持历史和标记时间点过程评估语义与时间惊奇度，并在监督证据头与双状态滤波器辅助下，HACT在多项评估指标上超越了现有方法，展现出优异的异常检测性能和泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 双手操作, 过程异常检测, 时间点过程, 动作转换建模, 智能制造
AI.comments: 该论文提出了HACT模型，通过对双手事件进行交替建模和时间点过程分析，有效解决了双手装配过程中的异常检测问题。创新点在于利用了角色保持历史和带有标记的时间点过程来捕捉语义和时间惊奇度，并在恢复阶段表现出极低的误报率。这对于智能制造和人机协作具有重要的实际意义和应用价值。

title: Information-Gain Rewards over Diversity-Pruned Tests: GT-Anchored Verifier Co-Training for Reliable Code Generation
summary: Self-play methods that co-train a single language model as both coder and test author promise to move code-generation RL beyond fixed test suites, but they suffer from two coupled pathologies: permissiveness collapse, where pass-rate rewards are maximised by trivial, non-discriminative tests, and concentration bias, where i.i.d. sampled tests cluster on modal inputs and inflate estimator variance. We introduce CoVer (Co-trained Coder and Verifier), a single-policy GRPO framework that addresses both failure modes. First, an information-gain (IG) reward scores each self-generated test by the mutual information between its pass/fail vector and a graded, ground-truth-anchored correctness signal y [0, 1] m, gated by the sign of their covariance so that only positively discriminative tests receive reward. Second, a three-stage diversity-aware selection step prunes a candidate pool to a behaviourally non-redundant suite (invalidity, input-string, execution-profile filtering), raising the effective sample size of the IG estimator at fixed execution budget. On five benchmarks (LiveBench, MBPP, LiveCodeBench, CodeContests, Code-Forces), CoVer raises one-shot pass@1 by +5.8 points at 7B and +7.1 points at 14B over the Qwen2.5-Instruct backbone, and achieves the highest macro-average among all compared methods at both scales. As a drop-in backbone inside the CodeT ranking pipeline, CoVer-7B adds +3.5 points, demonstrating the dual benefit of co-training for both generation and selection.

AI.title_translation: 基于多样性剪枝测试的信息增益奖励：用于可靠代码生成的GT锚定验证器联合训练
AI.tldr: 提出CoVer框架，通过信息增益奖励和多样性测试剪枝联合训练代码生成器与验证器，解决了自博弈代码生成的病理问题，显著提升了代码生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的代码生成自博弈方法（同时训练代码生成器和测试编写器）受到两个耦合病理的影响：一是宽松度崩溃（通过编写琐碎、无区分度的测试来最大化通过率奖励），二是集中偏差（独立同分布采样的测试聚集在模态输入上，导致估计器方差膨胀）。
AI.method: 提出CoVer框架（单策略GRPO），包含两个核心组件：一是基于真实标签（Ground-Truth）锚定的信息增益（IG）奖励，用于筛选正向判别力的测试用例；二是三阶段多样性感知选择步骤（无效性、输入字符串、执行配置文件过滤），对候选测试集进行剪枝去冗余。
AI.result: 在LiveBench、MBPP、LiveCodeBench、CodeContests和Code-Forces五个基准测试中，CoVer相比Qwen2.5-Instruct骨干网，在7B规模下将one-shot pass@1提升了5.8个百分点，在14B规模下提升了7.1个百分点，并在所有对比方法中实现了最高的宏平均值。作为CodeT排序管道中的即插即用骨干网，CoVer-7B额外提升了3.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CoVer框架通过信息增益奖励和多样性测试剪枝，有效解决了代码生成自博弈中的宽容度崩溃和集中偏差问题，在多个基准测试中显著提升了代码生成性能。
AI.translation: 将单个语言模型同时训练为代码编写者和测试编写者的自博弈方法有望将代码生成强化学习推向固定测试集之外，但它们受到两个耦合病理的影响：一是宽容度崩溃，即通过微不足道的、无区分度的测试来最大化通过率奖励；二是集中偏差，即独立同分布采样的测试聚集在模态输入上并膨胀估计器方差。我们推出了CoVer（联合训练的代码编写者和验证者），这是一个单一策略的GRPO框架，解决了这两种失效模式。首先，信息增益（IG）奖励通过其通过/失败向量与分级的、真实标签锚定的正确性信号 $y \in [0, 1]^m$ 之间的互信息来对每个自生成测试进行评分，并通过其协方差的符号进行门控，以便只有正向判别性的测试才能获得奖励。其次，三阶段多样性感知选择步骤将候选池修剪为行为上非冗余的套件（无效性、输入字符串、执行配置文件过滤），在固定执行预算下提高了IG估计器的有效样本大小。在五个基准测试（LiveBench、MBPP、LiveCodeBench、CodeContests、Code-Forces）中，CoVer在Qwen2.5-Instruct骨干网的基础上，将7B时的one-shot pass@1提高了5.8个百分点，14B时提高了7.1个百分点，并在两个规模的所有比较方法中实现了最高的宏平均值。作为CodeT排序管道中的即插即用骨干网，CoVer-7B增加了3.5个百分点，证明了联合训练对生成和选择的双重好处。
AI.summary: 论文提出了CoVer，一种通过信息增益奖励和多样性测试剪枝来联合训练代码生成器与验证器的强化学习框架，有效克服了传统自博弈方法中的宽松度崩溃和集中偏差，显著提高了代码生成的可靠性和准确率。
AI.keywords: 代码生成, 自博弈, 信息增益, 测试用例剪枝, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文针对代码生成中自博弈方法（代码生成与测试用例编写联合训练）面临的宽容度崩溃和集中偏差问题，提出了CoVer框架。创新性地引入了基于真实标签锚定的信息增益奖励和多样性感知测试剪枝策略，显著提升了模型在多个基准测试上的代码生成能力，兼顾了生成和选择的双重效益。

title: Stochastic Neural Signed Swept Volume for Real-time Chance-Constrained Trajectory Optimization
summary: Collision-free motion planning requires reliable collision models from sensed environments and validation of states along a continuous trajectory. To make this tractable, most planners check for collision at discrete states along continuous trajectories against a single determinized model of the environment, introducing a trade-off between safety and computational efficiency. While continuous collision checking approaches that approximate the swept volume of the robot exist, they are computationally expensive or overly conservative. Data-driven approaches can learn the swept volume; however, these neural models are susceptible to approximation errors and are therefore often limited to serving as coarse filters for downstream collision checkers. In this work, we propose to learn a signed distance function of the swept volume as a probabilistic field, enabling quantification of epistemic uncertainty, incorporation of perception noise, and eventual integration into a chance-constrained trajectory optimization framework. We demonstrate our approach on challenging high-dimensional manipulation problems with significant sensor noise, both in simulation and on real hardware.

AI.title_translation: 用于实时机会约束轨迹优化的随机神经符号扫描体积
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于随机神经符号扫描体积的概率建模方法，实现了考虑感知噪声和不确定性的实时机会约束轨迹优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的离散状态碰撞检测和确定性环境模型在安全性和计算效率之间存在权衡，而现有的连续扫描体积近似方法计算成本高或过于保守，数据-驱动模型则易受近似误差影响。
AI.method: 提出学习扫描体积的有符号距离函数作为概率场，以量化认知不确定性、吸纳感知噪声，并将其整合到机会约束轨迹优化框架中。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实硬件的高维操纵问题中，成功验证了该方法能够有效处理显著的传感器噪声并实现实时机会约束轨迹优化。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功实现了实时机会约束轨迹优化，并在高维机械臂操作任务中验证了其在模拟和真实硬件上的有效性。
AI.translation: 无碰撞运动规划需要来自感知环境的可靠碰撞模型以及对连续轨迹上状态的验证。为了使这一问题易于处理，大多数规划器在连续轨迹的离散状态上针对环境的单一确定化模型进行碰撞检查，这在安全性和计算效率之间引入了权衡。虽然存在近似机器人扫描体积的连续碰撞检查方法，但它们计算成本高昂或过于保守。数据驱动的方法可以学习扫描体积；然而，这些神经模型容易受到近似误差的影响，因此往往仅限于作为下游碰撞检查器的粗略过滤器。在这项工作中，我们建议将扫描体积的有符号距离函数学习为概率场，从而能够量化认知不确定性、纳入感知噪声，并最终整合到机会约束轨迹优化框架中。我们在具有显著传感器噪声的挑战性高维操作问题上，在模拟和真实硬件中展示了我们的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于实时机会约束轨迹优化的随机神经符号扫描体积方法，通过将扫描体积的有符号距离函数学习为概率场，能够量化认知不确定性并结合感知噪声，从而在复杂高维操作任务中实现高效安全的无碰撞运动规划。
AI.keywords: 扫描体积, 机会约束轨迹优化, 神经符号距离函数, 认知不确定性, 碰撞避免
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将概率场与神经符号扫描体积（signed swept volume）结合，解决了机器人连续轨迹优化中的安全与计算效率之间的权衡问题，特别是在处理感知噪声和认知不确定性方面表现出色。限制在于依赖数据驱动模型，可能仍存在一定的泛化误差。

title: Visual Navigation Transformer with Pose Attention
summary: Learned navigation policies typically consume observations as a temporally ordered history, with positional encodings tying each observation to when it was seen, making it difficult to reuse experience from earlier traversals of an environment. Systems that do reuse such experience usually construct an explicit representation, such as a map or a topological graph, and plan on it. We propose VNT-PA (Visual Navigation Transformer with Pose Attention), a transformer planner whose context is a set of depth keyframes indexed by camera pose. With camera poses as positional encoding, attention depends on the pose differences between keyframes rather than on their temporal order. VNT-PA is trained to imitate a shortest-path planner operating on the ground-truth scene mesh, predicting actions by querying the spatial context with only its current pose and the goal position. On point-goal navigation in HM3D validation scenes, VNT-PA reaches 93.3% success and 90.4% success weighted by path length (SPL), outperforming baselines that encode the same context as a temporal sequence or treat pose as an input feature, in both navigation performance and training efficiency. Because the spatial context is a pose-indexed set, frames from different trajectories can be fused at test time. The planner also degrades more gracefully under localization noise than a conventional baseline which plans on explicit maps. These results show that pose-stamped experience can serve directly as the environment representation for a learned planner, and that making attention depend on pose differences, rather than on temporal order, speeds up training and improves long-horizon navigation.

AI.title_translation: 结合位姿注意力的视觉导航Transformer
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为VNT-PA的视觉导航Transformer，它利用相机位姿代替时间顺序作为位置编码，从而能够高效地融合多轨迹空间经验并显著提升长视野导航性能。
AI.motivation: 传统学习型导航策略通常将观察视作按时间顺序排列的历史并采用时间位置编码，导致难以复用早期遍历环境的经验；而依赖显式地图或拓扑图的方法则构建复杂。为此，需要一种能够直接利用空间上下文进行高效导航的学习型规划器。
AI.method: 提出VNT-PA（Visual Navigation Transformer with Pose Attention），一个以相机位姿索引的深度关键帧集合为上下文的Transformer规划器，使用相机位姿作为位置编码，使注意力取决于关键帧之间的位姿差异而非时间顺序，并通过模仿地面真值场景网格上的最短路径规划器进行训练。
AI.result: 在HM3D验证集的点目标导航任务中，VNT-PA取得了93.3%的成功率和90.4%的SPL（路径长度加权成功率），在导航性能和训练效率上均优于将相同上下文编码为时间序列或将位姿作为输入特征的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 以位姿作为位置编码的Visual Navigation Transformer (VNT-PA) 能够有效利用空间上下文进行视觉导航，其性能和训练效率均优于传统基线，且对定位噪声具有更强的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 学习得来的导航策略通常将观测数据视为按时间顺序排列的历史，并通过位置编码将每个观测数据与其被看到的时间绑定，这使得重复使用先前遍历环境的经验变得困难。重复使用此类经验的系统通常会构建显式表示（如地图或拓扑图）并在此基础上进行规划。我们提出了VNT-PA（Visual Navigation Transformer with Pose Attention），这是一个Transformer规划器，其上下文是由相机位姿索引的一组深度关键帧。以相机位姿作为位置编码，注意力取决于关键帧之间的位姿差异，而不是它们的临时顺序。VNT-PA被训练来模仿在地面真实场景网格上运行的最短路径规划器，仅通过其当前位姿和目标位置查询空间上下文来预测动作。在HM3D验证场景的点目标导航中，VNT-PA达到了93.3%的成功率和90.4%的按路径长度加权成功率（SPL），在导航性能和训练效率上均优于将相同上下文编码为时间序列或将位姿视为输入特征的基线。由于空间上下文是位姿索引集，因此可以在测试时融合来自不同轨迹的帧。在定位噪声下，该规划器也比在显式地图上规划的传统基线表现出更优雅的性能退化。这些结果表明，带位姿标记的经验可以直接用作学习规划器的环境表示，并且使注意力依赖于位姿差异而不是时间顺序，可以加速训练并改善长视野导航。
AI.summary: 本文提出了VNT-PA，一种基于位姿注意力的视觉导航Transformer。该模型通过将相机位姿作为位置编码来索引深度关键帧，使注意力依赖于位姿差而非时间顺序，从而实现了高效的跨轨迹经验复用、出色的点目标导航性能以及对定位噪声的良好鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: Visual Navigation, Transformer, Pose Attention, Spatial Context, Point-Goal Navigation
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出用相机位姿作为视觉Transformer的位置编码，打破了传统按时间顺序处理观察的历史局限，使得跨轨迹的经验复用和空间上下文融合成为可能，对具身智能和视觉导航领域具有重要意义。

title: Ability-Residual Decoupled Modeling for Affective Cognitive Diagnosis
summary: Cognitive diagnosis infers students' concept mastery from response logs. However, students' responses are not determined by mastery alone: non-cognitive factors such as emotion, engagement, and fatigue can also affect performance. Affective cognitive diagnosis therefore extends conventional cognitive diagnosis by incorporating affective states. Existing methods often assume that the cognitive diagnosis backbone has already explained ability, item, and concept effects, so the remaining errors can be attributed mainly to affect. We argue that this assumption can be insufficient in real educational data: item calibration bias, systematic concept bias, personalized student-concept deviations, and latent student-item matching can form stable cognitive residuals. Without an explicit modeling pathway, these residuals may leak into affective representations, producing affect contamination. To address this problem, we propose an ability-residual decoupled framework for affective cognitive diagnosis. The model first captures unmodeled cognitive residuals through student, item, concept, student-concept, and low-rank student-item components, and then uses an affective module to modulate guess/slip effects. A Q-matrix-constrained concept residual attention mechanism adaptively aggregates only item-relevant concept residuals. Experiments on ASSIST2017, ASSIST2012, ASSIST2009, and Junyi with six cognitive diagnosis backbones show response-prediction gains across the reported comparisons and generally improved affect alignment when affect labels are available. Ablation studies, leakage probes, principal component analysis visualization, long-tail analysis, and case studies further indicate that ability residuals absorb stable cognitive bias, reduce cognitive contamination in the affective branch, and enhance the robustness and predictive accuracy of cognitive diagnosis models.

AI.title_translation: 面向情感认知诊断的能力-残差解耦建模
AI.tldr: 提出了一种能力-残差解耦的情感认知诊断框架，有效解决了未建模认知偏差导致的情感污染问题，提升了预测准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的情感认知诊断方法假设认知诊断骨干网络已经完全解释了能力、题目和概念效应，残余误差可归因于情感。然而在真实教育数据中，这种假设往往不足，项目校准偏差、系统概念偏差等会形成稳定的认知残差，若缺乏显式建模路径，这些残差会泄漏进情感表示中并导致情感污染。
AI.method: 提出了一种能力-残差解耦框架。首先通过学生、题目、概念、学生-概念以及低秩学生-项目组件捕获未建模的认知残差，接着利用情感模块调节猜测/失误效应，并引入Q矩阵约束的概念残差注意力机制自适应聚合题目相关的概念残差。
AI.result: 在ASSIST2017、ASSIST2012、ASSIST2009和Junyi数据集上的实验表明，该方法在响应预测上取得了增益，并在有情感标签时普遍改善了情感对齐。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的能力-残差解耦框架能有效吸收稳定认知偏差，减少情感分支中的认知污染，并在多个数据集上验证了其优越的预测准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 认知诊断从响应日志中推断学生的知识概念掌握情况。然而，学生的响应并非仅由掌握程度决定：情绪、参与度和疲劳等非认知因素也会影响表现。因此，情感认知诊断通过纳入情感状态扩展了传统认知诊断。现有方法通常假设认知诊断骨干网络已经解释了能力、题目和概念效应，因此剩余误差主要可归因于情感。我们认为，这一假设在真实的教育数据中可能并不充分：项目校准偏差、系统概念偏差、个性化学生-概念偏差以及潜在的学生-题目匹配可能会形成稳定的认知残差。如果没有显式的建模路径，这些残差可能会泄漏到情感表示中，产生情感污染。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种用于情感认知诊断的能力-残差解耦框架。该模型首先通过学生、题目、概念、学生-概念和低秩学生-题目组件捕获未建模的认知残差，然后使用情感模块来调节猜测/失误效应。Q矩阵约束的概念残差注意力机制自适应地仅聚合与题目相关的概念残差。在ASSIST2017、ASSIST2012、ASSIST2009和Junyi数据集上结合六种认知诊断骨干网络的实验表明，在报告的比较中获得了响应预测增益，并且在有情感标签时普遍改善了情感对齐。消融实验、泄漏探针、主成分分析可视化、长尾分析和案例研究进一步表明，能力残差吸收了稳定的认知偏差，减少了情感分支中的认知污染，并增强了认知诊断模型的鲁棒性和预测准确性。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种能力-残差解耦的情感认知诊断框架，旨在解决现有方法中未建模的认知偏差泄漏至情感表示而导致的情感污染问题。通过显式捕获多种认知残差并结合情感模块，该方法有效提升了认知诊断模型的鲁棒性和预测准确性。
AI.keywords: 认知诊断, 情感建模, 能力-残差解耦, 教育数据挖掘, Q矩阵约束
AI.comments: 该论文针对情感认知诊断中的关键问题——未建模的认知偏差泄漏到情感表示中导致情感污染，提出了一种能力-残差解耦建模框架。创新点在于通过多维度的残差组件（学生、题目、概念、学生-概念、低秩学生-项目）显式捕获稳定的认知残差，从而提高了认知诊断模型的鲁棒性和预测准确性。

title: Fewer Steps, Better Actions: Rethinking Flow-Matching Inference for VLA Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies based on flow matching generate action chunks through repeated evaluations of an action expert. Increasing the number of integration steps raises inference cost, but does not necessarily improve closed-loop success. We propose Coda, which reallocates part of this integration budget to a single learned endpoint correction. A frozen policy first completes a few-step noise-to-action trajectory; a lightweight Transformer then predicts a demonstration-supervised residual using the candidate action, source noise, and shared observation-prefix cache. Only the corrector is trained. On 50 RoboTwin Easy tasks, five-step Coda improves success from 71.64% to 74.68% over the matched five-step baseline, while reducing forward latency by 30.2% relative to the default ten-step policy. A two-step configuration achieves 71.88% success with a 2.12$\times$ speedup. An independent 13-task control shows a 5.69-percentage-point gain at nearly equal latency, supporting correction as an effective alternative to additional integration. The same design also improves frozen official SmolVLA, raising two-step success from 60.8% to 69.4%. These results show that endpoint correction improves the quality-latency trade-off of frozen flow-matching policies.

AI.title_translation: 更少的步数，更好的动作：重新思考VLA策略的流匹配推理
AI.tldr: 通过引入轻量级的终点校正机制，Coda 改善了基于流匹配的机器人 VLA 策略的质量与延迟权衡，实现更少步数下更高的成功率。
AI.motivation: 基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过重复评估动作专家来生成动作块，但增加积分步数会增加推理成本，且不一定能提高闭环成功率。为此，论文旨在重新思考并优化VLA策略的流匹配推理，改善质量与延迟的权衡。
AI.method: 提出Coda方法，将部分积分预算重新分配给单次学习的终点校正。冻结的策略完成几步噪声到动作的轨迹后，由一个轻量级的 Transformer 利用候选动作、源噪声和共享的观察前缀缓存来预测一个监督残差，且仅训练该校正器。
AI.result: 在50个RoboTwin Easy任务上，5步的Coda将成功率从71.64%提高到74.68%，同时将前向延迟降低了30.2%（相比默认10步策略）；2步配置实现了71.88%的成功率和2.12倍的加速；在SmolVLA上也将2步成功率从60.8%提升至69.4%。
AI.conclusion: 终点校正是一种有效且高效的替代方案，能够取代传统流匹配策略中增加积分步数的方法，显著提升冻结VLA策略的质量与延迟权衡。
AI.translation: 基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过重复评估动作专家来生成动作块。增加积分步数会增加推理成本，但不一定能提高闭环成功率。我们提出了 Coda，它将这一积分预算的一部分重新分配给单次学习的终点校正。一个冻结的策略首先完成几步噪声到动作的轨迹；随后，一个轻量级的 Transformer 利用候选动作、源噪声和共享的观察前缀缓存来预测一个由示范监督的残差。仅对校正器进行训练。在 50 个 RoboTwin Easy 任务上，5 步的 Coda 将成功率从 71.64% 提高到 74.68%，同时相比默认的 10 步策略将前向延迟降低了 30.2%。2 步配置实现了 71.88% 的成功率和 2.12 倍的加速。一项独立的 13 任务控制实验显示，在几乎相同的延迟下成功率提升了 5.69 个百分点，证明了校正作为增加积分的有效替代方案。该设计还改善了冻结的官方 SmolVLA，将 2 步成功率从 60.8% 提高到 69.4%。这些结果表明，终点校正改善了冻结流匹配策略的质量-延迟权衡。
AI.summary: 论文提出了Coda，一种用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的流匹配推理方法。通过将部分积分预算分配给单次学习的终点校正，Coda仅需训练一个轻量级残差预测器，即可在显著降低推理延迟的同时提高闭环成功率。
AI.keywords: Vision-Language-Action, Flow Matching, Endpoint Correction, Robotics, Inference Optimization
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将终点校正机制引入基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中，通过训练一个轻量级 Transformer 残差预测器，在保持或减少推理步数的同时显著提升了闭环成功率，有效改善了生成质量与推理延迟的权衡。

title: X-SPUR: Explainable Surprisal-Based Protocol-Aware Unsupervised Reasoning for Automotive Ethernet Intrusion Detection
comments: 12 pages, 4 figures. This article has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics. This is the author's accepted manuscript
summary: Automotive Ethernet carries heterogeneous multi-protocol traffic in modern in-vehicle networks, where labeled attack data are rarely available and the strongest prior unsupervised detector still relies on handcrafted traffic features. This article presents X-SPUR, an explainable, surprisal-based, protocol-aware unsupervised reasoning framework that instead represents raw packet fields as token sequences, learns benign traffic patterns through causal language modeling, and detects anomalies from per-token cross-entropy surprisal. To incorporate temporal context, we introduce a bimodal fusion architecture that combines payload-token embeddings with inter-packet timing through additive fusion and a Hadamard interaction. To handle the heterogeneous score distributions of different protocol families, we further propose a dual top-$k$% per-protocol $Z$-score calibration that jointly captures moderately distributed and sparse anomaly signatures. On the TOW-IDS dataset, X-SPUR achieves an AUC of 0.9987. This is marginally higher than the 0.9969 reported for AERO. X-SPUR also eliminates handcrafted feature engineering. We train a separate CarDS model using the same architecture and training hyperparameters. This model retains strong performance on the second automotive Ethernet dataset. Beyond detection, per-token surprisal provides fine-grained explainability by attributing anomaly scores to specific protocol fields, supporting interpretable security analysis in heterogeneous in-vehicle networks.
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. This article has been accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics. This is the author's accepted manuscript

AI.title_translation: X-SPUR：面向汽车以太网入侵检测的可解释的、基于惊奇度的、协议感知无监督推理
AI.tldr: X-SPUR是一种无需人工特征、基于因果语言模型和惊奇度的车载以太网无监督异常检测与解释框架。
AI.motivation: 现代车载以太网承载异构的多协议流量，且缺乏带标签的攻击数据，现有的无监督检测器仍依赖于手工制作的流量特征，因此需要一种更智能、可解释且无需人工特征工程的无监督推理框架。
AI.method: 将原始数据包字段表示为标记序列，利用因果语言模型学习良性流量模式，基于每标记的交叉熵惊奇度检测异常；引入双模态融合架构结合载荷标记嵌入与包间时间；提出双top-k% per-protocol Z分数校准以处理异构得分分布。
AI.result: 在TOW-IDS数据集上取得了0.9987的AUC，略高于AERO的0.9969，且无需手工特征工程；在CarDS数据集上也保持了出色的性能，同时能够通过每标记惊奇度将异常分数归因于特定的协议字段，提供细粒度的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: X-SPUR是一个高效、可解释且无需人工特征工程的车载以太网无监督入侵检测框架，在多个数据集上表现优异，具有很高的实际应用价值。
AI.translation: 车载以太网在现代车载网络中承载着异构的多协议流量，其中很少有带标签的攻击数据，且最强大的先验无监督检测器仍然依赖于手工制作的流量特征。本文提出了X-SPUR，一个可解释的、基于惊奇度的、协议感知的无监督推理框架，它将原始数据包字段表示为标记序列，通过因果语言模型学习良性流量模式，并根据每标记的交叉熵惊奇度检测异常。为了纳入时间上下文，我们引入了一种双模态融合架构，通过加法融合和哈达玛交互将有效载荷标记嵌入与包间时间结合起来。为了处理不同协议族的异构分数分布，我们进一步提出了双top-k% per-protocol Z分数校准，以共同捕获中等分布和稀疏的异常特征。在TOW-IDS数据集上，X-SPUR实现了0.9987的AUC，略高于AERO报告的0.9969。X-SPUR还消除了手工特征工程。我们使用相同的架构和训练超参数训练了一个单独的CarDS模型，该模型在第二个车载以太网数据集上保持了强大的性能。除了检测之外，每标记惊奇度还通过将异常分数归因于特定的协议字段提供了细粒度的可解释性，支持异构车载网络中可解释的安全分析。
AI.summary: X-SPUR是一个用于车载以太网入侵检测的可解释、基于惊奇度且具有协议意识的无监督推理框架。它将数据包字段视为标记序列，通过因果语言模型学习良性模式并通过惊奇度检测异常，结合双模态时间融合与协议自适应校准，在消除了人工特征工程的同时实现了高精度和细粒度的可解释性。
AI.keywords: 汽车以太网, 入侵检测, 因果语言模型, 无监督学习, 可解释性AI
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个基于因果语言模型和信息论惊奇度的无监督车载以太网入侵检测框架X-SPUR。其创新之处在于消除了对手工特征工程的依赖，能处理多协议异构流量，并通过双模态融合和双top-k Z分数校准提升了检测精度，同时提供了细粒度的可解释性。

title: License Compliance in Open Source Cybersecurity Projects
summary: Developers of cybersecurity software often include and rely upon open source software packages in their commercial software products. Before open source code is absorbed into a proprietary product, developers must check the package license to see if the project is permissively licensed, thereby allowing for commercial-friendly inheritance and redistribution. However, there is a risk that the open source package license could be inaccurate due to being silently contaminated with restrictively licensed open source code that may prohibit the sale or confidentiality of commercial derivative work. Contamination of commercial products could lead to expensive remediation costs, damage to the company's reputation, and costly legal fees. In this article, we report on our preliminary analysis of more than 200 open source cybersecurity projects to identify the most frequently used license types and languages and to look for evidence of permissively licensed open source projects that are likely contaminated by restrictive licensed material (i.e., containing commercial-unfriendly code). Our analysis identified restrictive license contamination cases occurring in permissively licensed open source projects. Furthermore, we found a high proportion of code that lacked copyright attribution. We expect that the results of this study will: i) provide managers and developers with an understanding of how contamination can occur, ii) provide open source communities with an understanding on how they can better protect their intellectual property by including licenses and copyright information in their code, and iii) provide entrepreneurs with an understanding of the open source cybersecurity domain in terms of licensing and contamination and how they affect decisions about cybersecurity software architectures.

AI.title_translation: 开源网络安全项目中的许可证合规性
AI.tldr: 对200多个开源网络安全项目的研究发现，许多声称使用允许性许可证的项目实际上受到了限制性许可证代码的污染，且普遍缺乏版权归属信息。
AI.motivation: 网络安全软件开发者常使用开源软件包，但开源项目可能由于被引入限制性代码而导致许可证信息不准确，进而给商业化产品带来昂贵的修复成本、声誉损害和法律纠纷风险。
AI.method: 对200多个开源网络安全项目进行了初步分析，识别其最常用的许可证类型和编程语言，并检查允许性许可证项目中是否存在限制性许可证材料的污染证据。
AI.result: 研究发现在原本应为允许性许可的开源项目中存在限制性许可证污染的情况，并且有很大一部分代码缺乏版权归属信息。
AI.conclusion: 开源网络安全项目中存在许可证污染及版权归属缺失的隐患，可能对依赖这些项目的商业软件产生严重法律和经济风险。
AI.translation: 网络安全软件的开发者经常在商业软件产品中包含并依赖开源软件包。在将开源代码吸收进专有产品之前，开发者必须检查软件包许可证，以查看该项目是否获得允许性许可，从而允许商业友好的继承和再分发。然而，开源软件包的许可证可能由于被限制性许可的开源代码“静默污染”而变得不准确，从而可能禁止商业衍生作品的销售或机密性。商业产品的污染可能导致昂贵的整改成本、公司声誉受损以及高昂的法律费用。在本文中，我们报告了对200多个开源网络安全项目的初步分析，以识别最常用的许可证类型和语言，并寻找被限制性许可材料（即包含对商业不友好的代码）污染的允许性许可开源项目的证据。我们的分析发现，允许性许可的开源项目中存在限制性许可证污染的情况。此外，我们发现很大一部分代码缺乏版权归属。我们期望本研究的结果将：i）帮助管理者和开发者理解污染是如何发生的，ii）帮助开源社区了解如何通过在代码中包含许可证和版权信息来更好地保护其知识产权，iii）在许可证和污染及其如何影响网络安全软件架构决策方面，为创业者提供对开源网络安全领域的理解。
AI.summary: 本文对200多个开源网络安全项目进行了初步分析，旨在识别常用的许可证类型并检测潜在的限制性许可证污染及版权缺失问题。研究结果发现多起污染案例及高比例的版权归属缺失，为开发者、开源社区和创业者提供了关于许可证风险的洞察。
AI.keywords: 开源软件, 许可证合规, 网络安全项目, 许可证污染, 版权归属
AI.comments: 本研究揭示了开源网络安全项目中广泛存在的许可证污染和版权缺失问题，对于商业软件开发和开源治理具有重要的警示和指导意义。

title: Multi-viewpoint Geo-localization with Event Cameras
summary: Robot localization is an ongoing challenge that demands mapping and positioning systems that are tolerant to viewpoint change. Event cameras are attracting increasing interest and adoption in robotics; however, dealing with viewpoint variance is an under-investigated problem in existing event-based localizers. In addition, event-based datasets that emphasize viewpoint variance for challenging localization situations are scarce. Here, we introduce an event-based visual place recognition (VPR) system that performs robustly under viewpoint changes. We converted five large-scale geo-tagged datasets, conventionally used to train frame-based localization systems, into synthetic event streams using Image-to-Event (I2E) conversion, and used them to fine-tune a pre-trained event-based vision transformer backbone with a multi-loss function, yielding a system we call MegaEvent that learns viewpoint-robust features for place recognition. We achieved an average Recall@1 of 82% across three existing event-based localization datasets, leading the next best event-based method by 20 recall points, and frame-based VPR models applied directly to event frames by 8 to 26 recall points. We introduce a new, challenging dataset - Springfield-Event-VPR - which features a 3.7km walking route recorded in three camera orientations for a total of 11.1km, which MegaEvent outperforms the strongest baseline by 9 recall points. The code for MegaEvent is available at https://github.com/AdamDHines/megaevent.

AI.title_translation: 基于事件相机的多视点地理定位
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为MegaEvent的事件相机视觉定位系统，通过将传统大规模数据集转换为合成事件流并微调视觉Transformer，显著提升了系统应对视点变化的能力，性能远超现有基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人定位需要对视点变化具有鲁棒性的系统。虽然事件相机在机器人中越来越受到关注，但处理视点变化在现有的事件定位器中研究尚不充分，且强调视点变化的事件数据集也十分匮乏。
AI.method: 利用图像到事件（I2E）转换将五个大规模地理标记数据集转换为合成事件流，并使用多损失函数微调预训练的基于事件的视觉Transformer主干网络，开发了名为MegaEvent的系统，同时引入了一个包含多相机方向的新挑战性数据集Springfield-Event-VPR。
AI.result: 在三个现有的事件定位数据集上实现了82%的平均Recall@1，比次优的事件方法高出20个召回点，比直接应用于事件帧的基于帧的VPR模型高出8到26个召回点；在新的Springfield-Event-VPR数据集上，比最强的基线方法高出9个召回点。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的MegaEvent系统通过利用转换后的传统大规模数据集进行微调，显著提升了事件相机在面对视点变化时的视觉位置识别能力，并在多个公开及新提出的数据集上大幅超越了现有方法。
AI.translation: 机器人定位是一个持续面临的挑战，需要能够容忍视点变化的建图和定位系统。事件相机在机器人领域的应用日益受到关注；然而，在现有的基于事件的定位器中，处理视点变化是一个研究不足的问题。此外，强调视点变化的具有挑战性定位情况的基于事件的数据集也很稀缺。在此，我们引入了一种在视点变化下仍能稳健运行的基于事件的视觉位置识别（VPR）系统。我们将五个传统上用于训练基于帧的定位系统的大规模地理标记数据集通过图像到事件（I2E）转换转换为合成事件流，并使用多损失函数微调预训练的基于事件的视觉Transformer骨干网络，从而产生了一个名为MegaEvent的系统，该系统学习用于位置识别的具有视点鲁棒性的特征。我们在三个现有的基于事件的定位数据集上取得了82%的平均Recall@1，比第二好的基于事件的方法高出20个召回点，比直接应用于事件帧的基于帧的VPR模型高出8到26个召回点。我们引入了一个新的、具有挑战性的数据集——Springfield-Event-VPR，其特征是以三种相机方向记录的3.7公里步行路线，总计11.1公里，在该数据集上，MegaEvent比最强的基线高出9个召回点。MegaEvent的代码可在 https://github.com/AdamDHines/megaevent 获取。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为MegaEvent的事件视觉位置识别系统，能够有效应对视点变化。通过将传统的大规模地理标记数据集转化为合成事件流来微调事件视觉Transformer，该系统在多个事件定位数据集及新引入的挑战性数据集上表现出卓越的准确性和鲁棒性，大幅超越了现有方法。
AI.keywords: 事件相机, 视觉位置识别, 多视点地理定位, 视觉Transformer, 机器人定位
AI.comments: 该论文首次系统性地研究了事件相机在多视点地理定位（VPR）中的应用，通过巧妙地利用I2E转换将传统的大规模地理标记数据集转化为合成事件流，训练出了一个具备强大视点鲁棒性的MegaEvent系统，并在多个基准测试及新提出的Springfield-Event-VPR数据集上取得了显著的性能提升。这为事件相机在极端视点变化场景下的机器人定位开辟了新途径。

title: Safe Real-Time Policy Steering via Noise-Space Trajectory Optimization for One-Step Generative Policies
summary: Generative robot policies can represent diverse, multimodal behaviors, but adapting pretrained policies to deployment-time constraints such as collision avoidance and orientation maintenance remains challenging. Existing inference-time steering methods typically apply gradient guidance through iterative diffusion or flow processes, which can be computationally expensive for real-time control. We propose INSPO, which formulates inference-time steering of one-step generative policies as trajectory optimization in the policy's input noise space. By optimizing the input noise while evaluating constraints on the induced state trajectory, INSPO searches the policy-induced behavior space without directly modifying generated actions. The optimization includes a regularization term that encourages solutions to remain consistent with the policy's input distribution and is solved online using population-based particle optimization. We evaluate INSPO on state- and image-based task-specific policies and generalist vision-language-action policies across Push-T, Can pick-and-place, and LIBERO-Spatial. INSPO improves task success and constraint satisfaction over best-of-N sampling and action projection, while comparing favorably with gradient-guided generation at lower runtime.

AI.title_translation: 通过噪声空间轨迹优化实现一步生成式策略的安全实时策略引导
AI.tldr: 提出了一种在噪声空间进行轨迹优化的方法（INSPO），实现了单步生成式策略的高效、实时安全引导。
AI.motivation: 现有的推理时引导方法通常通过迭代扩散或流过程应用梯度引导，对于实时控制来说计算成本过高；而将预训练的生成式策略适应部署时的约束（如避障和方向保持）仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出INSPO方法，将单步生成式策略的推理时引导表述为策略输入噪声空间的轨迹优化；采用包含与策略输入分布保持一致的正则化项，并利用基于群体的粒子优化在线求解。
AI.result: 在Push-T、Can抓取放置和LIBERO-Spatial等多项任务中，INSPO在任务成功率和约束满足度上均优于Best-of-N采样和动作投影，且在较低的运行时间内表现出与梯度引导生成相媲美的性能。
AI.conclusion: INSPO通过在输入噪声空间进行轨迹优化，有效实现了单步生成式策略的实时安全引导，在提升任务成功率和约束满足度的同时保持了较低的计算成本。
AI.translation: 生成式机器人策略可以表示多样化的多模态行为，但将预训练策略适应部署时的约束（如避障和方向保持）仍然具有挑战性。现有的推理时引导方法通常通过迭代扩散或流过程应用梯度引导，这对于实时控制来说计算成本很高。我们提出了INSPO，它将一步生成式策略的推理时引导表述为策略输入噪声空间中的轨迹优化。通过在评估诱导状态轨迹约束的同时优化输入噪声，INSPO在不直接修改生成动作的情况下搜索策略诱导的行为空间。优化过程包括一个正则化项，该正则化项鼓励解保持与策略输入分布的一致性，并通过基于群体的粒子优化在线求解。我们在Push-T、Can抓取放置以及LIBERO-Spatial上的基于状态和图像的任务特定策略以及通用视觉-语言-动作策略上评估了INSPO。与Best-of-N采样和动作投影相比，INSPO提高了任务成功率和约束满足度，同时在较低的运行时间下与梯度引导生成相比具有优势。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了INSPO，一种用于单步生成式策略的安全实时策略引导方法。通过在输入噪声空间而非直接修改动作进行轨迹优化，并结合基于群体的粒子优化，INSPO能够在满足安全约束的同时实现高效的实时控制。
AI.keywords: 生成式策略, 轨迹优化, 噪声空间, 实时控制, 安全引导
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将一步生成式策略的推理时引导转化为输入噪声空间的轨迹优化，不仅规避了迭代扩散过程中巨大的计算开销，还通过粒子优化方法实现了高效的实时安全约束控制。

title: A Fully Differentiable Neuro-Soft-Symbolic Framework for Perceptual Task Planning
summary: Perceptual planning tasks require two key capabilities: accurately perceiving uncertain scenes and planning valid action sequences following logical rules. Conventional methods convert perception into discrete symbolic facts and then plan, discarding perceptual uncertainty and severing task-level feedback to perception. We introduce a generic, fully differentiable neuro-soft-symbolic framework that connects visual perception and task planning within a single computational graph. The framework maintains a continuous soft symbolic state, lifts domain rules into a differentiable soft-$T_P$ transition operator, and optimizes action logits over a short planning horizon. Gradients from the planning objective can also update the perception parameters, allowing task-relevant perceptual representations to be refined during planning. On Blocksworld, our method solves 40/40 LatPlan-40 tasks and 596/600 PlanBench-600 tasks, compared with 33/40 for LatPlan and 587/600 for the reasoning-model baseline, while requiring substantially less computation and time. In the perceptual-uncertainty ablation, our method improves the success rate from 59\% with frozen perception to 83\%. We further conduct task-and-motion simulations on Blocksworld scenes, providing an execution-level validation of the compatibility between decoded task plans and downstream robotic motion execution.

AI.title_translation: 一个用于感知任务规划的全可微分神经软符号框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将感知与规划无缝结合的全可微分神经软符号框架，能够通过任务规划的反向梯度优化感知参数，显著提升复杂和不确定场景下的任务规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 传统的感知规划方法将感知转化为离散的符号事实后再进行规划，这会丢弃感知的不确定性，并且切断了任务层面对感知的反馈。为了解决这一痛点，需要一种能够将视觉感知与任务规划在单个计算图中紧密结合的方法。
AI.method: 引入了一个通用的全可微分神经软符号框架，将视觉感知和任务规划连接在单个计算graph中；维护连续的软符号状态，将领域规则提升为可微分的软 $T_P$ 转移算子，并在短规划范围内优化动作logits，允许规划目标的梯度更新感知参数。
AI.result: 在Blocksworld上，该方法成功解决了40/40个LatPlan-40任务和596/600个PlanBench-600任务，优于对比方法且计算量和时间显著减少；在感知不确定性消融实验中，成功率从冻结感知的59%提升至83%。
AI.conclusion: 本论文提出了一种全新的全可微分神经软符号框架，成功打通了感知与规划的壁垒，显著提升了在感知不确定性场景下的规划成功率与效率。
AI.translation: 感知规划任务需要两项关键能力：准确感知不确定场景以及遵循逻辑规则规划出有效的动作序列。传统方法将感知转换为离散的符号事实然后进行规划，这丢弃了感知的不确定性，并切断了任务级对感知的反馈。我们引入了一个通用的、完全可微分的神经软符号框架，它在单个计算图中连接了视觉感知和任务规划。该框架维护一个连续的软符号状态，将领域规则提升为可微分的软 $T_P$ 转移算子，并在短规划视界上优化动作logits。来自规划目标的梯度还可以更新感知参数，从而允许在规划过程中精细调整与任务相关的感知表示。在Blocksworld上，我们的方法解决了40/40个LatPlan-40任务和596/600个PlanBench-600任务，而LatPlan为33/40，推理模型基线为587/600，同时所需计算和时间显著减少。在感知不确定性消融实验中，我们的方法将冻结感知的成功率从59%提高到83%。我们进一步在Blocksworld场景上进行了任务与动作仿真，为解码后的任务规划与下游机器人动作执行之间的兼容性提供了执行级别的验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种全可微分的神经软符号框架，通过在单个计算图中结合视觉感知与任务规划，利用软符号状态和可微分转移算子，不仅实现了规划对感知参数的反向优化，还在多个基准测试中展现出卓越的求解成功率和高效率。
AI.keywords: 神经软符号框架, 感知任务规划, 可微分计算, 逻辑规则, 视觉感知
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将视觉感知与任务规划融合在同一个可微分计算图中，有效解决了传统方法中感知不确定性丢失以及感知与规划割裂的问题。通过软符号状态和可微分的转移算子，实现了规划目标对感知参数的反向更新，展现出极高的求解成功率与计算效率。

title: Combining Exploratory Analysis and Automated Analysis for Anomaly Detection in Real-Time Data Streams
summary: Security analysts can become overwhelmed with monitoring real-time security information that is important to help them defend their network. They also tend to focus on a limited portion of the alerts, and therefore risk missing important events and links between them. At the heart of the problem is the system that analysts use to detect, explore, and respond to cyber-attacks. Developers of security analysis systems face the challenge of developing a system that can present different sources of information at multiple levels of abstraction, while also creating a system that is intuitive to use. In this article, we examine the complementary nature of exploratory analysis and automated analysis by testing the development of a system that monitors real-time Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) traffic for anomalies that might indicate security threats. BGP is an essential component for supporting the infrastructure of the Internet; however, it is also highly vulnerable and can be hijacked by attackers to propagate spam or launch denial-of-service attacks. Some of the attack scenarios on the BGP infrastructure can be quite elaborate, and it is difficult, if not impossible, to fully automate the detection of such attacks. This article makes two contributions: i) it describes a prototype platform for computing indicators and threat alerts in real time and for visualizing the context of an alert, and ii) it discusses the interaction of exploratory analysis (visualization) and automated analysis. This article is relevant to students, security researchers, and developers who are interested in the development or use of real-time security monitoring systems. They will gain insights into the complementary aspects of automated analysis and exploratory analysis through the development of a real-time streaming system.

AI.title_translation: 结合探索性分析与自动化分析用于实时数据流中的异常检测
AI.tldr: 本文结合了可视化（探索性分析）与自动化分析，开发了一个实时监控BGP流量异常的原型平台，以解决安全分析师面对海量数据时的信息过载与漏报问题。
AI.motivation: 安全分析师在监控实时安全信息时容易信息过载且往往只关注有限的警报，从而面临遗漏重要事件的风险。由于复杂的网络攻击很难完全自动化检测，开发能够平衡多抽象级别信息展示与直观操作的安全系统面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 开发了一个原型平台，用于实时计算指标和威胁警报，并可视化警报上下文，以此测试和讨论探索性分析（可视化）与自动化分析的交互。
AI.result: 提出了一个能够实时计算威胁警报并可视化警报上下文的原型平台，并深入探讨了探索性分析与自动化分析在实时流系统开发中的互补交互机制。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过开发和测试实时BGP流量监控系统，展示了探索性分析与自动化分析相结合在应对复杂网络安全威胁方面的有效性与互补性。
AI.translation: 安全 analysts（分析师）在监控对防御网络至关重要的实时安全信息时，常常会感到应接不暇。他们也倾向于关注有限的一部分警报，因此面临遗漏重要事件及其间联系的风险。问题的核心在于分析师用来检测、探索和响应网络攻击的系统。安全分析系统开发者面临的挑战是：开发一个能够以多个抽象级别呈现不同信息源，同时又具备直观易用性的系统。在本文中，我们通过测试一个用于监控实时边界网关协议（BGP）流量中可能指示安全威胁的异常系统的开发，研究了探索性分析与自动化分析的互补性质。BGP是支持因特网基础设施的重要组成部分；然而，它也高度脆弱，可能被攻击者劫持以传播垃圾邮件或发起拒绝服务攻击。BGP基础设施上的某些攻击场景可能非常复杂，完全自动化检测此类攻击是困难的，甚至是不可能的。本文作出了两项贡献：i）描述了一个用于实时计算指标和威胁警报并可视化警报上下文的原型平台，ii）讨论了探索性分析（可视化）与自动化分析的交互。本文对有兴趣开发或使用实时安全监控系统的学生、安全研究人员和开发者具有相关性。通过开发实时流系统，他们将深入了解自动化分析与探索性分析的互补方面。
AI.summary: 本文针对实时安全监控中安全分析师容易信息过载的问题，探讨了探索性分析与自动化分析的互补性。通过开发一个监控实时BGP流量异常的原型平台，论文展示了如何结合实时指标计算、警报可视化以及自动化分析来提升复杂网络攻击的检测能力。
AI.keywords: 异常检测, 实时数据流, 探索性分析, 自动化分析, 边界网关协议 (BGP)
AI.comments: 该论文结合了探索性分析（可视化）与自动化分析，用于实时BGP流量的异常检测，有效解决了安全分析师在海量警报前面临的信息过载和认知局限问题，对实时安全监控系统开发具有重要参考价值。

title: SafeStage: Evaluating Safety Before, During, and After Vision-Language-Conditioned Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-conditioned robot policies integrate perception, language understanding, and control for general-purpose manipulation. However, existing evaluations often focus on task success, isolated physical constraints, semantic refusal, or realized physical damage, providing limited insight into where safety fails during closed-loop manipulation. We introduce SafeStage, a lifecycle-structured benchmark for evaluating manipulation safety before, during, and after task execution. SafeStage contains 97 purpose-built risk scenarios organized into three stages. Initial-State Hazards captures safety-relevant relations that must be resolved before manipulating the target. Execution-Time Safety evaluates unsafe contacts, trajectories, region entries, and object interactions during execution. Final-State Hazards capture unstable or otherwise unsafe conditions remaining after nominal task completion. The benchmark evaluates realized interactions using event-based and state-based checks and reports native task success independently from stage-specific safety outcomes. We evaluate representative direct-action Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies and policies with world-model-based policies under a common closed-loop protocol. Our results demonstrate that nominal task completion frequently coexists with safety violations and that different policies exhibit distinct failure profiles across the three stages. By separating task success from safety and localizing when violations occur, SafeStage provides a unified diagnostic testbed for evaluating and improving vision-language-conditioned robot manipulation policies.

AI.title_translation: SafeStage：在视觉语言条件机器人操作的前、中、后阶段评估安全性
AI.tldr: 提出 SafeStage 基准测试，用于在机器人操作的执行前、中、后三个阶段评估视觉语言策略的安全性，发现任务成功往往伴随着安全违规。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人策略评估通常只关注任务成功率、孤立的物理约束、语义拒绝或已造成的物理损害，无法全面深入地了解闭环操作过程中安全失效的具体环节。
AI.method: 引入了名为 SafeStage 的生命周期结构化基准测试，包含97个针对三个阶段（初始状态危害、执行期安全、最终状态危害）构建的风险场景，并采用基于事件和状态的检查来评估实际交互。
AI.result: 评估了代表性的直接动作视觉语言动作（VLA）策略和基于世界模型的策略，结果表明名义任务完成经常与安全违规并存，且不同策略在三个阶段表现出不同的失效特征。
AI.conclusion: SafeStage 提供了一个统一的诊断测试平台，证明了名义上的任务完成经常与安全违规并存，且不同策略在不同阶段展现出独特的失效特征。
AI.translation: 视觉语言条件机器人策略集成了感知、语言理解和控制，用于通用操纵。然而，现有的评估通常侧重于任务成功、孤立的物理约束、语义拒绝或实现的物理损坏，这为闭环操纵期间安全失败的位置提供了有限的见解。我们介绍了 SafeStage，这是一个生命周期结构化的基准测试，用于评估任务执行前、中、后的操纵安全性。SafeStage 包含 97 个专门构建的风险场景，分为三个阶段。“初始状态危害”捕获在操纵目标之前必须解决的安全相关关系。“执行期安全性”评估执行期间的不安全接触、轨迹、区域进入和对象交互。“最终状态危害”捕获在名义任务完成后仍然存在的、不稳定或其他不安全的条件。该基准测试使用基于事件和状态的检查来评估实现的交互，并独立于特定阶段的安全结果报告原生任务成功率。我们在一个共同的闭环协议下评估了代表性的直接动作视觉语言动作 (VLA) 策略和基于世界模型的策略。我们的结果表明，名义任务的完成经常与安全违规共存，并且不同的策略在三个阶段表现出不同的失效特征。通过将任务成功与安全性分离并定位违规发生的时间，SafeStage 为评估和改进视觉语言条件机器人操作策略提供了一个统一的诊断测试平台。
AI.summary: SafeStage 是一个生命周期结构化的基准测试，用于评估视觉语言条件下的机器人操作安全，分为执行前、执行中和执行后三个阶段，旨在分离任务成功与安全结果并精细化诊断故障。
AI.keywords: 机器人操作, 视觉语言策略, 安全评估, 基准测试, 全生命周期
AI.comments: SafeStage 填补了视觉语言机器人操作策略在全生命周期安全评估上的空白，通过将安全划分为执行前、中、后三个阶段，能够更精细地诊断故障并分离任务成功率与安全性。

title: VGGT-CAD: Reconstructing Parametric CAD 3D Model with Geometric Grounding
summary: Parametric CAD reconstruction requires recovering both precise geometry and editable modeling operations from visual observations, making it challenging under limited and ambiguous views. Existing methods mainly rely on 2D appearance cues and lack strong multi-view geometric priors. In this work, we present VGGT-CAD, a geometry-aware framework for parametric CAD reconstruction from single- and multi-view observations. We transfer pretrained 3D geometric priors into CAD reconstruction by encoding camera parameters as condition tokens and jointly modeling them with image tokens. To handle varying numbers of viewpoints, we introduce a variable-view cross-view context aggregation module that adaptively fuses multi-view features. We further develop a training-free geometry-aware view selection strategy to select complementary and reliable frames during inference. The resulting representation is decoded into CAD command sequences using a non-autoregressive decoder. We also develop VideoCAD, a large-scale multi-view video benchmark derived from existing CAD data through multi-view re-rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of VGGT-CAD for visual CAD reconstruction under different observation configurations.

AI.title_translation: VGGT-CAD：基于几何基准的参数化 CAD 3D 模型重建
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 VGGT-CAD 的几何感知框架，通过融合预训练的 3D 几何先验和多视角上下文，实现了单/多视角下高精度的参数化 CAD 模型重建。
AI.motivation: 现有的参数化 CAD 重建方法主要依赖 2D 外观线索，缺乏强大的多视角几何先验，在视角受限和模糊的情况下难以恢复精确的几何形状和可编辑的建模操作。
AI.method: 1. 将预训练的3D几何先验转移到CAD重建中，通过将相机参数编码为条件令牌并与图像令牌联合建模；2. 引入可变视角跨视角上下文聚合模块自适应融合多视角特征；3. 开发免训练的几何感知视角选择策略在推理时选择互补帧；4. 使用非自回归解码器将表示解码为CAD命令序列；5. 构建VideoCAD大型多视角视频基准。
AI.result: 广泛的实验证明了 VGGT-CAD 在不同观测配置下的视觉 CAD 重建中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VGGT-CAD 框架通过引入强大的 3D 几何先验和自适应的多视角融合策略，有效提升了单、多视角下参数化 CAD 模型重建的精度和鲁棒性，并在新构建的 VideoCAD 基准上验证了其优越性。
AI.translation: 参数化 CAD 重建需要从视觉观测中恢复精确的几何形状和可编辑的建模操作，这在有限且模糊的视角下极具挑战性。现有方法主要依赖 2D 外观线索，缺乏强有力的多视角几何先验。在本文中，我们提出了 VGGT-CAD，这是一个用于单视角和多视角观测参数化 CAD 重建的几何感知框架。我们通过将相机参数编码为条件令牌并将其与图像令牌联合建模，将预训练的 3D 几何先验迁移到 CAD 重建中。为了处理不同数量的视点，我们引入了一个可变视角跨视角上下文聚合模块，自适应地融合多视角特征。我们进一步开发了一种免训练的几何感知视角选择策略，以在推理过程中选择互补且可靠的帧。所得表示通过非自回归解码器解码为 CAD 命令序列。我们还开发了 VideoCAD，这是一个通过多视角重新渲染现有 CAD 数据而衍生的大规模多视角视频基准。大量实验证明了 VGGT-CAD 在不同观测配置下进行视觉 CAD 重建的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 VGGT-CAD，这是一个结合了几何先验的参数化 CAD 重建框架。通过引入预训练 3D 几何先验、可变视角跨视角上下文聚合模块以及免训练的几何感知视角选择策略，该方法能够在单视角和多视角观测下准确重建参数化 CAD 模型，并借助新构建的 VideoCAD 基准验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: Parametric CAD reconstruction, Geometric priors, Multi-view fusion, Non-autoregressive decoder
AI.comments: 该论文通过将预训练的3D几何先验引入参数化CAD重建中，并提出了一种新颖的可变视角跨视角上下文聚合模块和免训练的几何感知视角选择策略，有效地解决了单视角和多视角下CAD重建几何精度不足的问题，并构建了大型多视角视频基准VideoCAD，具有很高的实用价值和创新性。

title: AirSplan: Risk-Aware Motion Planning for Quadrotors in Cluttered 3D Gaussian Splats
comments: To appear in the proceedings of IROS 2026
summary: Quadrotors are increasingly deployed in applications such as agriculture, infrastructure inspection, and maintenance. In each of these applications, the robot must navigate complex scene geometry while remaining strictly collision-free. Unlike in ground domains, even minor collisions for aerial vehicles can result in the loss of the robot. This safety requirement induces a pair of technical challenges. First, the environment must be represented with sufficient fidelity to encode complex structure, even when no ground-truth obstacle data is available. Second, a motion planner must leverage this representation to determine a collision-free path to the goal. This paper proposes a system that addresses these complementary challenges. The proposed method, AirSplan, adopts a normalized variant of 3D Gaussian Splatting that encodes high-fidelity scene geometry. It then applies a novel reachability-based motion planner that leverages the differential flatness of quadrotors to compute continuous-time collision constraints that tightly overapproximate the robot's occupancy. Experiments demonstrate that AirSplan successfully finds a path in 81.2% of challenging test cases, a significant improvement over the nearest baseline method's 51.2%.
comment: To appear in the proceedings of IROS 2026

AI.title_translation: AirSplan：杂乱三维高斯散射环境中四旋翼的风险感知运动规划
AI.tldr: AirSplan是一个结合了3D高斯散射与可达性运动规划的新系统，能够显著提升四旋翼在复杂三维环境中的安全导航成功率。
AI.motivation: 为了解决四旋翼在复杂三维环境中缺乏真实障碍物数据时，如何利用高保真环境表示来计算确保零碰撞的安全路径这一技术难题。
AI.method: 提出AirSplan系统，采用归一化变体的3D高斯散射（3DGS）来编码高保真场景几何图形，并应用一种新颖的基于可达性的运动规划器，利用四旋翼的微分平坦性计算连续时间碰撞约束以紧密高估机器人的占用空间。
AI.result: 实验表明，AirSplan在具有挑战性的测试案例中成功找到了81.2%的路径，显著优于最近基线方法的51.2%。
AI.conclusion: AirSplan通过结合高保真3D高斯散射场景表示和新型可达性运动规划，显著提升了四旋翼在复杂三维环境中的防撞导航能力和成功率。
AI.translation: 四旋翼越来越多地被部署在农业、基础设施检查和维护等应用中。在这些应用中，机器人必须导航复杂的场景几何体，同时保持严格的无碰撞。与地面领域不同，即使是轻微的碰撞对飞行器来说也可能导致机器人的损失。这种安全要求带来了两个技术挑战。首先，必须以足够的保真度表示环境以编码复杂的结构，即使没有地面真实的障碍物数据。其次，运动规划器必须利用这种表示来确定通往目标的无碰撞路径。本文提出了一个解决这些互补挑战的系统。所提出的方法AirSplan采用了一种3D高斯散射的归一化变体，该变体编码了高保真的场景几何体。然后，它应用了一种新颖的基于可达性的运动规划器，该规划器利用四旋翼的微分平坦性来计算连续时间的碰撞约束，以紧密地高估机器人的占用空间。实验表明，AirSplan在81.2%的具有挑战性的测试案例中成功找到了路径，显著优于最近的基线方法的51.2%。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了AirSplan，这是一个针对四旋翼在复杂3D高斯散射环境中进行风险感知运动规划的系统。通过结合高保真3D高斯散射场景表示和基于可达性的新型运动规划器，该方法能够计算出紧密包裹机器人占有率的连续时间碰撞约束，从而在复杂环境中显著提高无碰撞导航的成功率。
AI.keywords: 四旋翼, 3D高斯散射, 运动规划, 风险感知, 碰撞避免
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将3D高斯散射（3DGS）与基于可达性的运动规划相结合，解决了四旋翼在复杂、未知真实几何结构环境中的安全导航问题，具有极高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Hallucination-R1: Robustness-Oriented Paraphrase Generation for Factual Consistency
summary: Factual hallucination is commonly defined by incorrect factual outputs. We study a paraphrase-induced hallucination setting, where a model answers a factual question correctly in its original form but generates an incorrect answer under a semantically equivalent paraphrase. Such inconsistencies expose latent factual instability under semantic invariance. However, general-purpose paraphrases are often insufficient as robustness-oriented supervision: near-copy paraphrases provide weak signals, while overly diverse paraphrases may break semantic equivalence. In this paper, we propose HALLUCINATION-R1, a robustness-oriented paraphrase generation framework that learns to produce semantically faithful yet robustness-challenging paraphrases for factual consistency. Through two-stage optimization, it first stabilizes meaning-preserving and diverse paraphrasing, then rewards paraphrases that reveal factual consistency degradation in downstream QA models. Experiments on SimpleQuestions, PopQA, and TruthfulQA show that HALLUCINATION-R1 achieves a strong consistency--diversity trade-off and exposes robustness failures across multiple model families and datasets. Further analyses indicate that these failures are not reducible to surface-level artifacts or semantic drift, but reveal non-trivial factual instability under meaning-preserving variation. A lightweight fine-tuning study also shows that HALLUCINATION-R1-generated data improves robust accuracy under paraphrase variations, suggesting its utility for robustness-oriented training. Our code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/yuwenhan07/Hallucination-R1.

AI.title_translation: Hallucination-R1：面向事实一致性的鲁棒性导向复述生成
AI.tldr: 提出Hallucination-R1框架，通过两阶段优化生成挑战性复述以暴露并提升大语言模型的事实一致性鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的通用复述作为鲁棒性监督往往不足：近拷贝复述提供的信号微弱，而过度多样化的复述则可能破坏语义等价性，因此需要一种能够平衡语义保真度与鲁棒性挑战的复述生成方法来解决模型的事实不一致问题。
AI.method: 提出Hallucination-R1框架，采用两阶段优化：首先稳定保持语义且具有多样性的复述生成，然后奖励能够暴露出下游QA模型事实一致性退化的复述。
AI.result: 在SimpleQuestions、PopQA和TruthfulQA上的实验表明，Hallucination-R1实现了很强的“一致性-多样性”权衡，能够暴露出多个模型家族和数据集的鲁棒性缺陷，并且使用其生成的数据进行轻量级微调提高了模型在复述变化下的鲁棒准确率。
AI.conclusion: Hallucination-R1是一个有效的鲁棒性导向复述生成框架，能够成功暴露并缓解大语言模型在语义不变性下的事实不一致问题。
AI.translation: 事实幻觉通常被定义为不正确的事实输出。我们研究了一种复述诱导的幻觉设定：模型在原始形式下能正确回答事实问题，但在语义等价的复述下却会生成不正确的答案。这种不一致暴漏了语义不变性下潜在的事实不稳定性。然而，通用的复述通常不足以作为鲁棒性导向的监督：近拷贝复述提供微弱的信号，而过度多样化的复述则可能破坏语义等价性。在本文中，我们提出了HALLUCINATION-R1，这是一个面向鲁棒性的复述生成框架，旨在学习生成语义忠实且具鲁棒性挑战的复述，以保证事实一致性。通过两阶段优化，它首先稳定保持意义且多样化的复述生成，然后奖励那些揭示下游QA模型中事实一致性退化的复述。在SimpleQuestions、PopQA和TruthfulQA上的实验表明，HALLUCINATION-R1实现了很强的“一致性-多样性”权衡，并暴露出多个模型家族和数据集的鲁棒性失效。进一步分析表明，这些失效不能归结为表面伪影或语义漂移，而是揭示了在保持意义的变化下非平凡的事实不稳定性。一项轻量级微调研究还表明，由HALLUCINATION-R1生成的数据提高了复述变化下的鲁棒准确率，表明其在面向鲁棒性的训练中的实用性。我们的代码和模型已在 https://github.com/yuwenhan07/Hallucination-R1 公开。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了Hallucination-R1框架，通过两阶段优化生成语义忠实且具挑战性的复述，以解决和暴露大语言模型在语义等价问题下的事实不一致（幻觉）问题。
AI.keywords: 事实幻觉, 复述生成, 鲁棒性, 语义一致性, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该论文针对大语言模型在事实问答中的鲁棒性问题，创新性地提出了Hallucination-R1框架，通过两阶段优化生成既保持语义等价又具挑战性的复述数据，有效暴露并提升了模型对语义变化的鲁棒性。

title: FOCAL-VLA: Subtask-Guided Geometry Distillation and Implicit World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models built on pretrained vision-language models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. However, VLA models that directly map current 2D observations to actions often lack sufficient spatial and temporal understanding, limiting their performance in precise and long-horizon manipulation. Recent methods enhance VLA models through geometric supervision and future-state prediction across the entire scene. However, these methods can suffer from redundant scene information, distracting the model from learning the geometry and dynamics relevant to the current interaction. To address this issue, we propose FOCAL-VLA, a framework that combines subtask-guided geometry distillation with implicit world modeling to learn representations of current spatial structure and future interaction dynamics. To focus geometric learning on the current subtask, we transfer geometric knowledge from VGGT to the VLA model by aligning geometry latents with features from subtask-relevant image regions. To capture the future 3D evolution of the current interaction, we incorporate implicit world modeling using Track4World features from current and future demonstration frames. The two complementary representations jointly guide action generation without running VGGT or Track4World at inference time. Experiments show that FOCAL-VLA outperforms baselines on both simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. Project website: https://zhiyuan-gao.github.io/FOCAL-VLA/.

AI.title_translation: FOCAL-VLA：基于子任务引导的几何蒸馏与隐式世界建模的视觉-语言-动作模型
AI.tldr: FOCAL-VLA通过子任务几何蒸馏和隐式世界建模增强了机器人VLA模型的空间和时间理解能力，显著提升了操作性能且推理高效。

title: KnowDemo: Knowledge-Guided Robot Demonstration Generation from Human Videos
summary: Learning robot manipulation policies typically requires substantial demonstration data, which are costly to collect on real robots. Recent methods generate robot demonstrations from human videos by adapting recovered motion and validating the resulting trajectories in simulation. However, methods centered on motion-reference adaptation can limit behavioral diversity by retaining the demonstrated contact strategies and subtask orders, while insufficient understanding of task requirements and scene relations can reduce demonstration generation efficiency by generating invalid candidates. To address these limitations, we propose KnowDemo, a framework that uses structured manipulation knowledge from human videos to generate diverse robot demonstrations for a target workspace. To distinguish task requirements from demonstration-specific choices, we develop a knowledge extraction and reasoning module based on a vision-language model (VLM) that associates object and action descriptions with inferred task conditions, demonstration references, and permissible execution variations. To translate this knowledge into executable demonstrations, we resolve the descriptions against target-scene entities and geometry to guide candidate generation and screening before motion planning and simulation. The resulting demonstrations exhibit multimodal behavior through alternative contact strategies and valid subtask orders, with structured execution labels. Experiments demonstrate additional verified execution modes beyond a reference-only configuration and improved candidate planning success through task-guided grasp sampling. To validate the generated data for policy learning, we fine-tune the pretrained $π_{0.5}$ model on simulation data, achieving sim-to-real transfer across three tasks. Project page: https://zhiyuan-gao.github.io/knowdemo/

title: Minimizing Bid Cost Recovery for Energy Storage with Uniform Pricing
comments: Accepted to the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)
summary: We study in-market uniform pricing and out-of-market bid cost recovery (BCR) payments in rolling-window dispatch for real-time power system operations with energy storage resources (ESRs). Due to intertemporal state-of-charge (SOC) constraints, ESR operations are temporally coupled, and existing in-market locational marginal pricing (LMP) may fail to compensate ESR's intertemporal opportunity costs, thereby triggering out-of-market BCR payments. We show that positive BCR is unavoidable when dispatched generators or ESRs have supply-side bids higher than the demand-side bid. We further identify an intertemporal coupling indicator associated with binding SOC constraints and demonstrate empirically that positive BCR arises only when this indicator is active, revealing that BCR is fundamentally driven by intertemporal coupling. In the simulation, we compare a BCR-minimizing uniform pricing scheme (UP-BCR) with existing real-time pricing methods under forecast uncertainty and show that UP-BCR substantially reduces BCR and demand payments relative to LMP while maintaining zero merchandising surplus in a copper-plate model.

title: Beyond Reference-Based Evaluation: Reward Models for Meta-Evaluation of Grammatical Error Correction
summary: Reference-based metrics for Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) such as M$^2$ and ERRANT assume that the reference set enumerates all valid edits, and therefore often penalize corrections that are grammatical and meaning-preserving but phrased differently. We introduce RM-EVAL, a reward model trained on human preference data from SEEDA, as a reference-free meta-evaluator that predicts human-like quality judgments at both full-sequence and partial-sequence levels. Beyond evaluation, we show that the same reward model can be used as a learning signal to improve GEC generation via Reward-Guided Text Generation (RGTG), which keeps a base GEC model frozen and performs online, reward-driven decoding. Across SEEDA, RM-EVAL achieves strong agreement with human rankings, and RGTG yields consistent gains in reward and external validation, demonstrating a unified framework for both assessing and enhancing GEC systems without relying on gold references.

title: Succinct Representation of Search Trees on Trees
summary:
A search tree on trees (STT) is a data structure for performing a search for a target vertex in a reference tree. A standard binary search tree is a special case of an STT, where the reference tree is a path of totally ordered elements.
  In this paper, we study the problem of succinct representation of STTs. We consider two cases: (1) general search trees on trees, and (2) Steiner-closed search trees on trees [Bose et al. TALG 2023]. For both cases, we present representations that can be constructed in polynomial time and achieve optimal space up to the lower-order additive terms.
  We also present data structures for supporting fast traversals of both general and Steiner-closed STTs. For general STTs our data structure still takes optimal space up to lower-order additive terms.

title: Performance Analysis of Cooperative Multi-Carrier Relay-Based UAV Networks Over Generalized Fading Channels
summary: The outage probability in a network of cooperative unmanned airborne vehicles (UAVs) over generalized fading channels is studied analytically using finite mixture with expectation maximization technique. A relay-based topology with one ground control unit (GCU) is considered, where the cooperative UAVs can communicate with the GCU directly or through relay. The application the UAV assigned for specifies the minimum required transmission rate the UAV should achieve. The outage probability of the system is defined as the probability that either the transmission rate over any of the links drops below a predefined minimum threshold for that link or the Relay-GCU link is not able to transmit the aggregate data from all relayed UAVs and the minimum rate required by the relay UAV itself. Throughout the paper, expressions for the outage probability and the average achievable bit rate of a cooperative multi-carrier system are derived over generalized fading channels. Finite Mixture with Expectation-Maximization algorithm is utilized to derive a simple approximate expression for the probability density function (pdf) of the achievable bit rate assuming adaptive M-ary quadrature amplitude modulation (M-QAM). This pdf is used to derive closed-form expressions for the outage probability and the average bit rate.

title: Self-Care and Mental Health: Mapping Over A Decade of HCI Interventions
summary: Technology increasingly supports self-care for understanding and improving one's own mental health. HCI is at the center of the turn towards self-care technology, yet we lack an account of who these interventions serve, what practices they support, how technology mediates those practices, and assumptions underlying design for self-care. In order to characterize the current landscape and inform future research, we analyzed 91 SIGCHI papers that contribute HCI interventions for mental health self-care from the ACM Digital Library from 2015 through June 2026. Then, we conducted an interpretive synthesis to surface six orientations of self-care, which describe how HCI self-care interventions constitute care through shared assumptions regarding self, care, and technology. Overall, our work provides an interconnected vocabulary for positioning HCI mental health self-care, highlights changing responsibilities of care towards users, and discusses implications for providing a more situated account of HCI self-care technology in addressing the 'general' user.
