title: Skel-WAM: A Hand-Skeleton-Conditioned World Action Model for Human-to-Robot Manipulation Transfer
summary: Robot demonstrations are expensive to collect and often provide limited distributional coverage of task variations. Human videos offer a low-cost source of complementary manipulation experience, but learning from them requires bridging embodiment gaps in visual appearance and action spaces. We introduce Skel-WAM, a world action model that bridges these differences through a unified hand-skeleton motion interface. The key insight is to align human and robot motion through a common hand topology, combining skeleton overlays that ground motion in the scene with structured 2.5-D keypoints that encode explicit hand kinematics. Video and Keypoint Experts jointly learn visual and skeletal dynamics through a Mixture-of-Transformers, while a separate robot-trained Action Expert maps these predictions to executable controls. This separation enables human and robot demonstrations to directly supervise shared dynamics without requiring robot action labels for human videos. Across four real-world bimanual tasks and seven simulated tasks, Skel-WAM achieves average success rates of 79.86% and 63.29%, surpassing the strongest baseline by 22.22 and 8.28 percentage points, respectively. Human-robot cotraining more than doubles real-world success on task variations absent from robot training data, from 38.89% to 86.11%. These results demonstrate that a shared skeletal interface enables joint learning across human and robot data and expands robot task coverage through complementary human demonstrations.

title: ServeGuard: Verifiable, Bounded-Residual Confinement of Operator-Invisible Channels Without Revealing the Certified Read Factor
summary: Third-party adapters for open-weight language models ship as opaque weight matrices; a recipient cannot check whether an adapter hides a backdoor without trusting the publisher or inspecting the weights, the publisher's core asset. For one important class (payloads placed where a safety monitor is structurally blind), detection is unsound as a defense: every detector that factors through the declared monitor is invariant on its blind subspace, and honest and backdoored adapters overlap on every blind-subspace statistic we evaluate, because benign adaptation uses that subspace too. Rather than detect this channel, we make it structurally \emph{absent} and prove that we did. The publisher builds the adapter to read the input only through directions the monitor covers and proves this in zero knowledge, revealing nothing about the read factor it certifies. The certificate is cheap because the expensive part, identifying the monitor's blind spot, is a deterministic function of the \emph{public} base model, so only one linear identity is proved; the served residual is the base model's own public floor, not a prover-chosen tolerance. The result is \emph{ServeGuard}, a supply-chain primitive: the publisher ships a \emph{proof-carrying adapter} whose proof lets a consumer or regulator verify, without the certified read factor and without trusting the publisher, that the adapter carries no hidden channel of this class relative to the declared monitor; an admission-time typing guard binds the guarantee to the adapter bytes admitted at serving time. Across eight checkpoints up to 7B from four families, the monitoring budget is architectural: the measured frontier saturates at the value-path rank on grouped-query checkpoints but not on multi-head ones. On a 0.5B model confinement is nearly free for benign adaptation, making monitor quality the security lever.

title: 2D GauSS-MI: Efficient Active Scene Reconstruction with Balanced Visual and Geometric Quality
summary: Active reconstruction requires efficient active view selection to achieve high-quality reconstruction within limited onboard computational resources. Existing methods face challenges in adequately balancing visual and geometric quality with the computational efficiency required for real-time operation. In this work, we present an active reconstruction framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS). We develop an efficient online 2DGS mapping pipeline for incremental RGB-D observations and introduce a probabilistic reliability model that characterizes the view-dependent reconstruction quality of individual 2D Gaussian splats. Building on this model, we formulate 2D Gaussian Splatting Shannon Mutual Information (2D GauSS-MI), a mutual-information-based metric that exploits the explicit surface orientation of 2DGS to evaluate the expected information gain of candidate views. The proposed metric enables active view selection to account for both visual and geometric reconstruction quality. We evaluate the proposed system against three state-of-the-art baselines on eight Replica scenes. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves a favorable balance between visual and geometric reconstruction quality with substantially lower computational cost and competitive model storage.

title: Learning-to-Optimize as the Missing Architectural Layer of AI-Native Networks
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming a fundamental design principle of future AI-native communication networks, enabling autonomous resource management, adaptive control, and zero-touch network operation. While current AI-native architectures increasingly embed intelligence across network functions, they provide little guidance on how optimisation knowledge should be systematically generated, transferred, and exploited by AI models. This paper argues that the Learning-to-Optimize (L2O) represents the missing architectural layer between optimisation and AI-native intelligence. Rather than viewing optimisation merely as an online decision engine, the proposed paradigm redefines optimisation algorithms as offline knowledge generators that produce high-quality supervisory information for neural surrogate models. The resulting models inherit optimisation expertise while enabling low-latency runtime inference suitable for dynamic network environments. A generic four-stage L2O workflow is introduced, comprising optimisation, knowledge generation, surrogate learning, and runtime inference. Unlike existing Learning-to-Optimize approaches, which primarily focus on algorithm acceleration, the proposed framework establishes L2O as an architectural abstraction applicable across heterogeneous communication and computing systems. The proposed paradigm is illustrated by an NR-V2X relay-selection problem, in which optimisation-generated solutions from a Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) solver are used to train a Graph Neural Network that can reproduce near-optimal decisions in real time. The presented perspective positions Learning-to-Optimize as a key architectural enabler for future AI-native networks.

title: VidOmni-Bench: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Video Understanding via Spatio-Temporal Event Verification across Complexity and Duration
summary: While Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have recently demonstrated strong performance, reliably evaluating their fine-grained video understanding remains challenging. Existing benchmarks often rely on question answering or ground-truth caption matching, where models may succeed through superficial cues and incomplete annotations. To this end, we introduce VidOmni-Bench, a benchmark that requires models to verify whether each event in dense video captions is supported by the video. VidOmni-Bench consists of 500 videos spanning five complexity types and diverse durations from 4 seconds to 90 minutes. After collecting videos along these axes, we use diverse Video-LLMs to generate dense captions and obtain human-verified sentence-level labels, where sentences containing incorrect events serve as hard negatives for evaluation. Our experiments on VidOmni-Bench reveal three key findings: (i) Video-LLMs frequently generate hallucinated descriptions in dense video captioning; (ii) they also struggle as verifiers, failing to reliably detect plausible but incorrect event descriptions; and (iii) model weaknesses vary across video complexity and duration, revealing diverse, model-specific bottlenecks in current Video-LLMs.

title: Refine Then Fusion: Training-Free 3D Point Cloud Adaptation with Priority Refinement and Multi-Modal Knowledge Fusion
summary: Recent pre-trained foundation models provide rich multi-modal priors for downstream 3D vision tasks. However, the effectiveness of these representations in few-shot scenarios is limited by two fundamental challenges: High-dimensional features often contain substantial channel redundancy and task-irrelevant noise, while the reliability of different modalities varies across samples. Consequently, direct aggregation of heterogeneous representations overlooks sample-dependent modality reliability and may obscure the discriminative cues essential. To address these limitations, we propose Refine Then Fusion(RTF), a training-free framework for few-shot 3D recognition. RTF first identifies discriminative feature channels by jointly modeling inter-class similarity and intra-class stability, thereby decoupling domain-specific knowledge refinement from the cached representations of pre-trained models. It then introduces a reliability-aware fusion mechanism that estimates sample-wise modality reliability from the distribution shifts induced by feature refinement, enabling adaptive aggregation of multi-modal representations. Furthermore, RTF constructs a memory cache that integrates instance-level support features with class-level prototypes to infer query labels. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate that RTF consistently outperforms single-modal baselines, partial-fusion variants, and existing lightweight adaptation methods, achieving state-of-the-art few-shot 3D recognition performance without gradient optimization, additional training data, auxiliary training, or parameter updates.

title: What Must Survive? Exact Task-Information--State Frontiers for Resource-Sufficient Learning
summary:
A system may be compressed before its downstream task is fully known. We ask how much retained state is then necessary and how much can be saved by limited advance task information.
  For a finite family of linear tasks, a task message is revealed before state formation and the exact task only afterwards. For an advice alphabet of size $K$, the exact frontier is \[ p^*(K)= \min_{\substack{\Pcal\text{ partition of }\U\\|\Pcal|\le K}} \max_{C\in\Pcal}\rank(T_C), \] with the $b$-bit frontier obtained by setting $K=\min(2^b,|\U|)$. Thus advance task information reduces state through partitions whose joint task operators have low rank.
  We also give an approximate singular-value frontier, a common-core lower bound and exact direct-sum law, and strong NP-hardness of finding an optimal advice partition. The hardness persists at every fixed positive approximation tolerance.
  Three examples illustrate the result. A well-conditioned softmax attention construction gives an exact $524{,}288\to1{,}024$ coordinate frontier when nine bits resolve one of $512$ continuations. A domain-decomposed digital twin yields an interface-plus-local-state law and a weighted partition problem for heterogeneous regions.
  A hierarchical multi-task model gives a two-stage frontier in which three bits reduce the required state from $3136$ to $448$ coordinates, with further task information approaching the irreducible $328$-coordinate single-task floor.

title: IncentRL: The Trade-Off Between Preference Guidance and Task Performance
summary: Preference-based reward shaping can guide reinforcement learning, but adding preference signals to the reward may unintentionally change the task being optimized. We address this problem with IncentRL, a framework that introduces preference guidance while explicitly characterizing its effect on external-task performance. IncentRL adds a Kullback--Leibler (KL) penalty between a specified outcome distribution and a preferred distribution. For finite discounted Markov decision processes with bounded shaping costs, we derive an external-value perturbation bound, establish a sufficient strict-action-gap condition for preserving the original optimal policy, and characterize the large-weight regime through discounted cumulative preference cost. Exact examples clarify the limits of these guarantees, including tied optima and support mismatch. We study a practical implementation using a hand-designed, distance-based outcome proxy, a fixed preference distribution, and score-weighted coefficient search. On MiniGrid DoorKey-8x8, the reported three-seed mean success rate after two million training steps reaches 98\% with coefficient 0.01, compared with 90.5\% for the reported zero-coefficient baseline, while the search progressively shifts toward smaller coefficients. Together, these results provide a principled view of the central trade-off in preference-based RL: using additional guidance to improve learning without excessively distorting the original task objective. The current experiments remain descriptive and do not yet isolate KL shaping from simpler alternatives.

title: OpenMAS-GCom. A Diagnostic Benchmark for Graph-enhanced Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Graph-enhanced multi-agent systems (G-MAS) coordinate large language model agents through communication graphs and role assignments, which determine how agents exchange information and divide responsibilities. However, final-score comparisons across systems combine differences in models, communication patterns, roles, and computation costs, making performance differences difficult to attribute to specific communication structures, role assignments, and information flows. To address this evaluation attribution problem, we introduce OpenMAS-GCom, a benchmark for diagnosing how these components affect G-MAS performance through controlled interventions. We represent systems through collaboration units, communication links, shared intermediate information, and execution rules. OpenMAS-GCom compares original systems with versions modified by changing one component while keeping tasks, models, prompts, and budget limits fixed. We rewire communication edges, remove specialist or critic agents, replace intermediate messages with incorrect content, and disable workers during execution. The benchmark evaluates 17 single-agent, ordinary multi-agent, and graph-enhanced configurations on 29 datasets across six domains. We add 400 G-MAS-Complex tasks requiring agents to combine information from multiple documents, resolve conflicting records, and return specified values with source identifiers. Experiments show larger mean losses after specialist removal than after critic removal, different performance degradation under incorrect messages and worker failures despite similar original scores, and different configurations achieving the highest accuracy and accuracy per token on G-MAS-Complex.

title: Critical sets of Latin squares based on autoparatopisms
summary: In cryptography, critical sets of Latin squares have particularly been implemented to design secret sharing schemes. A main problem in these cryptographic protocols arises from absent holders of pieces of information that are common to different critical sets, because they become indispensable to recover the secret. This paper solves this problem by making use of the orbits of entries described by the autoparatopism group of the Latin square under consideration. To this end, we introduce the more general problem of computing critical sets of Latin squares having a given paratopism in their autoparatopism group. These critical sets depend only on the conjugacy class of the autoparatopism and the main class of the Latin square under consideration. Based on this fact, as an illustrative example, we determine the smallest and largest sizes of critical sets associated with autoparatopisms of Latin squares of order up to six. We implement this approach in the design of a new secret sharing scheme.

title: MACE: Memory-Agent Co-Evolution with Adaptive Memory Graphs for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems generate collaboration traces that record how agents plan tasks, verify intermediate results, and repair failures. Reusing these procedures requires preserving an action's prerequisites and the outputs needed by subsequent agents. Our empirical studies show that grouping these dependencies into functional memory units improves their retention, while connecting units increases retrieval of the units and links jointly required by a task. The preferred combination of units also changes between instructions and checklists, even when each combination's content is fixed across formats. Updating choices from the outcomes of each combination and format pairing outperforms scoring combinations and formats separately. These findings motivate MACE, a memory-agent co-evolution framework that adapts memory organization and agent memory use through execution feedback. Its MemGoG structure represents functional units as subgraphs of related conditions, actions, and outputs, connecting them through support, conflict, and repair relations. MACE Loop selects task-relevant units and relations within a memory budget and provides each agent with instructions or checklists for its current operation. It records the selected units, presentation formats, agent outputs, and task outcomes to update unit scores and relations for retrieval and inform subsequent presentation choices. Across eight benchmarks, MACE outperforms ten baselines with an average score of 81.11%, compared with 78.97% for the strongest baseline, SAGE.

title: Element-wise Convergence Behavior of Subspace Iteration
summary: This paper studies the element-wise convergence behavior of subspace iteration. All results are established for both \(\mathbb{F}=\mathbb{R}\) and \(\mathbb{F}=\mathbb{C}\). For a diagonal matrix \(Λ=\mathrm{diag}(λ_1,\ldots,λ_n)\) with \(|λ_1|>\cdots>|λ_n|>0\), we analyze the modulus of each entry of the iterative matrix sequence generated by subspace iteration, both without and with the Rayleigh--Ritz procedure. Under mild assumptions on the initial matrix \(X\in\mathbb{F}^{n\times m}\), we first derive exact asymptotic expressions for \(|Q_k(i,j)|\) in the subspace iteration without the Rayleigh--Ritz procedure: entries with \(i\neq j\) decay as \((|λ_{\max\{i,j\}}|/|λ_{\min\{i,j\}}|)^k\), and the deviation of \(|Q_k(j,j)|\) from \(1\) decays as \(\max\{|λ_j|/|λ_{j-1}|,|λ_{j+1}|/|λ_j|\}^{2k}\), with explicit coefficients determined by the LU factorization of \(X\). For the Rayleigh--Ritz variant, we obtain element-wise bounds for the normalized Ritz vectors \(Z_k\). Specifically, for \(|Z_k(i,j)|\), off-diagonal entries with \(i\geq m+1\) decay as \((|λ_i|/|λ_j|)^k\), off-diagonal entries with \(i\leq m\) decay as \((|λ_{m+1}|^2/(|λ_i||λ_j|))^k\), and the deviation of \(|Z_k(j,j)|\) from \(1\) decays as \((|λ_{m+1}|/|λ_j|)^{2k}\). These results give an element-wise description of the convergence behavior of subspace iteration. After an orthogonal or unitary change of basis, the results apply to real symmetric or complex normal matrices.

AI.title_translation: 子空间迭代法的逐元素收敛行为
AI.tldr: 本文分析了子空间迭代法中各个元素的收敛速度和渐近行为。
AI.motivation: 为了深入理解和描述子空间迭代法中每个独立元素的收敛行为，而不仅仅是整体子空间的收敛性。
AI.method: 通过数学分析，在对初始矩阵施加温和假设的条件下，分别推导了不带瑞利-里茨过程的子空间迭代矩阵项的精确渐近表达式，以及带瑞利-里茨过程的归一化Ritz向量的逐元素界。
AI.result: 对于不带瑞利-里茨过程的情况，非对角项按特定特征值比率的k次方衰减，对角项偏差按特定特征值比率的2k次方衰减；对于带瑞利-里茨过程的情况，也给出了明确的非对角项衰减率和对角项偏差衰减率。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功推导出了子空间迭代法在有无瑞利-里茨过程下，迭代矩阵及Ritz向量各个元素收敛行为的渐近表达式和上下界。
AI.translation: 本文研究了子空间迭代法的逐元素收敛行为。所有结果均适用于\(\mathbb{F}=\mathbb{R}\)和\(\mathbb{F}=\mathbb{C}\)。对于具有\(|λ_1|>\cdots>|λ_n|>0\)的对角矩阵\(Λ=\mathrm{diag}(λ_1,\ldots,λ_n)\)，我们分析了在有和没有瑞利-里茨（Rayleigh--Ritz）程序的情况下，由子空间迭代生成的迭代矩阵序列中每个条目的模数。在对初始矩阵\(X\in\mathbb{F}^{n\times m}\)施加温和假设的条件下，我们首先推导了在没有瑞利-里茨程序的子空间迭代中\(|Q_k(i,j)|\)的精确渐近表达式：\(i\neq j\)的条目以\((|λ_{\max\{i,j\}}|/|λ_{\min\{i,j\}}|)^k\)的速度衰减，而\(|Q_k(j,j)|\)偏离\(1\)的偏差以\(\max\{|λ_j|/|λ_{j-1}|,|λ_{j+1}|/|λ_j|\}^{2k}\)的速度衰减，其显式系数由\(X\)的LU分解决定。对于瑞利-里茨变体，我们获得了归一化Ritz向量\(Z_k\)的逐元素界。具体而言，对于\(|Z_k(i,j)|\)，\(i\geq m+1\)的非对角条目以\((|λ_i|/|λ_j|)^k\)的速度衰减，\(i\leq m\)的非对角条目以\((|λ_{m+1}|^2/(|λ_i||λ_j|))^k\)的速度衰减，并且\(|Z_k(j,j)|\)偏离\(1\)的偏差以\((|λ_{m+1}|/|λ_j|)^{2k}\)的速度衰减。这些结果给出了子空间迭代收敛行为的逐元素描述。在正交或酉基变换之后，这些结果适用于实对称矩阵或复正规矩阵。
AI.summary: 本文研究了子空间迭代法在实数域和复数域上的逐元素收敛行为，推导了有无瑞利-里茨过程时矩阵各个元素收敛速度的精确渐近表达式和界。
AI.keywords: Subspace iteration, Element-wise convergence, Rayleigh--Ritz procedure, Asymptotic expressions
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了子空间迭代法中每个元素的收敛行为，填补了以往主要关注整体子空间收敛而对逐个元素研究不足的空白，理论分析严谨，涵盖了有无瑞利-里茨过程两种情况。

title: Purification and Regulation: Comorbidity-Aware Multi-Label Few-Shot Learning for Medical Image Classification
summary: Multi-label few-shot learning (MLFSL) remains a significant challenge in medical image analysis (MIA). Current metric-based meta-learning methods face two critical limitations in MIA. First, conventional prototype generation often entangles irrelevant disease information, leading to contaminated prototypes and degraded performance. Second, prior studies typically enforce inter-class separability in embedding space, largely neglecting the inherent correlations among diseases. To overcome these challenges, we propose Prototype Purification and Regulation (PPR), a novel MLFSL framework for MIA. PPR first performs prototype purification by leveraging sample-level comorbidity scores to emphasize disease-specific features, producing purified prototypes that better characterize each disease. Building upon these purified prototypes, PPR further addresses the underexplored problem of inter-class prototype distance in MIA by incorporating disease-level comorbidity statistics to adaptively regulate inter-class similarity, forming a comorbidity-aware embedding space. Overall, PPR sequentially enables the model to capture pure disease features and inter-class relationships for reliable MLFSL in MIA. Extensive experiments across four chest X-ray benchmark datasets, including cross-domain evaluation, show that PPR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, significantly improving disease detection while demonstrating robust generalization and clinical applicability.

AI.title_translation: 净化与正则化：面向医学图像分类的共病感知多标签少样本学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向医学图像分类的共病感知多标签少样本学习框架（PPR），通过原型净化与共病正则化解决了原型污染与共病关联忽视的问题，显著提升了分类性能。
AI.motivation: 当前基于度量的元学习方法在医学图像分析的多标签少样本学习（MLFSL）中面临两大局限：一是常规原型生成常混入不相关疾病信息导致原型污染；二是以往研究忽略了疾病之间内在的共病关联。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“原型净化与正则化”（PPR）的新型多标签少样本学习框架。首先，利用样本级共病分数进行原型净化，突出疾病特异性特征；其次，利用疾病级共病统计数据自适应调节类间相似性，构建共病感知嵌入空间。
AI.result: 在四个胸部X光基准数据集（包括跨领域评估）上的广泛实验表明，PPR consistently（持续地）优于现有最先进的方法，显著提升了疾病检测性能，并表现出强健的泛化能力和临床适用性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的PPR框架通过原型净化和共病感知的正则化，有效解决了医学图像多标签少样本学习中的原型污染和共病关联忽视问题，实验证明了其卓越性能与临床应用潜力。
AI.translation: 多标签少样本学习（MLFSL）仍然是医学图像分析（MIA）中的一个重大挑战。当前基于度量的元学习方法在MIA中面临两个关键局限。首先，传统的原型生成通常会混入不相关的疾病信息，导致原型污染并性能下降。其次，先验研究通常在嵌入空间中强制实现类间可分性，很大程度上忽略了疾病之间固有的相关性。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了原型净化与正则化（PPR），这是一个用于MIA的新型MLFSL框架。PPR首先利用样本级共病分数来强调疾病特异性特征，进行原型净化，从而产生能更好表征每种疾病的纯净原型。在这些纯净原型的基础上，PPR通过结合疾病级共病统计数据自适应调节类间相似性，进一步解决了MIA中未被充分探索的类间原型距离问题，从而形成一个共病感知的嵌入空间。总体而言，PPR依次使模型能够捕获纯粹的疾病特征和类间关系，以实现MIA中可靠的MLFSL。在四个胸部X光基准数据集（包括跨领域评估）上的广泛实验表明，PPR始终优于最先进的方法，显著改善了疾病检测，同时展示了强大的泛化能力和临床适用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为PPR的共病感知多标签少样本学习框架，用于医学图像分类。该方法通过样本级共病分数净化原型特征，并利用疾病级共病统计数据自适应调节类间相似性以构建共病感知嵌入空间，在胸部X光数据集上取得了优于SOTA的实验结果。
AI.keywords: 多标签少样本学习, 医学图像分析, 原型净化, 共病感知, 元学习
AI.comments: 本文针对医学图像分析中的多标签少样本学习任务（MLFSL），指出了现有方法中原型受噪声干扰以及忽略疾病间共病关联的两大痛点，并提出了“原型净化与正则化”（PPR）框架。创新点在于通过样本级共病分数净化原型，并利用疾病级共病统计信息自适应调节类间相似性，构建共病感知嵌入空间，在四个胸部X光数据集上展现了优异的性能和鲁棒的泛化能力。

title: From Retrieval to Recognition:How Vision--Language Models Become OCR Specialists
summary: Does a general vision--language model acquire specialized OCR ability by developing a new reading circuit or by reusing an existing mechanism? We address this question in the setting of full-sequence OCR, rather than local-answer retrieval. Using an evidence-grounded protocol with held-out causal interventions, we identify sparse and stable OCR-head sets in GLM-OCR, MinerU2.5, and PaddleOCR-VL-1.6. We then investigate the mechanistic origin of these OCR heads by comparing them with independently identified textual retrieval/copy heads in general VLMs. Across two general VLMs, visual OCR heads strongly overlap independently identified textual retrieval/copy heads, yielding untuned top-20 intersections of 73.3% and all-head Spearman correlations of 0.677-0.886. The overlap and causal interventions suggest that full-sequence OCR operates as dense sequential multimodal copy-and-paste, repeatedly retrieving visual evidence and routing it to the current output position. Finally, we examine how this shared circuit changes as a general VLM becomes an OCR specialist. Matched base-to-specialized comparisons show that OCR specialization largely preserves head identity, retaining 17-20 of the top 20 heads per task with all-head rank correlations of 0.874-0.942, while redistributing their functional and causal strengths.

AI.title_translation: 从检索到识别：视觉-语言模型如何成为OCR专家
AI.tldr: 视觉语言模型的OCR能力并非凭空产生，而是通过复用并微调其已有的文本检索和复制机制来实现的。
AI.motivation: 探讨通用的视觉语言模型（VLM）是通过发展新的阅读回路还是通过复用现有机制来获得专用的OCR能力的。
AI.method: 采用基于证据的协议与保留因果干预（held-out causal interventions），在GLM-OCR、MinerU2.5和PaddleOCR-VL-1.6等模型中识别稀疏且稳定的OCR头，并将其与通用VLM中的文本检索/复制头进行比较和匹配基础-专业对比。
AI.result: 视觉OCR头与独立识别的文本检索/复制头高度重合（前20个交叉重合度达73.3%，Spearman相关性为0.677-0.886）；在模型转化为OCR专家的过程中，核心头的身份高度保留（前20个头中保留17-20个），但其功能和因果强度被重新分配。
AI.conclusion: 全序列OCR在VLM中本质上是一种密集的顺序多模态复制粘贴操作，且视觉OCR头与文本检索/复制头高度重合；模型成为OCR专家的过程主要通过重新分配功能和因果强度来实现，而非改变核心神经回路。
AI.translation: 通用的视觉-语言模型是通过发展新的阅读回路还是通过复用现有机制来获得专门的OCR能力的？我们在全序列OCR（而非局部答案检索）的设置下探讨了这个问题。使用带有保留因果干预的证据基础协议，我们在GLM-OCR、MinerU2.5和PaddleOCR-VL-1.6中识别出了稀疏且稳定的OCR头。然后，通过将这些OCR头与通用VLM中独立识别出的文本检索/复制头进行比较，研究了它们的机械起源。在两个通用VLM中，视觉OCR头与独立识别的文本检索/复制头强力重合，未调优的前20个交叉重合度达到73.3%，全头Spearman相关性为0.677-0.886。重合度和因果干预表明，全序列OCR作为密集的顺序多模态复制粘贴操作运行，重复检索视觉证据并将其路由到当前的输出位置。最后，我们检验了当通用VLM成为OCR专家时，这个共享回路是如何变化的。匹配的基础到专业比较表明，OCR专业化在很大程度上保留了头的身份，每个任务保留了前20个头中的17-20个，全头等级相关性为0.874-0.942，同时重新分配了它们的功能和因果强度。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了视觉语言模型如何获得OCR能力，发现全序列OCR本质上是多模态复制粘贴机制，视觉OCR头与通用VLM中的文本检索/复制头高度重合，且模型转化为OCR专家时主要通过重新分配这些头的强度来实现。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 光学字符识别, 机械可解释性, 复制机制
AI.comments: 该研究通过机械可解释性方法深入探讨了视觉语言模型（VLM）中OCR能力的起源和演化，创新性地揭示了OCR本质上是文本检索/复制机制的延伸，对于理解多模态大模型的内部工作原理具有重要意义。

title: Cross-Platform vs Native Mobile Development: An Empirical Study of Software Quality Trade-offs
summary:
Cross-platform mobile frameworks promise code reuse, shorter delivery cycles, and lower implementation effort, but their trade-offs relative to native development remain difficult to assess objectively. Many comparisons rely on simplified applications, inconsistent feature sets, or a narrow set of metrics. This paper compares five implementations of the same plant-management application: native iOS, native Android, Flutter, React Native, and Kotlin Multiplatform. The shared approaches target both Android and iOS, yielding eight executable variants. Guided by ISO/IEC 25010, the study examines time behavior, implementation footprint, source-code organization, and observable rendering responsiveness.
  All implementations share the same domain, backend services, functional requirements, and benchmark contract. The supplied dataset contains 2,000 completed runs per variant and covers authenticated and cached retrieval, image transfer and decoding, list rendering and scrolling, local synchronization, and media upload. Backend preparation and framework-specific UI drivers are analyzed separately from the primary client workflow.
  Native records the lowest non-UI client subtotal on both operating systems, with Kotlin Multiplatform the closest cross-platform implementation, while operation and UI-wrapper rankings vary by task. The shared approaches contain less authored mobile source than the native applications combined, and the source inventory shows different patterns of file size, organization, and dependency use. Rather than identifying a universally superior technology, the study shows that each approach's advantages and costs depend on the quality attribute, workload, platform, and measurement boundary.

AI.title_translation: 跨平台与原生移动开发：软件质量权衡的实证研究
AI.tldr: 通过对原生与多种跨平台移动开发框架的实证对比，研究发现没有一种技术在所有指标上都占优，其权衡取决于具体的工作负载和质量属性。
AI.motivation: 跨平台移动框架承诺代码复用和缩短交付周期，但其与原生开发相比的权衡取舍难以客观评估，且以往的比较往往依赖于简化应用、不一致的功能集或狭窄的指标。
AI.method: 基于ISO/IEC 25010标准，使用统一的植物管理应用实现了5种版本（原生iOS、原生Android、Flutter、React Native和Kotlin Multiplatform），衍生出8个可执行变体，涵盖2,000次运行的基准测试，从时间行为、实现占用、源码组织和渲染响应等多维度进行实证分析。
AI.result: 原生开发在两个操作系统上的非UI客户端子总计中记录了最低耗时，Kotlin Multiplatform是最接近的跨平台实现，而操作和UI包装器的排名因任务而异；共享方法包含的代码量少于原生应用的组合，且呈现出不同的源码组织和依赖使用模式。
AI.conclusion: 没有一种技术在所有方面都绝对优于其他技术，其优势与成本取决于具体的质量属性、工作负载、平台和测量边界。
AI.translation:
跨平台移动框架承诺实现代码复用、更短的交付周期和更低的实现成本，但它们相对于原生开发的权衡取舍仍然难以客观评估。许多比较依赖于简化的应用程序、不一致的功能集或狭窄的指标范围。本文对比了同一植物管理应用的五种实现：原生iOS、原生Android、Flutter、React Native和Kotlin Multiplatform。共享方法同时针对Android和iOS，产生了八个可执行变体。在ISO/IEC 25010的指导下，本研究考察了时间行为、实现占用、源码组织和可观测的渲染响应能力。
所有实现共享相同的域、后端服务、功能需求和基准合同。所提供的测数据集包含每个变体2,000次完整运行，涵盖认证和缓存检索、图像传输和解码、列表渲染和滚动、本地同步以及媒体上传。后端准备和框架特定的UI驱动程序与主客户端工作流分开分析。
原生开发在两个操作系统上均记录了最低的非UI客户端子总计，Kotlin Multiplatform是最接近的跨平台实现，而操作和UI包装器的排名随任务而异。共享方法包含的编写移动源码比组合的原生应用少，并且源码清单显示出文件大小、组织和依赖项使用的不同模式。该研究没有指出一种普遍优越的技术，而是表明每种方法的优势和成本取决于质量属性、工作负载、平台和测量边界。
AI.summary: 本文通过一项全面的实证研究，对比了原生与Flutter、React Native、Kotlin Multiplatform等跨平台移动开发方案在统一功能和基准下的质量权衡，发现各技术优劣取决于质量属性、工作负载及测量边界，不存在普遍意义上的最优技术。
AI.keywords: Cross-platform development, Native mobile development, Software quality trade-offs, ISO/IEC 25010
AI.comments: 该论文通过严谨的实证研究，对比了原生与多种主流跨平台移动开发框架在统一业务场景下的表现，对实际开发中的技术选型具有重要的参考价值。

title: Do We Care About Personalization and Explainability? An Interview Study with News Recommendation Engineers
comments: 10 pages, Accepted at ACM RecSys 2026 Main Track
summary: Research on explainability in recommender systems largely centers on end users, overlooking the perspectives of those who build and maintain these systems and their potential use cases such as model debugging. In this study, we examine how news engineers and related technical stakeholders perceive and implement personalization and explainability in practice. We conducted 15 semi-structured interviews across nine news organizations, spanning diverse regions in both public and private sectors, to investigate the challenges and motivations shaping their approaches. Our findings reveal that personalization is not always a straightforward or desirable choice for news organizations, as concerns around user tracking, editorial control, and resource constraints often limit its adoption. Even among organizations implementing personalized news recommender systems in production, explainability is rarely prioritized, with day-to-day operational demands frequently taking precedence over longer-term transparency goals. Definitions of explainability vary widely across organizations, though some demonstrate promising internal practices and visualization tools that facilitate communication between engineering teams and newsrooms. Based on our analysis, we provide actionable and practical guidelines for news engineers and researchers on how to adopt explainability methods within a news personalization pipeline.
comment: 10 pages, Accepted at ACM RecSys 2026 Main Track

AI.title_translation: 我们真的关心个性化和可解释性吗？与新闻推荐工程师的访谈研究
AI.tldr: 通过对15位新闻推荐工程师的访谈发现，由于运营压力、编辑控制和资源限制，新闻机构在实际生产中往往不会优先考虑个性化和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 当前推荐系统的可解释性研究主要集中在最终用户身上，忽视了构建和维护这些系统的开发人员的视角及其在模型调试等方面的潜在用例。
AI.method: 对来自不同地区、公共及私营部门的9家新闻机构的15名新闻工程师及相关技术利益相关者进行了半结构化访谈。
AI.result: 研究发现，个性化并不总是新闻机构的首选，用户追踪、编辑控制和资源限制常限制其应用；可解释性在实际中很少被优先考虑，且不同机构对可解释性的定义差异很大，但部分机构已采用可视化工具促进工程团队与编辑部的沟通。
AI.conclusion: 新闻推荐系统中的个性化与可解释性受制于运营压力、编辑控制及资源限制等多重因素，研究呼应了实际业务场景与学术研究之间的脱节，并为未来的实践提供了切实可行的指导。
AI.translation: 推荐系统中关于可解释性的研究主要集中在最终用户身上，忽视了构建和维护这些系统的开发人员的视角及其潜在的用例，例如模型调试。在本研究中，我们考察了新闻工程师及相关技术利益相关者如何在实践中看待和实现个性化与可解释性。我们在来自不同地区的公共和私营部门的9家新闻机构中进行了15次半结构化访谈，以调查塑造他们方法的挑战和动机。我们的研究结果表明，个性化并不总是新闻机构直接或可取的选择，因为对用户追踪、编辑控制和资源限制的担忧往往限制了其采用。即使在生产中实现个性化新闻推荐系统的组织中也很少优先考虑可解释性，日常运营需求经常优先于长期的透明度目标。不同组织对可解释性的定义差异很大，尽管一些组织展示了有前途的内部实践和可视化工具，以促进工程团队和新闻编辑室之间的沟通。基于我们的分析，我们为新闻工程师和研究人员提供了关于如何在新闻个性化流水线中采用可解释性方法的可行和实用的指导。
AI.summary: 本文通过对来自9家新闻机构的15名工程师进行半结构化访谈，探讨了新闻推荐系统中个性化和可解释性的实际应用与挑战，发现由于运营压力和编辑控制等原因，这两者在实际生产中往往受到限制，并据此提出了实用的改进指南。
AI.keywords: 新闻推荐, 个性化, 可解释性, 访谈研究, 新闻工程
AI.comments: 该研究填补了推荐系统可解释性研究中忽视开发者视角的空白，通过深入新闻机构工程师的访谈，揭示了实际生产环境中个性化和可解释性面临的种种现实阻碍与权衡。

title: Dual-Interest Sequential Product Recommendation With Multi-Granular SSM
summary: Sequential recommendation aims to predict the next item a user will interact with based on their historical behavior. Advances in Transformers have significantly improved sequential recommendation but are still limited by cost efficiency. Although State Space Models (SSMs) have recently enabled efficient long-range modeling, most existing methods encode each item with a single static contextual role, overlooking the phenomenon of item polysemy. In fact, the same item often plays different semantic roles depending on user context, and existing methods are limited in capturing dynamic behavior across different temporal granularities. In this work, we propose DSRec, a novel dual-interest cross-SSM model that explicitly disentangles item roles across long-term and short-term semantic context. Sequential items are encoded into long-term interest embeddings that capture stable preferences via historical aggregation, and a short-term interest branch that emphasizes local session intent modulated by inter-click time intervals. These interest embeddings are processed through distinct SSM encoders: a full-sequence Mamba for long-term modeling, and a time-modulated SSM that dynamically adjusts state evolution based on temporal gaps. To enable effective cross-granularity alignment, we adopt a residual cross-fusion mechanism that exchanges contextual information between the two branches while preserving semantic independence. Experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate that DSRec outperforms other state-of-the-art methods.

AI.title_translation: 基于多粒度 SSM 的双兴趣序列商品推荐
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于多粒度状态空间模型（SSM）的双兴趣序列推荐方法 DSRec，有效解决了物品多义性与长短期偏好建模问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的 Transformer 模型成本高昂，而基于状态空间模型（SSM）的方法通常将每个物品编码为单一的静态角色，忽略了物品的多义性以及不同时间粒度下的动态行为。
AI.method: 提出 DSRec 模型，包含处理长远稳定偏好的全序列 Mamba 分支和通过时间间隔调制、捕捉短期局部意图的时间调制 SSM 分支，并通过残差跨融合机制实现跨粒度对齐。
AI.result: 在公开基准数据集上的实验表明，DSRec 的性能优于其他最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: DSRec 能够有效捕捉用户的长短期双重兴趣并处理物品的多义性，在公开基准数据集上超越了现有的先进方法。
AI.translation: 序列推荐旨在根据用户的历史行为预测其下一个将要交互的物品。Transformer 的进展显著改进了序列推荐，但仍受限于成本效率。尽管状态空间模型（SSMs）最近实现了高效的长程建模，但大多数现有方法将每个物品编码为单一的静态上下文角色，忽视了物品的多义性现象。事实上，根据用户上下文的不同，同一个物品通常扮演不同的语义角色，且现有方法在捕捉不同时间粒度下的动态行为方面存在局限。在这项工作中，我们提出了 DSRec，一种新颖的双兴趣跨 SSM 模型，它显式地解耦了长短期语义上下文中的物品角色。序列物品被编码为通过历史聚合捕获稳定偏好的长短期兴趣嵌入，以及强调由点击间时间间隔调制的局部会话意图的短期兴趣分支。这些兴趣嵌入通过不同的 SSM 编码器进行处理：用于长期建模的全序列 Mamba，以及根据时间间隙动态调整状态演化的时间调制 SSM。为了实现有效的跨粒度对齐，我们采用了残差跨融合机制，在保持语义独立性的同时交换两个分支之间的上下文信息。在公共基准上的实验证明，DSRec 优于其他最先进的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 DSRec 的新型双兴趣跨 SSM 推荐模型。该模型通过长短期两个分支分别捕获用户的稳定偏好和受时间间隔调制的局部意图，利用不同的 SSM 编码器和残差跨融合机制，有效解决了物品多义性和长短期动态行为建模的问题，并在实验中取得了优于现有SOTA的效果。
AI.keywords: 序列推荐, 状态空间模型, 双重兴趣, 物品多义性, 跨时间粒度
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将状态空间模型（SSM）与双兴趣建模相结合，解决了序列推荐中物品多义性和长短期动态偏好捕捉的难题，同时兼顾了计算效率，具有很高的实用价值和学术意义。

title: OneBid: A Unified Auto-Bidding Foundation Model for Diverse oCPX Advertising Scenarios
summary: Auto-bidding is central to computational advertising, where strategies must maximize advertisers' conversion value under economic constraints. It has evolved from rule-based controllers to reinforcement learning and generative methods such as Decision Transformer (DT). Yet these methods increasingly mismatch the prevailing optimized cost-per-X (oCPX) paradigm, which spans heterogeneous scenarios (e.g., registration, purchase), each served by a separate model, leading to fragmented pipelines and underexploring cross-scenario modeling. Inspired by foundation models like LLMs, unifying these oCPX scenarios into one model raises three challenges: multi-objective control, scalable capacity under strict latency, and safe offline policy improvement. We present OneBid, a unified auto-bidding foundation model that learns a reusable backbone from heterogeneous oCPX logs and adapts it to scenario-specific deployments via offline post-training. Building on DT, OneBid extends single Return-to-Go conditioning to two atomic signals, Return-to-Go for conversion value and Cost-to-Go for cost ratio, plus value-aware regularization on next-action prediction. To absorb distributional heterogeneity, we design a sequence-level Mixture-of-Experts architecture, where shared experts encode cross-scenario knowledge and sparsely-routed experts capture scenario-specific patterns at low latency, yielding consistent scaling with model size and data. During post-training, we align the backbone with scenario preferences via Critic-guided Relative Offline Policy optimization (CROP): a learned critic scores candidate actions group-relatively, avoiding the unsafe online exploration of GRPO-style fine-tuning while constraining policy shift to reduce OOD risk. Validated via online A/B tests and fully deployed at Kuaishou, OneBid delivers an overall +2.2% ADVV gain on oCPX Ads, peaking at +13.1% in the ROAS scenario.

AI.title_translation: OneBid：面向多元oCPX广告场景的统一自动出价基础模型
AI.tldr: OneBid是一个统一的自动出价基础模型，通过多信号条件控制、MoE架构和CROP离线后训练，解决了多oCPX场景碎片化问题，并在快手广告投放中取得了显著收益。
AI.motivation: 传统的自动出价方法和模型无法很好地匹配当前主流的oCPX（优化的按转化成本计费）范式，导致各个异构场景各自使用独立模型，造成了管道碎片化且未能充分探索跨场景建模的潜力。
AI.method: 基于Decision Transformer进行扩展，引入Return-to-Go和Cost-to-Go双原子信号及值感知正则化；设计序列级混合专家（MoE）架构以捕捉异构场景的共性与特性；提出基于Critic引导的相对离线策略优化（CROP）进行高效安全的离线后训练。
AI.result: 在线上A/B测试中，OneBid在快手的oCPX广告上实现了整体+2.2%的广告价值（ADVV）增长，在ROAS场景中最高提升达+13.1%，并已全量部署。
AI.conclusion: OneBid成功将基础模型范式引入自动出价领域，通过统一的主干网络、MoE架构和CROP微调，实现了异构oCPX场景的高效泛化与安全部署，具有重要的工业应用价值。
AI.translation: 自动出价是计算广告的核心，其策略必须在经济约束下最大化广告主的转化价值。它已经从基于规则的控制器演变为强化学习和生成方法（如决策变换器，DT）。然而，这些方法日益与当前主流的优化按转化成本（oCPX）范式不匹配。oCPX涵盖了异构场景（如注册、购买），每个场景由单独的模型服务，导致了碎片化的流水线，且对跨场景建模的探索不足。受大语言模型等基础模型的启发，将这些oCPX场景统一到一个模型中带来了三个挑战：多目标控制、严格延迟下的可扩展容量以及安全的离线策略改进。我们提出了OneBid，一个统一的自动出价基础模型，它从异构的oCPX日志中学习可复用的主干网络，并通过离线后训练将其适配到特定场景的部署中。基于DT，OneBid将单一的Return-to-Go条件扩展为两个原子信号：用于转化价值的Return-to-Go和用于成本比率的Cost-to-Go，并对下一个动作预测进行了价值感知正则化。为了吸收分布异构性，我们设计了序列级混合专家（MoE）架构，其中共享专家编码跨场景知识，稀疏路由专家以低延迟捕捉场景特定模式，从而实现与模型大小和数据一致的扩展。在后训练期间，我们通过Critic引导的相对离线策略优化（CROP）将主干网与场景偏好对齐：一个学到的Critic对候选动作进行组相对评分，避免了GRPO式微调的不安全在线探索，同时限制策略偏移以降低分布外（OOD）风险。通过线上A/B测试验证并已在快手全面部署，OneBid在oCPX广告上实现了整体+2.2%的ADVV增长，在ROAS场景中峰值达到+13.1%。
AI.summary: 论文提出了OneBid，一个用于多元oCPX广告场景的统一自动出价基础模型。它通过扩展决策变换器（DT）、采用序列级MoE架构以及CROP离线后训练方法，解决了多目标控制、低延迟下的大规模容量以及安全离线策略优化等挑战，并在工业界取得了显著效果。
AI.keywords: Auto-bidding, Foundation Model, oCPX Advertising, Decision Transformer, Mixture-of-Experts
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种统一的自动出价基础模型OneBid，创新性地将多目标控制、序列级MoE架构以及基于CROP的离线后训练相结合，解决了传统oCPX广告场景中模型碎片化和跨场景学习不足的问题，并在工业界（快手）取得了显著的线上收益。

title: MIRAGE: Multi-Perspective Creative Language Model Reasoning with Reinforcement Learning Guidance
comments: 18 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the ICML 2025 Workshop on Multi-Agent Systems in the Era of Foundation Models: Opportunities, Challenges and Futures (MAS-2025)
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized artificial intelligence and how human interact with AIs. Despite impressive advancements, LLMs struggle with complex mathematical, scientific, and logical tasks. Inspired by human cognitive flexibility - our ability to dynamically switch mental perspectives - we propose MIRAGE (Multi-perspective Inference-time Reasoning via Agent-Guided Exploration), a novel inference-time creative thinking framework. MIRAGE includes a Selector that prioritizes effective conceptual perspectives (e.g., algebraic, probabilistic) and a Reasoner that sequentially solves tasks until a confident solution emerges, otherwise aggregating multiple perspectives. Tested on GSM8K, MATH500, MMLU-Pro, and Game-of-24 benchmarks, MIRAGE consistently outperforms methods like Chain-of-Thought and diverse prompting ensembles, significantly boosting accuracy with minimal inference overhead, providing a scalable solution for practical applications.
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the ICML 2025 Workshop on Multi-Agent Systems in the Era of Foundation Models: Opportunities, Challenges and Futures (MAS-2025)

AI.title_translation: MIRAGE：基于强化学习引导的多视角创造性语言模型推理
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为MIRAGE的新推理框架，通过模拟人类的多视角思维切换，显著提升了大语言模型在复杂数学、科学和逻辑任务中的准确率。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型取得了显著进展，但在处理复杂的数学、科学和逻辑任务时仍显不足，且缺乏人类那样动态切换思维视角的认知灵活性。
AI.method: 提出MIRAGE框架，包含一个优先选择有效概念视角的Selector和一个顺序求解直至高置信度解出现或聚合多视角的Reasoner。
AI.result: 在GSM8K、MATH500、MMLU-Pro和Game-of-24基准测试中，MIRAGE持续优于思维链（Chain-of-Thought）和多样化提示词集成方法，以最小的推理开销显著提高了准确率。
AI.conclusion: MIRAGE作为一种新颖的推理时创造性思维框架，能够有效提升大语言模型在数学、科学和逻辑任务中的表现，具有较高的实用价值和可扩展性。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展彻底改变了人工智能以及人类与AI交互的方式。尽管取得了令人瞩目的进展，LLM在处理复杂的数学、科学和逻辑任务时仍然存在困难。受人类认知灵活性——即动态切换思维视角的能力的启发，我们提出了MIRAGE（通过智能体引导探索的多视角推理时推理），这是一个新颖的推理时创造性思维框架。MIRAGE包含一个优先选择有效概念视角（如代数、概率）的Selector和一个顺序求解任务直至出现自信解、否则聚合多个视角的Reasoner。在GSM8K、MATH500、MMLU-Pro和Game-of-24基准测试上的测试表明，MIRAGE始终优于思维链和多样化提示词集成等方法，以最小的推理开销显著提高了准确率，为实际应用提供了可扩展的解决方案。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了MIRAGE框架，通过模拟人类认知灵活性进行多视角推理，利用Selector优先选择概念视角并通过Reasoner进行顺序求解或多视角聚合，从而有效提升大语言模型在复杂任务上的推理能力。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 推理时思维, 多视角推理, 强化学习, 智能体探索
AI.comments: 该论文引入了多视角推理框架MIRAGE，模仿人类思维的动态切换，结合强化学习引导和智能体探索，在多个复杂推理基准测试中展现出显著的性能提升和较低的推理开销。

title: Compact Partial Symmetry Breaking for Graph Search Problems
summary: Symmetry breaking in graph search problems remains challenging: complete symmetry breaking constraints are typically exponential in size, while partial approaches trade precision for scalability. We introduce a strength-driven, redundancy-aware methodology for constructing compact partial symmetry breaking constraints based on graph patterns. Each pattern corresponds to a Boolean clause over equality literals and can be integrated directly into CP or SAT models. Our approach incrementally selects strong, non-redundant graph patterns, yielding partial symmetry breaks that achieve substantial pruning of non-canonical graphs while remaining compact in size. This provides a principled framework for deriving lightweight partial symmetry breaking constraints which are significantly more precise than all published state-of-the-art alternatives. We evaluate the proposed constraints on graph instances with up to 25 vertices using a redundancy ratio metric. The resulting partial symmetry breaks constitute only a small fraction of the size of complete symmetry breaking constraints, while delivering significant performance improvements across several graph search benchmarks compared to previously defined partial symmetry breaking methods.

AI.title_translation: 图搜索问题的紧凑局部对称破除
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于图模式的紧凑局部对称破除方法，在图搜索问题中兼顾了小规模约束与高精度剪枝。
AI.motivation: 图搜索问题中的对称破除面临挑战：完全对称破除约束通常呈指数级大小，而现有的局部方法则在精度和可扩展性之间进行权衡，无法兼顾。
AI.method: 引入了一种基于图模式的强度驱动、冗余感知的方法来构建紧凑的局部对称破除约束，每个模式对应关于相等文字的布尔子句，并可增量选择强力且非冗余的图模式。
AI.result: 在多达25个顶点的图实例上进行的评估表明，该方法生成的局部对称破除约束远小于完整约束，且在多个图搜索基准测试中表现出显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在图实例测试中仅占完整对称破除约束极小比例的情况下，大幅超越了现有先进的局部对称破除方法，提升了图搜索基准的性能。
AI.translation: 图搜索问题中的对称破除仍然具有挑战性：完全对称破除约束的大小通常呈指数级增长，而局部方法则在精度和可扩展性之间进行权衡。我们引入了一种基于图模式的、强度驱动且感知冗余的方法，用于构建紧凑的局部对称破除约束。每个模式对应于关于相等文字的布尔子句，并且可以直接集成到CP或SAT模型中。我们的方法增量式地选择强大且非冗余的图模式，产生的局部对称破除在保持紧凑规模的同时，实现了对非规范图的大幅剪枝。这为一个有原则的框架提供了基础，用于推导轻量级的局部对称破除约束，其精度明显高于所有已发表的最先进替代方案。我们在多达25个顶点的图实例上，使用冗余率指标对提出的约束进行了评估。与先前定义的局部对称破除方法相比，所产生的局部对称破除仅占完全对称破除约束大小的一小部分，同时在多个图搜索基准测试中带来了显著的性能提升。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于图模式的紧凑型局部对称破除方法，通过增量选择强力且非冗余的图模式，在保持约束规模较小的同时，显著提高了图搜索问题（CP或SAT模型）的剪枝精度和性能。
AI.keywords: 图搜索, 对称破除, 图模式, 约束规划, SAT模型
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于图模式的新颖局部对称破除方法，通过强度驱动和冗余感知策略在保持约束规模紧凑的同时实现了显著的剪枝效果，对图搜索问题（如CP和SAT模型）具有重要推动作用。

title: On Repulsive and Attractive Teachers: Separating Correctness from Behavior in Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation provides dense, token-level supervision by conditioning a model on privileged information and distilling the resulting teacher distribution back into the model. However, privileged information can change not only what the teacher knows, but also how it behaves, entangling correctness-relevant learning signals with unintended behavioral shifts. We study this effect in reasoning tasks by contrasting attractive self-distillation, which moves the model toward a privileged teacher, with repulsive self-distillation, which moves it away from a privileged teacher. We find that both objectives can induce strong and opposing behavioral shifts: attraction suppresses exploratory reasoning and promotes shorter, more confident responses, whereas repulsion increases response length, can trigger unintended switches into a model's latent thinking mode, and ultimately becomes unstable. Motivated by these observations, we study contrastive self-distillation, which combines attraction toward a correct-solution-conditioned teacher with repulsion from an incorrect-solution-conditioned teacher. In contrast to prior work that combines such distillation signals with a GRPO objective, we isolate the self-distillation objective and study its behavior on its own. We find that the shared behavioral shifts of the two teachers largely cancel, leaving a token-level signal that more directly reflects correctness. Across non-thinking, instruct-only, and already-thinking models, this contrastive objective improves reasoning performance while maintaining stable response lengths.

AI.title_translation: 论排斥与吸引教师：在自蒸馏中将正确性与行为分离
AI.tldr: 通过结合吸引和排斥教师的信号，对比自蒸馏能够从自蒸馏中分离出正确性信号，在提升大模型推理能力的同时保持稳定的响应长度。
AI.motivation: 现有的在线自蒸馏中的特权信息不仅会改变模型所学的内容，还会改变其行为，导致正确性相关的学习信号与非预期的行为偏移相互纠缠。
AI.method: 通过对比吸引式自蒸馏（向特权教师靠拢）和排斥式自蒸馏（远离特权教师），并提出对比自蒸馏（结合正确解条件教师的吸引与错误解条件教师的排斥），孤立并研究自蒸馏目标。
AI.result: 吸引会抑制探索并产生更短、更自信的回答，而排斥会增加响应长度并导致不稳定；结合两者的对比自蒸馏能够抵消行为偏移，更直接地反映正确性，并在各类模型上提升推理性能同时保持稳定的响应长度。
AI.conclusion: 对比自蒸馏通过抵消两个教师共享的行为偏移，能够有效分离正确性与行为，在保持响应长度稳定的同时显著提升模型的推理性能。
AI.translation: 在线自蒸馏通过将模型条件化于特权信息，并将生成的教师分布蒸馏回模型，提供了一种密集的、token级别的监督。然而，特权信息不仅会改变教师所知晓的内容，还会改变其行为，使与正确性相关的学习信号与非预期的行为偏移纠缠在一起。我们在推理任务中研究了这一效应，通过对比“吸引式自蒸馏”（使模型向特权教师靠拢）与“排斥式自蒸馏”（使模型远离特权教师）。我们发现，这两种目标都会引起强烈且相反的行为偏移：吸引会抑制探索性推理并促进更短、更自信的回答，而排斥会增加回答长度、可能触发模型意外进入其潜在思考模式，并最终变得不稳定。受这些观察的启发，我们研究了“对比自蒸馏”，它结合了对正确解条件教师的吸引和对错误解条件教师的排斥。与以往将此类蒸馏信号与GRPO目标结合的工作不同，我们孤立了自蒸馏目标并单独研究其行为。我们发现，两个教师共享的行为偏移在很大程度上相互抵消，留下了更能直接反映正确性的token级信号。在非思考模型、仅指令模型和已有思考模型的实验中，这一对比目标在保持稳定响应长度的同时，提高了推理性能。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了在线自蒸馏中特权信息带来的行为偏移问题，发现吸引和排斥教师会引发强烈且相反的行为变化。在此基础上，作者提出了对比自蒸馏方法，通过结合对正确解教师的吸引和对错误解教师的排斥，成功解耦了正确性与行为，在提升推理性能的同时保持了响应长度的稳定。
AI.keywords: 自蒸馏, 强化学习, 推理任务, 行为偏移, 对比学习
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了自蒸馏中特权信息引入的行为偏差问题，通过巧妙地结合吸引和排斥教师信号，解耦了正确性与行为模式，为推理任务中的大模型训练提供了新的视角和高效的对比自蒸馏方法。

title: GameLogicBench: Evaluating Coding Agents on Runtime Game Logic with Tick-Level State Assertions
comments: 36 pages, 9 figures, 13 tables. Xinyu Che, Yunfei Ge, Shihao Li, Yanchen Liu, Hang Yan, and Xinping Lei contributed equally. Jiaheng Liu is the corresponding author. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/NJU-LINK/GameLogicBench
summary: Coding agents can modify and test code across large software projects. Game development is a domain where agents must implement gameplay rules. A game can end in a valid state even after violating its rules during the run. Current game-development benchmarks replay fixed examples, score videos, or ask another model to judge the result. However, no existing benchmark checks game rules throughout execution across varied evaluator-selected scenarios while ensuring exactly reproducible verdicts. We introduce GameLogicBench, a benchmark of 72 gameplay-logic tasks in Godot projects. An automated evaluator checks each game's rules at every simulation tick. Across 403 hand-designed scenarios, seeded parameter variations produce 1,451 test cases. To ensure that the evaluator measures behavior rather than implementation choice, it must accept different correct implementations for each task while rejecting mutants, implementations with one required capability removed. The tasks span isolated mechanics, multi-system interactions, and repository-scale features. Across 20 combinations of language models and scaffolds, the best observed run solves 52.78% of tasks. Under Claude Code, all twelve models solve fewer tasks as task scope expands from isolated mechanics, through interacting systems, to repository-scale features. Agents inspect code more often and make more tool calls on repository-scale tasks than on isolated-mechanic tasks. Most unsuccessful submissions are runnable, but implement some required game behavior incorrectly. We compared versions of our benchmark evaluator built with and without validation using mutants. Without this validation, incorrect agent submissions passed. A separate analysis finds agents copying code from public repositories when network access is open. Reliable evaluation thus depends both on what the tests reject and on what external code agents can access.
comment: 36 pages, 9 figures, 13 tables. Xinyu Che, Yunfei Ge, Shihao Li, Yanchen Liu, Hang Yan, and Xinping Lei contributed equally. Jiaheng Liu is the corresponding author. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/NJU-LINK/GameLogicBench

AI.title_translation: GameLogicBench：基于滴答级状态断言评估编码智能体在运行时游戏逻辑中的表现
AI.tldr: GameLogicBench 是一个新型基准，通过在游戏运行的每个模拟滴答进行状态断言，严格评估编码智能体在Godot项目中的游戏逻辑实现能力，揭示了当前大模型在处理复杂游戏开发任务时的显著局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有的游戏开发基准通常只重放固定示例、对视频评分或依赖其他模型判断，无法在整个执行过程中跨多样化场景进行严格、可复现且基于游戏规则的滴答级状态断言。因此，需要一个能够精确评估编码智能体运行时游戏逻辑实现能力的基准。
AI.method: 引入了包含72个Godot项目任务和1,451个测试用例的 GameLogicBench，使用自动化评估器在每个模拟滴答（tick）检查游戏规则，并通过变异测试（mutant validation）确保评估器能够容纳不同正确实现同时拒绝缺陷实现。
AI.result: 在20种语言模型与框架组合中，表现最好的组合解决了52.78%的任务。随着任务范围从孤立机制扩展到多系统交互和仓库级特征，所有模型的任务解决率均下降。大多数失败的提交虽然可运行，但游戏行为实现错误。没有变异验证的评估器会导致错误的智能体提交通过。
AI.conclusion: GameLogicBench 通过滴答级状态断言和严格的变异验证，成功评估了当前编码智能体在游戏逻辑实现上的不足。实验表明，随着任务规模扩大，模型性能下降，且可靠的评估高度依赖于严格的测试过滤和对外部代码访问的控制。
AI.translation: 编码智能体能够在大型软件项目中修改和测试代码。游戏开发是一个要求智能体实现游戏玩法规则的领域。游戏在运行过程中即使违反了规则，也可能以合法状态结束。当前的游戏开发基准重放固定示例、对视频评分或要求另一个模型来判断结果。然而，没有现有的基准能够在整个执行过程中检查游戏规则，跨越各种评估者选择的场景，同时确保完全可复现的判定。我们推出了 GameLogicBench，这是一个包含Godot项目中72个游戏玩法逻辑任务的基准。自动化评估器在每个模拟滴答（tick）检查每个游戏的规则。在403个手工设计的场景中，种子参数变化产生了1,451个测试案例。为了确保评估器衡量的是行为而不是实现选择，它必须接受每个任务的不同正确实现，同时拒绝突变体（即移除了一个必需功能的实现）。这些任务涵盖孤立机制、多系统交互和仓库级功能。在20种语言模型和框架的组合中，表现最好的运行解决了52.78%的任务。在Claude Code下，所有12个模型随着任务范围从孤立机制、交互系统扩展到仓库级功能，解决的任务越来越少。与孤立机制任务相比，智能体在仓库级任务上更频繁地检查代码并进行更多的工具调用。大多数不成功的提交是可以运行的，但实现了一些错误的游戏行为。我们比较了使用和不使用突变验证构建的基准评估器版本。如果没有这种验证，不正确的智能体提交就会通过。一项单独的分析发现，当网络访问开放时，智能体从公共仓库复制代码。因此，可靠的评估既取决于测试拒绝的内容，也取决于智能体可以访问的外部代码。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 GameLogicBench，这是一个用于评估编码智能体在Godot项目中实现运行时游戏逻辑能力的基准。该基准包含72个任务和1,451个测试用例，利用自动化评估器在每个模拟滴答（tick）进行状态断言，并通过变异体验证确保评估的准确性。实验表明，当前顶级智能体在面对复杂的仓库级游戏逻辑任务时仍面临严峻挑战。
AI.keywords: Coding Agents, Game Development, Benchmark, Tick-Level State Assertions, Godot Engine
AI.comments: GameLogicBench 提出了一个创新的游戏逻辑编码智能体评估基准，填补了当前基准无法在运行时进行滴答级（tick-level）状态断言的空白。该工作强调了对变异体（mutants）进行验证以确保评估器鲁棒性的重要性，并揭示了当前大模型在处理复杂、多系统及仓库级任务时的局限性。

title: On the Fourier Entropy-Influence Conjecture for Boolean Plateaued Functions
comments: 8 papes, the paper was written with the assistance of ChatGPT
summary:
We prove the following inequality for Boolean functions: $2\sum_{x\in F_2^n}f(x)wt(x)\geq wt(f)(n-deg(f))$. Using this inequality, we establish the Fourier Entropy-Influence (FEI) conjecture for Boolean plateaued functions. In particular, we show that the sharp FEI constant for the class of plateaued functions is 4. We also prove the FEI conjecture for partially bent functions and show that the corresponding sharp constant is 2. Finally, we derive several estimates for the p-biased distribution on the Boolean hypercube.
  Keywords: Fourier entropy, total influence, average sensitivity, plateaued function, algebraic degree, Reed-Muller code, p-biased distribution.

AI.title_translation: 关于布尔平展函数的傅里叶熵-影响猜想
AI.tldr: 论文证明了布尔平展函数和部分弯曲函数满足傅里叶熵-影响（FEI）猜想。
AI.motivation: 解决布尔函数领域中关于傅里叶熵-影响（FEI）猜想在特定函数类（如平展函数和部分弯曲函数）中的成立性问题。
AI.method: 通过证明一个新的布尔函数不等式（$2\sum_{x\in F_2^n}f(x)wt(x)\geq wt(f)(n-deg(f))$），结合傅里叶分析方法研究布尔平展函数的性质。
AI.result: 证明了布尔平展函数的FEI猜想且锐常数为4，证明了部分弯曲函数的FEI猜想且锐常数为2，并得出了p偏置分布的多个估计。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了布尔平展函数和部分弯曲函数满足傅里叶熵-影响猜想，并推导了p偏置分布的相关估计。
AI.translation: 我们证明了布尔函数的以下不等式：$2\sum_{x\in F_2^n}f(x)wt(x)\geq wt(f)(n-deg(f))$。利用这个不等式，我们为布尔平展函数建立了傅里叶熵-影响（FEI）猜想。特别是，我们证明了平展函数类的尖锐FEI常数是4。我们还证明了部分弯曲函数的FEI猜想，并表明相应的尖锐常数是2。最后，我们导出了布尔超立方体上p偏置分布的几个估计。
AI.summary: 该论文通过建立一个新的布尔函数不等式，成功证明了布尔平展函数和部分弯曲函数满足傅里叶熵-影响（FEI）猜想，并分别给出了它们的精确常数4和2，同时给出了p偏置分布的估计。
AI.keywords: Fourier entropy, total influence, plateaued function, algebraic degree
AI.comments: 该论文在布尔函数分析领域取得了重要进展，首次证明了布尔平展函数（plateaued functions）满足傅里叶熵-影响（FEI）猜想，并给出了精确常数，对理解布尔函数的复杂度和密码学性质具有重要意义。

title: kgsteward: a tool for building, reproducing and maintaining distributed knowledge graphs
summary: Collaborative research projects in life sciences increasingly need to integrate private, embargoed consortium data with public reference databases in order to reach statistically meaningful interpretations. The Resource Description Framework (RDF) is well suited to this task: it facilitates the integration of heterogeneous data sources, and allows researchers to keep data and their documentation as metadata in the same place, provided the knowledge graph itself remains private during the time course of the project. Nevertheless, the development and long-term maintenance of a scientific knowledge graph remains a challenging, labour-intensive endeavour owing to the state of constant flux of most public resources. To tackle this challenge, we present kgsteward, a Python command-line tool that builds and maintains knowledge graphs inside RDF stores from a single, version-controlled configuration file. kgsteward supports multiple triplestores, keeps the local graph up-to-date with its external sources possibly already in RDF, or transformed into it on the fly, and uses SPARQL 1.1 UPDATE commands to amend further imported RDF on the fly. It can also validate the resulting graph with SPARQL queries that double as usage examples for both human users and AI agents. kgsteward has already been used in several collaborative projects at the SIB Swiss Institute of Bioinformatics, and we demonstrate its applicability in two real-world international research projects: one that builds a library of plant extracts with chemical analyses and associated bio-activities, and a second that reconciles public reference resources for human metabolic-network reconstruction.

AI.title_translation: kgsteward：用于构建、复现和维护分布式知识图谱的工具
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 kgsteward 的 Python 工具，用于自动化构建、更新和维护生命科学领域的分布式知识图谱。
AI.motivation: 生命科学领域的协作研究需要将私有受限数据与公共数据库进行集成，但由于公共资源处于常态化变动中，科学知识图谱的开发和长期维护是一项极具挑战且劳民伤财的工作。
AI.method: 开发了名为 kgsteward 的 Python 命令行工具，支持多三元组存储，通过单一的、受版本控制的配置文件构建和维护知识图谱，利用 SPARQL 1.1 UPDATE 命令处理动态导入的 RDF，并使用 SPARQL 查询对生成的图谱进行验证。
AI.result: kgsteward 已成功应用于 SIB 瑞士生物信息学研究所的多个合作项目，并在植物提取物化学活性库构建和人类代谢网络重建这两个真实国际研究项目中验证了其适用性。
AI.conclusion: kgsteward 能够有效简化分布式知识图谱的构建与长期维护，已在多个生物信息学实际项目中得到成功应用。
AI.translation: 生命科学领域的合作研究日益需要将私有的、受限制的联合数据与公共参考数据库进行整合，以便得出具有统计学意义的解释。资源描述框架（RDF）非常适合这项任务：它促进了异构数据源的整合，并允许研究人员将数据及其文档作为元数据保存在同一位置，前提是知识图谱本身在项目期间保持私密。然而，由于大多数公共资源处于不断变化的状态，科学知识图谱的开发和长期维护仍然是一项具有挑战性且劳动力密集的工作。为了应对这一挑战，我们推出了 kgsteward，这是一个 Python 命令行工具，它可以通过单个受版本控制的配置文件在 RDF 存储中构建和维护知识图谱。kgsteward 支持多个三元组存储，使本地图谱与其外部源保持最新状态（这些源可能已经是 RDF 格式，或者可以即时转换为 RDF），并使用 SPARQL 1.1 UPDATE 命令即时修改进一步导入的 RDF。它还可以使用 SPARQL 查询来验证生成的图谱，这些查询同时也是人类用户和 AI 代理的使用示例。kgsteward 已经在 SIB 瑞士生物信息学研究所的几个合作项目中得到了应用，并且我们在两个现实世界的国际研究项目中展示了它的适用性：一个项目构建了包含化学分析和相关生物活性的植物提取物库，另一个项目协调了用于人类代谢网络重建的公共参考资源。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 kgsteward，这是一个基于 Python 的命令行工具，旨在帮助生命科学领域的协作研究轻松构建、复现和维护基于 RDF 的分布式知识图谱，解决了公共数据源频繁变动及私有数据整合的难题。
AI.keywords: 知识图谱, RDF, 数据集成, 生命科学, Python工具
AI.comments: 该论文针对生命科学领域分布式知识图谱构建与维护的痛点，提出了实用且自动化程度高的工具 kgsteward，有效解决了公共数据源变动频繁和私有数据安全整合的挑战。

title: Logics of Filter Bubbles
summary: Filter bubbles can be understood as configurations characterized by within-group proximity and separation from outsiders. Personalized feeds may form or preserve such configurations. We develop hybrid-style logics for reasoning about filter bubbles. The static logic characterizes bubble-shaped configurations, while its dynamic extension captures their formation and persistence under personalized feeds. We provide sound and strongly complete axiomatizations for the static and dynamic logics and prove their decidability.

AI.title_translation: 过滤泡的逻辑
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一套严密的静态与动态逻辑系统，用于形式化推理个性化推荐所带来的“信息茧房”（过滤泡）现象，并证明了其数学完备性与可判定性。
AI.motivation: 个性化推荐动态地形成或维持了“信息茧房”（过滤泡），其特征是组内邻近和与外人隔离。目前缺乏一种严密的、基于逻辑的形式化方法来推理这种配置及其动态演化过程。
AI.method: 开发了混合风格的逻辑系统，包括用于表征泡状配置的静态逻辑，以及用于捕捉个性化推送下泡状结构形成与持续性的动态扩展逻辑，并证明了其可靠性、强完备性和可判定性。
AI.result: 成功建立了一套能够对过滤泡进行推理的静态和动态逻辑系统，给出了可靠且强完备的公理化系统，并证明了这些逻辑的判定性（decidability）。
AI.conclusion: 本研究成功开发了用于推理过滤泡的静态和动态混合逻辑，并证明了其完备性和可判定性，为形式化分析个性化推荐带来的信息隔离现象奠定了理论基础。
AI.translation: 过滤泡可以被理解为一种以群组内部亲近和与外部人员隔离为特征的配置。个性化推送可能会形成或维持这种配置。我们开发了用于推理过滤泡的混合风格逻辑。静态逻辑刻画了泡状配置，而其动态扩展则捕捉了它们在个性化推送下的形成与持续。我们为静态和动态逻辑提供了可靠且强完备的公理化体系，并证明了它们的可判定性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一套用于推理过滤泡（信息茧房）的混合逻辑框架。通过静态逻辑刻画组内邻近与组外隔离的泡状配置，并通过动态扩展逻辑捕捉个性化推送下茧房的形成与持续，同时证明了该逻辑体系的可靠性、强完备性和可判定性。
AI.keywords: 过滤泡, 混合逻辑, 动态逻辑, 形式化推理, 可判定性
AI.comments: 本文将社会学和信息科学中的“信息茧房/过滤泡”概念引入形式化逻辑领域，通过开发静态和动态混合逻辑，为分析和推理信息茧房的结构特征及其形成机制提供了严密的数学工具。该研究在理论计算机科学和信息传播学交叉领域具有较高的创新价值。

title: Goal-Oriented Communication and Control Co-Design via Semantic Push-Pull in Industrial IoT
comments: 6 pages, 3 figures, accepted in IEEE Globecom 2026
summary: Emerging 6G industrial IoT architectures require wireless networked control systems capable of stabilizing diverse control loops over tightly constrained radio resources. Conventional periodic and Age-of-Information (AoI) based scheduling guarantees bounded staleness at the cost of persistent channel saturation. Conversely, pure event-triggered (PureET) strategies minimize transmissions but risk catastrophic silent deterioration when local sensor-side thresholds fail to reflect critical state evolution. To bridge this gap, we propose a communication-control co-design framework governed by a 6G Semantic Layer that independently arbitrates uplink and downlink resources. Instead of relying on freshness, our architecture evaluates the actual control impact of a packet using the state-to-error ratio (SER). We unify this control confidence with channel reliability in terms of signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) to orchestrate a threshold-based sensor push and a state-aware controller pull mechanism. To ensure equitable resource allocation across dynamically heterogeneous plants, the proposed framework explicitly scales actuation deadbands according to local plant dynamics. Simulations over Rayleigh-faded channels demonstrate that this approach fundamentally shifts the Pareto frontier between transmission rate and control quality. The proposed scheme achieves tracking accuracy comparable to periodic schedulers at a reduced communication overhead, while mitigating the estimation errors characteristic of PureET.

AI.title_translation: 工业物联网中基于语义推拉机制的面向目标通信与控制协同设计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种工业物联网中基于语义推拉机制的通信与控制协同设计方案，通过结合状态误差比和信噪比，在减少通信开销的同时显著提升了控制质量。
AI.motivation: 传统的周期性和基于信息年龄（AoI）的调度以持续信道饱和为代价保证有界陈旧度，而纯事件触发策略虽然减少了传输，但在局部阈值未能反映关键状态演变时存在灾难性无声恶化的风险。为了填补这一空白，需要设计一种既能保证控制性能又能降低通信开销的新型通信与控制协同框架。
AI.method: 提出由6G语义层主导的通信-控制协同设计框架，独立仲裁上下行资源；利用状态误差比（SER）评估数据包的控制影响，并将控制置信度与信噪比（SNR）结合，编排基于阈值的传感器“推”和状态感知控制器“拉”机制；根据本地植物动态显式缩放致动死区。
AI.result: 在Rayleigh衰落信道上的仿真表明，该方法从根本上改变了传输速率与控制质量之间的帕累托前沿，在降低通信开销的同时实现了与周期性调度器相当的跟踪精度，并减轻了纯事件触发策略的估计误差特征。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的语义推拉机制和基于植物动态的 actuation deadbands 缩放方法，能够在减少通信开销的同时，实现与周期性调度器相当的跟踪准确度，并避免纯事件触发策略带来的估计误差。
AI.translation: 新兴的6G工业物联网架构需要无线网络化控制系统，以便在严格受限的无线电资源上稳定各种控制回路。传统的周期性和基于信息年龄（AoI）的调度以持续的信道饱和为代价来保证有界陈旧度。相反，纯事件触发（PureET）策略虽能最小化传输，但当本地传感器端阈值无法反映关键状态演变时，存在发生灾难性无声恶化的风险。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一种由6G语义层主导的通信-控制协同设计框架，该框架可独立仲裁上行和下行资源。我们的架构不依赖于时效性，而是使用状态误差比（SER）评估数据包的实际控制影响。我们将这种控制控制置信度与信噪比（SNR）方面的信道可靠性统一起来，以编排基于阈值的传感器“推”和状态感知控制器“拉”机制。为了确保动态异构工厂之间的公平资源分配，所提出的框架根据本地工厂动态显式缩放致动死区。在Rayleigh衰落信道上的仿真表明，这种方法从根本上改变了传输速率与控制质量之间的帕累托前沿。与周期性调度程序相比，所提出的方案以较低的通信开销实现了可比拟的跟踪准确度，同时减轻了纯事件触发策略特征的估计误差。
AI.summary: 论文针对工业物联网中无线网络化控制系统的挑战，提出了一种基于语义推拉机制的通信与控制协同设计框架。该框架利用状态误差比（SER）和信噪比（SNR）进行资源编排，并通过动态缩放致动死区来平衡通信速率与控制质量。仿真结果证明了其在减少通信开销和保证控制精度方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 面向目标通信, 工业物联网, 语义层, 控制协同设计, 状态误差比
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种基于语义推拉机制的工业物联网面向目标通信与控制协同设计框架，通过引入状态误差比（SER）和信噪比（SNR）联合优化上下行资源，有效平衡了传输速率与控制质量。

title: Et Tu, MacBook? Unprivileged Keystroke Inference and Context Profiling via the Built-in IMU Side Channel
summary: Recent generations of Apple MacBooks embed an inertial measurement unit (IMU) within their unibody chassis for device orientation and motion sensing. However, this IMU inadvertently captures not only intended device-level information but also subtle physical vibrations from user interactions and the surrounding environment. These signals establish a novel, previously unexplored side channel. We uncover a vulnerability allowing non-root access to IMU data via an IOKit driver, alongside two content-free system metadata interfaces (HIDIdleTime and CGEventSource) that further enrich the side-channel leakage. Through rigorous characterization of the IMU data, we reveal that the leakage spans three core dimensions: (1) keystroke identity (which key is typed), (2) desk surface (where the laptop is placed), and (3) user behavior (who is typing). Leveraging these findings, we introduce BRUTUS, the first comprehensive unprivileged side-channel attack targeting built-in IMU sensors on Apple MacBooks. BRUTUS achieves a character-level accuracy of 89.1% to 97.5% in key recovery. Furthermore, aided by language models, it can successfully reconstruct certain sentences with 100% accuracy. For user identification and environment profiling, BRUTUS correctly discovers user and environment profiles without labels and correctly assigns subsequent segments to their corresponding profiles. Ultimately, this work highlights the urgent necessity of strictly regulating access to built-in IMU sensors.

AI.title_translation: MacBook，连你也这样？通过内置IMU侧信道进行无特权按键推断与环境画像分析
AI.tldr: 本论文发现苹果MacBook内置的IMU传感器存在侧信道漏洞，无特权用户可通过其物理振动信号以高精度推断键盘输入并进行用户和环境画像分析。
AI.motivation: 苹果MacBook内置的惯性测量单元（IMU）在用于设备方向和运动传感时，会无意中捕捉到用户交互和周围环境产生的微妙物理振动，从而形成一个未被探索过的新型侧信道，这引发了对无特权访问该传感器所带来的隐私和安全风险的担忧。
AI.method: 通过发现并利用无特权访问IMU数据的IOKit驱动程序，以及两个无内容的系统元数据接口（HIDIdleTime和CGEventSource），对IMU数据进行了严格表征，并结合语言模型开发了名为BRUTUS的综合侧信道攻击框架。
AI.result: BRUTUS在按键恢复方面实现了89.1%至97.5%的字符级准确率，借助语言模型能够以100%的准确率成功重构某些句子，并且能够正确识别和分类用户及环境画像。
AI.conclusion: 现代MacBook内置的IMU传感器存在严重的无特权侧信道安全隐患，可被利用进行高精度的键盘按键恢复及用户与环境画像分析，必须对内置传感器的访问权限进行严格监管。
AI.translation: 最新一代的苹果MacBook在其一体化机身中内置了一个惯性测量单元（IMU），用于设备方向和运动感应。然而，这个IMU不仅无意中捕获了预期的设备级信息，还捕获了来自用户交互和周围环境的微妙物理振动。这些信号建立了一个新颖的、此前未被探索过的侧信道。我们揭示了一个允许通过IOKit驱动程序进行IMU数据非root访问的漏洞，以及两个进一步丰富侧信道泄露的无内容系统元数据接口（HIDIdleTime和CGEventSource）。通过对IMU数据的严格表征，我们发现泄露跨越了三个核心维度：（1）按键身份（敲击了哪个键），（2）（笔记本电脑放置的）桌面表面，以及（3）用户行为（谁在敲击键盘）。利用这些发现，我们推出了BRUTUS，这是第一个针对苹果MacBook内置IMU传感器的全面的无特权侧信道攻击。BRUTUS在按键恢复方面实现了89.1%到97.5%的字符级准确率。此外，在语言模型的辅助下，它能够以100%的准确率成功重构某些句子。对于用户识别和环境画像，BRUTUS在无标签的情况下正确发现了用户和环境画像，并将后续片段正确分配到其对应的画像中。最终，这项工作凸显了严格监管内置IMU传感器访问权限的紧迫必要性。
AI.summary: 本文揭示了苹果MacBook内置IMU传感器存在的一个新型无特权侧信道漏洞，该漏洞允许通过特定接口泄露物理振动信号。研究人员推出了BRUTUS攻击框架，利用这些信号实现了高精度的按键推断、桌面表面识别和用户行为画像，凸显了严格管控硬件传感器访问权限的紧迫性。
AI.keywords: 侧信道攻击, 惯性测量单元 (IMU), 键盘输入推断, 硬件安全, 隐私漏洞
AI.comments: 该论文首次揭示并利用了现代苹果MacBook内置惯性测量单元（IMU）的侧信道漏洞，不仅实现了高精度的按键推断，还涵盖了桌面表面分析与用户行为画像，展示了硬件传感器无特权访问带来的严重隐私隐患，对未来的硬件安全与操作系统权限控制具有重要的警示作用。

title: CityLearn v3: A Configurable Simulation and Evaluation Framework for Realistic Control Studies of Renewable Energy Communities
summary: Renewable energy communities (RECs) coordinate buildings, photovoltaic generation, batteries, electric vehicles and flexible loads. Controller studies often simplify changing participation, equipment availability, service deadlines and data quality, so lower cost or peak demand can conceal missed services or infeasible power requests. This paper presents CityLearn v3, a configurable simulation and evaluation framework for REC control studies under these conditions. It represents changing members and assets, flexible-load deadlines, demand-response requests, local energy sharing, and data or equipment failures within one simulation environment. Building and phase power limits constrain controllable requests, while a declared timestep preserves consistent power-to-energy accounting. The framework records controller inputs and distinguishes requested actions from those applied to the simulated equipment. Reference controllers, service- and constraint-aware performance indicators, and trajectory exports support comparisons within and across communities. Software checks and application examples examine service delivery, electrical constraints, settlement and changing scenarios; a synthetic high-frequency trace replay illustrates how aggregation can conceal short peaks without changing annual energy. Together, these records allow aggregate performance to be interpreted alongside service failures, action reductions and participant-level outcomes.

AI.title_translation: CityLearn v3：用于可再生能源社区现实控制研究的可配置仿真与评估框架
AI.tldr: CityLearn v3是一个旨在填补控制研究与现实不确定性（如设备故障、约束、动态变化）之间差距的可再生能源社区仿真与评估框架。
AI.motivation: 现有的可再生能源社区（REC）控制器研究往往简化了参与者动态变化、设备可用性、服务期限以及数据质量等现实复杂性，导致低成本或低峰值需求的结果掩盖了实际中的服务缺失或不切实际的功率请求。
AI.method: 开发了CityLearn v3仿真框架，能够模拟成员与资产的动态变化、柔性负载期限、需求响应请求、本地能源共享以及数据/设备故障。通过功率限制约束控制请求、利用固定时间步长保证能量核算，并能记录控制器输入、区分请求动作与实际应用动作。
AI.result: 通过软件检查和应用示例验证了框架在服务交付、电气约束、结算和动态场景方面的能力，高频轨迹回放示例展示了聚合如何掩盖短期峰值而不改变年能耗，实现了将总体性能与服务故障、动作缩减及参与者级结果结合解释的目的。
AI.conclusion: CityLearn v3有效弥补了现有研究中对现实不确定性（如故障、动态变化及约束）模拟不足的缺陷，为可再生能源社区的控制研究提供了一个强大、可配置且具现实指导意义的仿真评估工具。
AI.translation: 可再生能源社区（RECs）协调建筑、光伏发电、电池、电动汽车和灵活负载。控制器研究往往简化了动态参与、设备可用性、服务期限和数据质量，因此较低的成本或峰值需求可能会掩盖丢失的服务或不可行的功率请求。本文介绍了CityLearn v3，一个在这些条件下用于REC控制研究的可配置仿真和评估框架。它在一个仿真环境中代表了不断变化的成员和资产、灵活的负载期限、需求响应请求、本地能源 sharing（共享）、以及数据或设备故障。建筑和相功率限制约束了可控请求，同时声明的时间步长保持了持续的功率到能量核算。该框架记录控制器输入，并将请求的操作与应用于模拟设备的动作区分开来。参考控制器、服务和约束感知性能指标以及轨迹导出支持社区内部和跨社区的比较。软件检查和应用示例检查了服务交付、电气约束、结算和不断变化的场景；合成的高频轨迹重放说明了聚合如何在不改变年度能源的情况下掩盖短期峰值。总之，这些记录允许将聚合性能与服务失败、操作减少和参与者级结果一起进行解释。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了CityLearn v3，一个用于可再生能源社区控制研究的可配置仿真与评估框架。它在一个环境中整合了动态成员与资产变化、柔性负载期限、需求响应、能源共享及设备故障等现实因素，并提供物理约束处理、动作记录和全面的性能指标，以支持真实且可比的控制研究。
AI.keywords: 可再生能源社区, 强化学习控制, 仿真框架, 电网约束, 需求响应
AI.comments: 该论文提出的CityLearn v3框架通过引入设备故障、动态参与、柔性负载期限等现实挑战以及精细化的功率约束与动作矫正机制，显著提升了可再生能源社区控制研究的真实性与评估准确性。

title: SABER: Learning Attention-based Semantic Affordance for Legged Locomotion
summary: Perceptive legged locomotion has advanced rapidly by integrating terrain geometry into learned policies, yet the integration of terrain meaning remains sparse: a pipe, a patch of grass, or a fragile box may be geometrically traversable while being inappropriate for contact. In industrial environments, where legged robots increasingly operate, a single misplaced step can damage fragile equipment, destabilize the robot, or endanger the site. To address this, we introduce SABER, a planner-free reinforcement-learning policy that jointly reasons about terrain geometry and semantic contact permission. The policy consumes a unified terrain-affordance map, where each cell encodes local 3D geometry and a semantic contact cost. We augment cross-attention with a learned, signed semantic bias: an additive term on the attention logits, gated by the contact cost, that reweights flagged cells by their distance from the nearest foot. A hazard therefore reshapes attention where it can still affect the next foothold, and its influence fades where it cannot. The resulting policy selects footholds on permitted support and keeps the leg clear of forbidden regions throughout the swing phase. We perform a systematic ablation that isolates the contribution of each architectural component; removing the semantic bias alone increases forbidden contacts by 55% while velocity tracking is unchanged. We validate the policy on a Unitree B2, demonstrating sim-to-real semantic contact selection across indoor and outdoor environments and four semantic obstacle classes.

AI.title_translation: SABER：学习基于注意力的腿式机器人语义可供性 locomotion
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为SABER的强化学习策略，使四足机器人能够结合地形几何与语义信息，实现安全的语义接触选择和避障。
AI.motivation: 现有的感知型腿式 locomotion 主要关注地形几何，忽略了地形的语义含义（如管道、草地或易碎箱子），导致机器人在工业环境中因踩错一步而损坏设备或自身失稳。
AI.method: 提出了一种无需规划器的强化学习策略SABER，利用统一的地形-可供性地图编码局部3D几何与语义接触代价，并在交叉注意力机制中引入学习得到的带符号语义偏差（基于接触代价门控、随距离衰减的注意力对数加权项）。
AI.result: 消融实验表明，仅去除语义偏差就会导致违规接触增加55%，同时速度跟踪性能保持不变；在Unitree B2上的实验成功验证了该策略在室内外环境及四类语义障碍中的sim-to-real表现。
AI.conclusion: SABER通过将语义接触代价与交叉注意力机制结合，使四足机器人能够学会在感知几何的同时辨别语义可通行区域，显著减少了违规接触，并在真实世界的室内外环境中得到了有效验证。
AI.translation: 感知型腿式 locomotion 通过将地形几何形状整合到学习策略中取得了快速进展，但对地形含义的整合仍然很少：一根管道、一块草地或一个易碎的箱子在几何上可能是可通过的，但并不适合接触。在四足机器人日益运行的工业环境中，一步踩错就可能损坏易碎设备、破坏机器人稳定或危及现场安全。为了解决这一问题，我们介绍了SABER，这是一种无需规划器的强化学习策略，能够联合推理地形几何形状和语义接触许可。该策略消耗统一的地形-可供性地图，其中每个单元格编码局部3D几何形状和语义接触代价。我们将交叉注意力机制与学习到的、带符号的语义偏差进行了增强：这是注意力对数（attention logits）上的一个附加项，由接触 cost 门控，并根据标记单元格距离最近脚部的距离进行重新加权。因此，危险会在仍能影响下一个落脚点的地方重塑注意力，而在不能影响的地方其影响会减弱。由此产生的策略在允许的支撑点上选择落脚点，并在整个摆动阶段使腿部远离禁区。我们进行了系统的消融实验，隔离了各个架构组件的贡献；仅去除语义偏差就会使违规接触增加55%，同时速度跟踪保持不变。我们在Unitree B2上验证了该策略，展示了跨室内外环境和四个语义障碍类别的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）语义接触选择。
AI.summary: 论文提出了SABER，一种通过在注意力机制中融入语义偏差来实现联合几何与语义可供性推理的强化学习策略，使四足机器人能够在复杂环境中选择合法支撑点并避开禁区。
AI.keywords: 腿式机器人, 语义可供性, 强化学习, 步态规划, 地形感知
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将语义信息（如材质、脆弱性等）与地形几何学结合，引入了基于注意力的语义可供性（Semantic Affordance）学习方法，解决了具身智能机器人在复杂工业环境中盲目依几何通行而引发的安全风险，具有很强的实用价值和出色的sim-to-real表现。

title: Micro-Collaborative Poisoning: A Distributed Attack on RAG Systems
comments: 19 pages, 3 images, 4 tables, conference: 31st European Symposium on Research in Computer Security (ESORICS) 2026, Workshop: 2nd Workshop on the Use of Large Language Models for Cybersecurity
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves large language models by grounding outputs in external knowledge sources, but this dependency also creates a surface for poisoning attacks. This paper introduces Micro-Collaborative Poisoning, a distributed attack in which a false target claim is divided across multiple locally plausible documents instead of being concentrated in a single malicious passage. We evaluate the attack across 108 RAG configurations by varying dataset, retriever architecture, retrieval depth, database composition, number of poisoned databases, and generator model. The results indicate that Micro-Collaborative Poisoning is not driven by a single dominant poisoned passage, but by the accumulation of weak adversarial signals across retrieved sources. Increasing top-$k$ and poisoning multiple databases make it more likely that these signals will appear together in the retrieved context, while clean database diversity and stronger retrievers can reduce their influence. The document-level poisoning visibility analysis further shows that this threat is difficult to expose through isolated document inspection, since Micro-Collaborative Poisoning achieves downstream influence while leaving a weaker explicit poisoning signature than direct poisoning.

AI.title_translation: 微协作投毒：对RAG系统的分布式攻击
AI.tldr: 提出一种新型分布式RAG投毒攻击：微协作投毒，通过将虚假信息分散到多个文档中实现隐蔽且高效的攻击。
AI.motivation: RAG系统依赖外部知识源改善大语言模型输出的同时，也带来了投毒攻击的风险；传统的投毒攻击集中于单个恶意段落，容易被检测，因此需要研究更隐蔽的分布式攻击方式。
AI.method: 提出微协作投毒攻击，并将虚假目标声明分散到多个局部合理的文档中；在108种RAG配置（涵盖不同数据集、检索器架构、检索深度、数据库组合、中毒数据库数量及生成模型）下评估了该攻击。
AI.result: 攻击效果并非由单个主导的中毒段落驱动，而是源于检索源中弱对抗信号的积累；增加top-$k$和中毒多个数据库会提高攻击成功率，而干净数据库的多样性和更强的检索器可以降低其影响；文档级可见性分析表明该威胁难以通过隔离文档检查来暴露。
AI.conclusion: 微协作投毒能够有效绕过孤立文档检查，对RAG系统构成隐蔽且强大的威胁，防御此类攻击需要结合全局上下文分析与更强的检索器和干净数据库多样性。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将输出建立在外部知识源上来改进大语言模型，但这种依赖性也为其带来了投毒攻击的攻击面。本文介绍了微协作投毒（Micro-Collaborative Poisoning），这是一种分布式攻击，其中一个虚假的目标声明被分散到多个局部合理的文档中，而不是集中在一个恶意段落中。通过改变数据集、检索器架构、检索深度、数据库组成、中毒数据库数量以及生成器模型，我们在108种RAG配置中评估了该攻击。结果表明，微协作投毒不是由单个主导的中毒段落驱动的，而是由检索到的源中弱对抗信号的积累驱动的。增加top-$k$和中毒多个数据库使得这些信号更有可能一起出现在检索到的上下文中，而干净数据库的多样性和更强的检索器可以降低其影响。文档级投毒可见性分析进一步表明，这种威胁很难通过孤立的文档检查来暴露，因为微协作投毒在产生下游影响的同时，留下的显式投毒特征比直接投毒更弱。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对RAG系统的分布式投毒攻击——微协作投毒（Micro-Collaborative Poisoning），它将虚假声明拆分到多个看似合理的文档中，通过弱对抗信号的积累实现下游影响，且由于签名较弱而难以通过孤立文档检测发现。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成 (RAG), 投毒攻击, 分布式攻击, 大语言模型, 对抗性信号
AI.comments: 该论文针对RAG系统的安全性提出了一种新颖的分布式投毒攻击，通过将虚假信息分散到多个文档中规避传统基于单文档的检测，具有重要的安全警示意义。

title: GestureFAR: Streaming Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Flow Autoregression
summary: Generating natural co-speech gestures from streaming speech is essential for embodied conversational agents, where motion must be produced while a user is still speaking. Recent streaming gesture systems make online generation possible by autoregressing over discrete motion tokens, but this design compresses high-dimensional continuous motion into finite codebooks and can limit the realism and diversity of generated gestures. To preserve both causality and continuous expressiveness, we propose \textbf{GestureFAR}, a flow-autoregressive framework for streaming co-speech gesture generation. First, GestureFAR autoregresses over causal continuous motion latents, using a transformer to model streaming audio-motion context and a per-token flow-matching head to sample the next latent from a continuous distribution. Second, we introduce a head-only flow distillation strategy that freezes the causal backbone and distills the multi-step per-token flow head into a single network evaluation using consistency and distribution-matching objectives. This keeps the model token-causal while removing the main latency bottleneck for live interaction. Experiments on BEAT2 show that GestureFAR significantly improves the quality--latency trade-off among streaming-capable methods, preserving strong gesture quality while enabling real-time token-causal generation. Project Page: https://andypinxinliu.github.io/GestureFAR

AI.title_translation: GestureFAR：基于流自回归的流式伴随语音手势生成
AI.tldr: GestureFAR提出了一种基于流自回归和流蒸馏的流式伴随语音手势生成框架，在保证实时因果生成的同时显著提升了手势的质量与表现力。
AI.motivation: 现有的流式手势生成系统主要依赖离散动作标记的自回归，这压缩了高维连续动作，限制了生成手势的真实感与多样性；同时，为了在保持因果关系的同时提供连续表现力并实现实时交互，需要解决流式生成中的延迟瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出GestureFAR框架，利用Transformer对流式音频-动作上下文进行因果连续动作潜变量的自回归建模，并通过每标记流匹配头及头部流蒸馏策略实现单次网络评估，确保动作因果性并降低延迟。
AI.result: 在BEAT2数据集上的实验表明，GestureFAR显著提升了流式方法的质量-延迟权衡，在保持强大手势质量的同时实现了实时、标记因果的生成。
AI.conclusion: GestureFAR通过流自回归与头部流蒸馏策略，成功实现了高质量且实时的流式伴随语音手势生成，显著改善了现有方法的质量与延迟权衡。
AI.translation: 从流式语音中生成自然的伴随语音手势对于具身对话智能体至关重要，因为动作必须在用户仍在说话时生成。最近的流式手势系统通过对离散动作标记进行自回归，使在线生成成为可能，但这种设计将高维连续动作压缩到了有限的代码本中，从而限制了生成手势的真实感和多样性。为了保持因果关系和连续表现力，我们提出了GestureFAR，这是一个用于流式伴随语音手势生成的流自回归框架。首先，GestureFAR对因果连续动作潜变量进行自回归，使用Transformer来建模流式音视频上下文，并利用每标记流匹配头从连续分布中采样下一个潜变量。其次，我们引入了一种仅头部的流蒸馏策略，该策略冻结因果主干网络，并使用一致性和分布匹配目标，将多步每标记流头蒸馏为单次网络评估。这保持了模型的标记因果性，同时消除了实时交互的主要延迟瓶颈。在BEAT2上的实验表明，GestureFAR显著改善了流式方法之间的质量-延迟权衡，在保持强大的手势质量的同时实现了实时的标记因果生成。
AI.summary: GestureFAR是一种用于流式伴随语音手势生成的流自回归框架，它通过因果连续动作潜变量自回归和头部流蒸馏策略，在保持实时因果生成的同时，显著提升了手势的质量与真实感。
AI.keywords: 伴随语音手势生成, 流自回归, 流匹配, 实时交互, 具身对话智能体
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了流匹配与自回归机制，解决了流式手势生成中连续动作表达与因果实时性之间的矛盾，并通过流蒸馏技术有效消除了延迟瓶颈，对具身对话智能体的发展具有重要意义。

title: Tilt as a Certified Resource: Preserving Motor Wrench-Rate Authority on Articulated Multirotors
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Fully-actuated multirotor aerial vehicles must not only track nominal wrenches but retain the "readiness" to modulate them rapidly under disturbances. Classical effort-minimizing allocators ignore this dynamic limit, whereas maximizing readiness leads to topologically disconnected optimal sheets demanding physically impossible actuator rates. Enforcing a readiness safety floor on fixed-geometry symmetric platforms further encounters a zero-sum degeneracy: motor-speed redistribution cannot improve authority without conceding wrench tracking. This paper uses active morphology to break the degeneracy, treating servo tilt as a geometric resource supplying authority-recovery directions unavailable to static rotors. We construct a configuration-dependent, motor-only readiness certificate - the log-volume of the reachable wrench-rate set - that explicitly excludes servo capacity, preventing a "ghost capacity fallacy" in which the certificate would falsely credit slow mechanical kinematic limits instead of collapsing accurately at motor saturation. The certificate is enforced as a Control Barrier Function (CBF) within a Unified Physical-Command Quadratic Program acting on motor torques and servo setpoints. Closed-loop simulations of an articulated octorotor under severe gust disturbances show classical allocators diverging and uncertified articulated allocators violating the safety floor, while the proposed CBF filter bounds the system state and preserves vehicle authority.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

AI.title_translation: 倾斜作为一种经认证的资源：保持关节型多旋翼的电机螺旋桨速率控制权
AI.tldr: 本文提出利用主动倾斜机制作为几何资源，并通过控制屏障函数（CBF）确保持续的电机响应速率，从而解决全驱动多旋翼在扰动下的控制权丢失问题。
AI.motivation: 全驱动多旋翼飞行器不仅需要跟踪名义 wrench，还需要在扰动下保持快速调节它们的“就绪状态”（readiness）。传统的最小努力分配器忽略了这一动态限制，而固定几何平台则面临零和退化问题，无法在不牺牲 wrench 跟踪的前提下提高控制权。为此，本文利用主动形态来打破这种退化。
AI.method: 构建了一个与构型相关的、仅限电机的就绪状态证书（即可达 wrench-rate 集的对数体积），排除了伺服容量以避免“虚假容量谬误”，并将其作为控制屏障函数（CBF）实施于统一的物理指令二次规划中，作用于电机扭矩和舵机设定值。
AI.result: 在严重阵风扰动下的闭环仿真表明，经典分配器会出现发散，未经认证的关节型分配器会违反安全底线，而所提出的 CBF 滤波器成功约束了系统状态并保持了车辆的控制权。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于控制屏障函数的倾斜资源分配方法，能有效防止全驱动多旋翼在扰动下的控制权丧失和状态发散，为关节型多旋翼的安全控制提供了新范式。
AI.translation: 全驱动多旋翼飞行器不仅必须跟踪名义上的 wrench，还必须保持在扰动下迅速调节它们的“就绪状态”（readiness）。经典的努力最小化分配器忽略了这一动态极限，而最大化就绪状态则会导致拓扑上断开的最优片，需要物理上不可能的执行器速率。在固定几何对称平台上强制执行就绪安全底线还会遇到零和简并：电机速度重新分配无法在不妥协 wrench 跟踪的情况下提高权威性。本文利用主动形态来打破简并，将伺服倾斜视为一种几何资源，提供静态转子所不具备的权威恢复方向。我们构建了一个依赖于配置的、纯电机的就绪证书——可达 wrench-rate 集的对数体积——它明确排除了伺服容量，防止了“幽灵容量谬误”，即证书会错误地将缓慢的机械运动学限制归功于电机饱和时准确崩溃。该证书作为控制屏障函数（CBF）在作用于电机扭矩和伺服设定值的统一物理命令二次规划中强制执行。在严重阵风扰动下的关节型八旋翼闭环仿真表明，经典分配器会发散，未经认证的关节型分配器会违反安全底线，而所提出的 CBF 滤波器限制了系统状态并保留了车辆的权威性。
AI.summary: 本文针对全驱动多旋翼飞行器在扰动下保持动态调节能力（就绪状态）的问题，提出利用主动形态（倾斜伺服）作为几何资源来打破传统构型的零和退化。通过构建一个仅包含电机的就绪证书并将其作为控制屏障函数（CBF）嵌入二次规划中，实现了在严重扰动下有效保护系统状态并维持飞行器控制权。
AI.keywords: 全驱动多旋翼, 动量控制, 主动形态, 控制屏障函数, 空间可达性
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地利用主动形态（active morphology）打破了传统多旋翼固定几何构型的零和退化困境，将倾斜角度作为一种有证书的资源（certified resource），通过控制屏障函数（CBF）保障了全驱动多旋翼在严重扰动下的动态响应能力和安全性。

title: Predictive Suppression Layers for Communication-Efficient Spiking Neural Networks
comments: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the 1st Neuromorphic Physical Layer Signal Processing for Wireless Systems Workshop (NeuroPHY 2026), co-located with EWSN 2026
summary: Feedforward Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) typically propagate every generated spike indiscriminately, disregarding whether the information is redundant from an information-theoretic perspective. This lack of selectivity induces high redundancy in inter-layer communication, creating an expensive overhead, e.g., in scenarios involving many-core neuromorphic hardware or communication-dominated Internet-of-Things (IoT) where features are transmitted wirelessly. To address this challenge, we trade localized processing for leaner network channels by introducing a minimal predictive coding framework for SNNs. We propose two layer variants sharing a predictor block: error units, which transmit signed spiking residuals, and predictive suppression, which uses residual magnitude to dynamically gate and forward only unpredictable, "surprising" activity. Evaluated on the N-MNIST and Spiking Heidelberg Digits (SHD) datasets using diagnostic metrics that decouple local processing from cross-layer communication, our new predictive coding layers achieve significant communication savings. Numerical results reveal a three-fold reduction in communicated activity, while increasing the task accuracy for both datasets. The latter finding is notable, and suggests that predictive coding layers not only minimize communication overhead, but also produce output feature vectors with a higher representation power.
