title: Fair Prophets
summary:
We initiate the study of $α$-fair prophet inequalities. This interpolates between utilitarian welfare $(α=0)$, Nash welfare $(α=1)$, and Rawlsian max-min fairness $(α\to\infty)$. Given the non-linearity of the objective, it matters when the expectation is applied. For instance, for the Rawlsian objective, it matters whether we aim to maximize $\min \mathbb{E}[u_i]$ or $\mathbb{E}[\min u_i]$. We refer to the former as the ex-ante model, and the latter as the ex-post model.
  For ex-ante fairness, full distributional knowledge yields a tight competitive ratio of exactly $1/2$ for every $α\ge 0$. Under sample access, $O(n\log n)$ samples per distribution suffice for a constant competitive ratio when $α\in(0,1]$. In contrast, for every $α>1$, no finite number of samples improves upon the trivial $1/n$ guarantee. Thus, unlike in the utilitarian setting, full-information and sample-access prophet inequalities become fundamentally separated.
  For ex-post fairness, under full information, we obtain a uniform constant ratio for all $α\in(0,1)$, while for every $α>1$ the competitive ratio collapses to $1/n$. In the sample-access model, one sample per distribution suffices for each fixed $α<1$, but no sample budget depending only on $n$ yields a uniform constant guarantee as $α\to 1$. Beyond these phase transitions for $α$-fairness, our results open the door to a broader theory of prophet inequalities for non-linear welfare objectives.

AI.title_translation: 公平先知
AI.tldr: 本文首次研究了α-公平先知不等式，探讨了事前与事后两种公平性模型在不同信息（全信息与样本访问）下的竞争比与相变规律。
AI.motivation: 现有的先知不等式（prophet inequalities）研究主要集中在功利主义福利最大化上，缺乏对考虑公平性（如纳什福利和罗尔斯最大最小公平）的非线性福利目标的系统研究。为此，本文旨在填补这一空白，建立α-公平先知不等式的理论框架。
AI.method: 研究了ex-ante（事前）和ex-post（事后）两种公平性模型，在全信息和样本访问（sample access）两种设定下分析了竞争比（competitive ratio），并探讨了不同α值和样本数量对结果的影响。
AI.result: 对于事前公平，全信息下所有α≥0均给出1/2的紧凑竞争比；样本访问下α∈(0,1]时O(n log n)个样本足够，而α>1时样本无能为力。对于事后公平，全信息下α∈(0,1)时获得统一常数比，而α>1时崩溃至1/n；样本访问下α<1时每个分布一个样本足够，但当α→1时无法得到统一常数保证。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了α-公平先知不等式的理论基础，揭示了全信息与样本访问模型之间以及不同α值之间的根本差异与相变规律，拓展了先知不等式在非线性福利目标领域的研究。
AI.translation:
我们开启了对$\alpha$-公平先知不等式的研究。这在功利主义福利（$\alpha=0$）、纳什福利（$\alpha=1$）和罗尔斯式最大最小公平（$\alpha\to\infty$）之间进行了插值。鉴于目标的非线性性，期望应用的时机至关重要。例如，对于罗尔斯目标，优化$\min \mathbb{E}[u_i]$还是$\mathbb{E}[\min u_i]$会产生不同结果。我们将前者称为事前模型，后者称为事后模型。
对于事前公平，完全分布知识对每个$\alpha\ge 0$给出了正好为$1/2$的紧凑竞争 ratio。在样本访问下，当$\alpha\in(0,1]$时，每个分布$O(n\log n)$个样本足以实现常数竞争比。相比之下，对于每个$\alpha>1$，没有有限数量的样本能改进琐碎的$1/n$保证。因此，与功利主义设定不同，完全信息和样本访问先知不等式发生了根本性的分离。
对于事后公平，在完全信息下，我们对所有$\alpha\in(0,1)$获得了统一的常数比，而对于每个$\alpha>1$，竞争比崩溃至$1/n$。在样本访问模型中，对于每个固定的$\alpha<1$，每个分布一个样本就足够了，但当$\alpha\to 1$时，没有仅取决于$n$的样本预算能产生统一的常数保证。除了这些$\alpha$-公平性的相变之外，我们的结果为非线性福利目标的先知不等式更广泛的理论打开了大门。
AI.summary: 该论文首次研究了α-公平先知不等式，通过引入事前（ex-ante）和事后（ex-post）模型，在全信息和样本访问设定下分析了不同公平参数下的竞争比，揭示了非线性福利目标下先知不等式的复杂相变与理论边界。
AI.keywords: 先知不等式, α-公平性, 机制设计, 样本复杂度, 福利目标
AI.comments: 该论文首次研究了α-公平先知不等式（α-fair prophet inequalities），将功利主义福利、纳什福利和罗尔斯式最大最小公平性有机结合。研究揭示了在不同信息模型（全信息与样本访问）和不同公平参数下竞争比的相变现象，为非线性福利目标的先知不等式理论开辟了新方向。

title: RheoSampling: Resolving the One-Hot Dilemma in Stochastic Dynamic-Tree Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel, with tree-based methods further improving efficiency through hierarchical structures. Dynamic-tree methods such as EAGLE-3 perform well under greedy decoding via deterministic top-K expansion and global pruning. However, in stochastic decoding (T>0), this mechanism collapses the draft distribution into one-hot probabilities, causing a severe drop in acceptance rate. This creates a dilemma: dynamic-tree methods sacrifice stochastic sampling to preserve context-aware topology, while static-tree methods preserve stochastic sampling with context-agnostic structures. The issue arises because the same probability distribution is used for two conflicting tasks: constructing the tree and verifying tokens. This coupling makes direct injection of randomness challenging due to the resulting stochastic process. We resolve this by decoupling these roles: RheoSampling assigns a token sampled from the draft distribution a proxy probability for tree expansion and pruning alongside its true sampling probability for verification. Specifically, we inject a sampled token among the deterministic top-K slots and treat it with different probabilities during construction and verification, making RheoSampling the first dynamic-tree method with both context-aware top-K construction and stochastic sampling while maintaining losslessness. We establish the lossless guarantee through an equivalence-class analysis that compresses the stochastic tree space into tractable classes. An OT-based verification strategy and a sparse draft mechanism ensure that theoretical gains translate into practical efficiency. Experiments across LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate improvements in acceptance rate and speedup over state-of-the-art dynamic tree methods. This framework may provide a template for analyzing stochastic tree structures.

AI.title_translation: RheoSampling：解决随机动态树推测解码中的独热困境
AI.tldr: 提出RheoSampling，解决了大语言模型随机动态树推测解码中的“独热困境”，在保持无损的前提下实现了高效的随机动态树生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的动态树推测解码方法（如EAGLE-3）在随机解码（T>0）下会导致草稿分布退化为独热概率，造成接受率急剧下降。这是由于同一概率分布被同时用于构建树和验证Token这一矛盾任务导致的。为了打破这种将随机性直接注入的困境，需要设计一种能够同时具备上下文感知和随机采样能力的无损动态树方法。
AI.method: 提出RheoSampling方法，通过解耦树构建与Token验证的角色，为草稿分布中采样的Token分配用于树扩展和剪枝的代理概率以及用于验证的真实采样概率；结合基于最优输运（OT）的验证策略和稀疏草稿机制，并通过等价类分析证明其无损性。
AI.result: 实验表明，RheoSampling在多个大语言模型和基准测试中，相较于现有的动态树方法，显著提高了接受率和推理加速比。
AI.conclusion: RheoSampling成功解决了动态树推测解码在随机采样下的独热困境，通过解耦角色、代理概率分配以及基于OT的验证策略，在保证无损的前提下显著提升了随机解码的接受率和推理加速比。
AI.translation: 推测解码通过并行生成多个Token来加速大语言模型推理，而基于树的方法则通过分层结构进一步提升了效率。像EAGLE-3这样的动态树方法在贪婪解码下通过确定性的Top-K扩展和全局剪枝表现良好。然而，在随机解码（T>0）下，这种机制将草稿分布崩溃为独热概率，导致接受率急剧下降。这就产生了一个困境：动态树方法牺牲了随机采样来保持上下文感知拓扑，而静态树方法则通过与上下文无关的结构保留了随机采样。该问题的出现是因为相同的概率分布被用于两个相互冲突的任务：构建树和验证Token。这种耦合由于产生的随机过程使得直接注入随机性极具挑战性。我们通过解耦这些角色来解决这个问题：RheoSampling为从草稿分布中采样的Token分配一个用于树扩展和剪枝的代理概率，以及用于验证的真实采样概率。具体来说，我们将采样的Token注入到确定性的Top-K槽中，并在构建和验证过程中对其采用不同的概率，这使得RheoSampling成为第一个既具备上下文感知Top-K构建又具备随机采样能力，同时保持无损性的动态树方法。我们通过将随机树空间压缩为易处理类别的等价类分析，确立了无损保证。基于最优输运（OT）的验证策略和稀疏草稿机制确保了理论收益转化为实际效率。在各种大语言模型和基准测试上的实验表明，其在接受率和加速比上均优于现有的动态树方法。该框架可能为分析随机树结构提供一个模板。
AI.summary: RheoSampling是一种针对大语言模型随机动态树推测解码的新方法。它解决了在随机解码下动态树方法因概率独热化而导致接受率下降的“独热困境”。通过将树构建与Token验证的概率角色解耦、引入代理概率以及基于最优输运的验证策略，该方法在保持无损性的同时，首次实现了兼具上下文感知顶级K扩展和随机采样能力的动态树推测解码。
AI.keywords: Speculative Decoding, Stochastic Sampling, Dynamic Tree, Large Language Models, Token Verification
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地解决了动态树推测解码在随机采样（T>0）下的“独热困境”，通过解耦树构建与Token验证的概率，实现了无损的随机动态树生成，对提升大语言模型在非贪婪解码下的推理速度具有重要意义。

title: Touvigation: Embodied Adaptive Object Acquisition for Blind and Low-Vision Users in Unfamiliar Indoor Environments
summary: Blind and low-vision users often face challenges when locating and physically acquiring objects in unfamiliar indoor environments. Existing vision-language-model-based assistants can provide semantic descriptions but may introduce latency, hallucinations, and guidance that is poorly aligned with embodied action. We present Touvigation, a hands-free object acquisition system that combines vision-language understanding with persistent local spatial modeling to provide low-latency, body-relative guidance. Drawing on formative interviews with eight blind and low-vision participants, we design a multi-stage guidance framework that adapts spatial references as users transition from orienting, to walking, to reaching and tactile verification. We evaluated Touvigation with 12 blind and low-vision participants against a multimodal large-language-model assistant and unassisted search. Touvigation achieved 100% task success, compared with 58% for the multimodal assistant and 85% for unassisted search, while reducing completion time and cognitive workload. Our findings demonstrate how persistent spatial grounding and adaptive embodied guidance can improve object acquisition for blind and low-vision users.

AI.title_translation: Touvigation：面向盲人和低视力用户的具身自适应室内陌生环境物体获取系统
AI.tldr: Touvigation是一个为视障用户设计的免提物体获取系统，通过结合视觉语言理解和持久化空间建模，实现了100%的任务成功率并减少了认知负荷。

AI.method: 基于与8名视障参与者的访谈，设计了一个多阶段引导框架，结合视觉语言理解与持久化局部空间建模，在用户从定向、行走到着陆和触觉验证的过渡中自适应调整空间参考。
AI.result: 在对12名视障参与者的评估中，Touvigation达到了100%的任务成功率（相比多模态助手的58%和无辅助搜索的85%），同时减少了完成时间和认知负荷。
AI.conclusion: Touvigation通过持久化的空间基础和自适应的具身引导，显著改善了视障用户在陌生室内环境中的物体获取体验，实现了100%的任务成功率，且降低了完成时间和认知负荷。
AI.translation: 盲人和低视力用户在陌生室内环境中定位和物理获取物体时经常面临挑战。现有的基于视觉语言模型的助手可以提供语义描述，但可能会引入延迟、幻觉以及与具身动作契合度较差的引导。我们提出了Touvigation，这是一个免提物体获取系统，它将视觉语言理解与持久化局部空间建模相结合，以提供低延迟、身体相对的引导。通过对八名盲人和低视力参与者的形成性访谈，我们设计了一个多阶段引导框架，随着用户从定向、行走到着陆和触觉验证的过渡，自适应调整空间参考。我们通过12名盲人和低视力参与者，将Touvigation与多模态大语言模型助手和无辅助搜索进行了对比评估。Touvigation实现了100%的任务成功率，而多模态助手为58%，无辅助搜索为85%，同时减少了完成时间和认知负荷。我们的研究结果证明了持久的空间基础和自适应的具身引导如何改善盲人和低视力用户的物体获取。
AI.summary: Touvigation是一个专为视障用户设计的免提物体获取系统，它将视觉语言理解与持久化局部空间建模相结合，提供低延迟、身体相对的自适应引导，从而在陌生室内环境中高效、准确地帮助用户定位并获取目标物体。
AI.keywords: 视障用户, 具身智能, 物体获取, 视觉语言模型, 空间引导
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了视觉语言理解与持久化局部空间建模，针对视障群体设计了多阶段自适应引导框架，显著提升了在陌生室内环境中物体获取的成功率、效率并降低了认知负荷，具有很高的实用价值和人文关怀。

title: Federated Deep Clustering Networks for High-Dimensional and Heterogeneous Data
comments: Accepted to the 4th International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA 2026)
summary: Clustering high-dimensional data is a fundamental task in unsupervised machine learning with applications to a variety of domains. In the centralized data scenario, this task is commonly solved using deep clustering methods that utilize deep neural network architectures to learn clustering-friendly latent space representations. In Federated Learning, where data is distributed between clients and is private, deep clustering methods are less explored. In particular, recently introduced federated deep clustering methods, despite showing very promising performance, still fall short in reliably providing good performance if data across clients are non-identically-independently distributed. In this work, we introduce a generalization of Deep Clustering Networks to the federated scenario, named FedDCN, that simultaneously optimizes a reconstruction loss and a clustering loss. To ensure robustness and latent space alignment in non-identically-independently distributed data scenarios, FedDCN generates synthetic data augmentations, and its learning objective includes a geometric regularization for latent space alignment. Through experimental evaluation, the effectiveness of the approach under IID and non-IID assumptions is demonstrated, and future research directions are identified.

AI.title_translation: 面向高维和异构数据的联邦深度聚类网络
AI.tldr: 本文提出了FedDCN，一种能够有效处理联邦学习中高维非独立同分布（non-IID）异构数据的深度聚类新方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的联邦深度聚类方法在面对客户端之间数据呈非独立同分布（non-IID）的异构场景时，往往无法稳定提供良好的性能。
AI.method: 提出FedDCN框架，同时优化重构损失与聚类损失，生成合成数据增强，并通过几何正则化实现潜在空间的对齐以应对非独立同分布（non-IID）数据。
AI.result: 实验评估证明了该方法在独立同分布（IID）和非独立同分布（non-IID）假设下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: FedDCN通过结合重构损失、聚类损失以及用于潜在空间对齐的几何正则化，有效解决了联邦学习场景下高维非独立同分布数据的深度聚类问题。
AI.translation: 高维数据的聚类是无监督机器学习中的一项基础任务，在多个领域有着广泛应用。在集中式数据场景中，该任务通常使用利用深度神经网络架构来学习聚类友好潜在空间表示的深度聚类方法来解决。在数据分布在客户端且具有隐私性的联邦学习中，深度聚类方法受到的探索较少。特别是最近引入的联邦深度聚类方法，尽管表现出非常 promising 的性能，但在客户端之间的数据呈非独立同分布时，仍然无法可靠地提供良好的性能。在这项工作中，我们将深度聚类网络推广到联邦场景中，名为 FedDCN，它同时优化重构损失和聚类损失。为了确保在非独立同分布数据场景下的鲁棒性和潜在空间对齐，FedDCN 生成了合成数据增强，并且其学习目标包含用于潜在空间对齐的几何正则化。通过实验评估，证明了该方法在独立同分布和非独立同分布假设下的有效性，并指出了未来的研究方向。
AI.summary: 本文提出了名为FedDCN的联邦深度聚类网络，旨在解决高维和异构数据场景下的聚类问题。通过引入合成数据增强和几何正则化，该方法在联邦学习中实现了稳健的潜在空间对齐与优异的聚类性能。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 深度聚类, 高维数据, 异构数据, 潜在空间对齐
AI.comments: 本文针对联邦学习中高维异构数据的深度聚类难题，创新性地提出了FedDCN框架，引入了合成数据增强和几何正则化来实现潜在空间对齐，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: PopNavShift: Stress-Testing Social Navigation under Behavioral Population Shift
summary: Social-navigation algorithms are often evaluated under a fixed pedestrian-behavior distribution, despite substantial variation in pedestrian responses to robots across individuals and social contexts. We introduce PopNavShift, a matched simulation framework for stress-testing social-navigation strategies under pedestrian population shifts. PopNavShift constructs population-conditioned pedestrian motion profiles by prompting Gemini 3.7 Flash with 600 synthetic persona records from MatrAIx Persona 1M and deterministically mapping the responses into bounded motion parameters. It then compares three representative navigation strategies, reactive avoidance, early yielding, and reciprocal collision avoidance, across eight population conditions and 7,488 matched robot runs. In a matched intervention on the same 202 personas, changing only time pressure reverses 8.6% of controller rankings based on robot travel time, but 22.4% based on mean pedestrian delay and 23.9% based on worst-decile delay. Across population conditions, this sensitivity is greater for pedestrian burden than for robot travel time and increases in spatially constrained settings; the same qualitative pattern persists under a second pedestrian dynamics model. These findings support evaluating navigation strategies across behavioral populations using both robot performance and pedestrian burden.

AI.title_translation: PopNavShift：行为人群转变下的社交导航压力测试
AI.tldr: 通过PopNavShift框架对社交导航算法进行行为人群转变压力测试，发现行人的行为变化会显著改变不同导航策略的优劣排名。
AI.motivation: 现有的社交导航算法通常在固定的行人行为分布下进行评估，忽视了个体和社会背景对行人反应的巨大差异，因此需要一个框架来对行为人群转变下的策略进行压力测试。
AI.method: 引入PopNavShift仿真框架，利用Gemini 3.7 Flash结合合成人物画像构建行人运动配置文件，并在多种人群条件和匹配运行中对比了三种代表性导航策略。
AI.result: 在时间压力等干预下，会导致控制器排名发生显著反转（例如基于机器人旅行时间反转8.6%，基于行人延迟反转高达22.4%至23.9%），且这种敏感性在空间受限环境中对行人负担更为明显。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实，评估社交导航策略时必须考虑行为人群的变化，并应同时权衡机器人性能和行人负担。
AI.translation: 社交导航算法通常在固定的行人行为分布下进行评估，尽管个体和社交背景对机器人反应的行人反应存在巨大差异。我们介绍了 PopNavShift，这是一个用于在行人种群转变下对社交导航策略进行压力测试的匹配仿真框架。PopNavShift 通过用 MatrAIx Persona 1M 的 600 条合成人物记录提示 Gemini 3.7 Flash 构建人群条件下的行人运动配置文件，并将响应确定性地映射到有界运动参数中。然后，它在八种人群条件和 7,488 次匹配的机器人运行中比较了三种具有代表性的导航策略：反应性避让、早期让路和互惠防碰撞。在对相同的 202 个角色进行的匹配干预中，仅改变时间压力就会根据机器人行程时间颠倒 8.6% 的控制器排名，但根据平均行人延迟颠倒 22.4%，根据最差十分位数延迟颠倒 23.9%。在人群条件下，这种敏感性对行人负担大于对机器人行程时间，并且在空间受限的环境中增加；在第二个行人动力学模型下，相同的定性模式仍然存在。这些发现支持使用机器人性能和行人负担跨行为人群评估导航策略。
AI.summary: 论文提出了PopNavShift框架，用于在行人行为人群转变下对社交导航策略进行压力测试，发现行人群体的变化会显著影响导航策略的性能排名，强调了在评估时需兼顾机器人表现与行人负担。
AI.keywords: Social Navigation, Population Shift, Stress-Testing, Pedestrian Dynamics, Large Language Models
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了PopNavShift框架，利用大语言模型生成多样化的行人行为画像，用于对社交导航算法进行压力测试，并揭示了行人行为分布变化对导航策略性能评估的显著影响。

title: FPT=PTIME for Homomorphism Problems on Sparse-Incidence and Bounded-Independence Patterns
summary: Assuming the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH), fixed-parameter tractability and polynomial-time solvability coincide for homomorphism problems specified by classes of pattern hypergraphs of bounded incidence degeneracy or bounded primal independence number. In both cases, tractability is characterised by bounded fractional hypertree width. Grohe (JACM 2007) established the corresponding FPT-PTIME equivalence under bounded arity. Our result allows unbounded arity and covers important cases such as bounded-degree patterns and patterns whose incidence graphs exclude a fixed minor. Building on the recent fractional balanced-separator framework and rounding theorem of Korchemna et al. (FOCS 2024), we prove a near-linear bound on fractional hypertree width ($\mathsf{fhw}$) in terms of adaptive width ($\mathsf{adw}$). For every hypergraph $H$ with $\mathsf{adw}(H)\geq 2$, \[ \mathsf{fhw}(H)=O\bigl(λ(H)\mathsf{adw}(H)\log\mathsf{adw}(H)\bigr), \] where $λ(H)=\min\{μ(H),\max\{1,\logα(H)\}\}$, with $μ(H)$ denoting incidence degeneracy and $α(H)$ the independence number of the primal graph. As a further consequence, we obtain a corresponding FPT-PTIME collapse for exact homomorphism counting on every bounded-$λ$ class. More generally, for every recursively enumerable class of pattern hypergraphs, fixed-parameter tractability of the parameterised homomorphism problem implies quasipolynomial-time solvability of the corresponding unparameterised problem, assuming ETH.

title: EnterpriseVal: Quantifying the Efficacy, Reliability and Value of Generative AI in the Enterprise
summary: Frontier language models now produce professional deliverables that expert graders judge to match human work on a substantial share of economically valuable tasks, yet most enterprise GenAI initiatives fail to show a measurable business effect and a large fraction of agentic projects are expected to be cancelled. We argue that this is substantially a measurement problem: public benchmarks answer "what can the model do?", whereas a deployment decision requires "is this workflow fit, reliable, safe and worth scaling - here, on our data, under our controls?". We present EnterpriseVal, a use-case-level evaluation system that closes this gap. It comprises (i) a formal specification of the use case and of the frozen socio-technical configuration under test, model, prompts, retrieval, tools, guardrails and human oversight, with an autonomy level and consequence tier that jointly set the required evaluation intensity; (ii) a metric catalogue spanning fidelity, utility, efficiency, reliability, assurance and oversight; (iii) a grading protocol that scales blinded expert judgement with calibrated LLM-as-judge scoring through prediction-powered inference; (iv) a two-tier threshold gate, stated as an executable algorithm, that maps metric vectors with confidence bounds to REJECT/CONDITIONAL/SCALE decisions; and (v) a value-and-risk model in which the reviewer catch rate is a measured parameter. We report a pilot across three workflows in a global bank. In credit-memo drafting, human-graded citation precision reached 88% and hallucination rate 1.6% for the best model against gates of 70% and 5%; in procedure transformation, analyst refinement effort fell from an estimated 27.4 to 2.9 hours per document. We separate established results, documented pilot evidence, the proposed system and open hypotheses, and specify the experiments required for full validation

AI.title_translation: EnterpriseVal：量化企业中生成式AI的效能、可靠性与价值
AI.tldr: 提出了EnterpriseVal评估系统，通过用例级度量、决策门控和价值风险模型，解决了企业生成式AI部署中缺乏有效评估标准的难题。
AI.motivation: 尽管前沿语言模型在许多经济价值任务上能媲美人类工作，但大多数企业级生成式AI项目未能显示出可测量的业务效果，甚至面临取消。这主要是因为公共基准无法解答企业部署时关注的适应性、可靠性、安全性和投资回报等“度量问题”。
AI.method: 提出EnterpriseVal评估系统，包含：(1)用例及社会-技术配置的正式规范；(2)涵盖保真度、效用、效率、可靠性、保证和监督的指标目录；(3)通过预测赋能推理扩展盲法专家判断与LLM作为裁判评分的评分协议；(4)将度量向量映射到决策的两级阈值门控算法；(5)包含审阅者捕获率的价值与风险模型。在一家全球银行的三个工作流中进行了试点。
AI.result: 在一家全球银行的信用备忘录起草试点中，最佳模型的引用准确率达到88%，幻觉率为1.6%（门控要求分别为70%和5%）；在程序转换试点中，分析师的精炼工作量从预计的每份文档27.4小时降至2.9小时。
AI.conclusion: EnterpriseVal通过提供一个结构化的用例级评估系统，有效弥补了公共基准与企业实际部署决策之间的鸿沟，为生成式AI在企业中的安全、可靠和高效规模化应用奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 前沿语言模型现在能够生成专业交付物，专家评分员认为这些交付物在相当大比例的具有经济价值的任务上与人类工作相媲美，然而大多数企业GenAI计划未能显示出可测量的业务效果，且很大一部分智能体项目预计将被取消。我们认为这在很大程度上是一个度量问题：公共基准回答了“模型能做什么？”，而部署决策需要的是“这个工作流是否合适、可靠、安全且值得扩展——在我们的数据、我们的控制之下？”。我们提出了EnterpriseVal，一个填补这一空白的用例级评估系统。它包括：(i)对用例以及测试中的冻结社会-技术配置、模型、提示词、检索、工具、护栏和人类监督的正式规范，其中自主权级别和后果层级共同决定了所需的评估强度；(ii)涵盖保真度、效用、效率、可靠性、保证和监督的指标目录；(iii)通过预测赋能推理将盲法专家判断与校准的LLM作为裁判评分相结合的评分协议；(iv)一个两级阈值门控（陈述为可执行算法），将带有置信区间的度量向量映射到“拒绝/有条件/扩展”决策；以及(v)一个将审阅者捕获率作为测量参数的价值与风险模型。我们报告了一项在一家全球银行进行的三个工作流的试点研究。在信用备忘录起草中，对于最佳模型，人类评分的引用精确度达到了88%，幻觉率为1.6%，而门控标准分别为70%和5%；在程序转换中，分析师的精炼工作量从预计的每份文档27.4小时下降到2.9小时。我们区分了既定结果、记录的试点证据、提出的系统和开放性假设，并明确了全面验证所需的实验。
AI.summary: 本文提出了EnterpriseVal，一个用例级的企业生成式AI评估系统。它通过形式化规范、全面的指标目录、结合LLM与专家判断的评分协议、两级决策门控以及价值风险模型，解决了企业部署GenAI时缺乏有效度量标准的难题，并通过银行试点验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: EnterpriseVal, Generative AI, Evaluation System, Enterprise Deployment, LLM-as-judge
AI.comments: 该论文针对企业级生成式AI落地难、缺乏度量标准的痛点，提出了EnterpriseVal评估系统。其创新之处在于将模型评估与具体的社会-技术配置、工作流、置信区间及业务价值/风险模型紧密结合，并引入了预测赋能推理和可执行的决策门控。然而，文中所述结果主要基于特定银行的三个试点工作流，其广泛适用性和长期经济效益仍需进一步验证。

title: Restructuring Tree Decision Diagrams
summary:
Tree Decision Diagrams (TDDs) are a data structure recently introduced by Capelli et al. (SAT 2026). They are structured along a vtree and the size of their canonical form lies between Ordered Binary Decision Diagrams (OBDDs) and deterministic structured DNNF circuits (d-SDNNFs). While the succinctness gap between TDD and d-SDNNF is exponential, only a quasipolynomial separation between OBDD and TDD has been shown and it was left as open question whether this is optimal. We answer this question affirmatively by showing that every TDD can be transformed to an equivalent OBDD of quasipolynomial size.
  Although this might be seen as a weakness, our second result shows that TDDs share another desirable property with OBDDs that is not known to hold for d-SDNNF: Given a TDD and another target vtree, it is possible to construct the minimal and canonical TDD respecting the new vtree in time polynomial in the input and output. As a result we also obtain that the equivalence test between TDDs over different vtrees can be done in polynomial time.

AI.title_translation: 树决策图的重构
AI.tldr: 本文证明了TDD可转化为拟多项式大小的OBDD，且支持多项式时间的vtree重构与等价性测试。
AI.motivation: 探究树决策图（TDD）与有序二元决策图（OBDD）之间存在的拟多项式分离是否是最优的，并研究TDD在不同vtree下的重构和等价性测试能力。
AI.method: 通过理论证明展示了任意TDD可以转化为等价的拟多项式大小的OBDD，并开发了在给定新目标vtree下多项式时间内构建极小规范TDD的方法。
AI.result: 证明了每个TDD都可以转换为等价的拟多项式大小的OBDD（证实拟多项式分离是最优的），并证明了给定新vtree时可在多项式时间内构建极小规范TDD，从而实现了不同vtree下TDD的多项式时间等价性测试。
AI.conclusion: 本文肯定地回答了TDD与OBDD转换复杂度的公开问题，证明了TDD到OBDD的拟多项式大小界限是紧确的，并证明了TDD支持基于新vtree的多项式时间规范重构及等价性测试。
AI.translation:
树决策图（TDDs）是Capelli等人（SAT 2026）最近引入的一种数据结构。它们的结构沿vtree排列，其规范形式的大小介于有序二元决策图（OBDDs）和确定性结构DNNF电路（d-SDNNFs）之间。虽然TDD与d-SDNNF之间的简洁性差距是指数级的，但此前仅显示了OBDD与TDD之间存在拟多项式分离，这是否最优一直是一个公开问题。我们通过证明每个TDD都可以转换为等价的拟多项式大小的OBDD，对这个问题给出了肯定的回答。
虽然这可能被视为一个弱点，但我们的第二个结果表明，TDD与OBDD共享另一个d-SDNNF未知的理想性质：给定一个TDD和另一个目标vtree，可以在输入和输出的多项式时间内构建满足新vtree的极小且规范的TDD。因此，我们还得出结论，不同vtree上的TDD之间的等价性测试可以在多项式时间内完成。
AI.summary: 本文研究了树决策图（TDDs）的性质，证明了TDD可转化为拟多项式大小的OBDD，肯定了解决了两者间隙的最优性问题；同时证明了TDD支持在多项式时间内基于新vtree进行重构及等价性测试。
AI.keywords: Tree Decision Diagrams, Ordered Binary Decision Diagrams, vtree, succinctness gap, canonical form
AI.comments: 本文解决了TDD与OBDD之间关于拟多项式界限是否最优的公开问题，证明了每个TDD都可以转化为等价的拟多项式大小的OBDD，同时展示了TDD在不同vtree之间的高效重构和多项式时间等价性测试能力，具有重要的理论价值。

title: Supporting Industrial Test-Failure Analysis with LLM-Based Systems: An Experience Report
comments: 16 pages, 4 figures, accepted to PROFES 2026, 30 Nov to 2 Dec 2026, Karlskrona, Sweden
summary: This study examines tool-augmented Large Language Model (LLM) systems for supporting Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of nightly test failures at Westermo Network Technologies AB. Nightly test executions produce heterogeneous test data and logs that practitioners currently inspect manually across multiple sources. We implemented an RCA workflow in single-agent and orchestrated multi-agent configurations, both with access to test metadata and logs. An exploratory industrial case study used two real failure scenarios. Six practitioners evaluated the scenario reports through a survey and focus group, and operational measurements were collected from 120 repeated executions. The evaluation covered practitioner-perceived correctness, reasoning quality, fix realism, clarity, usefulness, and trust, as well as cost, duration, and consistency. Neither configuration showed a consistent practitioner-perceived quality advantage across the two scenarios. The single agent system generated reports faster and at lower cost, making it the more practical baseline in this context. The potential benefits of agent architectures require further evaluation in more complex scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 支持工业测试故障分析的基于LLM系统：经验报告
AI.tldr: 本文通过工业经验报告发现，在测试故障的根本原因分析中，单智能体LLM系统相比多智能体架构具有更低的成本和更高的速度，是更具实用性的基线。
AI.motivation: 夜间测试执行会产生异构的测试数据和日志，目前从业者需要手动跨多个源进行检查，耗时且费力，因此需要研究工具增强的大语言模型系统来支持根本原因分析（RCA）。
AI.method: 在Westermo Network Technologies AB实施了单智能体和多智能体配置的RCA工作流，利用真实故障场景通过问卷、焦点小组及120次重复执行的运营测量进行评估。
AI.result: 两种配置在两个场景中均未表现出一致的从业者感知质量优势；然而，单智能体系统生成报告的速度更快且成本更低，更适合作为当前的实用基线。
AI.conclusion: 在当前的工业测试故障分析场景下，单智能体系统因其较低的成本和更快的执行速度，比多智能体架构更具实际应用价值。复杂的智能体架构在更具挑战性的场景中的优势仍需进一步验证。
AI.translation: 本研究探讨了支持Westermo Network Technologies AB夜间测试失败根本原因分析（RCA）的工具增强型大语言模型（LLM）系统。夜间测试执行会产生异构的测试数据和日志，目前从业人员需要在多个源中进行手动检查。我们实现了单智能体和多智能体配置的RCA工作流，两者都可以访问测试元数据和日志。一项探索性工业案例研究使用了两个真实的失败场景。六名从业人员通过问卷和焦点小组评估了场景报告，并从120次重复执行中收集了运营测量数据。评估涵盖了从业人员感知的正确性、推理质量、修复真实性、清晰度、有用性和信任度，以及成本、持续时间和一致性。在这两个场景中，没有任何一种配置表现出一致的从业人员感知质量优势。单智能体系统生成报告的速度更快、成本更低，使其成为该背景下更具实用性的基线。智能体架构的潜在优势需要在更复杂的场景中作进一步评估。
AI.summary: 本文评估了基于大语言模型的工具增强系统在工业测试故障根本原因分析中的应用，对比了单智能体与多智能体架构的性能。研究发现单智能体系统在成本和速度上更具优势，而多智能体架构的潜力需在更复杂场景中进一步评估。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 根本原因分析, 工业测试, 智能体架构, 经验报告
AI.comments: 这篇工业经验报告评估了基于大语言模型的工具增强系统在工业夜间测试故障根本原因分析（RCA）中的应用。研究设计严谨，对比了单智能体与多智能体架构在真实工业场景中的表现，并结合了从业者评估和运营数据，为LLM在工业界落地的成本与效益平衡提供了宝贵的实证依据。

title: Reusing Latent Speech Representations for Query-Conditioned Topic Localization in Transcripts
summary: Long transcripts are costly inputs for downstream NLP systems and often contain irrelevant context. We study query-conditioned topic localization: predicting the sentence span in a transcript that best addresses a topic-title query. To improve span localization, we reuse ASR encoder states as sentence-level representations and fuse them with textual embeddings. This lets lightweight span locators exploit speech information without running a separate audio encoder. Experiments on two public datasets show consistent gains over text-only baselines, especially under strict boundary-matching criteria. Cross-dataset experiments further indicate that the benefits are strongest for structured or semi-structured speech, while gains on spontaneous speech are limited and mixed.

AI.title_translation: 在转录本中重用潜在语音表征用于查询条件主题定位
AI.tldr: 通过重用ASR编码器的隐状态并与文本结合，无需额外音频编码器即可在长转录本中更精准地定位主题相关的句子区间。
AI.motivation: 长文本转录本对于下游NLP系统而言输入成本高且包含大量无关上下文，因此需要研究如何高效且准确地预测出最能回应主题查询的句子区间。
AI.method: 重用ASR编码器状态作为句子级表征，并将其与文本 embeddings 进行融合，供轻量级跨度定位器（span locators）使用，无需单独运行音频编码器。
AI.result: 在两个公共数据集上的实验表明，该方法在文本基线（尤其是严格的边界匹配标准下）上取得了持续的性能提升；跨数据集实验表明其对结构化或半结构化语音的效益最强，而对自然口语的效果有限且混合。
AI.conclusion: 重用ASR隐式表征是一种有效提升长文本转录本中查询主题定位的方法，特别适用于结构化语音，具有较高的计算效率和实用价值。
AI.translation: 长转录本是下游NLP系统的昂贵输入，且通常包含无关上下文。我们研究了查询条件主题定位：预测转录本中最能回应主题查询的句子跨度。为了改进跨度定位，我们重用ASR编码器状态作为句子级表征，并将其与文本嵌入进行融合。这使得轻量级的跨度定位器能够在不运行单独音频编码器的同时利用语音信息。在两个公共数据集上的实验表明，与纯文本基线相比，该方法取得了持续的性能提升，尤其是在严格的边界匹配标准下。跨数据集实验进一步表明，这种优势对结构化或半结构化语音最为显著，而对自然口语的提升则有限且混合。
AI.summary: 论文研究了长转录本中的查询条件主题定位任务，通过重用ASR编码器状态并与文本嵌入融合，使轻量级定位器能够有效利用语音信息，实验证明该方法在结构化语音的准确定位上取得了显著增益。
AI.keywords: 语音表征重用, 主题定位, 自动语音识别 (ASR), 文本嵌入, 查询条件定位
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出重用ASR编码器状态作为句子级表征，并与文本嵌入进行融合，以实现轻量级的查询条件主题定位。这不仅有效降低了长音频转录本处理的计算开销，还提升了边界匹配的准确性，对结构化语音表现尤为显著。

title: Distributed Balanced Butterfly Counting in Signed Bipartite Graphs
summary: The balanced butterfly is a fundamental primitive for analyzing signed bipartite graphs and provides a basis for studying higher-order structural properties, such as clustering coefficients and community structure. Despite its importance, existing approaches primarily rely on serial algorithms for balanced butterfly counting, which become inefficient on large-scale graphs. To address this limitation, we propose a distributed algorithm, D-BBC, based on a hybrid MPI+TBB framework that exploits MPI for inter-process communication and Intel TBB for intra-node parallelism. We conduct an experimental assessment of the proposed approach across 15 real-world datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that, on a single-node distributed system, D-BBC achieves average speedups of 1321x and 16.2x over the serial BB2K and multi-core M-BBC implementations, respectively. Furthermore, D-BBC achieves a maximum speedup of 23.58x over the distributed baseline S-Monarch in terms of end-to-end execution time. These results demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed distributed approach and its potential to enable high- performance signed motif analysis on large-scale bipartite graphs.

AI.title_translation: 带符号二分图中分布式平衡蝴蝶计数
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于MPI+TBB混合框架的分布式算法D-BBC，用于高效计算大规模带符号二分图中的平衡蝴蝶，大幅超越了现有串行和分布式方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 平衡蝴蝶是分析带符号二分图的基础基元，但现有的方法主要依赖串行算法，在面对大规模图数据时效率低下，因此需要开发高效的分布式算法来支持大规模图的分析。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为D-BBC的分布式算法，该算法基于混合的MPI+TBB框架，利用MPI进行进程间通信，并使用Intel TBB实现节点内并行。
AI.result: 在15个真实数据集上的实验结果表明，在单节点分布式系统上，D-BBC相比串行BB2K和多核M-BBC实现，平均加速比分别达到了1321倍和16.2倍；在端到端执行时间上，相比分布式基线S-Monarch最大加速比达到23.58倍。
AI.conclusion: 提出的D-BBC算法通过结合进程间通信与节点内并行，有效解决了大规模带符号二分图中平衡蝴蝶计数效率低下的问题，具有极高的实用价值和性能表现。
AI.translation: 平衡蝴蝶是分析带符号二分图的基本原语，为研究更高阶的结构属性（如聚类系数和社区结构）提供了基础。尽管其重要性不言而喻，但现有方法主要依赖于串行算法来计算平衡蝴蝶，这在大规模图上变得效率低下。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种基于混合MPI+TBB框架的分布式算法D-BBC，它利用MPI进行进程间通信，利用Intel TBB进行节点内并行。我们在15个真实世界数据集上对该方法进行了实验评估。实验结果表明，在单节点分布式系统中，D-BBC相比于串行BB2K和多核M-BBC实现，平均加速比分别达到了1321倍和16.2倍。此外，在端到端执行时间方面，D-BBC相比分布式基线S-Monarch取得了最高23.58倍的加速比。这些结果证明了所提出的分布式方法的效率及其在大规模二分图上实现高性能带符号模体分析的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文针对大规模带符号二分图中的平衡蝴蝶计数问题，提出了一种基于MPI+TBB混合框架的高效分布式算法D-BBC。实验证明，该算法在处理真实世界数据集时取得了显著的加速效果，展现了强大的高性能图分析能力。
AI.keywords: 带符号二分图, 平衡蝴蝶计数, 分布式算法, MPI+TBB, 高性能图分析
AI.comments: 该论文针对带符号二分图中平衡蝴蝶计数这一基础问题，创新性地提出了一种基于MPI+TBB混合框架的分布式算法（D-BBC），在处理大规模图数据时展现出显著的性能优势和加速效果。

title: The Weight Is Over - Interactive Diffusion on Consumer GPUs
summary: On-device inference is booming, but the momentum is almost all in language models. Diffusion pipelines are memory hungry, latency-sensitive, and require orchestrating an embedder, a transformer, a decoder, and often further postprocessing that is not as standardized as LLM inference loops are. We navigate the trade-off between performance, quality, and model footprint to reach as many client devices in the wild as possible. We make three contributions: an embedding translator that maps a small text encoder into a large encoder space to cut weight and latency; a reproducible sweep recipe for navigating the speed/quality/memory triangle in diffusion pipelines; and an interactive on-device image generation editor achieving sub-second TTFI on recent GPUs.

AI.title_translation: 沉重负担终结：消费级GPU上的交互式扩散模型
AI.tldr: 通过提出嵌入翻译器和优化方案，该论文在消费级GPU上实现了扩散模型的亚秒级交互式图像生成。
AI.motivation: 尽管端侧大语言模型发展迅猛，但扩散模型由于内存需求大、对延迟敏感且组件复杂，在消费级设备上的实时交互式部署仍面临巨大挑战。为此，需要在性能、质量和模型体积之间进行权衡。
AI.method: 1. 提出一种将小型文本编码器映射到大型编码器空间的嵌入翻译器以减少权重和延迟；2. 开发用于平衡扩散管道中速度、质量和内存的标准化搜索方案；3. 构建实现亚秒级TTFI的交互式端侧图像生成编辑器。
AI.result: 成功开发了一种交互式端侧图像生成编辑器，在近期发布的消费级GPU上实现了亚秒级的首帧图像生成（TTFI）。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功实现了消费级GPU上扩散模型的交互式、低延迟推理，为端侧高质量图像生成提供了切实可行的解决方案。
AI.translation: 端侧推理正在蓬勃发展，但势头几乎全在语言模型上。扩散管道对内存需求大、对延迟敏感，且需要协调嵌入器、Transformer、解码器以及通常比LLM推理循环标准化程度更低的其他后处理。我们探索了性能、质量和模型体积之间的权衡，以覆盖野外尽可能多的客户端设备。我们做出了三项贡献：一个将小型文本编码器映射到大型编码器空间以削减权重和延迟的嵌入翻译器；一个用于在扩散管道中平衡速度/质量/内存三角关系的可复现搜索方案；以及一个在近期GPU上实现亚秒级TTFI（首帧时间）的交互式端侧图像生成编辑器。
AI.summary: 该论文探讨了在消费级GPU上运行扩散模型的权衡问题，并带来了三项核心贡献：用于减小体积和延迟的嵌入翻译器、平衡速度与质量的搜索方案，以及在近期GPU上实现亚秒级TTFI的端侧图像生成编辑器。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 端侧推理, 消费级GPU, 嵌入翻译器, 交互式图像生成
AI.comments: 该论文针对消费级GPU上的扩散模型推理效率进行了深入探索，提出了嵌入翻译器和可复现的调优方案，显著降低了内存和延迟，实现了亚秒级的首帧图像生成（TTFI），对推动生成式AI在边缘设备上的普及具有重要价值。

title: Beyond Counting Blessings: Tracing the Evolution of Gratitude Practices and Technology Needs
comments: 30 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables, including references and appendices
summary: Gratitude technologies support well-being by prompting reflection on what people appreciate. But gratitude does not serve the same purpose in every circumstance: as life situations change, so does what people seek from it, and whether it feels appropriate at all. To understand how technology can adapt to and support such shifts, we conducted retrospective, artifact-elicitation interviews with 17 adults who had practiced gratitude for one to fifteen years. Participants' appraisals of their situations shaped what they needed, yielding six recurring practice patterns, including a boundary where gratitude felt forced. We contribute the Adaptive Gratitude Practice Model, which explains how appraisals shifted even within the same life situation, how participants adapted activities, modalities, and rhythms, lapsed under competing demands or emotional unreadiness, and resumed when gratitude again felt useful. Additionally, we derive design implications for situated support, self-understanding through past records, and relational care with changing life situations.
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables, including references and appendices

AI.title_translation: 超越数算祝福：追踪感恩实践与技术需求的演变
AI.tldr: 本研究通过访谈长期感恩实践者，揭示了生活变化如何影响感恩需求，并提出了“自适应感恩实践模型”及相关技术设计启示。
AI.motivation: 现有的感恩技术主要通过提示人们反思所感激的事物来支持幸福感，但感恩并非在所有情况下都具有相同的目的或适用性；为了解技术如何适应并支持人们在不同生活情境和需求下的转变，本研究展开了探究。
AI.method: 对17名有1到15年感恩实践经验的成年人进行了回顾性、人工制品引发的访谈（retrospective, artifact-elicitation interviews），并对其经历进行了定性分析。
AI.result: 研究揭示了六种经常出现的感恩实践模式（包括感恩感到勉强的边界），并贡献了“自适应感恩实践模型”，解释了评估如何随生活情境变化、人们如何调整活动及节奏、如何在需求冲突或情绪未就绪时中断以及在合适时恢复。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过对长期感恩实践者的访谈，提出了自适应感恩实践模型，强调感恩技术需要适应用户不断变化的生活情境、心理状态和实践需求，并为未来的技术设计提供了具体的指导原则。
AI.translation: 感恩技术通过提示人们反思他们感激的事物来支持幸福感。但在每种情况下，感恩的目的并不完全相同：随着生活情况的变化，人们对感恩的需求以及它是否合适也在改变。为了解技术如何适应并支持这些转变，我们对17名有1到15年感恩实践经验的成年人进行了回顾性的、人工制品引发的访谈。参与者对自身处境的评估决定了他们的需求，产生了六种经常出现的实践模式，其中包括感恩感到勉强的边界。我们贡献了“自适应感恩实践模型”，该模型解释了评估如何在同一生活情境中发生转变、参与者如何调整活动、方式和节奏、如何在竞争性需求或情绪未就绪时中断，以及在感恩再次显得有用时如何恢复。此外，我们针对适应性支持、通过过去记录进行自我理解以及随生活情境变化的关怀，衍生出了相关设计启示。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了长期感恩实践者在面对不断变化的生活情境时，其感恩需求和实践的演变过程。通过对17名成人的访谈，作者提出了自适应感恩实践模型，展示了人们如何调整感恩活动、应对实践的中断与恢复，并为未来的感恩技术设计提供了新的设计启示。
AI.keywords: 感恩技术, 积极心理学, 质性研究, 自适应设计, 生活情境
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了感恩实践随时间推移及生活情境变化的演变过程，突破了传统感恩技术仅停留在“数算祝福”的浅层设计，提出了自适应的感恩实践模型，对未来健康计算和积极心理学工具的设计具有重要的指导意义。

title: Distributed Multiconsensus Control of BESSs Based on Centrality of Eigenvectors
summary: Secondary control and the State-of-Charge (SoC) balance control are important control objectives for battery energy storage systems (BESSs). In this brief, a communication weight allocation method based on the centrality of eigenvectors is designed for a connected and directed graph, which results in the adjacency matrix having a given eigenvector. Subsequently, a distributed secondary voltage controller and an SoC balancing controller are designed for droop-controlled BESSs to achieve voltage leader-following multiconsensus and SoC balancing, respectively. It is worth mentioning that under the designed voltage secondary control scheme, only a single leader is needed to achieve voltage multiconsensus control. In addition, the capacity information/droop coefficient does not need to be transmitted in the communication network to achieve power sharing according to capacity and SoC balance. For SoC balance control, the control gain is also well analyzed to ensure stability. The relevant simulations verify the effectiveness of the designed scheme.

AI.title_translation: 基于特征向量中心性的BESSs分布式多共识控制
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于特征向量中心性的BESSs分布式控制方法，仅需单领导者即可实现电压多共识和SoC平衡，且无需在通信网络中传输容量信息。
AI.motivation: 电池储能系统（BESSs）中，二次控制和荷电状态（SoC）平衡控制是重要的控制目标，旨在解决传统控制中对领导者数量的依赖以及通信网络中容量信息传输的需求。
AI.method: 为连通有向图设计了一种基于特征向量中心性的通信权重分配方法，使邻接矩阵具有给定的特征向量；随后为下垂控制的BESSs设计了分布式二次电压控制器和SoC平衡控制器。
AI.result: 实现了电压领导者跟随多共识和SoC平衡控制，仅需单个领导者即可实现电压多共识控制，且无需在通信网络中传输容量信息或下垂系数即可按容量进行功率分配和SoC平衡，仿真验证了该方案的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功设计了一种基于特征向量中心性的分布式多共识控制方案，实现了BESSs的电压领导者跟随多共识和SoC平衡，且具有通信开销低、无需传输容量信息的优势，仿真验证了其有效性。
AI.translation: 二次控制和荷电状态（SoC）平衡控制是电池储能系统（BESSs）的重要控制目标。本文针对连通有向图设计了一种基于特征向量中心性的通信权重分配方法，从而使邻接矩阵具有给定的特征向量。随后，为下垂控制的BESSs设计了分布式二次电压控制器和SoC平衡控制器，分别实现电压领导者跟随多共识和SoC平衡。值得一提的是，在设计的电压二次控制方案下，仅需一个领导者即可实现电压多共识控制。此外，为了根据容量和SoC平衡实现功率分配，容量信息/下垂系数无需在通信网络中传输。对于SoC平衡控制，还对控制增益进行了详细分析以确保稳定性。相关仿真验证了所设计方案的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文针对电池储能系统（BESSs），提出了一种基于特征向量中心性的分布式多共识控制方法。通过设计特定的通信权重分配方法和分布式控制器，实现了单领导者电压多共识和SoC平衡控制，且无需传输容量信息，仿真验证了方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 电池储能系统, 特征向量中心性, 分布式多共识控制, 荷电状态平衡, 二次控制
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于特征向量中心性的分布式多共识控制方法，用于电池储能系统（BESSs），创新点在于仅需单个领导者即可实现电压多共识，且在实现容量功率分配和SoC平衡时无需在通信网络中传输容量信息或下垂系数。局限性仅在仿真中得到验证，缺乏实际硬件实验支撑。

title: Do Personality-Tuned LLMs Make Better Social Agents?
summary: LLMs are increasingly used in social simulations for socially interactive agents and robots, offering more flexibility than rule-based systems. However, even though they mimic human behaviour very well, there is a persistent alienness to them. This work investigates whether personality-aware fine-tuning can reduce this gap by improving the consistency and controllability of personality-conditioned dialogue generation compared with instruction prompting alone. We fine-tune two small open-weight LLMs, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Ministral-8B-Instruct, using a corpus that combines personality-labelled social media posts and dialogues to create a personality-based dialogue engine for social simulation. The resulting models are evaluated across multiple social interaction scenarios using three independent LLM judges, which assess personality fidelity and provide evidence-based behavioral interpretations. We additionally quantify inter-rater agreement and lexical characteristics of the generated dialogue. Results indicate that fine-tuned models are not better at role-playing different personalities than their respective baseline models. However, low inter-rater agreement limits the confidence with which these results can be interpreted. Concerning the quality of generated texts, fine-tuned models are mostly comparable to the baselines, with fine-tuning improving the linguistic diversity of the Qwen models. While the results appear generally usable and the baseline models offer the best overall performance, future studies should place greater emphasis on the quality and domain alignment of training data for accurate personality role-playing.

AI.title_translation: 性格微调的大语言模型能成为更好的社交代理吗？
AI.tldr: 性格微调未能显著提升大语言模型在社交模拟中的角色扮演能力，基线模型表现更优，凸显了高质量训练数据的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM能很好地模仿人类行为，但其仍存在“异质感”。本研究旨在探讨性格感知微调是否能通过提高性格条件对话生成的连贯性和可控性，来减少这种差距。
AI.method: 使用包含带有人格标签的社交媒体帖子和对话的语料库，对两个小型开源大模型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Ministral-8B-Instruct）进行微调，并通过三个独立的LLM裁判在多种社交互动场景中评估其人格保真度和行为解释，同时量化评分者间的一致性和生成对话的词汇特征。
AI.result: 微调后的模型在扮演不同性格时并不比各自的基线模型表现更好，且低评分者一致性限制了结果的解释置信度；但在文本质量上，微调模型与基线相当，且微调改善了Qwen模型的语言多样性。
AI.conclusion: 性格微调未能显著提升LLM的角色扮演能力，基线模型整体表现最佳，未来研究需更加关注训练数据的质量和领域对齐。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被应用于社交模拟中的互动代理和机器人，与基于规则的系统相比，它们提供了更大的灵活性。然而，尽管它们很好地模仿了人类行为，但它们仍然存在一种挥之不去的异质感。本工作探讨了与仅使用指令提示相比，性格感知微调是否能够通过提高性格条件对话生成的连贯性和可控性来缩小这一差距。我们使用结合了带有人格标签的社交媒体帖子和对话的语料库，微调了两个小型开源LLM（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Ministral-8B-Instruct），以构建用于社交模拟的基于性格的对话引擎。所得模型在多种社交互动场景中通过三个独立的LLM裁判进行评估，这些裁判评估了性格保真度并提供了基于证据的行为解释。我们还量化了生成对话的评分者间一致性和词汇特征。结果表明，微调后的模型在扮演不同性格时并不比各自的基线模型更好。然而，较低的评分者间一致性限制了解释这些结果的置信度。关于生成文本的质量，微调后的模型大多与基线相当，微调提高了Qwen模型的语言多样性。虽然结果大体上可用，且基线模型提供了最佳的整体性能，但未来的研究应更加重视训练数据的质量和领域对齐，以实现准确的性格角色扮演。
AI.summary: 本文研究了性格微调对社交代理大语言模型的影响。通过对开源模型进行微调并评估，结果发现微调并未显著提升性格角色扮演能力，基线模型表现更好，凸显了高质量训练数据对精确性格扮演的重要性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 社交模拟, 性格微调, 对话生成, 角色扮演
AI.comments: 该研究探讨了性格微调对LLM在社交模拟中表现的影响，结论表明简单微调并未显著提升角色扮演能力，强调了高质量领域对齐训练数据的重要性，具有一定的实证参考价值。

title: Watermarkable Multi-Draft Speculative Sampling via Poisson Processes
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of tasks, motivating two important aspects of deployment: inference efficiency and output provenance, which can be tackled by speculative sampling and watermarking, respectively. However, recent works have shown that combining these two goals is highly nontrivial and can be potentially impossible. In this work, we develop a novel multi-draft speculative sampling algorithm based on Poisson processes that improves the frontier of this fundamental trade-off. The proposed algorithm has strong sampling efficiency on its own and, more interestingly, is naturally watermarkable: we can embed an unbiased watermark without degrading speculative acceptance. Moreover, our algorithm is based on an exact list-coupling-without-communication scheme, which yields a drafter invariance property that benefits both sampling and watermarking. It is the first multi-draft, drafter-invariant speculative sampling scheme that maintains both watermark strength and sampling efficiency, and we experimentally verify its strong performance in both aspects.

AI.title_translation: 基于泊松过程的可加水印多草稿推测采样
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于泊松过程的水印多草稿推测采样算法，首次在保持采样效率的同时成功嵌入无偏水印。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的部署需要兼顾推理效率（通过推测采样）和输出溯源（通过水印），然而将二者结合极具挑战甚至可能无法实现，现有的权衡关系亟待突破。
AI.method: 开发了一种基于泊松过程的新型多草稿推测采样算法，利用精确的无通信列表耦合方案实现草稿器不变性。
AI.result: 实验验证了该算法在保持采样效率和水印强度方面均具有强大的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该基于泊松过程的多草稿推测采样算法成功兼顾了推理效率与水印强度，实现了首个多草稿且草稿器不变的方案，并在实验中验证了其卓越性能。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在各种任务中取得了最先进的性能，这促成了部署中的两个重要方面：推理效率和输出溯源，它们分别可以通过推测采样和加水印来解决。然而，最近的研究表明，结合这两个目标是非常复杂的，甚至可能是不可能的。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种基于泊松过程的新型多草稿推测采样算法，改善了这个基本权衡的前沿。所提出的算法本身具有很强的采样效率，更有趣的是，它是天然可加水印的：我们可以在不降低推测接受率的情况下嵌入无偏水印。此外，我们的算法基于一种精确的无通信列表耦合方案，该方案产生了一个有利于采样和加水印的草稿器不变性（drafter invariance）属性。这是第一个在保持水印强度和采样效率的同时，维持多草稿、草稿器不变的推测采样方案，我们通过实验验证了其在这两个方面的强大性能。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于泊松过程的水印多草稿推测采样算法。该算法利用精确的无通信列表耦合机制实现了草稿器不变性，在不降低推测接受率的前提下嵌入了无偏水印，首次在保持水印强度的同时保证了多草稿推测采样的效率。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 推测采样, 模型水印, 泊松过程, 推理效率
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多草稿推测采样与泊松过程结合，解决了大模型推理加速与水印嵌入之间的矛盾，实现了无性能退化的无偏水印嵌入，具有很高的实用价值。

title: TrialAtlas: Multi-Agent Research Organization for Clinical Trial Design and Optimization
summary: Nearly 90% of drugs entering clinical development ultimately fail, despite billions of dollars in investment. Pharmaceutical companies therefore rely on clinical development planning (CDP) and probability of technical and regulatory success assessment to anticipate development risks, yet these decisions remain labor-intensive and subjective, requiring experts across clinical science, statistics, regulatory affairs, and competitive intelligence to jointly acquire, synthesize, and reason over heterogeneous evidence. Here, we introduce TrialAtlas, a memory-augmented multi-agent research organization for CDP that mirrors this collaborative process by coordinating specialized agents for literature synthesis, competitive trial intelligence, regulatory precedent analysis, and integrated reasoning over trial design and development risk. TrialAtlas further learns from historical clinical trials and regulatory outcomes, including prior New Drug Applications (NDAs), to ground its decisions in accumulated development experience. To evaluate these capabilities in an authentic regulatory setting, we introduce TrialAtlasBench, constructed from 291 FDA Complete Response Letters and spanning three practical tasks: detecting trial design deficiencies, recommending actionable design improvements, and predicting technical and regulatory success. TrialAtlas achieves an F1 score of 50.0% for deficiency detection, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.1 points, and reaches 85.3% balanced accuracy and 84.7% F1 for prediction of technical and regulatory success, improving over the best baselines by 6.7 points in balanced accuracy and 12.0 points in Cohen's kappa. In expert evaluation, 86.4% of TrialAtlas-generated concerns were judged valid, compared with 83.1% for OpenAI DeepResearch and 59.3% for Gemini DeepResearch.

AI.title_translation: TrialAtlas：用于临床试验设计与优化的多智能体研究组织
AI.tldr: 本文提出TrialAtlas——一个多智能体研究组织，用于临床试验设计与优化，显著提升了药物临床开发中缺陷检测和成功率预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 近90%进入临床开发的药物最终失败，临床开发规划（CDP）和成功率评估高度依赖人工且具有主观性，需要跨领域的专家协作，因此亟需一种能够自动化并优化这一复杂流程的计算框架。
AI.method: 引入TrialAtlas，一个内存增强的多智能体研究组织，通过协调专门的智能体来进行文献综合、竞争性试验情报、监管先例分析，并在试验设计和研发风险上进行综合推理；同时引入TrialAtlasBench数据集（包含291封FDA完整回应函）用于评估三个实际任务。
AI.result: TrialAtlas在缺陷检测任务中F1分数为50.0%（超越最强基线6.1个百分点），在技术和监管成功预测中达到85.3%的平衡准确率和84.7%的F1分数；在专家评估中，其生成的担忧有86.4%被判定为有效，表现优于OpenAI DeepResearch和Gemini DeepResearch。
AI.conclusion: TrialAtlas作为一种内存增强的多智能体研究组织，能够有效协助临床开发规划并预测监管成功率，为提高临床试验成功率和降低研发风险提供了强有力的计算工具。
AI.translation: 尽管投入了数十亿美元，但进入临床开发的药物中仍有近90%最终失败。因此，制药公司依靠临床开发规划（CDP）以及技术和监管成功概率评估来预测开发风险，然而这些决策仍然劳动密集且具有主观性，需要临床科学、统计学、监管事务和竞争情报等领域的专家共同获取、综合和推理异构证据。在这里，我们介绍了TrialAtlas，这是一个用于CDP的内存增强型多智能体研究组织，它通过协调专门用于文献综合、竞争性试验情报、监管先例分析以及试验设计和开发风险综合推理的智能体，来镜像这一协作过程。TrialAtlas进一步从历史临床试验和监管结果（包括先前的对新药申请NDA的审批）中学习，以将决策建立在积累的开发经验基础之上。为了在真实的监管环境中评估这些能力，我们推出了TrialAtlasBench，它由291封FDA完整回应函构建而成，涵盖三个实际任务：检测试验设计缺陷、推荐可行的设计改进、以及预测技术和监管成功率。TrialAtlas在缺陷检测方面的F1分数为50.0%，比最强的基线高出6.1个百分点；在技术和监管成功预测方面，达到了85.3%的平衡准确率和84.7%的F1分数，比最佳基线在平衡准确率上提高6.7个百分点，在Cohen's kappa上提高12.0个百分点。在专家评估中，86.4%的TrialAtlas生成的担忧被认为有效，相比之下，OpenAI DeepResearch为83.1%，Gemini DeepResearch为59.3%。
AI.summary: 论文介绍了TrialAtlas，一个用于临床试验设计和优化的内存增强型多智能体研究组织，它模拟了跨学科专家的协作过程，并通过新提出的TrialAtlasBench数据集验证了其在缺陷检测、设计改进推荐以及监管成功预测方面的优越性能。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 临床试验设计, 药物研发, 监管成功率预测, TrialAtlasBench
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多智能体协作框架应用于药物临床试验设计与优化，不仅模拟了跨学科专家组的决策流程，还通过引入TrialAtlasBench基准数据集进行了严格的真实世界效果评估，展现出远超传统基线和通用大模型的能力，对降低新药研发风险具有重要意义。

title: Isogeometric analysis for the Helmholtz transmission eigenvalue problem
summary: The transmission eigenvalue problem plays an increasingly important role in inverse scattering theory. Although significant progress has been made in developing efficient numerical methods for the problem over the last two decades, its numerical treatment for curved domains in $\mathbb{R}^d$ ($d=2,3$) remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce and analyze a geometrically flexible and $H^2$-conforming isogeometric method for solving a fourth-order, quadratic and non-self-adjoint eigenvalue problem arising from the Helmholtz transmission eigenvalue problem. Using the spectral approximation theory for compact non-self-adjoint operators, we derive optimal error estimates for the discrete eigenvalues and eigenfunctions. Numerical results for the two- and three-dimensional benchmark problems, including those defined in curved domains, are presented to verify our theoretical results, and to demonstrate the advantages of the method over existing numerical methods in terms of both accuracy and geometric flexibility.

AI.title_translation: 亥姆霍兹透射特征值问题的等几何分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于求解亥姆霍兹透射特征值问题的等几何分析方法，具有高精度和处理曲线域的几何灵活性。
AI.motivation: 尽管反散射理论中的透射特征值问题数值方法取得了很大进展，但针对$\mathbb{R}^d$（$d=2,3$）中曲线域的数值处理仍然具有挑战性，因此需要更具几何灵活性和高效性的数值方法。
AI.method: 引入并分析了一种几何灵活且$H^2$协调的等几何分析方法，用以求解由亥姆霍兹透射特征值问题导出的四阶二次非自伴特征值问题，并利用紧非自伴算子的谱近似理论推导了误差估计。
AI.result: 理论上推导出了离散特征值和特征函数的渐近最优误差估计，数值实验验证了理论结果，并证明了该方法在精度和几何灵活性上优于现有数值方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于$H^2$协调等几何分析的方法能够高效且精确地求解亥姆霍兹透射特征值问题，非常适合处理复杂曲线边界。
AI.translation: 透射特征值问题在反散射理论中扮演着日益重要的角色。尽管在过去二十年中，开发该问题的高效数值方法取得了显著进展，但其在 $\mathbb{R}^d$（$d=2,3$）中曲线域的数值处理仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们引入并分析了一种几何灵活且 $H^2$ 协调的等几何方法，用于求解由亥姆霍兹透射特征值问题产生的四阶、二次、非自伴特征值问题。利用紧致非自伴算子的谱近似理论，我们推导了离散特征值和特征函数的最优误差估计。给出了二维和三维基准问题（包括在曲线域上定义的问题）的数值结果，以验证我们的理论结果，并证明该方法在精度和几何灵活性方面优于现有数值方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对亥姆霍兹透射特征值问题，提出了一种几何灵活且$H^2$协调的等几何分析方法。通过谱近似理论给出了最优误差估计，并通过二维和三维基准算例证明了该方法在精度和处理曲线域方面的优势。
AI.keywords: 等几何分析, 亥姆霍兹透射特征值问题, 谱近似理论, 曲线边界, $H^2$协调法
AI.comments: 该论文将等几何分析（IGA）成功引入到亥姆霍兹透射特征值问题中，特别是针对曲线边界区域，展现出了比传统方法更高的精度和几何灵活性。严格的谱近似理论分析增强了结论的可靠性。

title: AutoRecLab: Describe the Experiment, Get the Code!
comments: Accepted at the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26), Demo Track. 4 pages, 2 figures
summary: Empirical evaluation is central to recommender-systems (RecSys) research, but turning experimental designs into executable code remains a manual and error-prone task. We present AutoRecLab, a Python-based autonomous RecSys lab that automates RecSys experiments from natural-language prompts. Given a research idea, AutoRecLab derives explicit experiment requirements, builds and validates a prototype, and iteratively expands it into the requested full experiment. The workflow combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for documentation lookup, static type verification, and execution-steered tree search. In our demonstration, AutoRecLab autonomously implements an explicit-to-implicit feedback conversion study. In a baseline comparison across six algorithms and three datasets, 8 of 9 runs succeed at an average cost of approx- imately $1 per run with GPT-5.4-mini.
comment: Accepted at the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26), Demo Track. 4 pages, 2 figures

AI.title_translation: AutoRecLab：描述实验，获取代码！
AI.tldr: AutoRecLab是一个可以通过自然语言提示自动生成推荐系统实验代码的AI框架，具有高效、低成本和高成功率的特点。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统研究中的经验评估至关重要，但将实验设计转化为可执行代码通常需要大量手动操作且容易出错，亟需一种能够从自然语言提示自动生成推荐系统实验的自动化方案。
AI.method: 基于Python的自主推荐系统实验框架，结合了检索增强生成（RAG）用于文档查询、静态类型验证以及执行引导的树搜索，通过迭代扩展从原型构建完整实验。
AI.result: 在涵盖6种算法和3个数据集的基准测试中，使用GPT-5.4-mini时9次运行中有8次成功，平均每次运行成本约为1美元。
AI.conclusion: AutoRecLab作为首个基于自然语言的自主推荐系统实验框架，能够有效将研究想法转化为可执行代码，且具有高成功率和低成本的优势，展示了AI在自动化科学研究（AI for Science）中的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 经验评估是推荐系统（RecSys）研究的核心，但将实验设计转化为可执行代码仍然是一项手动且容易出错的任务。我们提出了 AutoRecLab，这是一个基于 Python 的自主 RecSys 实验室，可以根据自然语言提示自动完成 RecSys 实验。给定一个研究想法，AutoRecLab 推导出明确的实验需求，构建并验证原型，并将其迭代扩展为所请求的完整实验。该工作流程结合了用于文档查询的检索增强生成（RAG）、静态类型验证和执行引导的树搜索。在我们的演示中，AutoRecLab 自主实现了一项显式到隐式反馈转换的研究。在涵盖六种算法和三个数据集的基准比较中，使用 GPT-5.4-mini 时，9 次运行中有 8 次成功，平均每次运行成本约为 1 美元。
AI.summary: AutoRecLab是一个基于Python的自动化推荐系统实验框架，它能够根据自然语言提示，利用RAG、静态类型验证和树搜索等技术，自主推导实验需求、构建并迭代扩展出完整的可执行实验代码。
AI.keywords: AutoRecLab, 推荐系统, 自然语言提示, 自动化实验, 代码生成
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型与代码生成结合到推荐系统实验中，通过RAG、静态类型验证和执行引导的树搜索，实现了从自然语言到完整实验代码的自动化生成，显著提升了研究效率。然而，其评估范围仍主要基于特定演示和基准，对于更复杂的真实世界研究任务的效果仍需进一步验证。

title: Morphology-Aware Ambiguity Learning for Wafer Defect Decision Support
summary: Wafer map defect recognition is commonly formulated as a fixed-taxonomy classification problem that assigns each wafer to a single defect class. However, some wafers exhibit morphologies near class boundaries, for which forcing a single prediction may be less informative than providing plausible diagnostic alternatives. This paper proposes a morphology-aware ambiguity learning framework that supports three diagnostic actions: automatic single-class diagnosis, assisted diagnosis with two plausible defect classes, and full review. Using the radial, angular, and geometric characteristics of training wafer maps, the framework constructs a class-level ambiguity matrix representing defect-class pairs with similar morphology and plausible diagnostic alternatives. It guides the model to learn plausible alternative classes rather than treating all incorrect classes equally. During inference, the matrix determines whether an uncertain prediction can be represented by a meaningful two-class diagnostic set or should be escalated for full review. Experiments on WM-811K show that the proposed framework outperforms conventional approaches in defect recognition and diagnostic decision support, providing meaningful two-class alternatives while reserving full review for cases with unresolved ambiguity. Illustrative cost analyses further show the potential cost advantage of the proposed routing strategy. The diagnostic behavior of the framework remains consistent across different backbone architectures.

AI.title_translation: 面向晶圆缺陷决策支持的形态感知歧义学习
AI.tldr: 提出了一种形态感知的歧义学习框架，能够为晶圆缺陷识别中的边界模糊样本提供单类、双类替代或全面复审的多样化诊断决策支持。
AI.motivation: 传统的晶圆图缺陷识别通常将其表述为固定分类任务，强制分配单一类别；然而，许多晶圆图具有接近类边界的形态，强制单一预测不如提供合理的诊断替代方案更具参考价值。
AI.method: 利用训练晶圆图的径向、角度和几何特征，构建表示具有相似形态和合理解析替代方案的缺陷类对的类级歧义矩阵，以此引导模型学习合理的替代类别，并在推理时决定采用单类诊断、双类替代集还是全面复审。
AI.result: 在WM-811K数据集上的实验表明，该框架在缺陷识别和诊断决策支持方面优于传统方法，能提供有意义的两类替代方案，并将全面复审留给未解决歧义的案例，展现出潜在的成本优势。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种形态感知的歧义学习框架，能有效处理晶圆缺陷分类中的边界模糊性，提升决策支持能力并展现出潜在的成本优势。
AI.translation: 晶圆图缺陷识别通常被设定为一个固定的分类问题，为每个晶圆分配单一的缺陷类别。然而，一些晶圆表现出接近类边界的形态，强制进行单一预测比提供合理的诊断替代方案信息量更少。本文提出了一种形态感知的歧义学习框架，支持三种诊断动作：自动单类诊断、具有两个合理缺陷类的辅助诊断以及全面复审。利用训练晶圆图的径向、角度和几何特征，该框架构建了一个类级歧义矩阵，代表具有相似形态和合理诊断替代方案的缺陷类对。它引导模型学习合理的替代类别，而不是平等对待所有不正确的类别。在推理过程中，矩阵决定是不确定的预测可以用有意义的两类诊断集表示，还是应该升级进行全面复审。在WM-811K上的实验表明，所提出的框架在缺陷识别和诊断决策支持方面优于传统方法，在将全面复审保留给具有未解决歧义的情况的同时，提供了有意义的两类替代方案。说明性的成本分析进一步展示了所提出的路由策略的潜在成本优势。该框架的诊断行为在不同的主干网络架构中保持一致。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种形态感知的歧义学习框架用于晶圆缺陷决策支持。通过构建类级歧义矩阵来捕捉相似的形态特征，该方法不仅能进行自动单类诊断，还能为模糊样本提供合理的双类替代诊断或触发全面复审，在WM-811K数据集上验证了其有效性和成本优势。
AI.keywords: 晶圆缺陷识别, 形态感知, 歧义学习, 决策支持, 缺陷分类
AI.comments: 该论文针对晶圆图缺陷识别中常见的边界样本分类歧义问题，提出了一种形态感知的歧义学习框架。创新点在于利用晶圆的几何特征构建类级歧义矩阵，支持单分类、双分类辅助诊断和全面人工复审三种决策分流，有效提升了决策的灵活性和自动化水平。

title: Tangential stability and fully discrete convergence of the classical BGN scheme for curve shortening flow
summary: We prove fully discrete convergence of the classical Barrett--Garcke--Nürnberg (BGN) scheme for curve-shortening flow of smooth embedded closed planar curves. The main obstruction is that the mass form controls only normal motion, whereas the tangential motion is determined implicitly by the curvature equation and governs the parametrization. The usual length-decay estimate therefore does not control perturbations of the full position update. We separate temporal and spatial errors through the time-semidiscrete BGN solution. A scalar normal resolvent and exact curvature and length identities yield uniform regularity and first-order time convergence. For the spatial analysis, an adapted normal--tangential norm gives a near-contractive estimate for the linearized update. Gauss--Lobatto cancellations and an exact covariance identity for the assembled nodal normals produce an $H^1$ one-step defect of order $h^{k+1}$, while an exact difference identity controls the nonlinear remainder. For every fixed $k\ge1$, including the original piecewise linear method, we obtain the matched $W^{1,\infty}$ error bound $C(τ+h^k)$ on periodic quasi-uniform meshes with $h\le cτ^2$. All discrete steps are uniquely solvable, and the numerical curves remain regular and embedded. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first fully discrete convergence result for the classical BGN curve-shortening scheme without additional stabilization.

AI.title_translation: 经典BGN格式用于曲线缩短流的切向稳定性和完全离散收敛性
AI.tldr: 首次证明了经典BGN曲线缩短格式在无需额外稳定化时的完全离散收敛性，并给出了最优误差界。
AI.motivation: 经典的Barrett-Garcke--Nürnberg (BGN) 格式用于曲线缩短流时，质量形式仅控制法向运动，而切向运动由曲率方程隐式确定并控制参数化，导致通常的长度衰减估计无法控制全位置更新的扰动，此前缺乏该格式在不加额外稳定化情况下的完全离散收敛性证明。
AI.method: 通过时间半离散的BGN解分离时间和空间误差；利用标量法向预解式、精确曲率和长度恒等式证明时间收敛性；利用适应的法向-切向范数、Gauss--Lobatto相消以及精确协方差恒等式进行空间误差分析。
AI.result: 对于每个固定的 $k\ge1$（包括原始的分段线性方法），在 $h\le c\tau^2$ 的周期拟均匀网格上得到了匹配的 $W^{1,\infty}$ 误差界 $C(\tau + h^k)$，且所有离散步均可唯一求解，数值曲线保持正则和嵌入。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功证明了经典BGN格式在周期拟均匀网格下的完全离散收敛性，给出了匹配的 $W^{1,\infty}$ 误差界，且保证了离散步骤的唯一可解性以及数值曲线的正则性和嵌入性。
AI.translation: 我们证明了经典的Barrett--Garcke--Nürnberg (BGN) 格式在光滑嵌入闭平面曲线缩短流中的完全离散收敛性。主要的障碍在于质量形式仅控制法向运动，而切向运动由曲率方程隐式确定并控制参数化。因此，通常的长度衰减估计无法控制全位置更新的扰动。我们通过时间半离散的BGN解将时间和空间误差分离开来。标量法向预解式以及精确的曲率和长度恒等式导出了均匀正则性和一阶时间收敛性。对于空间分析，自适应的法向-切向范数给出了线性化更新的近收缩估计。Gauss--Lobatto相消和组装节点法向的精确协方差恒等式产生了阶数为 $h^{k+1}$ 的 $H^1$ 单步缺陷，而精确的差分恒等式则控制了非线性余项。对于每个固定的 $k\ge1$（包括原始的分段线性方法），我们在满足 $h\le c\tau^2$ 的周期拟均匀网格上得到了匹配的 $W^{1,\infty}$ 误差界 $C(\tau+h^k)$。所有离散步都是唯一可解的，并且数值曲线保持正则和嵌入。据我们所知，这是在没有额外稳定化的情况下，关于经典BGN曲线缩短格式的第一个完全离散收敛性结果。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了经典Barrett--Garcke--Nürnberg (BGN) 格式用于光滑嵌入闭平面曲线缩短流的完全离散收敛性。通过分离时空误差、利用法向-切向范数以及精细的代数恒等式，首次在无需额外稳定化的前提下，证明了该经典格式的完全离散收敛性并给出了最优误差界。
AI.keywords: 曲线缩短流, Barrett--Garcke--Nürnberg格式, 完全离散收敛性, 切向稳定性, 误差估计
AI.comments: 该论文首次证明了经典的Barrett-Garcke-Nürnberg (BGN) 格式在曲线缩短流中的完全离散收敛性，无需额外的稳定化处理，理论分析极其深入且具有重大突破。

title: Comparing Haptic Feedback Across Hand Tracking and Controllers in VR Object Interaction Tasks
summary: Hand tracking offers natural VR interaction but lacks controllers' inherent tactile feedback, while haptic feedback across input methods remains understudied. We conducted a participant study comparing vibration, impulse, and no feedback in hand- and controller-based VR interaction across grasp-, pinch-, and tap-like gestures assessing performance, workload, and preference. A custom glove and controller-mounted device provided both feedback types, aiming for consistency across input modalities. Controllers were faster for grasp and pinch, whereas hand tracking was more accurate for pinch and preferred overall. Haptics had limited performance effects, although impulse reduced grasp accuracy with controllers. Participants preferred vibration and impulse over no haptic feedback, favouring vibration overall. Our findings reveal a more nuanced relationship between haptic feedback, input device, and interaction context than suggested by previous work.

AI.title_translation: 在VR物体交互任务中比较手部追踪与手柄的触觉反馈
AI.tldr: 本文对比了VR中手部追踪和手柄在不同触觉反馈下的表现，发现手柄速度更快但手部追踪更受喜爱，用户普遍偏好带振动的触觉反馈。
AI.motivation: 手部追踪提供了自然的VR交互但缺乏控制器的触觉反馈，且跨输入方法的触觉反馈研究尚不充分，因此需要对比研究其对性能、工作量和用户偏好的影响。
AI.method: 进行了一项用户研究，对比了振动、脉冲和无反馈三种条件在手部追踪和手柄交互中的表现（涵盖抓取、捏取和轻击手势），评估指标包括性能、工作量和偏好。
AI.result: 手柄在抓取和捏取任务中速度更快，而手部追踪在捏取任务中准确度更高且总体更受欢迎；触觉反馈对性能影响有限，但振动和脉冲均受到用户青睐，其中振动最受欢迎。
AI.conclusion: 手部追踪与手柄在不同手势和触觉反馈下表现各异：手柄速度更快但手部追踪在捏取时更准确且更受欢迎；触觉反馈（振动或脉冲）总体上提升了用户偏好，但对性能影响有限。
AI.translation: 手部追踪提供了自然的VR交互，但缺乏控制器固有的触觉反馈，且跨输入方法的触觉反馈研究仍然不足。我们进行了一项参与者研究，比较了基于手部追踪和控制器的VR交互中的振动、脉冲和无反馈，涵盖了抓取、捏取和轻击类手势，评估了性能、工作量和偏好。定制手套和控制器安装的设备提供了两种反馈类型，旨在实现输入模态之间的一致性。控制器在抓取和捏取方面更快，而手部追踪在捏取方面更准确且总体上更受欢迎。触觉对性能的影响有限，尽管脉冲降低了控制器的抓取准确度。参与者更喜欢振动和脉冲，而不是没有触觉反馈，总体上更喜欢振动。我们的研究结果揭示了触觉反馈、输入设备和交互环境之间比以往工作所暗示的更细微的关系。
AI.summary: 本研究通过用户实验对比了手部追踪和手柄在不同触觉反馈（振动、脉冲、无反馈）及手势（抓取、捏取、轻击）下的表现。结果表明手柄速度占优而手部追踪准确度高且更受欢迎，用户偏爱带有振动或脉冲的触觉反馈。
AI.keywords: 虚拟现实, 手部追踪, 控制器, 触觉反馈, 用户研究
AI.comments: 该研究深入探讨了VR交互中手部追踪与手柄在不同触觉反馈下的性能和用户体验，对于优化未来VR设备的交互设计具有重要意义。局限性在于主要通过特定手套和手柄设备测试，结论可能受限于特定硬件实现。

title: Neural Cellular Automata Learn General Features in their Hidden Channels
summary: Modern deep learning models achieve impressive generalization through over-parameterization, but this paradigm often struggles with overfitting and memorization in few-shot regimes. Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) offer a highly parameter-efficient alternative, yet research has focused primarily on their output, leaving the role of their internal hidden channels largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate the internal dynamics of NCA hidden channels and introduce a novel transfer-learning mechanism that injects a pretrained teacher's hidden states into a student model to guide early optimization. Evaluated on few-shot and scale-variant MNIST benchmarks, NCAs outperform comparable recurrent and feed-forward architectures, demonstrating superior generalization with a minimal parameter budget (~9,800 parameters). Mechanistic analysis reveals that the hidden channels decouple feature extraction from uniform classification consensus by absorbing morphological complexity and converging to mutually orthogonal states. Furthermore, we demonstrate that these hidden channels capture general, scale-invariant topological primitives rather than class-specific templates. This allows a student model to achieve strong few-shot performance on unseen classes using features transferred from a teacher trained only on a subset of digits (0-5). Our results highlight the potential of utilizing hidden-state dynamics as a robust, decentralized computational substrate for parameter-efficient transfer learning

title: A filtered time stepping scheme for curve shortening flow for open and closed curves
summary: We propose a filtered time stepping finite element scheme for curve shortening flow of open and closed curves in arbitrary codimension that is second-order accurate in time. Open curves are assumed to evolve inside a given domain $Ω\subset \mathbb R^n$, $n\geq2$, and meet the external boundary $\partialΩ$ orthogonally. We prove optimal error bounds for the $L^2$-- and $H^1$--norms. In practice only a single linear system needs to be solved at each time step. Numerical experiments confirm the accuracy and practicality of the introduced method, including an asymptotic equidistribution property.

title: Chronosphere: Space-Time Tessellation of Local Climate Experts
summary: We introduce Chronosphere, a spatio-temporal neural field that learns representations of climate. A central challenge in geographic representation learning is modeling environmental processes whose spatial and temporal complexity varies widely. Yet existing location encoders typically fix a single level of detail everywhere. Global bases such as spherical harmonics spread capacity uniformly across space and time. Localized bases resolve only predefined regions. Learned tessellations adapt, but are inefficient at representing higher frequencies. Chronosphere unifies these approaches, pairing an adaptive tessellation of learnable sites on the spacetime torus $S^2\times S^1$ with a shared bank of local basis functions. Both where capacity is placed and how much detail each region carries adapt to the data, across space and time. Trained to reconstruct climatology, Chronosphere matches or leads state-of-the-art location encoders across spatial and temporal tasks, with the largest gains under spatial and temporal transfer.

title: SFPF: Spatio-Frequency Polarization Fingerprint for Anomalous Wireless Device Detection
summary: Periodic inspection of deployed wireless devices is necessary because unauthorized hardware replacement may preserve communication functions, credentials, and logical identity, making anomalous devices difficult to detect. Such inspections are conducted under controlled measurement conditions to verify that each device remains consistent with its enrolled hardware state. Conventional radio-frequency fingerprint (RFF) may provide insufficient separation when replacement hardware closely resembles legitimate hardware, while a polarization fingerprint (PF) constructed at one observation direction may miss spatially nonuniform polarization changes. This paper proposes the spatio-frequency polarization fingerprint (SFPF), which jointly represents complex polarization responses over multiple frequencies and observation directions; conventional PF is its fixed-direction slice. We derive SFPF formation from hardware-dependent modal excitation, directional far-field radiation, and polarization projection. A first-order sensitivity analysis shows that the response to the same hardware change varies with both frequency and direction, motivating joint spatio-frequency acquisition. Electromagnetic simulations confirm the nonuniform spatio-frequency sensitivity and show that, under the same observation budget, SFPF improves normalized distance, Fisher score, and the inter-/intra-class ratio over PF by 17.7%, 45.8%, and 11.3%, respectively. Experiments show that SFPF consistently outperforms RFF and PF over 0--20~dB. At 15--20~dB, SFPF achieves anomalous-device F1 scores of 87.3--90.4% and AUROC values of 85.4--95.5%.

title: Geometric Mean Pooling for Equal-Weight Multiplicative Coarse-Graining
summary: As an alternative to the additive and extremal biases of average and max pooling, we introduce Geometric Mean Pooling (GMP), a signed pooling operator that combines the product of feature signs with the geometric mean of feature magnitudes. Motivated by local-to-global composition in quantum many-body physics, GMP retains both joint sign information and a characteristic multiplicative scale without introducing learnable pooling parameters. We show that non-overlapping hierarchical GMP preserves the corresponding global multiplicative statistic and evaluate it on synthetic sequence tasks, iterative coarse-graining, image classification, and molecular lipophilicity regression. On the synthetic tasks, GMP recovers product-based signals more accurately than average and max pooling and maintains predictive performance under the tested levels of multiplicative input noise. On image and molecular data, however, its effectiveness depends on the representation, target parameterization, and placement of local and global pooling. These results position GMP as a complementary, regime-dependent inductive bias for tasks in which equal-weight multiplicative composition is plausible, rather than as a universal replacement for standard pooling operators.

title: Benchmarking the Explanatory Quality of Open-Weight Vision-Language Models in Face Recognition
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have recently been proposed as promising tools for face recognition, as they can produce natural language explanations alongside similarity scores. This capability is considered appealing for face comparisons in forensic contexts, which require decisions to be transparent and auditable. However, existing evaluations of VLMs for that use case focus mostly on recognition accuracy, while the validity of generated explanations remains unquantified. In this work, we introduce a benchmarking framework for VLM-based face recognition that treats explanation quality as a core evaluation axis. We propose two criteria that explanations should satisfy: relevance, i.e., reliance on identity-stable facial features; and faithfulness, i.e., alignment with the visible image content without hallucinated features. We jointly develop a methodology enabling the quantification of relevance and faithfulness of evaluated models, based on constraining model outputs to a structured explanation format that supports automated querying and auditing. Using this framework, we benchmark several families of open-weight VLMs, jointly evaluating face verification accuracy and explanation quality. Our results highlight remaining shortcomings of produced explanations, and emphasize the need for such explanation quality metrics to get a complete picture of model performance. The proposed benchmark and open-source evaluation harness provide a foundation for proper benchmarking and future fine-tuning of explainable face recognition systems.

title: VIRGA: Virtual-Agent-Intermediated Riemannian Geometry for Active-Sensing Air-Ground Coordination
summary: Air-ground autonomy becomes harder when the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) must remain observable by a gimbal light detection and ranging (LiDAR) mounted on the unmanned ground vehicle (UGV). The platforms must avoid dynamic obstacles while coordinating heterogeneous motion, limited sensing, and changing task initiative within one closed loop. This paper presents VIRGA, a neural geometric coordination framework that turns dual-LiDAR observations into bounded source-specific Riemannian fields and couples them through a virtual agent with reciprocal elastic feedback. Platform-aware execution maps convert the shared coordination reference into feasible UAV, UGV, and gimbal commands while enforcing active-observation safeguards. Evaluation against three complementary baselines reveals distinct limitations. An adapted Ray-RMP controller provides the fastest Riemannian response but produces insufficient clearance in the coupled air-ground task. A dense analytical Riemannian field improves geometric avoidance, yet its high evaluation cost prevents stable field-of-view maintenance. An adapted ColAG controller achieves the lowest latency but still incurs safety and observability violations. VIRGA completes all paired warehouse conditions safely, while a long-range cave stress test without retraining demonstrates sustained coordination in irregular and confined geometry. Ablations confirm contributions from online geometric evaluation, virtual-agent mediation, and reciprocal feedback.

title: Catena: A Comprehensive Software Suite for Large-Scale Connectomics
summary: The gold standard datasets for mapping connectomes are electron microscopy volumes of densely labeled neural tissue at nanometer resolution. Yet reconstructing and proofreading neuronal arbors and annotating all synapses requires pipelining multiple software tools that are often fragmented, inconsistently maintained, or proprietary, hindering reproducibility and automation. Here, we introduce Catena, an open-source, comprehensive, developer-centric software suite for connectomics that integrates modules for 3D neuron and organelle segmentation, synapse detection, microtubule tracking, and neurotransmitter inference. Catena organizes its modules in composable, chunk-wise processing pipelines in a completely documented, extensible, and adaptable design. We further reduce compute and ground-truth data requirements with pretrained machine learning models, facilitating fine-tuning. Catena ships fully containerized modules that encapsulate evolving dependencies for consistent execution across workstations and clusters. By consolidating open components, shareable models, and containerized runtimes, Catena delivers a reproducible and scalable approach to mapping cellular connectomes from electron microscopy volumes. Code and documentation: https://github.com/Mohinta2892/catena.git

title: Detecting Pretraining Data in Large Language Models from a Free-Energy Perspective
summary: Detecting pretraining data in large language models is challenging because high likelihood can reflect either training exposure or strong generalization. In the joint space of prediction loss and predictive entropy, a likelihood-only detector uses a horizontal boundary and can mistake predictable non-members for members. Motivated by this, we introduce an inclined boundary that evaluates prediction loss relative to predictive entropy. Our analysis shows that entropy correction can preserve the expected membership signal while reducing its variance, thereby improving standardized member--non-member separation. We further extend the mean--variance analysis to the more general setting with a nonzero mean entropy gap. Interestingly, this entropy-adjusted score admits a Helmholtz free-energy interpretation, leading to Energy Transfer Detection (ETD), which views pretraining data detection from a macroscopic residual free-energy transfer perspective. Extensive experiments show that ETD achieves the best average detection performance, improving average AUROC by up to 3.5\% and TPR@5\%FPR by up to 5.1\%, while remaining robust across diverse settings.

title: Online Algorithms with a Sample: Tight Bounds and Adversarial Robustness
summary:
Suppose an online algorithm is given an unbiased $p$-sample of its input as offline advice; can the algorithm exploit the sample to achieve beyond-worst-case performance? We study this online algorithms with a sample (OAS) model. We show a tight $O\left(\log (1/p) \cdot \log m + \log n\right)$-competitive algorithm for set cover, exponentially improving upon the $O\left(1/p \cdot \log (mn)\right)$ guarantee of Gupta et al. (SODA'24) and answering an open question therein. Our techniques extend to covering integer programs and non-metric facility location, also yielding tight bounds for these problems. Further, we give an $O(\log (1/p)/ \log \log (1/p))$-competitive algorithm for metric facility location, answering an open question of Argue et al. (NeurIPS'22).
  We then introduce and study the robust variant of the OAS model, in which an adversary is allowed to arbitrarily modify $k$ elements of the $p$-sample. For set cover, covering integer programs, and non-metric facility location, we obtain a tight competitive ratio of $O\left(\log (k/p) \cdot \log m + \log n\right)$. For metric facility location and Steiner tree, we obtain tight competitive ratios of $O\left(\log (k/p) / \log \log (k/p) \right)$ and $O\left(\log (k/p)\right)$ respectively. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first results for robust algorithms in the OAS setting.

title: LLMs as Feature Engineers for Text-and-Tabular Prediction
summary: We introduce an iterative framework that automates the extraction of interpretable, schema-bound categorical features from unstructured text for tabular prediction models. To navigate the feature space, a generator LLM proposes semantic definitions, a separate extractor LLM materializes the features, and a downstream tabular model evaluates their predictive performance. We optimize this search by translating explicit model errors, such as AUC ranking inversions, into natural-language feedback, steering the LLM to resolve specific predictive failures. Evaluated across three public datasets, this error-driven loop accelerates feature discovery by up to $3\times$ compared to unguided search. Empirically, the generated features demonstrate strong multi-view complementarity, strictly outperforming any subset when combined with TF-IDF and dense embeddings. Finally, the framework guarantees instance-level interpretability: the discovered features dominate SHAP importance rankings and provide a fully transparent, semantic audit trail for every prediction.

title: ExpBoN: Exponential-Noise Best-of-$n$ for Efficient Test-Time LLM Alignment
summary: Best-of-$n$ (BoN) sampling is a simple yet effective inference-time alignment method, but hard maximization provides only coarse control over the trade-off between reward and distribution shift. Soft Best-of-$n$ (Verdun et al. 2025) provides smoother control and converges to the optimal distribution associated with KL-regularized reward maximization. In this paper, we introduce ExpBoN, an alternative soft BoN method based on the exponential-noise report-noisy-max mechanism. It admits an exact finite-$n$ decomposition, which yields exponentially fast convergence in total variation, expected reward, and both directions of KL divergence. We provide comprehensive theoretical analyses of its convergence and regret behavior. We further integrate ExpBoN into the guided speculative inference (GSI) framework (Geuter, Mroueh, and AlvarezMelis 2025), resulting in ExpGSI, for efficient reward-guided LLM alignment. ExpGSI yields substantial reductions in computational cost while maintaining comparable accuracy. Experiments on MATH500, MMLU-STEM, and Minerva Math with the Qwen2.5-Math and Qwen3 model families show that ExpGSI reduces estimated computation by $14\%$-$39\%$ across candidate budgets for Qwen2.5-Math and by up to $45\%$ at $n=16$ for Qwen3. Overall, our results provide a theoretical and algorithmic foundation for exponential-noise BoN and efficient test-time LLM alignment.

title: The Role of Radiometric Features in Cross-Site Leaf-Wood Segmentation of LiDAR Point Clouds
comments: 5 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for presentation at IGARSS 2026 (IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium)
summary: Leaf-wood segmentation of individual trees from LiDAR point clouds is essential for quantitative structure models (QSMs) used in non-destructive biomass estimation. Existing segmentation methods typically exclude radiometric features (e.g., intensity, return number) to maximize cross-sensor compatibility. We challenge this design choice by evaluating cross-site and cross-platform generalization: training on the public Heidelberg dataset (terrestrial TLS, 1550nm) and testing on a novel dataset from Ontario, Canada (RPA-LS, 905nm). Results show that geometry-only methods - including state-of-the-art deep learning models trained on high-density LiDAR datasets - fail to generalize to the sparse, top-down geometry of aerial scans, achieving F1 scores <= 0.56. Incorporating radiometric features (intensity, return number, number of returns) improves F1 to 0.61, but more critically, increases wood recall by 119% from 0.16 to 0.35. Furthermore, geometry-only approaches often result in fragmented stem and branch components. We find that leveraging radiometric features preserves greater structural connectivity, resulting in more coherent architectures that are better suited for QSM reconstruction. We demonstrate that while geometric patterns are view-dependent and prone to overfitting scan patterns, radiometric features encode physical material properties that generalize across disparate sensors and environments.

title: Intervention Granularity Matters: Coherent Treatment Bundles in Counterfactual Simulation with Clinical World Models
summary: Counterfactual simulation with a clinical world model means fixing a patient's history, changing the treatment, and reading off the predicted response. Doing so requires deciding what counts as one intervention. In clinical settings, interventions are documented as bundles: a co-occurrence audit of 945,707 patient-hours from MIMIC-IV shows groups of components, such as every parameter of a dialysis circuit, that never appear apart, so an edit that changes one component on its own describes an hour that never occurs in the data. We hypothesize that the granularity at which an intervention is edited changes how a world model responds, and test this with Clin-JEPA, a latent world model of patient trajectories conditioned on hourly treatment text. At 1,019 documented onsets of invasive ventilation, we keep the patient's history and other treatments fixed and compare editing one ventilator setting with editing the complete configuration recorded for a real patient with the most similar recent trajectory. The complete bundle moves the predicted next state further than any single setting, consistently across all five settings, and the difference remains after accounting for how much each edit changes the model's input. Intervention granularity therefore materially affects the response of a clinical world model: single-component edits may understate treatment sensitivity, and bundle-aware editing may offer a better-supported basis for counterfactual treatment simulation.

title: CommitFlow: Semantic Commitment Verification and Local Correction for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation VLA Execution
comments: 8 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027
summary: Although vision-language-action (VLA) policies have advanced rapidly, long-horizon execution may still progress to the next task stage before the required physical effect has been established. We call this a mismatch between semantic commitments, physical conditions that a stage must establish or maintain, and the actual physical state. Because an action command alone cannot confirm such a condition, local deviations can propagate and cause task failure. To address this problem, we present CommitFlow, a closed-loop execution framework that combines commitment monitoring with local correction while keeping the base policy frozen. CommitFlow integrates three components. A Semantic Commitment Monitor (SCM) compares stage requirements against current state evidence and holds back dependent actions when a required condition is unmet or violated. BoundaryFlow then generates a local correction conditioned on the current state and base action, and Relation and Gain Calibration (RGC) selects the smallest correction strength that satisfies the relevant constraints. Across the ten common RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark tasks, CommitFlow achieves a mean success rate of 75.9 percent, improving on the base policy pi0.5 by 22.7 percent. Cross-policy experiments show consistent gains, pointing toward reliable long-horizon robot execution.

title: Beyond Kinematics: Benchmarking Simulation Fidelity for Muscle-Driven Imitation Learning
comments: 8 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, submitted to ICRA 2027
summary: In this work, we conduct a systematic comparison of two state-of-the-art motion-imitation reinforcement learning (MIRL) pipelines, one built on SCONE/HyFyDy and one built on MuJoCo/MyoSim. HyFyDy emphasizes physiological realism through detailed musculotendon modeling, while MuJoCo prioritizes computational efficiency and scalable policy learning. While recent work has demonstrated that both pipelines reproduce human kinematics with high fidelity, it remains unclear if they accurately capture the underlying neuromuscular behavior that produced the movement. This limitation is particularly important for robotic assistive-device design and control, where outcome measures such as muscle activation patterns and metabolic cost are often used as optimization targets. To conduct a systematic comparison, our work compares both pipelines using a common set of human motion-capture and electromyography (EMG) measurements. The results find that while both pipelines produce similar kinematics with relative accuracy, the muscle activations from HyFyDy are more aligned with the experimental EMG, as supported by the average pooled (RMSE, r) values for muscle activations from HyFyDy and MuJoCo: (0.164, 0.4) and (0.344, 0.11), respectively. While we conclude that the more advanced physiological realism of HyFyDy currently makes it more suitable for musculoskeletal modeling, both require further development to bring physiological realism to GPU-parallelizable simulation environments and advance robotic assistive device design.
