title: MIRANDA: short signatures from a leakage-free full-domain-hash scheme
summary: We present $\mathsf{Miranda}$, the first family of full-domain-hash signatures based on matrix codes. This signature scheme fulfils the paradigm of Gentry, Peikert and Vaikuntanathan ($\mathsf{GPV}$), which gives strong security guarantees. Our trapdoor is very simple and generic: if we propose it with matrix codes, it can actually be instantiated in many other ways since it only involves a subcode of a decodable code (or lattice) in a unique decoding regime of parameters. Though $\mathsf{Miranda}$ signing algorithm relies on a decoding task where there is exactly one solution, there are many possible signatures given a message to sign and we ensure that signatures are not leaking information on their underlying trapdoor by means of a very simple procedure involving the drawing of a small number of uniform bits. In particular $\mathsf{Miranda}$ does not use a rejection sampling procedure which makes its implementation a very simple task contrary to other $\mathsf{GPV}$-like signatures schemes such as $\mathsf{Falcon}$ or even $\mathsf{Wave}$. We instantiate $\mathsf{Miranda}$ with the famous family of Gabidulin codes represented as spaces of matrices and we study thoroughly its security (in the EUF-CMA security model). For~$128$ bits of classical security, the signature sizes are as low as~$90$ bytes and the public key sizes are in the order of~$2.6$ megabytes.

AI.title_translation: MIRANDA：基于无泄漏全域哈希方案的短签名
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于矩阵码的新型签名方案 MIRANDA，无需拒绝采样即可实现简单、安全且签名极小的抗量子签名。
AI.motivation: 现有的 GPV 型签名方案（如 Falcon 或 Wave）在实现时通常依赖复杂的拒绝采样过程，导致实现较为繁琐。本文旨在设计一种简单、无泄漏、基于矩阵码的全域哈希签名方案，以简化实现并保持较小的签名尺寸和强安全性。
AI.method: 利用矩阵码（特别是 Gabidulin 码）作为陷门，在唯一解码参数体制下构建 GPV 型签名方案，并采用简单的均匀比特抽取步骤防止签名泄露底层陷门信息，无需拒绝采样。
AI.result: 在 EUF-CMA 安全模型下进行了深入的安全性研究。对于 128 位经典安全性，其签名尺寸低至 90 字节，公钥尺寸约为 2.6 兆字节。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功提出了 MIRANDA 方案，它是一种基于矩阵码的简单且高效的 GPV 型签名方案，兼具强安全保证和极小的签名尺寸，同时避免了复杂的拒绝采样。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 $\mathsf{Miranda}$，这是第一个基于矩阵码的全域哈希签名方案族。该签名方案满足 Gentry、Peikert 和 Vaikuntanathan ($\mathsf{GPV}$) 的范式，从而提供了强安全性保证。我们的陷门非常简单且通用：如果将其与矩阵码一起提出，它实际上可以以许多其他方式实例化，因为它只涉及唯一解码参数体制下的可解码码（或格）的子码。尽管 $\mathsf{Miranda}$ 签名算法依赖于恰好有一个解的解码任务，但对于给定的待签名消息，存在许多可能的签名，我们通过一个非常简单（涉及抽取少量均匀比特）的过程确保签名不会泄露其底层的陷门信息。特别是，$\mathsf{Miranda}$ 不使用拒绝采样过程，这使得它的实现非常简单，这与 $\mathsf{Falcon}$ 甚至 $\mathsf{Wave}$ 等其他 $\mathsf{GPV}$ 样式的签名方案相反。我们用以矩阵空间表示的著名的 Gabidulin 码族实例化了 $\mathsf{Miranda}$，并对其安全性（在 EUF-CMA 安全模型中）进行了彻底的研究。对于 $128$ 位的经典安全性，签名大小低至 $90$ 字节，公钥大小约为 $2.6$ 兆字节。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 MIRANDA，这是第一个基于矩阵码的全域哈希签名方案族。它遵循 GPV 范式，采用简单且通用的陷门，并通过抽取少量均匀比特来防止签名泄露陷门信息，避免了复杂的拒绝采样。该方案基于 Gabidulin 码实例化，在 128 位经典安全性下实现了 90 字节的超小签名尺寸。
AI.keywords: 矩阵码, 全域哈希签名, GPV 范式, Gabidulin 码, 抗量子密码
AI.comments: MIRANDA 提出了一种基于矩阵码（如 Gabidulin 码）的无泄漏全域哈希签名方案，摒弃了复杂的拒绝采样，简化了实现，同时在128位经典安全下实现了较小的签名尺寸（90字节）。这在抗量子密码学和基于编码的密码方案设计中具有重要创新意义。

title: The Impact of Semantic Pairs on Self-Supervised Representation Learning
summary: Instance discrimination learns visual representations by treating different augmented views of the same image as positive pairs. While this encourages invariance to handcrafted transformations, same-image positives can preserve nuisance correlations such as background, texture, illumination, and object-specific details. Semantic positive pairs, i.e., different same-class instances, may reduce these correlations by presenting objects across diverse contexts. However, previous studies often combine semantic pairs with augmented positives or false neighbors (i.e., incorrectly mapped semantic pairs), making it difficult to isolate the effect of semantic pairing. We present a controlled empirical study of semantic positive pairs for self-supervised representation learning. From ImageNet-1K, we construct two matched subsets: an augmented-pair baseline and a manually curated semantic-pair dataset with the same class composition and training-pair count. We use these datasets to compare representative contrastive and non-contrastive SSL methods under matched training conditions. Across transfer learning and object detection evaluations, semantic-pair pretraining consistently improves generalisation over augmented-pair pretraining. Additional ablations show that semantic pairs induce invariances beyond the standard transformation pipeline. Among the evaluated methods, contrastive learning benefits most strongly from semantic pairs, with SimCLR showing the largest relative improvement. These results clarify the role of semantic positive pairs in SSL and provide guidance for selecting and designing frameworks that can exploit semantic pair information effectively.

AI.title_translation: 语义正对对自监督表示学习的影响
AI.tldr: 该研究通过受控实验证明，相比于传统的图像增强对，使用同类不同实例的“语义正对”进行自监督预训练能显著提升模型在迁移学习和目标检测中的泛化能力，且对比学习方法受益最大。
AI.motivation: 传统的实例判别自监督学习方法使用同一图像的不同增强视图作为正对，但这会保留背景、纹理等有害的干扰关联；而语义正对（同类不同实例）可能减少这些干扰，但以往研究由于混入了增强对或假邻居，难以单独隔离和评估语义配对的效果。
AI.method: 构建了两个匹配的ImageNet-1K子集（一个基于增强对的基线和一个人工策划的语义对数据集，具有相同的类别组成和训练对数量），并在相同的训练条件下对比了代表性的对比和非对比自监督学习方法，通过迁移学习和目标检测进行评估。
AI.result: 在迁移学习和目标检测评估中，使用语义正对进行预训练 consistently 优于增强对预训练；消融实验表明语义正对能诱导超越标准变换流水线的对不变性；其中对比学习受益最大，SimCLR表现出最大的相对改进。
AI.conclusion: 语义正对在自监督表示学习中能显著提升模型的泛化能力和鲁棒性，特别适用于对比学习框架，为未来自监督学习的数据构造和方法设计提供了重要指导。
AI.translation: 实例判别通过将同一图像的不同增强视图视为正对来学习视觉表示。虽然这鼓励了对人工变换的不变性，但同一图像的正对可能会保留诸如背景、纹理、光照和对象特定细节等滋扰相关性。语义正对（即不同的同类实例）可以通过在不同上下文中呈现对象来减少这些相关性。然而，以往的研究通常将语义正对与增强正对或假邻居（即错误映射的语义正对）结合起来，这使得很难隔离语义配对的效果。我们对自监督表示学习的语义正对进行了受控实证研究。从ImageNet-1K中，我们构建了两个匹配的子集：一个增强对基线和一个手动策划的语义对数据集，它们具有相同的类别组成和训练对计数。我们使用这些数据集在匹配的训练条件下比较了具有代表性的对比和非对比SSL方法。在迁移学习和目标检测评估中，语义正对预训练 consistently 提高了优于增强对预训练的泛化能力。额外的消融表明，语义正对引起了超出标准变换流水线的不变性。在评估的方法中，对比学习从语义对中受益最大，SimCLR显示出最大的相对改进。这些结果澄清了语义正对在SSL中的作用，并为选择和设计能够有效利用语义对信息的框架提供了指导。
AI.summary: 该论文对自监督表示学习中的语义正对进行了受控实证研究。通过构建类别组成和训练对数量相匹配的增强对与语义对数据集，研究发现语义正对能有效减少背景和纹理等干扰相关性，从而在迁移学习和目标检测中显著提高模型泛化能力，其中对比学习方法（如SimCLR）受益最为明显。
AI.keywords: 自监督学习, 语义正对, 实例判别, 迁移学习, 对比学习
AI.comments: 该论文通过精心控制的实验，探讨了语义正对（同类不同实例）在自监督表示学习中的独立作用。研究表明，语义正对能够有效减少背景、纹理等有害关联，提升模型的泛化能力，其中对比学习方法（如SimCLR）受益最大，对未来自监督学习框架的设计具有重要指导意义。

title: MigrateLib: a tool for end-to-end Python library migration
comments: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2504.13272
summary: Library migration is the process of replacing a library with a similar one in a software project. Manual library migration is time consuming and error prone, as it requires developers to understand the Application Programming Interfaces (API) of both libraries, map equivalent APIs, and perform the necessary code transformations. Due to the difficulty of the library migration process, most of the existing automated techniques and tooling stop at the API mapping stage or support a limited set of libraries and code transformations. In this paper, we develop an end-to-end solution that can automatically migrate code between any arbitrary pair of Python libraries that provide similar functionality. Due to the promising capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) in code generation and transformation, we use LLMs as the primary engine for migration. Before building the tool, we first study the capabilities of LLMs for library migration on a benchmark of 321 real-world library migrations. We find that LLMs can effectively perform library migration, but some post-processing steps can further improve the performance. Based on this, we develop MigrateLib, a command line application that combines the power of LLMs, static analysis, and dynamic analysis to provide accurate library migration. We evaluate MigrateLib on 717 real-world Python applications that are not from our benchmark. We find that MigrateLib can migrate 32% of the migrations with complete correctness. Of the remaining migrations, only 14% of the migration-related changes are left for developers to fix for more than half of the projects.

title: ECG-Mamba-V2: Architectural Refinements to a Bidirectional State Space Model for Multi-Label 12-Lead ECG Classification
comments: The article has been accepted by Frontiers of Computer Science (FCS), with the DOI: 10.1007/s11704-026-60814-4
summary: State space models offer linear-time sequence modeling and are a promising backbone for multi-label 12-lead ECG classification, but the design choices that drive their accuracy remain unclear. This letter presents ECG-Mamba-V2, a set of empirical refinements to a bidirectional Vision Mamba encoder: the class token is appended at the end of the token sequence instead of the midpoint, the forward and backward scan outputs are summed without the conventional 1/2 scaling, and dropout is applied at a uniform rate across blocks. On PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2021, ECG-Mamba-V2 reaches 0.6494 macro AUPRC and 0.9716 macro AUROC, against 0.6100 and 0.9646 for its predecessor, while using 34\% fewer parameters and delivering 38\% higher throughput; it wins all 15 paired runs.

title: Provably Optimal Reinforcement Learning under Safety Filtering
comments: Proceedings of the Second International Association for Safe and Ethical AI Conference (IASEAI'26); 17 pages, 3 figures
summary: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) enable its use on increasingly complex tasks, but the lack of formal safety guarantees still limits its application in safety-critical settings. A common practical approach is to augment the RL policy with a safety filter that overrides unsafe actions to prevent failures during both training and deployment. However, safety filtering is often perceived as sacrificing performance and hindering the learning process. We show that this perceived safety-performance tradeoff is not inherent and prove, for the first time, that enforcing safety with a sufficiently permissive safety filter does not degrade asymptotic performance. We formalize RL safety with a safety-critical Markov decision process (SC-MDP), which requires categorical, rather than high-probability, avoidance of catastrophic failure states. Additionally, we define an associated filtered MDP in which all actions result in safe effects, thanks to a safety filter that is considered to be a part of the environment. Our main theorem establishes that (i) learning in the filtered MDP is safe categorically, (ii) standard RL convergence carries over to the filtered MDP, and (iii) any policy that is optimal in the filtered MDP, when executed through the same filter, achieves the same asymptotic return as the best safe policy in the SC-MDP, yielding a complete separation between safety enforcement and performance optimization. We validate the theory on Safety Gymnasium with representative tasks and constraints, observing zero violations during training and final performance matching or exceeding unfiltered baselines. Together, these results shed light on a long-standing question in safety-filtered learning and provide a simple, principled recipe for safe RL: train and deploy RL policies with the most permissive safety filter that is available.
comment: Proceedings of the Second International Association for Safe and Ethical AI Conference (IASEAI'26); 17 pages, 3 figures

AI.title_translation: 安全滤波下的可证明最优强化学习
AI.tldr: 本文证明了使用足够宽松的安全滤波器进行强化学习可以在保证绝对安全的同时，不牺牲渐近性能。
AI.motivation: 强化学习在安全关键领域的应用受限于缺乏形式化的安全保证，而传统的安全滤波器常被认为会牺牲学习性能，本研究旨在证明这种权衡并非不可避免，并提供理论支持。
AI.method: 使用安全关键马尔可夫决策过程（SC-MDP）形式化强化学习安全性，定义了将安全滤波器视为环境一部分的过滤后MDP，并通过主定理证明了其收敛性和渐近最优性。
AI.result: 理论证明了在过滤后的MDP中学习是绝对安全的，标准强化学习收敛性依然成立，且能达到SC-MDP中最优安全策略相同的渐近回报；在Safety Gymnasium上的实验验证了训练期间零违规且最终性能匹配或超过未过滤基线。
AI.conclusion: 使用足够宽松的安全滤波器进行强化学习可以在保证绝对安全的同时，实现与最优安全策略相同的渐近性能，从而实现了安全性与性能优化的解耦。
AI.translation: 强化学习（RL）的最新进展使其能够应用于日益复杂的任务，但缺乏形式化的安全保证仍然限制了其在安全关键环境中的应用。一种常见的实用方法是用安全滤波器来增强RL策略，该滤波器会覆盖不安全的操作，以防止在训练和部署期间发生故障。然而，安全滤波器通常被认为会牺牲性能并阻碍学习过程。我们证明了这种感知的安全-性能权衡并不是固有的，并且首次证明了使用足够宽松的安全滤波器强制实施安全性不会降低渐近性能。我们使用安全关键马尔可夫决策过程（SC-MDP）形式化了RL安全性，这需要分类（categorical）而不是高概率地避免灾难性故障状态。此外，我们定义了一个相关的过滤MDP，其中所有动作都会产生安全的效果，这要归功于被认为是环境一部分的安全滤波器。我们的主要定理确立了：（i）在过滤的MDP中学习是绝对安全的，（ii）标准RL收敛性延续到过滤的MDP中，以及（iii）在过滤的MDP中最优的任何策略，当通过相同的滤波器执行时，实现与SC-MDP中最佳安全策略相同的渐近回报，从而在安全强制和性能优化之间产生完全的分离。我们在带有代表性任务和约束的Safety Gymnasium上验证了该理论，观察到训练期间零违规，且最终性能匹配或超过未过滤的基线。总之，这些结果阐明了安全滤波学习中长期存在的问题，并为安全RL提供了一个简单、有原则的 recipe：使用可用的最宽松的安全滤波器训练和部署RL策略。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了强化学习中的安全滤波问题，首次证明了使用足够宽松的安全滤波器不仅能确保训练和部署过程中的绝对安全，而且不会牺牲渐近性能，为安全强化学习提供了一个简单而有原则的方法。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 安全滤波器, 安全关键马尔可夫决策过程, 渐近性能
AI.comments: 该论文首次从理论上证明了在足够宽松的安全滤波器下，强制实施安全性并不会牺牲渐近性能，打破了长期以来认为安全滤波会阻碍学习性能的传统认知，具有重要的理论和应用价值。

title: PRIVET: PRoximIty leakage detection Via Extreme value Theory
summary: Deep generative models are often trained on sensitive data, such as genetic sequences, health data, or more broadly, any copyrighted, licensed or protected content. This raises critical concerns around privacy-preserving synthetic data, and more specifically around privacy leakage, an issue closely tied to overfitting. Existing proximity-based methods mostly assess privacy risk through global criteria, which quantify a model's overall behaviour but cannot attribute risk to an individual record. Sample-level outputs do exist but they are either uncalibrated, discontinuous, or blind to leakage occurring while the model is globally underfit, which limits their practical use. Using extreme value statistics on nearest-neighbor distances, we propose PRIVET, a generic sample-based, modality-agnostic algorithm that assigns an individual proximity leak score to each synthetic sample. These are evaluated under a chosen representation and distance, each synthetic sample being assigned a continuous score measuring how improbable its proximity to the training set is under a no-leakage model. We empirically demonstrate that PRIVET detects memorization and more subtle forms of proximity-based data leakage across diverse data modalities, including settings with very high dimensionality and limited sample sizes such as genetic data, and in underfitting regimes that overfitting-based diagnostics cannot reach by construction. Our analysis further shows that the representation bounds what any distance-based evaluation can detect, existing computer vision embeddings failing to yield perceptually meaningful distances for near-duplicate samples. Accordingly, a low score is evidence of leakage in the chosen metric, while its absence is not a certificate of privacy.

AI.title_translation: PRIVET：通过极值理论进行邻近隐私泄露检测
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为PRIVET的基于极值理论的算法，能够有效检测深度生成模型中针对个体样本的隐私泄露风险。
AI.motivation: 深度生成模型常在敏感数据上训练，引发了严重的隐私泄露和过拟合问题。现有的基于邻近度的方法大多采用全局标准，无法将风险归因于个体记录；而现有的样本级方法存在未校准、不连续或在模型全局欠拟合时盲视等局限性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为PRIVET的通用、与模态无关的样本级算法，基于最近邻距离的极值统计学，为每个合成样本分配一个衡量其与训练集接近程度 improbability 的连续隐私泄露评分。
AI.result: 实验证明，PRIVET能够跨多种数据模态（包括高维且样本量小的基因数据以及过拟合诊断无法触及的欠拟合状态）检测出记忆效应和更隐蔽的邻近数据泄露。
AI.conclusion: PRIVET能够有效检测各类数据模态中的记忆效应和隐蔽的隐私泄露，同时揭示了特征表示对基于距离的隐私评估的根本限制。
AI.translation: 深度 generative 模型通常在敏感数据（如基因序列、健康数据，或更广泛的受版权保护、有许可证的内容）上训练。这引发了围绕保护隐私的合成数据，特别是隐私泄露（与过拟合密切相关的问题）的重大担忧。现有的基于邻近度的方法大多通过全局标准来评估隐私风险，这些标准量化了模型的整体行为，但无法将风险归因于个体记录。样本级输出确实存在，但它们要么未校准、不连续，要么对模型全局欠拟合时发生的泄露视而不见，这限制了它们的实际应用。通过将极值统计学应用于最近邻距离，我们提出了PRIVET，这是一种通用的、基于样本的、与模态无关的算法，它为每个合成样本分配一个单独的邻近泄露分数。这些分数在选定的表示和距离下进行评估，每个合成样本都被分配一个连续的分数，用于衡量在无泄露模型下其与训练集的接近程度是多么不可能。我们从经验上证明，PRIVET能够在不同的数据模态（包括基因数据等高维且样本数量有限的设置，以及过拟合诊断按结构无法触及的欠拟合状态）中检测到记忆效应以及更微妙的基于邻近度的数据泄露。我们的分析进一步表明，表示限制了任何基于距离的评估所能检测到的范围，现有的计算机视觉嵌入未能为近重复样本产生感知上有意义的距离。因此，低分数是所选指标中存在泄露的证据，而其不存在则不是隐私的证明。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了PRIVET，一种基于极值理论和最近邻距离的通用样本级算法，用于检测深度生成模型中的隐私泄露，克服了现有全局和样本级方法的局限性，能够有效评估高维及欠拟合状态下的隐私风险。
AI.keywords: 极值理论, 隐私泄露, 深度生成模型, 近邻距离, 样本级风险评分
AI.comments: 本文创新性地引入极值理论（Extreme Value Theory）来量化生成模型中的样本级隐私泄露风险，解决了传统全局指标无法定位到个体记录以及现有样本级方法在欠拟合状态下失效的问题。该方法通用且与模态无关，对基因等高维敏感数据具有重要价值。

title: Compass: General Filtered Search across Vector and Structured Data
summary: The increasing prevalence of hybrid vector and relational data necessitates efficient, general support for queries that combine high-dimensional vector search with complex relational filtering. However, existing filtered search solutions are fundamentally limited by specialized indices, which restrict arbitrary filtering and hinder integration with general-purpose DBMSs. This work introduces \textsc{Compass}, a unified framework that enables general filtered search across vector and structured data without relying on new index designs. Compass leverages established index structures -- such as HNSW and IVF for vector attributes, and B+-trees for relational attributes -- implementing a principled cooperative query execution strategy that coordinates candidate generation and predicate evaluation across modalities. Uniquely, Compass maintains generality by allowing arbitrary conjunctions, disjunctions, and range predicates, while ensuring robustness even with highly-selective or multi-attribute filters. Comprehensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that Compass consistently outperforms NaviX, the only existing performant general framework, across diverse hybrid query workloads. It also matches the query throughput of specialized single-attribute indices in their favorite settings with only a single attribute involved, all while maintaining full generality and DBMS compatibility. Overall, Compass offers a practical and robust solution for achieving truly general filtered search in vector database systems.

AI.title_translation: Compass：跨向量和结构化数据的通用过滤检索
AI.tldr: Compass是一个无需新索引设计的统一框架，通过协同现有的向量和关系索引，实现了高效且通用的混合过滤检索。
AI.motivation: 现有的混合向量和关系数据过滤检索方案受到专用索引的根本限制，这限制了任意过滤并阻碍了与通用DBMS的集成。
AI.method: 利用现有的成熟索引结构（如用于向量属性的HNSW和IVF，以及用于关系属性的B+-tree），实现了一种有原则的协同查询执行策略，以跨模态协调候选生成和谓词评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，Compass在各种混合查询工作负载下表现稳定，性能持续优于现有的通用框架NaviX，并且在单属性查询中能够匹配专用单属性索引的吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: Compass为向量数据库系统中的真正通用过滤检索提供了一个实用且鲁棒的解决方案，能够一致地超越现有框架NaviX，并在单属性场景下匹配专用索引的吞吐量。
AI.translation: 混合向量和关系数据的日益普及需要对结合高维向量搜索和复杂关系过滤的查询提供高效、通用的支持。然而，现有的过滤搜索解决方案从根本上受到专用索引的限制，这限制了任意过滤并阻碍了与通用DBMS的集成。这项工作介绍了Compass，一个统一的框架，它能够在不依赖新索引设计的情况下，实现跨向量和结构化数据的通用过滤检索。Compass利用成熟的索引结构（例如用于向量属性的HNSW和IVF，以及用于关系属性的B+-tree），实现了一种有原则的协同查询执行策略，该策略跨模态协调候选生成和谓词评估。独特的是，Compass通过允许任意合取、析取和范围谓词来保持通用性，同时即使在高度选择性或多属性过滤器的情况下也能确保鲁棒性。全面的实证评估表明，Compass在各种混合查询工作负载中始终优于NaviX（唯一现有的高性能通用框架）。它还匹配了专用单属性索引在其最喜欢的情景下的查询吞吐量，且仅涉及单个属性，同时保持了完全的通用性和DBMS兼容性。总的来说，Compass为在向量数据库系统中实现真正通用的过滤检索提供了一个实用且鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.summary: Compass是一个统一的框架，它利用现有的成熟向量和关系索引，通过协同查询执行策略实现了向量和结构化数据的通用过滤检索，无需设计新索引即可支持任意复杂的过滤条件，且具有出色的性能与兼容性。
AI.keywords: Vector Search, Filtered Search, Hybrid Queries, Relational Data, DBMS Compatibility
AI.comments: 该论文针对混合向量与关系型数据的高效过滤检索问题，提出了一种无需设计新型索引的统一框架Compass。它通过协同查询执行策略，完美结合了现有成熟的索引（如HNSW、IVF和B+-tree），在保证对任意复杂过滤条件支持的同时，实现了出色的性能与DBMS兼容性。

title: Souper-Model: How Simple Arithmetic Unlocks State-of-the-Art LLM Performance
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have displayed remarkable capabilities across diverse domains, but their training remains resource- and time-intensive, requiring massive computational resources and careful orchestration of training procedures. Model souping-the practice of averaging weights from multiple models of the same architecture-has emerged as a promising pre- and post-training technique that can enhance performance without expensive retraining. We observe that previous souping approaches can lead to collapse in precision-sensitive LLM capabilities. In this paper, we introduce SoCE, a principled approach for model souping to overcome this shortcoming. The proposed method utilizes benchmark composition to identify optimal model candidates and applies non-uniform weighted averaging to maximize performance. Contrary to previous approaches, our method leverages the observation that different clusters (or categories) of points within a benchmark often exhibit low inter-correlations in model performance. SoCE identifies "expert" models for each weakly-correlated category cluster and combines them using optimized weighted averaging rather than uniform weights. We demonstrate that SoCE improves performance and robustness across multiple domains and achieves state-of-the-art results on the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard.

AI.title_translation: Souper-Model：简单的算术如何释放大语言模型的最新性能
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SoCE的模型融合新方法，通过基准测试组合与非均匀加权平均，解决了传统模型融合的缺陷，并在Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的大语言模型训练资源和时间成本高昂，而现有的模型融合（souping）技术在面对大语言模型时容易导致精度敏感能力的崩溃，亟需一种更具原则性的方法来克服这一缺陷。
AI.method: 引入了SoCE方法，利用基准测试组合识别最优模型候选，并基于不同类别点间模型性能的低互相关性，识别出对应类别的“专家”模型，进而应用非均匀加权平均进行组合。
AI.result: SoCE方法改善了多个领域中的模型性能和鲁棒性，并在Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard上取得了最新的SOTA（State-of-the-Art）性能。
AI.conclusion: SoCE通过识别弱相关能力类别并进行非均匀加权融合，有效克服了传统模型融合的缺陷，提升了大语言模型的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）在各个领域展现出卓越的能力，但其训练仍然资源和时间密集，需要大量的计算资源和对训练过程的精心编排。模型汤（Model souping）——即对具有相同架构的多个模型的权重进行平均的实践——已经成为一种有前途的训练前和训练后技术，能够在无需昂贵重新训练的情况下提升性能。我们观察到，先前的模型融合方法会导致对精度敏感的LLM能力崩溃。在本文中，我们引入了SoCE，这是一种用于模型融合的原则性方法，以克服这一缺点。所提出的方法利用基准测试组合来识别最优模型候选，并应用非均匀加权平均来最大化性能。与先前的方法相反，我们的方法利用了这样一个观察结果：基准测试中不同点群（或类别）在模型性能上往往表现出较低的互相关性。SoCE为每个弱相关类别群识别“专家”模型，并使用优化的加权平均而不是统一权重将它们组合起来。我们证明了SoCE在多个领域中改善了性能和鲁棒性，并在Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard上取得了最新的SOTA结果。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型训练成本高且传统模型融合易导致精度敏感能力崩溃的问题，提出了一种名为SoCE的原则性模型融合方法。该方法通过基准测试组合识别“专家”模型，并采用非均匀加权平均进行融合，从而在多个领域和Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard上实现了SOTA性能。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 模型融合, 模型汤, 基准测试组合, 非均匀加权平均
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种名为SoCE的模型融合方法，通过基准测试组合和非均匀加权平均，解决了传统模型融合在LLM中容易导致精度敏感能力崩溃的问题，并在Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard上取得了SOTA的成绩，具有很高的实用价值。

title: SteganoBackdoor: Evading Data-Poisoning Defenses via Steganographic Backdoors
summary: Transformer-based models are highly susceptible to backdoor attacks via supervised fine-tuning (SFT). To red-team existing data-poisoning defenses, prior work has increasingly focused on stylized triggers, synthetic artifacts, and token-level perturbations designed to evade detection. However, this trend has shifted threat models away from naturally occurring semantic triggers and realistic low-budget poisoning settings. Addressing this gap, we introduce SteganoBackdoor, an optimization-based framework that transforms semantic-trigger seeds through autoregressive token replacement, sequentially minimizing embedding overlap with the inference-time trigger while preserving a strong per-sample training-time payload. The resulting SteganoPoisons maintain linguistic fluency and encode the payload across ordinary tokens, such that no individual token carries a concentrated signal and the full payload instead emerges from their exact combination and ordering. Across 18 encoder-based and decoder-only models spanning 120M to 14B parameters, SteganoBackdoor achieves high attack success under sub-percent poisoning budgets and exposes limitations in existing data-poisoning defenses.

AI.title_translation: SteganoBackdoor：通过隐写后门规避数据投毒防御
AI.tldr: 提出一种名为SteganoBackdoor的新型后门攻击方法，利用隐写术原理将攻击载荷分散在普通token中，在低预算下成功绕过多种数据投毒防御。
AI.motivation: 现有的绕过数据投毒防御的方法多采用风格化触发器、合成人工制品或token级扰动，偏离了自然语义触发器和现实的低预算投毒设置，因此需要一种更真实、更隐蔽的后门攻击框架来测试现有防御的局限性。
AI.method: 引入了一个基于优化的框架SteganoBackdoor，通过自回归token替换将语义触发器种子进行转化，最小化其与推理时触发器的嵌入重叠，同时保留强烈的训练时有效负载。
AI.result: 在120M到14B参数的18个编码器和解码器模型上，SteganoBackdoor在亚百分比投毒预算下实现了高攻击成功率，并成功暴露了现有数据投毒防御的局限性。
AI.conclusion: SteganoBackdoor成功在低投毒预算下绕过了现有防御，揭示了当前Transformer模型在监督微调下面临的严重安全隐患，强调了开发更先进防御机制的必要性。
AI.translation: 基于Transformer的模型非常容易受到通过监督微调（SFT）进行的后门攻击。为了对现有数据投毒防御进行红蓝对抗测试，先前的研究越来越多地关注旨在逃避检测的风格化触发器、合成人工制品和token级扰动。然而，这种趋势使威胁模型偏离了自然发生的语义触发器和现实的低预算投毒设置。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了SteganoBackdoor，这是一个基于优化的框架，它通过自回归token替换来转换语义触发器种子，在保持每个样本强训练时有效负载的同时，连续最小化与推理时触发器的嵌入重叠。由此产生的SteganoPoisons保持了语言流畅性，并将有效负载编码在普通token中，使得没有任何单个token携带集中的信号，完整的有效负载反而是从它们的精确组合和排序中涌现出来的。在跨越120M到14B参数的18个基于编码器和仅解码器的模型中，SteganoBackdoor在亚百分比投毒预算下实现了高攻击成功率，并暴露了现有数据投毒防御的局限性。
AI.summary: 论文提出了SteganoBackdoor，一种通过自回归token替换将语义触发器种子转化为普通token的优化框架。该方法将有效负载编码在普通token中，使其在没有单个token承载集中信号的情况下实现高攻击成功率，从而有效绕过现有数据投毒防御。
AI.keywords: 后门攻击, 数据投毒防御, 隐写术, 语言模型, 监督微调
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的隐写式后门攻击（SteganoBackdoor），通过将语义触发器种子转化为自回归替换的普通token，有效地绕过了现有的数据投毒防御，同时保持了高攻击成功率和低投毒预算，对大模型安全性研究具有重要警示意义。

title: Advancing Minimally Invasive Precision Surgery in Large Open Cavities with Robotic Flexible Endoscopy
summary: Flexible robots hold great promise for enhancing minimally invasive surgery (MIS) by providing superior dexterity, precise control, and safe tissue interaction. Yet, translating these advantages into endoscopic interventions within large open cavities remains challenging. The lack of anatomical constraints and the inherent flexibility of such devices complicate their control, and the limited field of view of endoscopes restricts situational awareness. We present a robotic platform designed to overcome these challenges and demonstrate its potential in fetoscopic laser coagulation, a complex MIS procedure typically performed only by highly experienced surgeons. Our system combines a magnetically actuated flexible endoscope with teleoperated and semi-autonomous navigation capabilities for performing targeted laser ablations. To enhance surgical awareness, the platform reconstructs real-time mosaics of the endoscopic scene, providing an extended and continuous visual context. The ability of this system to address the key limitations of MIS in open spaces is validated in vivo in an ovine model.

AI.title_translation: 利用机器人柔性内窥镜推进大开放腔内微创精准手术
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型机器人柔性内窥镜平台，通过磁驱动、半自主导航和实时图像拼接技术，解决了大开放腔内微创手术的控制与视野难题，并通过动物实验验证了其在复杂胎儿镜手术中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 柔性机器人在微创手术中具有巨大潜力，但将其应用于大开放腔内的内窥镜介入手术时，由于缺乏解剖约束、设备柔韧性导致控制复杂以及内窥镜视野有限，面临巨大挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合磁驱动柔性内窥镜与遥操作、半自主导航能力的机器人平台，并通过实时重建内窥镜场景的拼接图像来增强手术视野。
AI.result: 通过在绵羊模型上的体内实验，验证了该系统解决开放空间中微创手术关键局限性的能力，展示了其在复杂胎儿镜激光凝固手术中的应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发并验证了一个用于大开放腔内微创手术的机器人柔性内窥镜平台，克服了传统设备在控制和视野方面的局限性，在体内羊模型中展现出良好的应用前景。
AI.translation: 柔性机器人在提供卓越的灵巧性、精确控制和安全的组织交互方面，对增强微创手术（MIS）具有巨大的前景。然而，将这些优势转化为大开放腔内的内窥镜介入治疗仍然具有挑战性。缺乏解剖学约束以及此类装置固有的灵活性使它们的控制变得复杂，并且内窥镜有限的视野限制了态势感知。我们提出了一种旨在克服这些挑战的机器人平台，并展示了其在胎儿镜激光凝固术（一种通常仅由经验丰富的医生才能执行的复杂微创手术）中的潜力。我们的系统结合了磁驱动柔性内窥镜与用于执行靶向激光消融的遥操作和半自主导航功能。为了增强手术意识，该平台实时重建内窥镜场景的马赛克图，提供扩展且连续的视觉上下文。该系统解决开放空间微创手术关键局限性的能力在绵羊模型的体内得到了验证。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了一种专为大开放腔内微创手术设计的机器人柔性内窥镜平台。系统整合了磁驱动柔性内窥镜、遥操作/半自主导航以及实时图像拼接技术，成功解决了大开放腔内缺乏解剖约束、控制复杂及视野受限的问题，并在羊模型中通过体内实验验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 柔性内窥镜, 机器人微创手术, 大开放腔, 磁驱动, 胎儿镜激光凝固术
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将磁驱动柔性内窥镜与遥操作、半自主导航及实时图像拼接技术相结合，有效解决了大开放腔内微创手术中缺乏解剖约束、控制复杂及视野受限的难题，并通过动物实验验证了其在胎儿镜激光凝固术中的应用潜力。

title: Verifying Numerical Methods with Isabelle/HOL
comments: 18 pages, 16 listings, for accompanying formalisation, see https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17679525
summary: Modern machine learning pipelines are built on numerical algorithms. Reliable numerical methods are thus a prerequisite for trustworthy machine learning and cyber-physical systems. Therefore, we contribute a framework for verified numerical methods in Isabelle/HOL based on ITrees. Our user-friendly specification language enables the direct declaration of numerical programs that can be annotated with variants and invariants for reasoning about correctness specifications. The generated verification conditions can be discharged via automated proof methods and lemmas from the HOL-Analysis library. The ITrees foundation interacts with Isabelle's code generator to export source code. This provides an end-to-end path from formal specifications with machine-checked guarantees to executable sources. We illustrate the process of modelling numerical methods and demonstrate the effectiveness of the verification by focusing on two well-known methods, the bisection method and the fixed-point iteration method. We also contribute crucial extensions to the libraries of formalised mathematics required for this objective: higher-order derivatives and Taylor's theorem in Peano form. Finally, we qualitatively evaluate the use of the framework for verifying numerical methods.
comment: 18 pages, 16 listings, for accompanying formalisation, see https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17679525

AI.title_translation: 用 Isabelle/HOL 验证数值方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于Isabelle/HOL的数值算法形式化验证框架，通过ITrees实现了从带机器检查保证的规约到可执行代码的端到端路径，并成功验证了二分法和不动点迭代法。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习和信息物理系统极大地依赖于数值算法，因此可靠的数值方法是确保这些系统值得信赖的前提。为了实现具有机器检查保证的数值程序，需要一个端到端的形式化验证框架。
AI.method: 提出一个基于ITrees的Isabelle/HOL数值方法验证框架；设计了用户友好的规约语言支持变体和不变量注解；利用自动化证明方法和HOL-Analysis库消解验证条件；结合Isabelle的代码生成器导出可执行源码。
AI.result: 成功对二分法和不动点迭代法进行了建模和验证；扩展了Isabelle的形式化数学库，包括高阶导数和Peano形式的泰勒定理；实现了从形式化规约到可执行源码的端到端路径。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功构建了一个基于Isabelle/HOL和ITrees的数值方法形式化验证框架，通过对二分法和不动点迭代法的成功验证以及对关键数学库的扩展，证明了该框架在保障数值算法可靠性方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 现代机器学习管道建立在数值算法之上。因此，可靠的数值方法是值得信赖的机器学习和信息物理系统的先决条件。为此，我们基于 ITrees 在 Isabelle/HOL 中贡献了一个用于验证数值方法的框架。我们用户友好的规约语言能够直接声明数值程序，这些程序可以附带变体和不变量注释，以便对正确性规约进行推理。生成的验证条件可以通过自动化证明方法和 HOL-Analysis 库中的引理来消解。ITrees 基础与 Isabelle 的代码生成器交互以导出源代码。这提供了一条从具有机器检查保证的形式化规约到可执行源代码的端到端路径。我们通过关注两个知名方法（二分法和不动点迭代法），阐明了对数值方法进行建模的过程，并展示了验证的有效性。我们还为实现此目标所需的形式化数学库做出了至关重要的扩展：高阶导数和 Peano 形式的泰勒定理。最后，我们对该框架在验证数值方法时的应用进行了定性评估。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个基于Isabelle/HOL和ITrees的数值方法形式化验证框架，支持带变体和不变量注解的数值程序直接声明，能够生成并通过自动化方法消解验证条件。该框架连接了形式化规约与代码生成，通过二分法和不动点迭代法的实例验证及高阶导数与泰勒定理等数学库的扩展，展示了其在实现可信数值计算方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 数值方法, 形式化验证, Isabelle/HOL, ITrees, 交互式定理证明
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了ITrees与Isabelle/HOL交互式定理证明器，实现了数值算法的端到端形式化验证，并扩展了高阶导数和泰勒定理等关键数学库，对于构建高可信的机器学习和信息物理系统具有重要意义。

title: K2-V2: A 360-Open, Reasoning-Enhanced LLM
summary: We introduce K2-V2, a 360-open LLM built from scratch as a superior base for reasoning adaptation, in addition to functions such as conversation and knowledge retrieval from general LLMs. It stands as the strongest fully open model, rivals open-weight leaders in its size class, outperforms Qwen2.5-72B and approaches the performance of Qwen3-235B. We actively infuse domain knowledge, reasoning, long-context, and tool use throughout the training process. This explicitly prepares the model for complex reasoning tasks. We demonstrate this potential using simple supervised fine-tuning, establishing a strong baseline that indicates significant headroom for advanced alignment. By releasing the full training history and data composition, we maximize the effectiveness of continuous training, a key open source production scenario. We release the model weights and signature LLM360 artifacts, such as complete training data, to empower the community with a capable, reasoning-centric foundation.

AI.title_translation: K2-V2：一个360度开源、推理增强的大语言模型
AI.tldr: K2-V2是一个从零构建、完全开源且推理能力极强的基座大语言模型，性能超越Qwen2.5-72B并接近Qwen3-235B，官方同时开源了完整的训练数据与历史。
AI.motivation: 为了构建一个具备卓越推理能力且完全开源的基座模型，满足社区对集成了领域知识、推理、长文本和工具使用的高性能大语言模型的需求，并为持续训练提供透明的训练数据与历史。
AI.method: 从零构建模型，在整个训练过程中主动融入领域知识、推理、长文本和工具使用能力，并通过简单的监督微调（SFT）展示模型的潜力，同时发布完整的训练历史和数据组成。
AI.result: K2-V2在同尺寸开源权重模型中处于领先地位，性能超越了Qwen2.5-72B，并接近Qwen3-235B的水平，通过简单的监督微调即可展现出显著的复杂推理潜力。
AI.conclusion: K2-V2作为一个完全开源且具备强大推理能力的基座模型，能够通过简单的监督微调展现出卓越的性能，并为开源社区提供了完整的训练资产以支持进一步的高级对齐与持续训练。
AI.translation: 我们推出了K2-V2，这是一个从零开始构建的360度开源大语言模型，旨在成为推理适应的优质基座，同时兼具通用大语言模型的对话和知识检索等功能。它是最强的完全开源模型，在同尺寸开源权重模型中名列前茅，性能超越了Qwen2.5-72B，并接近Qwen3-235B。我们在整个训练过程中积极融入领域知识、推理、长文本和工具使用，明确为复杂推理任务做好准备。我们使用简单的监督微调展示了这种潜力，建立了一个强大的基线，表明高级对齐具有巨大的提升空间。通过释放完整的训练历史和数据组成，我们最大化了持续训练（一个关键的开源生产场景）的有效性。我们发布了模型权重和标志性的LLM360工件（例如完整的训练数据），以赋予社区一个功能强大、以推理为中心的基座。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了K2-V2——一个完全开源、专为推理增强而从零构建的大语言模型。它在训练全过程融入了领域知识、推理、长文本和工具使用能力，性能超越Qwen2.5-72B并接近Qwen3-235B。研究团队不仅开源了模型权重，还公布了完整的训练数据和历史，旨在赋能开源社区的持续训练与高级对齐研究。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 推理增强, 完全开源, 监督微调, 持续训练
AI.comments: 该论文介绍了K2-V2，一个强调完全开源（360-open）及推理增强的大语言模型。其创新之处在于从零构建，并在训练全程融入了领域知识、推理、长文本和工具使用能力，同时公开了完整的训练历史和数据组成，极大地促进了开源社区在持续训练方面的研究。

title: NeurIDA: Dynamic Modeling for Effective In-Database Analytics
summary:
Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS) manage complex, interrelated data and support a broad spectrum of analytical tasks. With the growing demand for predictive analytics, the deep integration of machine learning (ML) into RDBMS has become critical. However, a fundamental challenge hinders this evolution: conventional ML models are static and task-specific, whereas RDBMS environments are dynamic and must support diverse analytical queries. Each analytical task entails constructing a bespoke pipeline from scratch, which incurs significant development overhead and hence limits wide adoption of ML in analytics.
  We present NeurIDA, an autonomous end-to-end system for in-database analytics that dynamically "tweaks" the best available base model to better serve a given analytical task. In particular, we propose a novel paradigm of dynamic in-database modeling to pre-train a composable base model architecture over the relational data. Upon receiving a task, NeurIDA formulates the task and data profile to dynamically select and configure relevant components from the pool of base models and shared model components for prediction. For friendly user experience, NeurIDA supports natural language queries; it interprets user intent to construct structured task profiles, and generates analytical reports with dedicated LLM agents. By design, NeurIDA enables ease-of-use and yet effective and efficient in-database AI analytics. Extensive experiment study shows that NeurIDA consistently delivers up to 12% improvement in AUC-ROC and 25% relative reduction in MAE across ten tasks on five real-world datasets. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zrealshadow/NeurIDA

AI.title_translation: NeurIDA：用于高效数据库内分析的动态建模
AI.tldr: NeurIDA是一个创新的数据库内分析系统，它通过动态调整基础模型和支持自然语言查询，显著提升了机器学习在关系型数据库中的应用效率和性能。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习模型是静态且特定于任务的，而RDBMS环境是动态的且需要支持多样化的分析查询，每个任务都需要从头构建定制管道，导致巨大的开发开销，阻碍了机器学习在分析中的广泛应用。
AI.method: 提出了一种动态数据库内建模的新范式，预训练可组合的基础模型架构；接收任务后，基于任务和数据特征动态选择和配置模型组件；利用专用LLM代理处理自然语言查询并生成分析报告。
AI.result: 在五个真实数据集的十个任务上，NeurIDA的AUC-ROC提升高达12%，MAE相对降低高达25%。
AI.conclusion: NeurIDA是一种高效、易用的数据库内AI分析系统，通过动态调整基础模型并结合LLM代理，显著提升了预测分析的性能和用户体验。
AI.translation:
关系数据库管理系统（RDBMS）管理着复杂、相互关联的数据，并支持广泛的分析任务。随着对预测分析需求的增长，将机器学习（ML)深度集成到RDBMS中变得至关重要。然而，一个根本性的挑战阻碍了这一演进：传统的ML模型是静态且特定于任务的，而RDBMS环境是动态的，必须支持多样化的分析查询。每个分析任务都需要从头构建定制的管道，这会产生巨大的开发开销，从而限制了ML在分析中的广泛采用。
我们提出了NeurIDA，一个用于数据库内分析的自主端到端系统，它动态“调整”最佳可用基础模型以更好地服务于给定的分析任务。特别是，我们提出了一种动态数据库内建模的新范式，在关系数据上预训练可组合的基础模型架构。在接收到任务时，NeurIDA根据任务和数据配置文件，从基础模型池和共享模型组件中动态选择和配置相关组件进行预测。为了提供友好的用户体验，NeurIDA支持自然语言 queries；它解释用户意图以构建结构化任务配置文件，并使用专用的LLM代理生成分析报告。通过设计，NeurIDA既易于使用，又能实现有效且高效的数据库内AI分析。广泛的实验研究表明，在五个真实数据集的十个任务中，NeurIDA始终将AUC-ROC提升高达12%，MAE相对降低高达25%。源代码可在 https://github.com/Zrealshadow/NeurIDA 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了NeurIDA，一个用于数据库内分析的自主端到端系统，它通过动态调整预训练的可组合基础模型架构来服务于不同的分析任务，并利用LLM代理支持自然语言查询和报告生成，从而降低了开发开销并提高了分析性能。
AI.keywords: 数据库内分析, 动态建模, 机器学习, 大语言模型, 关系型数据库
AI.comments: NeurIDA通过预训练可组合的基础模型架构，并利用大语言模型支持自然语言查询，成功实现了数据库内预测分析的高效动态建模，具有很强的实用价值和创新性。

title: Chipstitch: A Scalable and Cost-Efficient Platform for Accelerated Silicon Prototyping
summary: Silicon evidence serves as a critical receipt of credibility across academia and industry, validating innovation and signaling feasibility in ways that simulations alone cannot. Its value is difficult to quantify but widely recognized for driving hardware-software innovation. However, access to this receipt has remained severely constrained by high dollar costs and engineering effort barriers, which lock out innovators unable to afford it. To bridge this gap, we consider a new design paradigm called silicon query architectures that spans EDA, architecture, and VLSI and aims to transform single-die area into a substrate for scalable, tessellated, intra-die silicon receipts, dropping the cost of entry by one to two orders of magnitude without sacrificing research-grade specifications. We concretely propose Chipstitch, a silicon query architecture realized with three contributions: an algorithmic three-layer approach to repeatable and scalable tessellation with a keystone algorithm, a scalable architecture-VLSI system interconnect that fits within interstitial regions of the tessellation with research-grade timing and clocking, and a grid-aligned perimeter-based power shutdown technique that mitigates overheads for research-grade power measurement. Using a vertically integrated methodology extending down to post-layout VLSI implementation, we demonstrate Chipstitch on a 25-site heterogeneous design scenario, achieving 9.9x-14.5x total cost advantage and up to two orders of magnitude reduction in single-receipt entry cost compared to a traditional multi-project wafer baseline in Skywater 130nm and Intel 16nm process nodes.

AI.title_translation: Chipstitch：一个用于加速硅原型制作的可扩展且高性价比的平台
AI.tldr: Chipstitch 提出了一种新型硅查询架构，通过创新的拼嵌算法、互连和功耗测量技术，在保持研究级规格的同时，将硅原型制作成本降低了 1 到 2 个数量级。
AI.motivation: 硅片验证对于硬件-软件创新至关重要，但高昂的资金成本和繁重的工程努力严重限制了学术界和工业界获取硅证据的机会。为了打破这一门槛，需要一种能够将单芯片面积转化为可扩展、拼嵌式芯片内硅证据基底的新设计范式。
AI.method: 提出名为 Chipstitch 的硅查询架构，包含三个核心贡献：一是基于 keystone 算法的算法三层可重复和可扩展拼嵌方法；二是适用于拼嵌间隙的可扩展架构-VLSI 系统互连（具研究级时序和时钟）；三是网格对齐的周边功耗关断技术（用于降低研究级功耗测量的开销）。
AI.result: 在 Skywater 130nm 和 Intel 16nm 工艺节点下，通过包含后版图 VLSI 实现的垂直集成方法验证了 25 站点异构设计场景，相比传统的多项目晶圆基线，Chipstitch 实现了 9.9x 到 14.5x 的总体成本优势，并将单次验证的入门成本降低了高达两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Chipstitch 通过算法拼嵌、系统互连和功耗关断技术，成功实现了一个可扩展且高性价比的硅原型制作平台，大幅降低了获取真实硅证据的门槛和成本。
AI.translation: 硅证据是学术界和工业界信誉的关键证明，它能以模拟无法做到的方式验证创新并表明可行性。然而，由于高昂的资金成本和工程努力障碍，获取这种证明的机会受到严重限制，将无法负担的创新者拒之门外。为了弥合这一差距，我们考虑了一种名为硅查询架构的新设计范式，它跨越 EDA、架构和 VLSI，旨在将单晶片面积转变为可扩展、拼嵌式的片内硅证据基底，在不牺牲研究级规格的情况下将入门成本降低一到两个数量级。我们具体提出了 Chipstitch，这是一种通过三项贡献实现的硅查询架构：一种基于 keystone 算法的算法三层可重复和可扩展拼嵌方法；一种适合拼嵌间隙、具有研究级时序和时钟的可扩展架构-VLSI 系统互连；以及一种减轻研究级功耗测量开销的网格对齐周边功耗关断技术。使用向下延伸至后版图 VLSI 实现的垂直集成方法，我们在 25 站点的异构设计场景中演示了 Chipstitch，在 Skywater 130nm 和 Intel 16nm 工艺节点下，与传统的多项目晶圆基线相比，实现了 9.9x-14.5x 的总体成本优势，并将单次验证的入门成本降低了高达两个数量级。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 Chipstitch，这是一个可扩展且高性价比的加速硅原型制作平台。它基于“硅查询架构”范式，通过三层拼嵌算法、间隙系统互连以及网格对齐的功耗关断技术，在保持研究级规格的同时，将硅原型制作的进入成本降低了一到两个数量级。
AI.keywords: 硅原型制作, 硬件设计, 多项目晶圆, VLSI, 硅查询架构
AI.comments: Chipstitch 创新性地提出了硅查询架构和网格拼嵌方法，通过软件和硬件的协同设计，大幅降低了硅片原型制作的成本和门槛，对学术界和工业界的硬件创新具有重要推动作用。

title: A Stabilized Finite Element Method for a Morpho-Visco-Poroelastic Model
summary: Studying the structure of soft tissues is important and relevant in biology, particularly in some diseases, such as tumor growth and dermal contraction after burn injury. Based on the complicated characteristics of the tissue and for the sake of a better understanding of the underlying biomechanics, we propose a mathematical model that combines elastic, viscous, and porous effects with growth or shrinkage due to microstructural changes. The framework is referred to as morpho-visco-poroelasticity. Although the existence results of the solution to the problem are not given in this study, we assess the stability of the equilibria for both the continuous and semi-discrete versions of the model, and the key features of this modelling framework have been discussed. To obtain reliable numerical solutions, a stabilized finite element (FE) scheme is proposed for the morpho-visco-poroelasticity equations to avoid spurious oscillations in the pressure profile; the success of this FE scheme is verified by numerical simulations and convergence investigation in both spatial and temporal aspects. For a more quantitative assessment, the total variation of the pressure profile is evaluated as a function of the stabilization parameter.

AI.title_translation: 形态-粘性-多孔弹性模型的稳定有限元方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于模拟软组织生物力学特性的形态-粘性-多孔弹性模型，并开发了一种稳定的有限元方法来消除压力振荡，通过数值模拟验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 为了更好地理解软组织（如肿瘤生长和烧伤后皮肤收缩）复杂的生物力学特性，并克服传统数值模拟中可能出现的压力振荡问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合弹性、粘性、多孔以及微结构生长或收缩效应的数学模型（形态-粘性-多孔弹性），并针对该方程组设计了一种能够避免压力分布虚假振荡的稳定有限元格式。
AI.result: 通过平衡性稳定性分析、数值模拟以及空间和时间上的收敛性研究，验证了所提出的稳定有限元格式的成功性，并评估了压力分布的全变差与稳定化参数的关系。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功建立并验证了形态-粘性-多孔弹性模型及其稳定有限元方法，能够有效避免压力伪振荡并确保数值解的可靠性。
AI.translation: 研究软组织结构在生物学中非常重要且相关，特别是在某些疾病中，例如肿瘤生长和烧伤后的皮肤收缩。基于组织的复杂特性为了更好地理解潜在的生物力学，我们提出了一种数学模型，该模型将弹性、粘性、多孔效应与由于微结构变化引起的生长或收缩结合起来。该框架被称为形态-粘性-多孔弹性。尽管本研究未给出该问题解的存在性结果，但我们评估了模型连续版本和半离散版本平衡态的稳定性，并讨论了该建模框架的关键特征。为了获得可靠的数值解，针对形态-粘性-多孔弹性方程提出了一种稳定的有限元（FE）格式，以避免压力分布中的虚假振荡；该FE格式的成功通过空间和时间方面的数值模拟和收敛性研究得到了验证。为了进行更定量的评估，压力分布的全变差被评估为稳定化参数的函数。
AI.summary: 本文针对软组织生物力学特性，提出了一种包含弹性、粘性、多孔及生长效应的“形态-粘性-多孔弹性”数学模型。为了获得可靠的数值解，作者设计了一种稳定的有限元格式以消除压力伪振荡，并通过数值模拟和收敛性分析验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 形态-粘性-多孔弹性, 软组织生物力学, 稳定有限元方法, 肿瘤生长, 数值模拟
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种针对形态-粘性-多孔弹性模型的稳定有限元方法，旨在解决软组织生物力学模拟中的压力振荡问题，对于理解肿瘤生长和伤口收缩等生物医学现象具有重要意义。

title: Machines, AI and the past//future of things
summary: This essay explores a techno-artistic experiment that reanimates a 1980s East German typewriter using a contemporary AI language model. Situated at the intersection of media archaeology and speculative design, the project questions dominant narratives of progress by embedding generative AI in an obsolete, tactile interface. Through public exhibitions and aesthetic intervention, we demonstrate how slowness, friction, and material render artificial intelligence not only visible but open to critical inquiry. Drawing on concepts such as zombie media, technostalgia, and speculative design, we argue that reappropriating outdated technologies enables new forms of critical engagement. Erika - the AI-enabled typewriter - functions as both interface and interruption, making space for reflection, irony, and cultural memory. In a moment of accelerated digital abstraction, projects like this foreground the value of deliberate slowness, experiential materiality, and historical depth. We conclude by advocating for a historicist design sensibility that challenges presentism and reorients human-machine interaction toward alternative, perceived futures.

AI.title_translation: 机器、人工智能与事物的过去//未来
AI.tldr: 本文通过将现代AI嵌入1980年代的旧打字机中，探讨了利用过时技术进行批判性设计和反思数字加速主义的可能性。
AI.motivation: 为了对抗当前数字技术加速抽象的趋势，通过将生成式AI置于过时且具有触感的界面中，质疑主流的进步叙事，并探讨如何通过回溯旧技术来实现对AI的批判性审视。
AI.method: 通过一项名为“Erika”的科技艺术实验，将现代AI语言模型嵌入1980年代的东德打字机中，并在公众展览中进行美学干预与展示。
AI.result: 实验证明，将AI与旧设备结合能够产生一种既作为界面又作为中断机制的媒介，激发公众的反思、讽刺和文化记忆，凸显了刻意放慢速度、体验物质性和历史深度的价值。
AI.conclusion: 通过将生成式AI嵌入废弃的硬件界面中，该项目倡导一种具有历史意识的设计敏感性，用以挑战技术现实主义，并重新引导人机交互走向多元的未来。
AI.translation: 本文探讨了一项科技艺术实验，该实验使用当代AI语言模型重新激活了一台20世纪80年代的东德打字机。该项目位于媒体考古学和思辨设计的交汇处，通过将生成式AI嵌入陈旧的触觉界面中，质疑了主流的进步叙事。通过公开展览和美学干预，我们展示了缓慢、摩擦和物质性如何使人工智能不仅可见，而且能够接受批判性探究。借鉴幽灵媒体、技术怀旧和思辨设计等概念，我们认为重新挪用过时技术能够实现新的批判性参与形式。Erika——这款由AI驱动的打字机——既是界面又是中断，为反思、讽刺和文化记忆留出了空间。在数字加速抽象的当下，这样的项目凸显了刻意放慢节奏、体验物质性和历史深度的价值。最后，我们主张建立一种历史主义的设计敏感性，以挑战当下主义，并将人机交互重新定向到替代的、可感知的未来。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了一项将20世纪80年代的打字机与现代AI大语言模型相结合的科技艺术实验。结合媒体考古学与批判性设计，作者通过“Erika”这一项目展示了如何利用过时的硬件来对抗数字加速主义，倡导一种强调历史深度、物质感与刻意放慢节奏的设计敏感性。
AI.keywords: 人工智能, 媒体考古学, 幽灵媒体, 批判性设计, 人机交互
AI.comments: 该论文新颖地将现代生成式AI与过时的1980年代打字机结合，通过引入“慢节奏”和“物理摩擦”来批判当前数字技术的盲目加速主义，对人机交互和历史维度的设计具有重要的启发意义。

title: Foundations and Design Principles of Lightweight Cryptography for IoT Systems
summary: The successful deployment of the Internet of Things (IoT) applications relies heavily on their robust security, and lightweight cryptography is considered an emerging solution in this context. While existing surveys have been examining lightweight cryptographic techniques from the perspective of hardware and software implementations or performance evaluation, there is a significant gap in addressing different security aspects, such as design principles, specific to the IoT environment. This study aims to bridge this gap. This research presents an examination with focusing on the security evaluation of symmetric lightweight ciphers commonly used in IoT systems. The objective of this study is to provide a concise overview of lightweight ciphers with emphasizing on their security challenges which is an essential consideration for real-time and resource-constrained applications.

AI.title_translation: 物联网系统轻量级密码学的基础与设计原则
AI.tldr: 本文填补了物联网轻量级密码学设计原则和安全性评估方面的研究空白，重点探讨了面向资源受限环境的对称轻量级密码及其安全挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有的调查大多从硬件、软件实现或性能评估的角度研究轻量级密码技术，但在针对物联网环境的不同安全方面（如设计原则）存在明显的空白，因此本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 通过文献检查与分析，重点关注物联网系统中常用的对称轻量级密码的安全性评估。
AI.result: 提供了一个关于轻量级密码的精炼概述，重点突出了其在实时和资源受限应用中面临的安全挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为物联网系统中的轻量级密码学提供了全面的安全评估和设计原则概览，有助于推动安全、高效的物联网应用部署。
AI.translation: 物联网（IoT）应用的成功部署很大程度上依赖于其强大的安全性，在此背景下，轻量级密码学被认为是一种新兴的解决方案。虽然现有的综述大多从硬件和软件实现或性能评估的角度来研究轻量级密码技术，但在解决物联网环境特有的不同安全方面（如设计原则）存在明显的空白。本研究旨在填补这一空白。本研究重点考察了物联网系统中常用的对称轻量级密码的安全性评估。本研究的目标是提供一个关于轻量级密码的精炼概述，重点关注其安全挑战，这对于实时和资源受限的应用而言是一个必不可少的考量因素。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了物联网系统中轻量级密码学的基本原理与设计原则，重点评估了常用对称轻量级密码的安全性，旨在填补当前缺乏针对物联网环境安全设计原则研究的空白。
AI.keywords: 物联网, 轻量级密码学, 对称密码, 安全评估, 设计原则
AI.comments: 该论文填补了物联网环境下轻量级密码学设计原则和安全评估方面的空白，对资源受限环境下的实时应用具有重要的理论和实际参考价值。

title: Bayesian Safety Guarantees for Port-Hamiltonian Systems with Learned Energy Functions
summary: Control barrier functions for port-Hamiltonian systems inherit model uncertainty when the Hamiltonian is learned from data. We show how to propagate this uncertainty into a safety filter with independently tunable credibility budgets. To propagate this uncertainty, we employ a two-stage Bayesian approach. First, posterior prediction over the Hamiltonian yields credible bands for the energy storage, producing Bayesian barriers whose safe sets are high-probability inner approximations of the true allowable set with credibility $1 - (η_{\mathrm{ptB}})$. Independently, a drift credible ellipsoid accounts for vector field uncertainty in the CBF inequality with credibility $1 - (η_{\rm dr})$. Since energy and drift uncertainties enter through disjoint credible sets, the end-to-end safety guarantee is at least $1 - (η_{\rm dr} + η_{\mathrm{ptB}})$. Experiments on a mass-spring oscillator with a GP-learned Hamiltonian show that the proposed filter preserves safety despite limited and noisy observations.

AI.title_translation: 具有学习能量函数的端口哈密顿系统的贝叶斯安全保证
AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对学习型端口哈密顿系统的两阶段贝叶斯安全滤波方法，有效克服了模型不确定性带来的安全隐患。
AI.motivation: 当哈密顿量从数据中学习时，端口哈密顿系统的控制屏障函数会继承模型不确定性，需要一种方法将这种不确定性传播到安全滤波器中以保证系统安全。
AI.method: 采用两阶段贝叶斯方法传播不确定性：第一阶段通过哈密顿量的后验预测生成能量储存的可信区间，构建贝叶斯屏障；第二阶段利用漂移可信椭球处理CBF不等式中的向量场不确定性。
AI.result: 端到端安全保证至少为 $1 - (η_{\rm dr} + η_{\mathrm{ptB}})$；在具有高斯过程学习哈密顿量的质量-弹簧振子上的实验表明，该滤波器在有限且带噪声的观测下仍能保持安全性。
AI.conclusion: 通过两阶段贝叶斯方法成功将学习型端口哈密顿系统的不确定性传播至安全滤波器中，实现了对噪声和有限观测下系统安全性的有效保障。
AI.translation: 具有学习能量函数的端口哈密顿系统的控制屏障函数在从数据中学习哈密顿量时会继承模型不确定性。我们展示了如何将这种不确定性传播到具有独立可调信誉预算的安全滤波器中。为了传播这种不确定性，我们采用了一种两阶段贝叶斯方法。首先，对哈密顿量的后验预测产生能量储存的可信带来产生贝叶斯屏障，其安全集是具有 $1 - (η_{\mathrm{ptB}})$ 信誉的真实允许集的具有高概率的内部近似。独立地，漂移可信椭球以 $1 - (η_{\rm dr})$ 的信誉度考虑CBF不等式中的向量场不确定性。由于能量和漂移不确定性通过不相交的可信集进入，端到端的安全保证至少为 $1 - (η_{\rm dr} + η_{\mathrm{ptB}})$。在具有GP学习哈密顿量的质量-弹簧振子上的实验表明，所提出的滤波器尽管有有限和噪声观测，但仍能保持安全性。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种针对具有学习能量函数的端口哈密顿系统的贝叶斯安全保证方法，利用两阶段贝叶斯方法独立传播能量和向量场的不确定性，从而在有限且带噪声的观测下通过安全滤波器维持系统安全性。
AI.keywords: Port-Hamiltonian systems, Control barrier functions, Bayesian uncertainty, Safety guarantees, Gaussian processes
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将贝叶斯不确定性传播与端口哈密顿系统（PHS）相结合，通过两阶段贝叶斯方法独立处理能量函数和向量场的不确定性，为学习型系统提供了端到端的安全性保证，具有很高的理论价值和实际应用潜力。

title: A System Architecture for Low Latency Multiprogramming Quantum Computing
summary:
As quantum systems scale, multiprogramming quantum computing (MPQC) provides a practical way to improve device utilization and throughput. However, because quantum executables are device-dependent, non-portable across qubit regions, and highly susceptible to noise and crosstalk, current MPQC pipelines rely on expensive online compilation to co-optimize concurrently running programs. This online step dominates runtime and impedes low-latency deployments for practical, real-world workloads in the future, such as repeatedly invoked quantum neural network (QNN) services.
  We present FLAMENCO, a fidelity-aware multi-version compilation system that enables independent offline compilation and low-latency multiprogramming at runtime. \textbf{At the architecture level}, the system abstracts devices into compute units to reduce the search space of region allocation. \textbf{At compile time}, it generates diverse executable versions for each program---each bound to a distinct qubit region---allowing dynamic region selection at runtime and overcoming non-portability. \textbf{At runtime}, it employs a lightweight orchestrator that uses post-compilation fidelity metrics to avoid conflicts and mitigate crosstalk, supporting conflict-free co-execution without online co-optimization. Evaluations show that FLAMENCO achieves over 5$\times$ runtime speedup in post-scheduling execution while maintaining comparable execution fidelity on common-success workloads. When integrated into existing scheduler-coupled systems, it raises workload-level conflict-free orchestration ratio from 0.183 to 1.000 for HyperQ and from 0.050 to 0.400 for QOS.

AI.title_translation: 面向低延迟多道程序量子计算的系统架构
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为FLAMENCO的保真度感知多版本编译系统，通过离线编译和轻量级运行时编排，实现了低延迟的量子多道程序设计，运行速度提升超5倍。
AI.motivation: 随着量子系统规模扩大，多道程序量子计算（MPQC）可提升设备利用率和吞吐量，但现有的在线编译步骤开销巨大，阻碍了诸如量子神经网络等实际工作负载的低延迟部署。
AI.method: 提出了FLAMENCO系统，在架构层将设备抽象为计算单元，在编译时为每个程序生成绑定不同量子比特区域的多种可执行版本，在运行时采用基于后编译保真度指标的轻量级编排器以实现无冲突的协同执行。

title: Efficient third-order iterative algorithms for computing zeros of special functions
summary: This manuscript presents a novel and reliable third-order iterative procedure for computing the zeros of solutions to second-order ordinary differential equations. By approximating the solution of the related Riccati differential equation using the trapezoidal rule, this study has derived the proposed third-order method. This work establishes sufficient conditions to ensure the theoretical non-local convergence of the proposed method. This study provides suitable initial guesses for the proposed third-order iterative procedure to compute all zeros in a given interval of the solutions to second-order ordinary differential equations. The orthogonal polynomials like Legendre and Hermite, as well as the special functions like Bessel, Coulomb wave, confluent hypergeometric, and cylinder functions, satisfy the proposed conditions for convergence. Numerical simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed theory. This work also presents a comparative analysis with recent studies.

title: Large Language Models As Shannon Lossy Compressors Not Solomonoff Induction Estimators: The Singularity Is Not Near Without Symbolic Model Synthesis
summary: On the one hand, the question of whether Large Language Models (LLMs) are Solomonoff induction estimators has become an explicit question at the intersection of Algorithmic Information Theory (AIT) and Machine Learning (ML) of great interest. On the other hand, the now old idea of an AI Singularity that requires a reliable positive-feedback process in which a system can generate, evaluate and retain genuine improvements to itself continues to come up and is a recurrent concept in the discussion of AGI. We connect and provide some answers to these issues based on current assumptions and future developments of neurosymbolic ML. We will demonstrate that cross-entropy, negative log-likelihood and cognate next-token objectives do not or cannot, by themselves, implement Solomonoff induction: they optimise fit to a supplied conditional distribution rather than a program-weighted universal mixture. While more compute within a fixed objective can improve fit without changing the inductive principle, additional computational resources do not intrinsically without external hyper-parameter or architectural changes, behave as optimal predictors in the Solomonoff and Levin sense. While the data-processing inequality (DPI) and Levin non-growth remain valid, we will show that for finite learners and finite observers, theoretical boundaries have less relevancy and generate a drift between possible approaches. To this end, we interpret different resource-bounded estimators as finite tools for mechanism search that show divergence, not violation, of (algorithmic) information conservation laws. A neurosymbolic approach is already being taken and adopted by current frontier-model developers, including models like Fable and Astra, embracing aspects of model synthesis through symbolic computation and cannot longer be considered purely statistical LLMs.

title: Robotic Tele-Operation for Upper Aerodigestive Tract Microsurgery: System Design and Validation
summary: Upper aerodigestive tract (UADT) treatments frequently employ transoral laser microsurgery (TLM) for procedures such as the removal of tumors or polyps. In TLM, a laser beam is used to cut target tissue, while forceps are employed to grasp, manipulate, and stabilize tissue within the UADT. Although TLM systems may rely on different technologies and interfaces, forceps manipulation is still predominantly performed manually, introducing limitations in ergonomics, precision, and controllability. This paper proposes a novel robotic system for tissue manipulation in UADT procedures, based on a novel end-effector designed for forceps control. The system is integrated within a teleoperation framework that employs a robotic manipulator with a programmed remote center of motion (RCM), enabling precise and constrained instrument motion while improving surgeon ergonomics. The proposed approach is validated through two experimental studies and a dedicated usability evaluation, demonstrating its effectiveness and suitability for UADT surgical applications.

title: Learning Password Best Practices Through In-Task Instruction
summary: Users often make security- and privacy-relevant decisions without a clear understanding of the rules that govern safe behavior. We introduce pedagogical friction, a design approach that inserts brief, instructional interactions at the moment of action. We evaluate this approach in the context of password creation, a familiar task with clear quality criteria. We conducted a randomized study with 128 participants across four interface conditions that varied the depth and interactivity of guidance. We assessed three outcomes: (1) rule compliance in a subsequent password task without guidance, (2) accuracy on survey questions tied to password rules, and (3) behavior-knowledge alignment, which captures whether participants who correctly followed a rule also recognized it on the survey. Across the guided conditions, participants corrected most rule violations in the follow-up task and showed high behavior-knowledge alignment. Survey results suggested clearer advantages for some rule types, especially symbol related questions. These results position pedagogical friction as a lightweight intervention for security- and privacy-critical interfaces.

title: Explainable Multimodal Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis with Dependency-guided Large Language Model
summary: Multimodal aspect-based sentiment analysis (MABSA) aims to identify aspect-level sentiments by jointly modeling textual and visual information, which is essential for fine-grained opinion understanding in social media. Existing approaches mainly rely on discriminative classification with complex multimodal fusion, yet they lack explicit sentiment explainability. In this paper, we reformulate MABSA as a generative and explainable task, proposing a unified framework that simultaneously predicts aspect-level sentiment and generates natural language explanations. Based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), our approach employs a prompt-based generative paradigm, jointly producing sentiment and explanation. To further enhance aspect-oriented reasoning capabilities, we propose a dependency-syntax-guided sentiment cue strategy. This strategy prunes and textualizes the aspect-centered dependency syntax tree, guiding the model to distinguish different sentiment aspects and enhancing its explainability. To enable explainability, we use MLLMs to construct explanation-augmented datasets for fine-tuning. Experiments show that our approach not only achieves overall gains in sentiment classification accuracy, but also produces coherent and aspect-grounded explanations.

title: BEAT-Net: Injecting Biomimetic Spatio-Temporal Priors for Interpretable ECG Diagnosis
comments: 10 pages, 6 figures and 2 tables. Revised version of the manuscript submitted to the IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics. Title updated from "Interpretable ECG Classification" to "Interpretable ECG Diagnosis"; author list expanded to match the submitted version
summary: Automated electrocardiogram diagnosis using deep learning remains limited by signal-agnostic representations that treat multi-lead recordings as undifferentiated time-series or images, forcing models to rediscover physiological structure implicitly. This leads to data inefficiency, poor generalization, and opaque decision boundaries misaligned with clinical reasoning. We present BEAT-Net, a supervised biomimetic framework that integrates QRS-centered biological tokenization with a hierarchical architecture mirroring the cardiologist's workflow. A QRS tokenizer converts continuous signals into semantically complete heartbeat sequences, which are processed through four specialized stages: morphological feature extraction via a Word Encoder, lead-invariant normalization through a Spatial Operator, temporal context injection by a Temporal Operator, and global reasoning using a Transformer-based Sentence Encoder. Evaluated across three large-scale benchmarks including PTB-XL, CPSC2018, and CSN, BEAT-Net achieves diagnostic accuracy of 0.924 AUC, comparable to dominant CNN baselines at 0.925 AUC, while reducing parameters by 95 percent from 2.06 million to 0.7 million. Critically, BEAT-Net surpasses the 39.5-million-parameter foundation model HeartLang on morphological Form classification, reaching 0.901 AUC compared to HeartLang's 0.832 AUC, while attaining full CNN-level performance using only 35 percent of training data and exhibiting superior cross-dataset generalization. Learned attention patterns spontaneously align with established clinical heuristics, demonstrating that explicit physiological structure provides a more efficient and interpretable alternative to massive pre-training for clinical deployment.

title: jBOT: Semantic Jet Representation Clustering Emerges from Self-Distillation
summary: Self-supervised learning, in the context of foundation model training, is a powerful pre-training method for learning feature representations without labels, which often capture generic underlying semantics from the data and can later be fine-tuned for downstream tasks. In this work, we introduce jBOT, a pre-training method based on self-distillation for jet data from the CERN Large Hadron Collider, which combines local particle-level distillation with global jet-level distillation to learn jet representations that support downstream tasks such as anomaly detection and classification. We observe that pre-training on unlabeled jets leads to emergent semantic class clustering in the representation space. The clustering in the frozen embedding, when pre-trained on background jets only, enables anomaly detection via simple distance-based metrics, and the learned embedding can be fine-tuned for classification with improved performance compared to supervised models trained from scratch.

title: Reachability Guarantees for Energy Arbitrage
summary: Batteries performing energy arbitrage may overdischarge ahead of a high-demand or critical operating hour when they re-optimize in real time and depart from the day-ahead schedule. This paper introduces a framework for battery energy arbitrage under uncertain market prices that integrates chance-constrained terminal state-of-charge (SoC) requirements with online threshold policies. We first cast the multi-interval arbitrage problem as a stochastic dynamic program enhanced by a probabilistic end-of-horizon SoC constraint, ensuring with high confidence that the battery terminates within a prescribed energy band. We then apply a $k$-search algorithm to derive explicit charging (buying) and discharging (selling) thresholds with a provable worst-case competitive ratio, and compute the corresponding action probabilities over the decision horizon. To compute exact distributions under operational limits, we develop a probability redistribution pruning method and use it to quantify the likelihood of meeting the terminal SoC band. Leveraging the resulting SoC distribution, we estimate the minimum stopping time required to satisfy the SoC chance constraint. Computational experiments on historical real price data demonstrate that the proposed framework improves SoC estimation and supports chance-constraint satisfaction, while also showing that reachability is highly sensitive to a given initial SoC and operating start time.

title: MemeLens: Multilingual Multitask VLMs for Memes
comments: disinformation, misinformation, factuality, harmfulness, fake news, propaganda, hateful meme, multimodality, text, images
summary: Memes are a dominant medium for online communication and manipulation because meaning emerges from interactions between embedded text, imagery, and cultural context. Existing meme research is distributed across tasks (e.g., \textit{hate, misogyny, propaganda, sentiment, humour}) and languages, which limits cross-domain generalization. To address this gap, we propose \textsc{MemeLens}, a unified multilingual, multitask explanation-enhanced Vision-Language Model (VLM) for meme understanding. We consolidate $38$ public meme datasets, filter and map dataset-specific labels into a shared taxonomy of $20$ tasks spanning harm, targets, figurative/pragmatic intent, and affect. We present a comprehensive empirical analysis across modeling paradigms, task categories, and datasets. Our findings suggest that robust meme understanding requires multimodal training, varies substantially across semantic categories, and remains sensitive to over-specialization when models are fine-tuned on individual datasets rather than trained in a unified setting. We make the experimental resources (https://github.com/MohamedBayan/MemeLens), model (https://huggingface.co/QCRI/MemeLens-VLM) and datasets (https://huggingface.co/datasets/QCRI/MemeLens) publicly available to the community.

title: DisasterInsight: A Building-Centric Benchmark for Evaluating Vision--Language Models in Disaster Response
comments: Presented at the TerraBytes workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: Vision--language models (VLMs) show promise for disaster-response remote sensing, but existing benchmarks mainly emphasize scene-level or damage-centric assessment. To study this building-centric gap, we introduce \method{}, a diagnostic benchmark built on xBD, a pre/post-disaster satellite dataset with building-level damage labels. \method{} enriches building instances with OpenStreetMap-derived functional labels and contains 134{,}108 task-specific instruction records across 15 task types, spanning instance-level assessment, scene-level counting, multi-instance reasoning, and structured report generation. The benchmark supports RGB pre/post-disaster imagery, single- and multi-view instance formulations, and scene-level RGB/SAR diagnostic inputs. Experiments with general-domain and remote-sensing VLMs show that models perform better on visible damage cues than on building-function understanding, multi-instance reasoning, counting, and grounded reporting. Instruction tuning improves performance on several tasks but does not close this building-centric gap.

title: Machine-Learning-Enhanced Discretize-then-Project Reduced-Order Modeling of Turbulent Flows on Collocated Grids
comments: 42 pages, 21 figures, and 5 tables. Revised manuscript with additional experiments, methodological clarifications, and an updated title. Preprint submitted to a journal
summary: This study presents a hybrid reduced-order modeling (ROM) framework for incompressible flows on collocated finite-volume grids, combining a discretize-then-project consistent-flux formulation for velocity and pressure with a non-intrusive neural-network closure for turbulent viscosity. The intrusive formulation preserves discrete mass conservation and pressure-velocity coupling, while a reduced pressure reference-cell constraint fixes pressure gauge ambiguity. We evaluate Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Transformer, and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) closures. For a three-dimensional lid-driven cavity at $Re=100$, the LSTM-based ROM achieves relative errors of 0.7% in velocity and 4% in turbulent viscosity. At $Re=3200$, a mode-sensitivity study identifies $N=15$ POD modes as the best overall configuration, balancing accuracy, dimension, robustness, and cost. It yields a final relative velocity error of approximately 12.3% and an online wall-clock speedup of approximately $50\times$ over the full-order model; energy and enstrophy errors remain below 11% for all three architectures. This regime requires case-specific neural-network retraining and pressure reference-cell parameter retuning. In a time-extrapolation test trained on $t\in[0,3]$,s and rolled out to $t=6$,s, the ROM remains bounded, although velocity and pressure errors increase beyond the training window. The LSTM turbulent-viscosity closure remains robust, identifying long-horizon pressure accuracy as the main limitation. These results demonstrate the potential of consistent projection-based modeling combined with data-driven turbulence closure for efficient reduced-order simulation.

title: Learning to Advect: A Neural Semi-Lagrangian Architecture for Weather Forecasting
summary: Machine-learning approaches to weather forecasting often employ a monolithic architecture in which distinct physical mechanisms, such as advection, diffusive mixing, thermodynamic processes, and forcing, are represented implicitly within a single large neural network. This is particularly problematic for advection, where long-range transport typically requires expensive global interaction mechanisms or deep stacks of local convolutional layers. To address this limitation, we introduce a physics-inspired neural architecture that decomposes latent-state evolution into dedicated advection, diffusion, and reaction operators. Its central component is a Neural Semi-Lagrangian operator that performs trajectory-based transport via differentiable interpolation on the sphere, allowing the network to learn both a compressed set of latent modes to be transported and their characteristic trajectories. The atmospheric state is projected into latent space and spatially coarsened to a processor grid, where advection, diffusion, and reaction operators jointly evolve the representation. Diffusive mixing and unresolved dissipation are represented by depthwise-separable spatial mixing, while local source terms and vertical interactions are handled through pointwise channel interactions. We evaluate a reference implementation of the proposed architecture on global weather forecasting. Evaluated on ERA5 benchmarks, the reference model achieves competitive deterministic forecast skill, with particularly strong performance at short to medium lead times, while preserving improved spectral fidelity and forecast activity relative to several leading data-driven baselines.

title: CORDS: Continuous Representations of Discrete Structures
comments: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026. 38 pages, including appendix. Code: https://github.com/stases/CORDS
summary: Many learning problems require predicting sets of objects when the number of objects is not known beforehand. Examples include object detection, molecular modeling, and scientific inference tasks such as astrophysical source detection. Existing methods often rely on padded representations or must explicitly infer the set size, which often poses challenges. We present a novel strategy for addressing this challenge by casting prediction of variable-sized sets as a continuous inference problem. Our approach, CORDS (Continuous Representations of Discrete Structures), provides an invertible mapping that transforms a set of spatial objects into continuous fields: a density field that encodes object locations and count, and a feature field that carries their attributes over the same support. Because the mapping is invertible, models operate entirely in field space while remaining exactly decodable to discrete sets. We evaluate CORDS across molecular generation and regression, object detection, simulation-based inference, and a mathematical task involving recovery of local maxima, demonstrating robust handling of unknown set sizes with competitive accuracy.

title: Semantic Calibration Prevails Where Token Confidence Fails: Benchmarking Long-Form Scientific QA
comments: Accepted to the Third Workshop on Uncertainty-Aware NLP at EMNLP 2026
summary: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for safe deployment of large language models (LLMs) in scientific question answering, where long-form outputs exceed practical human verification at scale. We introduce the first large-scale benchmark for UQ calibration in long-form, reasoning-demanding scientific QA, evaluating four UQ methods on 685,000 responses across up to 20 LLMs and seven datasets, supported by an extensible open-source framework whose shared-generation design enables reproducible cross-method comparisons. Instruction tuning is shown to associate with systematic token probability polarization, collapsing confidence distributions and undermining the reliability of token-level uncertainty signals. Reasoning model families diverge: some reproduce this polarization while others actively mitigate it, a pattern that clusters by provider and suggests training pipeline design as a key differentiating factor. Verbalized and token-aggregation sequence-level methods fail systematically. Only semantic consistency, as measured by consistency of the final answer, yields well-calibrated outputs, providing the first large-scale evidence that semantic calibration persists in multi-step, dependency-rich reasoning settings.

title: HERMES: A Holistic End-to-End Risk-Aware Multimodal Embodied System with Vision-Language Models for Long-Tail Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving models increasingly benefit from large vision-language models for semantic understanding, yet safe and reliable planning under long-tail conditions remains challenging, particularly in mixed-traffic environments involving heterogeneous road users and rare safety-critical interactions. This paper proposes HERMES, a holistic risk-aware end-to-end multimodal driving framework that explicitly incorporates long-tail semantic knowledge into trajectory planning. HERMES employs a foundation-model-assisted annotation pipeline to construct structured Long-Tail Scene Context and Long-Tail Planning Context, capturing hazard-centric scene information, maneuver intent, and risk-aware planning guidance. A Tri-Modal Driving Module then integrates multi-view visual observations, historical ego-motion, and long-tail semantic instructions through intent- and risk-aware conditioning for trajectory generation. Extensive experiments on a large-scale real-world long-tail driving benchmark demonstrate consistent improvements over representative recent baselines in overall planning performance and across diverse safety-critical scenarios. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness and complementary roles of the major components within HERMES.

title: RankSteer: Can Pointwise LLM Rankers Be Calibrated at the Representation Level?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are strong zero-shot pointwise rankers, but lag behind pairwise and listwise methods. Beyond missing comparative signals, we identify a \textit{calibration gap}: ranking-relevant information encoded in hidden states is not fully captured by the scalar output head. We propose RankSteer, a post-hoc activation-steering framework that calibrates ranking via projection-based interventions along multiple directions at inference time: decision, evidence, and, optionally, role. This is achieved without updating model weights or introducing cross-document comparisons. We instantiate RankSteer on two structurally distinct pointwise variants and observe improvements over their respective baselines on most TREC DL and BEIR datasets across three backbones. This suggests that the calibration gap is a general property of pointwise rankers. Our additional geometric analysis shows that steering improves ranking by concentrating each query's document representations along an existing ranking geometry, offering new insight into how LLMs internally represent and calibrate relevance judgments.

title: MENASpeechBank: A Reference Voice Bank with Persona-Conditioned Multi-Turn Conversations for AudioLLMs
comments: Foundation Models, Large Language Models, Native, Speech Models, Arabic, AI-persona, Persona-conditioned-conversations
summary: Audio large language models (AudioLLMs) enable instruction following over speech and general audio, but progress is limited by the scarcity of diverse, conversational, and instruction-aligned speech--text data. This gap is particularly pronounced for persona-grounded and dialectal interactions, where collecting real multi-speaker recordings remains costly and slow. We introduce MENASpeechBank, a reference speech bank comprising ~18K high-quality utterances from 124 speakers spanning multiple MENA countries, covering English, Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), and regional Arabic varieties. We develop a controllable data pipeline that (i) constructs persona profiles enriched with World Values Survey (WVS) inspired attributes, (ii) defines a taxonomy driven ~5Kconversational scenarios, (iii) matches personas to scenarios via semantic similarity, (iv) generates ~417K role-play conversations with an LLM where the user speaks as the persona and the assistant behaves as a helpful agent, and (v) produces speaker-conditioned user-turn audio (synthetic) from reference recordings to preserve speaker diversity. We evaluate synthetic and human recorded conversations and provide an analysis. We will make the MENASpeechBank available for the community.(\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/QCRI/MenaSpeechBank)

title: IntTravel: A Real-World Dataset and Generative Framework for Integrated Multi-Task Travel Recommendation
summary: Next Point of Interest (POI) recommendation is essential for modern mobility and location-based services. To provide a smooth user experience, models must understand several components of a journey holistically: "when to depart", "how to travel", "where to go", and "what needs arise via the route". However, current research is limited by fragmented datasets that focus merely on next POI recommendation ("where to go"), neglecting the departure time, travel mode, and situational requirements along the journey. Furthermore, the limited scale of these datasets impedes accurate evaluation of performance. To bridge this gap, we introduce IntTravel, the first large-scale public dataset collected from Amap for integrated travel recommendation, including 4.1 billion interactions from 163 million users with 7.3 million POIs. Built upon this dataset, we introduce an end-to-end, decoder-only generative framework for multi-task recommendation. It incorporates information preservation, selection, and factorization to balance task collaboration with specialized differentiation, yielding substantial performance gains. IntTravel has been successfully deployed on Amap serving hundreds of millions of users, leading to a 1.09\% increase in CTR. IntTravel is available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/DreamX-Rec/.

title: Gradient-Stable Attention Heads Signal LLM Correctness
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often generate plausible yet incorrect answers, posing risks in safety-critical settings such as medicine. Human evaluation is expensive, and LLM-as-judge approaches risk introducing hidden errors. Recent single-pass white-box methods detect contextual hallucinations using linear probes over model internals, but their generalization to out-of-domain, out-of-task, and training-free settings remains poorly understood. We introduce HeadEntropy, a method that predicts answer correctness by measuring how susceptible each attention head's pattern is to modification under further gradient updates. The key insight is that the trace of the softmax Jacobian is a monotonic function of 2-Renyi entropy, linking attention spread to gradient stability during training, even without the reference annotation. With no training, HeadEntropy reaches 0.736 AUROC, outperforms every training-free baseline in paired comparison and matches a hidden-state probe out-of-domain, at under 1% of inference cost. We evaluate broadly across 5 instruction-tuned LLMs and 5 datasets spanning general knowledge, multi-hop reasoning, mathematical reasoning, claim verification, and medicine. The code is available at https://github.com/StanfordMIMI/HeadEntropy.

title: MemoryArena: Benchmarking Agent Memory in Interdependent Multi-Session Agentic Tasks
summary: Existing evaluations of agents with memory typically assess memorization and action in isolation. One class of benchmarks evaluates memorization by testing recall of past conversations or text but fails to capture how memory is used to guide future decisions. Another class focuses on agents acting in single-session tasks without the need for long-term memory. However, in realistic settings, memorization and action are tightly coupled: agents acquire memory while interacting with the environment, and subsequently rely on that memory to solve future tasks. To capture this setting, we introduce MemoryArena, a unified evaluation gym for benchmarking agent memory in multi-session Memory-Agent-Environment loops. The benchmark consists of human-crafted agentic tasks with explicitly interdependent subtasks, where agents must learn from earlier actions and feedback by distilling experiences into memory, and subsequently use that memory to guide later actions to solve the overall task. MemoryArena supports evaluation across web navigation, preference-constrained planning, progressive information search, and sequential formal reasoning, and reveals that agents with near-saturated performance on existing long-context memory benchmarks like LoCoMo perform poorly in our agentic setting, exposing a gap in current evaluations for agents with memory. MemoryArena is now released at https://memoryarena.github.io/.

title: Position: A Dynamical Systems Perspective is Needed to Advance Time Series Modeling
summary: Time series (TS) modeling has come a long way from early statistical, mainly linear, approaches to the current trend in TS foundation models. With a lot of hype and industrial demand in this field, it is not always clear how much progress there really is. To advance TS forecasting and analysis to the next level, here we argue that the field needs a dynamical systems (DS) perspective. TS of observations from natural or engineered systems almost always originate from some underlying DS, and arguably access to its governing equations would yield theoretically optimal forecasts. This is the promise of DS reconstruction (DSR), a class of ML/AI approaches that aim to infer surrogate models of the underlying DS from data. But models based on DS principles offer other profound advantages: Beyond short-term forecasts, they enable to predict the long-term statistics of an observed system, which in many practical scenarios may be the more relevant quantities. DS theory furthermore provides domain-independent theoretical insight into mechanisms underlying TS generation, and thereby will inform us, e.g., about upper bounds on performance of any TS model, generalization into unseen regimes as in tipping points, or potential control strategies. After reviewing some of the central concepts, methods, measures, and models in DS theory and DSR, we will discuss how insights from this field can advance TS modeling in crucial ways, enabling better forecasting with much lower computational and memory footprints. We conclude with a number of specific suggestions for translating insights from DSR into TS modeling.
