title: Selective Interference Suppression of Siamese-Net in Heterogeneous Interference Channels
comments: Results in paper maybe erroneous. Needs further validation
summary: We study an end-to-end learnt short-block codes for a $N$-user real Gaussian interference channel with heterogeneous pairwise interference strengths, while keeping single-user decoding at every receiver. In this paper, we study the case wherein only a few dominant interferers exist and investigate whether Siamese-style coupled training can adapt selectively to encode (\& decode) to ensure optimal performance corresponding to best tradeoff between orthogonality and coding gain or it enforces unnecessary global orthogonality oblivious of the reality. Our work focuses on a 4-user unequal-interference configuration with one dominant pair $(1,2)$ (of strength $Λ$) and a weak pair (with weak background coupling ($λ$)), through which we demonstrate a selective interference suppression phenomenon where the learned codebooks become near-orthogonal primarily for the dominant pair, while weakly coupled pairs retain alignment needed for coding gain. We quantify this behaviour using latent-space cross-user similarity statistics (worst-case coherence measure, average similarity measure, etc) and connect these geometric signatures to the observed BLER robustness under unequal interference. It seems that the SiameseNet selectively suppresses the interferences from various interferring user pairs to yield optimal tradeoff between coding gain and BLER dictated by orthogonality.

title: SafeStep: An Interactive Demonstration of Semantic Communication for Pedestrian Safety Monitoring
comments: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the Quality, Value, and Age of Information for Tactical Networks Workshop (WS7), IEEE MILCOM 2026. Christian McDowell, Andrea Panebianco, and Jeremiah Yang are co-primary authors
summary: In this paper, we develop SafeStep, an interactive browser-based semantic communication platform for live pedestrian safety monitoring. SafeStep extracts pedestrian information from four live traffic-camera feeds, transmits it through a semantic communication transceiver over a software-emulated Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) channel, and renders user-specific positions, trajectories, and risk labels. The platform allows each user to select the transceiver, Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), codelength, and Age of Information (AoI) and view the resulting pedestrian reconstruction. SafeStep compares a recently proposed semantic communication design called Meta-VIB with five baseline transceivers. Meta-VIB uses a compact neural model with only $4.16$ million parameters to generalize across varying SNR, codelength, and AoI values without online retraining. Meta-VIB achieves mean task-loss reductions of up to $92.1\%$. On one high-end GPU server, the integrated concurrent-access workload maintains the target $5$ frames/s through $20$ users. At $100$ users, each requesting a distinct configuration, SafeStep records no request failures and a mean application response time below $1$ s, but its mean per-browser frame rate falls to approximately $1$ frame/s. To our knowledge, SafeStep is the first real-time semantic communication platform to make AoI-induced downstream degradation directly observable in live monitoring applications.

title: Self-extensional logics of formal inconsistency: Decidability and limits for paraconsistency
comments: Revised and expanded version. coNP-completeness was proved for the principal extensions containing at least one of the six minimal explosive pairs
summary: RmbC is a self-extensional paraconsistent logic in the family of Logics of Formal Inconsistency (LFIs). This system is obtained from mbC (the basic LFI) by adding the replacement property via two global inference rules. RmbC is characterized by a non-explosive negation $\neg$ and a consistency operator $\circ$, which recovers the principle of explosion in a controlled way. Together with its principal axiomatic extensions, RmbC admits a standard Lindenbaum-Tarski algebraization, with Boolean algebras with LFI operators (BALFIs) as its algebraic semantics. In this paper, we study how far this self-extensional paraconsistent behavior can be extended axiomatically, starting from RmbC. We classify pairs of very natural consistency axioms according to whether they preserve paraconsistency or force classical collapse; identify six minimal explosive combinations that collapse to a single algebraic core; and isolate a separate structural obstruction for the combination of excluded middle for $\neg$ with an involutive negation. We also investigate, for the first time, the decidability of this family of self-extensional LFIs. As a first result, we prove the finite model property for RmbC with respect to BALFI semantics via an algebraic filtration, which yields decidability, and transfer this result to several paraconsistent axiomatic extensions of RmbC. Finally, we establish a coNEXPTIME upper bound for the validity problem of RmbC and a coNP-hardness lower bound, and prove coNP-completeness for the principal extensions containing one of the six minimal explosive pairs.

title: Balance of Benchmarks: Semantic Density Reweighting for Task-Conditioned Model Comparison
comments: 65 pages including references and appendices. Expanded evaluation with WildScores, a collection of 148 developer-reported benchmarks
summary: Model comparison increasingly relies on large collections of publicly reported benchmark scores, yet common aggregation strategies trade off evidence coverage against control over capability weighting. Manually curated suites leave potentially informative evaluations unused, while uniform averaging retains them but gives greater influence to capabilities that happen to be benchmarked more densely. We introduce Balance of Benchmarks (BoB), a framework that retains eligible benchmark evidence while adapting its influence for task-conditioned model comparison using only public aggregate scores. BoB combines semantic density weighting, score equating across benchmarks of different difficulty, and task-relevant residual pooling. We evaluate it on 605 configurations across 14 Artificial Analysis benchmarks and on WildScores, a collection of 148 developer-reported benchmarks evaluated with held-out source-lineage families. On WildScores, BoB-Support raises family-mean Spearman correlation from 0.764 under uniform standardized averaging to 0.823, reduces MAE from 6.19 to 5.10 normalized score points, and increases three-model shortlist hit rate from 65.3% to 72.6%. BoB-Constant reaches a Spearman correlation of 0.831 and a hit rate of 74.6%. Separately, density weighting reduces average ranking changes when benchmarks are repeated, including as paraphrased copies. BoB-Support also reduces retrospective three-model shortlist regret from 2.08 to 1.67 normalized score points. BoB makes benchmark inclusion, redundancy, and task relevance explicit and testable measurement choices, allowing existing benchmark evidence to be used more fully while moderating the influence of benchmark proliferation.

title: PAVE: Predictive Alignment and Value-Guided Evolution for World-Action Policies
summary: Direct vision-language-action policies generate continuous robot actions efficiently, but standard behavior cloning leaves two complementary gaps: their representations are not explicitly required to describe how the scene evolves over multiple time scales, and deployment trajectories of unequal quality are often reused without separating useful dynamics from undesirable behavior. We introduce \method, a direct world-action policy that combines outcome-agnostic predictive learning with outcome-aware policy improvement. \method first retains a local fixed-offset JEPA objective and adds trajectory-relative multi-horizon transition alignment at 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% of the remaining episode. These training-only targets require the current policy representation to preserve both local physical changes and longer-range task progress, without supplying explicit future tokens to the action head. \method then trains an independent distributional value critic on cumulative deployment trajectories, computes action-chunk-aligned $N$-step advantages, and converts them into positive, negative, or null text conditions for a flow-matching actor. Thus, every valid trajectory can teach what physically happened, while the actor is deployed only under the condition associated with relatively better actions. The multi-horizon predictor and critic are removed from online execution, preserving direct action generation from the current observation, language instruction, and proprioception. \redclaim{Across the three simulation benchmarks, \method achieves the strongest overall performance while preserving the direct actor's online execution path.}

title: Mind the Gap: Theory-of-Mind-Grounded Friction for Epistemic Alignment
comments: 16 pages, 1 figure, To appear in Proceedings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Productive dialogue alignment requires distinguishing \emph{surface coordination} (acknowledgments and smooth task progression) from \emph{epistemic alignment} (convergence of belief states); standard preference-based methods typically optimize response-level preferences without explicitly modeling the latter. We operationalize Theory-of-Mind (ToM) inference as a control signal within Frictive Policy Optimization by extracting, at each referring expression, a four-part belief structure: the speaker's intended referent, the addressee's interpretation, and each participant's model of the other's belief. This makes friction mechanically computable from epistemic-state comparisons, capturing \emph{silent divergence}, where both participants proceed confidently while grounding to different referents. We evaluate the signal at two levels. At the representation level, ablating the second-order channel reduces misunderstanding recall from $65\%$ to $26\%$. At the policy level, reward-shaping (FAR) and trust-region (FTR) variants improve intervention F1 and warranted-context calibration over DPO, with Brier scores independently supporting the calibration gains. Across three training runs, FAR and FTR remain substantially more stable, whereas DPO varies widely and can degrade intervention competence already present in the base policy. Thus, ToM-grounded friction provides a trainable signal for context-sensitive intervention under referential belief divergence.

title: Comparison of Algebraic Block Multi-Coloring and Leiden Methods for Parallel Preconditioning in the ICCG Method
summary: In the application of incomplete Cholesky preconditioning to the incomplete Cholesky-conjugate gradient (ICCG) method, forward and backward substitutions exhibit sequential dependencies that constitute a major bottleneck for parallelization in multicore environments. To alleviate this bottleneck, the algebraic block multi-coloring (ABMC) method achieves both parallelism and data locality through block-wise coloring. However, ABMC requires the number of blocks to be specified as an input parameter in advance. This study evaluates the Leiden method as an alternative blocking approach for parallel preconditioning in the ICCG method. As a community detection technique that maximizes a quality function for graph partitioning, the Leiden method automatically generates blocks that reflect the matrix structure without requiring the number of blocks a priori. We partition the adjacency graphs of sparse matrices using the Leiden method and utilize the resulting blocks for parallel preconditioning. We implement the Leiden method using modularity and the constant Potts model as quality functions and compare its performance with that of the ABMC method in terms of the number of iterations, execution time, and L2 cache efficiency across eight symmetric positive definite matrices. The experimental results demonstrate that the Leiden method with the constant Potts model achieves performance comparable to that of the ABMC method configured with an optimized number of blocks.

title: Position Matters: Feature Inversion Attacks in ViT Split Inference with Token Reduction and Shuffling
comments: Accepted at the 19th ACM Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Security (AISec'26)
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are increasingly used in split-inference systems, where edge devices transmit intermediate token representations to a remote cloud. In this setting, token reduction lowers computation and communication costs, while token shuffling disrupts the spatial organization of the transmitted tokens, potentially limiting information leakage. However, their privacy benefits remain unclear against feature inversion attacks, which attempt to reconstruct the input from the transmitted embeddings. In this work, we show that, despite disrupting the spatial structure required by conventional reconstruction attacks, transmitted token embeddings retain substantial positional information. Based on this observation, we introduce the Spatially Aligned Reconstruction Attack (SARA), a unified pipeline that predicts token positions, restores their spatial layout, reconstructs missing embeddings using a feature-space masked autoencoder, and recovers the input image. Our results demonstrate that token shuffling provides only apparent privacy, as SARA largely reconstructs the original token organization. Token reduction offers stronger protection, but significant leakage persists when the retained tokens preserve sufficient semantic and positional information. Finally, we introduce a lightweight edge-side defense that removes positional embeddings and progressively adapts the edge-side transformer blocks through knowledge distillation. It substantially reduces attack performance against SARA, while preserving downstream task accuracy and requiring no changes to the cloud-side model.

title: Contact-Constrained Lower-Limb Joint-Offset Calibration for Humanoid Robots
summary: Accurate joint encoder offsets are essential for kinematic consistency in humanoid lower limbs, yet existing calibration methods typically require external motion-capture systems or fiducial targets. We present a self-contained calibration framework exploiting only onboard joint encoders and a pelvis-mounted IMU during static double-support contact. The inter-foot transform from forward kinematics must stay constant when both feet are fixed; minimizing its posture-dependent dispersion yields a nonlinear least-squares problem over the 12-dimensional offset vector. A Hessian eigenstructure analysis shows that parallel pitch axes induce a rotational coupling. Orientation residuals then observe only the pitch-offset sum, while translation and posture diversity set the remaining numerical observability. For the A3 pitch-to-roll-to-yaw ordering, hip-roll and hip-yaw excitation reduce hip-pitch coupling. A standing-posture knee prior then anchors the remaining weak pitch-chain decomposition. Simulation and real-machine injection tests show consistent recovery, and on held-out recordings calibration reduces foot-height RMS residuals from 4.26 to 2.20 mm on A3 and from 8.03 to 1.43 mm on A2. An independent LiDAR-inertial reference checks the pitch-coupled channel. Removing an injected pitch offset moves the leg-odometry vertical drift back toward the LiDAR trajectory. A few static double-support stances thus provide contact-consistent corrections for well-excited directions. Individual offsets in the weak pitch chain remain prior-dependent.

title: The Missing Temporal Link: Temporal Context Routing for Script-Driven Audio-Video Generation
summary: Joint audio-video generation models have made substantial progress in visual quality and audio-visual synchronization. However, they still provide limited control over when shot transitions occur and dialogue is spoken. This limitation constrains their application in script-driven content creation, where timing errors can undermine narrative coherence and the viewing experience. Current joint generators align video and audio representations on a shared temporal axis, yet the precise timing of shots and dialogue specified in a structured prompt is encoded only in the prompt's text representation and remains unaligned with the temporal coordinates of either modality. Consequently, video and audio may remain synchronized with each other while both fail to follow the script timeline. This mismatch motivates us to extend temporal alignment beyond video and audio to include the structured script. We therefore introduce Temporal Context Routing (TCR), which maps the script timing onto the shared temporal axis of video and audio generation and routes each prompt's guidance to the corresponding positions in both modalities. Compared with the baseline on 200 test scripts, TCR reduces Shot Boundary MAE by 96%, from 1.11 s to 0.042 s, and raises Dialogue Acc@0.5 s from 28.3% to 84.1%. TCR achieves these improvements while maintaining visual quality and audio-visual synchronization comparable to those of the baselines. A user study further shows that participants prefer TCR on all five evaluated dimensions.

AI.title_translation: 缺失的时间链接：用于剧本驱动音视频生成的时间上下文路由

title: TabScope: Question-Adaptive Scope Selection for Table Question Answering
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on table question answering, yet their accuracy often degrades as table size increases. We find that this degradation is not uniform across question types. Localization-sensitive questions are particularly affected by irrelevant table content, while questions requiring broader evidence may still benefit from full-table reasoning. Based on this observation, we propose a question-adaptive framework that dynamically selects between localized and full-table reasoning. The framework constructs question-specific sub-tables through operation-aware table decomposition and uses the predicted question type to determine the appropriate reasoning mode. We further introduce silver reference sub-tables for evaluating evidence selection and construct SLQA, a benchmark based on real-world long tables. Experiments on WikiTQ and SLQA show that localization is particularly effective for lookup and local reasoning questions, while adaptive selection between localized and full-table reasoning achieves the best overall performance. These results highlight that long-table QA requires deciding not only how to localize, but also when to localize. Our code and datasets will be made available upon publication of the paper.

AI.title_translation: TabScope：表格问答中基于问题自适应的范围选择
AI.tldr: 本文提出了TabScope框架，通过根据问题类型动态选择局部或全局表格推理，解决了大模型在处理长表格问答时性能下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 大模型在表格问答中的准确率会随着表格尺寸的增大而下降，且这种下降在不同问题类型中并不均匀（定位敏感型问题易受无关内容干扰，而需要广泛证据的问题则受益于全表推理）。
AI.method: 提出一个问题自适应框架，通过操作感知的表格分解构建问题特定的子表格，并利用预测的问题类型来决定是采用局部推理还是全局推理模式。
AI.result: 在WikiTQ和SLQA数据集上的实验表明，局部化对于查找和局部推理问题非常有效，而在局部推理和全表推理之间进行自适应选择可实现最佳的整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 长表格问答不仅需要解决如何定位的问题，更需要解决何时定位的问题。提出的TabScope框架通过问题自适应的范围选择，有效提升了大模型在长表格问答上的性能。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在表格问答中表现出强劲的性能，但其准确率往往随着表格尺寸的增大而下降。我们发现这种准确率的下降在不同问题类型中并不均匀。对定位敏感的问题特别容易受到无关表格内容的影响，而需要更广泛证据的问题仍然可以受益于全表推理。基于这一观察，我们提出了一种问题自适应框架，在局部推理和全表推理之间进行动态选择。该框架通过操作感知的表格分解构建问题特定的子表格，并利用预测的问题类型来确定合适的推理模式。我们进一步引入了用于评估证据选择的银标准参考子表格，并构建了基于真实世界长表格的基准测试SLQA。在WikiTQ和SLQA上的实验表明，局部化对于查找和局部推理问题特别有效，而在局部和全表推理之间进行自适应选择可实现最佳的整体性能。这些结果凸显出长表格问答不仅需要决定如何定位，还需要决定何时定位。我们的代码和数据集将在论文发表后公开。
AI.summary: 本文针对大模型在长表格问答中因表格增大而性能下降的问题，提出了TabScope框架。该框架根据问题类型动态选择局部推理或全表推理，通过操作感知分解表格，并在WikiTQ和SLQA数据集上验证了其优越性。
AI.keywords: Table Question Answering, Large Language Models, Scope Selection, Table Decomposition
AI.comments: 该论文切中了当前大模型处理表格问答（Table QA）时的核心痛点——随表格尺寸增大性能下降，并创新性地提出了根据问题类型自适应选择局部或全局推理的框架，具有很高的实用价值。

title: The Stochastic Target Discounted-Sum Problem
summary:
The target discounted-sum problem (TDS) asks, given a finite integer alphabet $Σ$, a rational discount factor $λ$, and a rational target $t$, whether some infinite sequence over $Σ$ has discounted sum exactly $t$. This problem remains open and underlies several open questions in automata theory, games, and Markov decision processes.
  We introduce and solve its stochastic counterpart, the stochastic target discounted-sum problem, which replaces existence by computation of the probability. We show that the probability that a random sequence generated by a finite Markov chain has discounted sum $t$ is rational and computable in pseudo-polynomial time. We further show how to decide, in polynomial time, whether the discounted-sum distribution of a Markov chain is atomless, and how to approximate to an arbitrary precision the probability that the discounted sum exceeds a rational threshold.
  Our techniques for the stochastic TDS problem allow us to make progress on TDS objectives in stochastic games, which are known to be as hard as the TDS problem. Restricting the maximizing player to finite-memory strategies, while allowing the minimizing player to use arbitrary strategies, we reduce the value problem and the synthesis problem to corresponding problems for safety objectives in stochastic games. This yields computable optimal values and deterministic optimal strategies with pseudo-polynomially bounded memory for stochastic games, and results in pseudo-polynomial-time algorithms for special cases of Markov decision processes and deterministic two-player games.

AI.title_translation: 随机目标折扣和问题
AI.tldr: 该研究解决了随机目标折扣和问题，证明了随机序列的折扣和概率是可计算的有理数，并为随机博弈和马尔可夫决策过程提供了算法。
AI.motivation: 解决目标折扣和问题（TDS）的随机对应问题，该问题在自动机理论、博弈和马尔可夫决策过程中具有重要意义。
AI.method: 引入随机目标折扣和问题，并利用计算概率的方法来解决。研究了随机序列折扣和的概率性质，并将其应用于随机博弈和马尔可夫决策过程。
AI.result: 随机序列的折扣和概率是有理数且可在伪多项式时间内计算。研究了随机博弈的价值问题和综合问题，并为马尔可夫决策过程和确定性二人博弈提供了伪多项式时间算法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为随机目标折扣和问题提供了有效的计算方法，并将其应用于解决随机博弈和马尔可夫决策过程中的相关问题，取得了理论和算法上的进展。
AI.translation:
目标折扣和问题（TDS）要求给定一个有限整数字母表$Σ$、一个有理数折扣因子$λ$和一个有理数目标$t$，判断是否存在一个无穷序列，其折扣和恰好为$t$。该问题仍未解决，并且是自动机理论、博弈和马尔可夫决策过程中若干未解决问题的基础。
我们引入并解决了其随机对应问题，即将存在性替换为概率的计算。我们证明了由有限马尔可夫链生成的随机序列的折扣和为$t$的概率是有理数，并且可以在伪多项式时间内计算。我们进一步展示了如何在多项式时间内判断马尔可夫链的折扣和分布是否是无原子的，以及如何以任意精度近似折扣和超过有理数阈值的概率。
我们用于随机TDS问题的技术使我们能够在大onnés博弈（stochastic games）中的TDS目标方面取得进展，而这些博弈已知与TDS问题一样难。将最大化玩家限制为有限记忆策略，同时允许最小化玩家使用任意策略，我们将价值问题和综合问题简化为随机博弈中相应于安全目标的问题。这产生了可计算的最优值和具有伪多项式界限记忆的确定性最优策略，并为马尔可夫决策过程的特例和确定性二人博弈产生了伪多项式时间算法。
AI.summary: 本研究解决了随机目标折扣和问题（stochastic target discounted-sum problem），证明了由马尔可夫链生成的随机序列的折扣和概率是有理数且可在伪多项式时间内计算。此外，研究还探讨了折扣和分布的无原子性判断以及概率近似问题，并将相关技术应用于随机博弈和马尔可夫决策过程，为这些领域的问题提供了伪多项式时间算法。
AI.keywords: 随机目标折扣和问题, 马尔可夫链, 概率计算, 随机博弈, 伪多项式时间算法
AI.comments: 该研究将目标折扣和问题扩展到了随机环境，并提供了有效的计算方法。其在随机博弈和马尔可夫决策过程方面的应用也具有重要的理论和实践意义。

title: VLA-Precision: Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping for Efficient Real-World Online RL of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models enable broad manipulation but remain unreliable in tasks demanding precision and repeatability. Applying real-world online reinforcement learning (RL) to VLA post-training enables autonomous trial-and-error improvement beyond demonstrations alone, but exposes two bottlenecks: 1) unreliable value signals can induce policy drift; 2) large-VLA overhead constrains throughput and sample efficiency. To address these challenges, we present VLA-Precision, an efficient real-world online RL framework featuring the Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping (ACoB) algorithm and the ACoB-Stream architecture. Specifically, ACoB establishes asymmetric co-bootstrapping across timescales: early intervention-guided behavioral learning rapidly improves policy performance while enhancing online experience quality. As autonomous experience accumulates, global return propagation and local preference ranking progressively calibrate value estimates, yielding relative action advantages for reference-regularized policy improvement while suppressing drift. To enable ACoB on large VLAs, we develop ACoB-Stream, a closed-loop experience--policy architecture that establishes invariant-state decoupling and on-demand streaming as design principles, delivering up to 10.9$\times$ improvements in throughput and computational efficiency. Extensive evaluations on nine high-precision chemistry tasks across four categories and four robot embodiments show that VLA-Precision achieves 98.3\% mean success rate in 45.8 min/task, with 27.6 s episodes running at 1.2$\times$ and 1.8$\times$ the speeds of VLA and RL baselines. Resources are available at https://vla-precision.github.io.

AI.title_translation: VLA-Precision：用于视觉-语言-动作模型高效真实世界在线强化学习的不对称共引导方法
AI.tldr: VLA-Precision通过不对称共引导算法与流式架构，解决了大尺度视觉-语言-动作模型在真实世界在线强化学习中的策略漂移与计算效率瓶颈，实现了高精度机器人操作任务的高效自主提升。
AI.motivation: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在需要高精度和可重复性的任务中仍然不够可靠，而应用真实世界在线强化学习进行后训练时，面临不可靠的价值信号导致策略漂移以及大型VLA开销限制吞吐量和样本效率两大瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出了VLA-Precision框架，包含不对称共引导（ACoB）算法（通过早期干预引导的行为学习和渐进价值校准抑制策略漂移）以及ACoB-Stream架构（基于不变状态解耦和按需流式传输原则以提升吞吐量）。
AI.result: 在九个高精度化学任务（涵盖四类及四种机器人实体）的大量评估中，VLA-Precision实现了98.3%的平均成功率，每个任务耗时45.8分钟，27.6秒的 episodes 运行速度达到VLA和RL基线速度的1.2倍和1.8倍，吞吐量和计算效率提升高达10.9倍。
AI.conclusion: VLA-Precision框架通过不对称共引导算法和流式架构，有效解决了VLA模型在真实世界在线强化学习中的策略漂移与计算效率瓶颈，在多项高精度化学任务中取得了极高的成功率与运行效率。
AI.translation: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型支持广泛的操作，但在需要精度和可重复性的任务中仍然不可靠。将真实世界在线强化学习（RL）应用于VLA后训练，可以实现超越单纯示范的自主试错改进，但暴露了两个瓶颈：1）不可靠的价值信号会导致策略漂移；2）大VLA开销限制了吞吐量和样本效率。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了VLA-Precision，这是一个高效的真实世界在线强化学习框架，具有不对称共引导（ACoB）算法和ACoB-Stream架构。具体而言，ACoB在时间尺度上建立不对称共引导：早期干预引导的行为学习迅速提高策略性能，同时提升在线体验质量。随着自主体验的积累，全局回报传播和局部偏好排序逐步校准价值估计，为正则化策略改进产生相对动作优势，同时抑制漂移。为了在大规模VLA上启用ACoB，我们开发了ACoB-Stream，这是一种闭环体验-策略架构，将不变状态解耦和按需流式传输作为设计原则，实现了高达10.9倍的吞吐量和计算效率提升。对四种机器人形态的四类九项高精度化学任务的大量评估表明，VLA-Precision在45.8分钟/任务内实现了98.3%的平均成功率，27.6秒的episodes运行速度达到了VLA和RL基线速度的1.2倍和1.8倍。相关资源可通过 https://vla-precision.github.io 获取。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了VLA-Precision，一个用于视觉-语言-动作模型的高效真实世界在线强化学习框架，通过不对称共引导算法和ACoB-Stream架构，解决了策略漂移和计算效率低下的问题，在多类高精度机器人任务中实现了卓越的性能与效率。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作模型, 在线强化学习, 机器人操作, 不对称共引导
AI.comments: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在需要高精度和可重复性任务中的不可靠性，提出了VLA-Precision框架。其创新点在于采用不对称共引导（ACoB）算法解决策略漂移与价值信号不可靠问题，并通过ACoB-Stream架构大幅提升了吞吐量和计算效率，为大模型在真实世界在线强化学习中的应用提供了高效的解决方案。

title: Near-Field Physical-Layer Authentication Under Impersonation Attacks
summary: This paper studies physical-layer authentication (PLA) in the near-field regime under impersonation attacks. Unlike the far-field case, where the steering vector depends only on the angle of arrival (AoA), in the near field it depends on both angle and distance. We analyze the attack by minimizing the mean-square error (MSE) between the signal received from a legitimate transmitter Alice and the signal generated by an active attacker Eve. For a single-antenna Eve, we derive the optimal scalar precoder and show that, for an inter-element spacing no larger than half a wavelength and under the standard second-order Fresnel approximation, perfect impersonation is possible only if Eve has the same angle and the same distance from Bob as Alice. We then extend the analysis to a multi-antenna Eve and derive the optimal precoding vector. In this case, perfect impersonation is possible only if Alice steering vector belongs to the subspace spanned by Eve steering vectors. Simulation results show that, in the near field, a distance difference is sufficient to prevent a successful impersonation attack even when Alice and Eve have the same AoA, and confirm the analytical results.

AI.title_translation: 近场模型下的物理层认证对抗模拟攻击
AI.tldr: 近场通信中，即使角度相同，距离差也足以防御模拟攻击。多天线攻击者需要其信道向量在攻击者信道向量构成的子空间内才能完美模拟。
AI.motivation: 研究近场模型下的物理层认证对抗模拟攻击，并分析模拟攻击的条件。
AI.method: 通过最小化合法信号与模拟信号之间的均方误差来分析模拟攻击。推导了单天线和多天线模拟攻击者的最优预编码器。
AI.result: 单天线模拟者，在特定条件下，只有当模拟者的角度和距离与合法发送者相同时，才能完美模拟。多天线模拟者，只有当合法发送者的信道向量在模拟者信道向量构成的子空间内时，才能完美模拟。仿真结果表明，近场模型下，即使角度相同，距离差也足以防御模拟攻击。
AI.conclusion: 近场模型下的物理层认证能够有效防御模拟攻击，即使在角度相同的情况下，距离差也足以阻止成功的模拟。多天线攻击者需要满足更严格的条件才能实现完美模拟。
AI.translation: 本文研究了近场模型下的物理层认证（PLA）在模拟攻击下的情况。与远场情况不同，远场情况下的导向矢量仅取决于到达角（AoA），而在近场情况下，它同时取决于角度和距离。我们通过最小化合法发射机Alice接收到的信号与主动模拟攻击者Eve生成的信号之间的均方误差（MSE）来分析模拟攻击。对于单天线Eve，我们推导出了最优标量预编码器，并证明在元间距不大于半个波长且在标准二阶菲涅尔近似下，只有当Eve与Bob的角度和距离都与Alice相同时，才可能实现完美模拟。然后，我们将分析扩展到多天线Eve，并推导出了最优预编码向量。在这种情况下，只有当Alice的导向矢量属于Eve导向矢量张成的子空间时，才可能实现完美模拟。仿真结果表明，在近场情况下，即使Alice和Eve具有相同的AoA，距离差也足以阻止成功的模拟攻击，并证实了分析结果。
AI.summary: 本文研究了近场通信中的物理层认证（PLA）对抗模拟攻击。与远场不同，近场认证不仅考虑到达角（AoA），还考虑距离。研究表明，在单天线攻击下，若元间距小于半波长且满足二阶菲涅尔近似，仅当攻击者与合法通信者在角度和距离上都重合时，才能完美模拟。对于多天线攻击者，若其信道向量能够张成包含合法通信者信道向量的子空间，则可实现完美模拟。仿真证实，近场通信中的距离差异足以有效防御模拟攻击，即使在攻击者与合法通信者具有相同到达角的情况下。
AI.keywords: 近场认证, 物理层安全, 模拟攻击, 导向矢量, 均方误差
AI.comments: 该研究为近场通信安全提供了重要的理论基础和实践指导。通过分析不同攻击场景下的认证可行性，为设计更安全的近场通信系统提供了参考。未来的工作可以进一步探讨在更复杂的信道模型和攻击模型下的认证方案。

title: Dynamic Lagging using Stable-Prefix Training for Simultaneous Translation
summary:
In streaming simultaneous speech translation, the speech translation system is trained to learn a read-write policy that alternates between consuming source words and generating target ones.
  In a cascaded setting, the output from the speech recognizer is passed to a separate machine translation component, making it more difficult to learn such a policy.
  Approximations such as fixed wait-k strategies or target-suffix deletion can be employed, but these approaches do not provide the model with a streaming system's flexibility to make contextual read-write decisions.
  This paper presents a training strategy for a cascaded machine translation system that enables it to dynamically decide how much of the growing source prefix to translate.
  We achieve this by fine-tuning a large language model (Qwen3-8B) on stable prefixes of the training data, which are produced by pairing every source sentence prefix in the training data with the longest translation of that prefix that is shared with the full source sentence translation.
  We fine-tune variants of the model on different subsets of the prefixes and compare against wait-k and target-suffix deletion.
  We also investigate the effect of fine-tuning the target-token generation confidence.
  Our experiments show that stable prefixes improve the quality-latency tradeoff when translating from English into German, Japanese, and Chinese across a range of test sets.

AI.title_translation: 基于稳定前缀训练的动态滞后同声传译方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于稳定前缀训练的大模型微调方法，实现了同声传译中的动态滞后策略，显著优化了翻译质量与延迟的权衡。
AI.motivation: 在级联式同传中，传统的固定 wait-k 策略或目标后缀删除策略缺乏动态决策的灵活性，因此需要一种能让系统根据不断增长的源前缀动态决定翻译时机的训练策略。
AI.method: 通过在稳定前缀（由源句子前缀与全句翻译共享的最长翻译配对生成）上微调大语言模型（Qwen3-8B），并研究目标词生成置信度的微调效果。
AI.result: 实验表明，在将英语翻译为德语、日语和中文的各项测试集中，稳定前缀方法均改善了质量与延迟的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 基于稳定前缀训练的动态滞后策略能够有效提升级联式同传系统的质量-延迟权衡表现，且适用于多种目标语言的翻译任务。
AI.translation: 在流式同声语音翻译中，语音翻译系统被训练来学习一种读写策略，该策略在消费源语言词汇和生成目标语言词汇之间交替进行。在级联设置中，语音识别器的输出被传递给独立的机器翻译组件，这使得学习这种策略变得更加困难。诸如固定 wait-k 策略或目标后缀 deletion 等近似方法可以被采用，但这些方法没有赋予模型流式系统根据上下文做出读写决策的灵活性。本文提出了一种针对级联机器翻译系统的训练策略，使其能够动态决定翻译多少不断增长的源前缀。我们通过在训练数据的稳定前缀上微调一个大型语言模型（Qwen3-8B）来实现这一点，稳定前缀是通过将训练数据中的每个源句子前缀与该前缀与完整源句子翻译共享的最长翻译配对产生的。我们在不同的前缀子集上微调了模型的变体，并与 wait-k 和目标后缀删除进行了比较。我们还研究了微调目标词生成置信度的效果。我们的实验表明，稳定前缀在将英语翻译成德语、日语和中文的一系列测试集时，改善了质量与延迟的权衡。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种针对级联式同传系统的稳定前缀训练策略。通过微调大模型（Qwen3-8B）学习源前缀与最长共享翻译的对应关系，使系统能够动态进行读写决策，并在英德、英日、英中翻译任务中取得了优于传统策略的质量-延迟权衡。
AI.keywords: 同传翻译, 级联系统, 稳定前缀, 大语言模型, 动态滞后
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于稳定前缀（stable-prefix）训练的动态滞后（Dynamic Lagging）方法，用于级联式同传系统。通过微调大语言模型（Qwen3-8B），该方法在不依赖固定wait-k或目标后缀删除策略的情况下，显著提升了同传系统在质量与延迟之间的权衡能力。

title: A Ticket from Marginals to Joints: Coupled-Noise Distillation for One-Step Block Generation in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) predict all tokens of a block in parallel, but a single forward pass samples each position from its own marginal distribution, so the tokens need not form a coherent block. We ask whether a discrete masked model can commit an entire block in one pass when its mask embeddings are perturbed by a sampled Gaussian noise field: the same noise should give the same coherent continuation, and different noise should give different ones. We propose CONDOR (Coupled-Noise Distillation for One-Step Readout), which trains such a model from scratch without a target-side encoder or an autoregressive teacher. Training combines two signals. On real text, the model predicts masked tokens under several noise samples and is supervised only through the sample that fits the ground truth best, so different noise can specialize to different continuations. For the remaining samples, the model refines its own one-pass prediction over several decoding steps under the same fixed noise and then distills that refined block back into a single pass. On a controlled TinyStories setting, this recipe yields coherent one-pass continuations that vary with the noise, both for a single block and, with a block-causal variant, when blocks are generated one after another.

AI.title_translation: 从边缘分布到联合分布的票证：扩散语言模型中用于一步块生成的耦合噪声蒸馏
AI.tldr: 提出了CONDOR方法，通过耦合噪声蒸馏解决了扩散语言模型单步生成文本块不连贯的问题，实现了高效且多样化的单步文本生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在单次前向传播中并行预测块内所有token时，各位置是从各自的边缘分布中独立采样的，导致生成的token无法构成连贯的文本块。因此，需要研究如何使离散掩码模型在单次前向传播中提交整个连贯的文本块。
AI.method: 提出CONDOR（Coupled-Noise Distillation for One-Step Readout）方法，通过向掩码嵌入中注入高斯噪声场，结合真实文本的最优噪声监督以及自我细化预测的单步蒸馏机制，从头训练模型。
AI.result: 在受控的TinyStories实验设置中，该方法能够根据噪声的变化产生连贯的、且随噪声变化的单步文本续写，无论是单个块还是采用块因果变体连续生成的块都表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 通过CONDOR方法，扩散语言模型能够在单个前向传播中生成多样且连贯的文本块，极大地提升了单步生成的质量和效率。
AI.translation: 扩散语言模型（dLLMs）可以并行预测一个块的所有token，但单个前向传递是从其自身的边缘分布中对每个位置进行采样的，因此这些token不一定能形成一个连贯的块。我们探讨了当离散掩码模型的掩码嵌入受到采样的随机高斯噪声场扰动时，它是否可以在一次传递中提交整个块：相同的噪声应该产生相同的连贯续写，不同的噪声应该产生不同的续写。我们提出了CONDOR（用于一步读出的耦合噪声蒸馏），该方法从头训练这样一个模型，而无需目标侧编码器或自回归教师模型。训练结合了两个信号。在真实文本上，模型在多个噪声样本下预测被掩码的token，并且仅通过最符合真实情况的样本进行监督，因此不同的噪声可以专门用于不同的续写。对于其余样本，模型在相同的固定噪声下经过多个解码步骤优化其自身的一步预测，然后将该优化后的块蒸馏回单步传递中。在一个受控的TinyStories实验设置中，这种方法产生了随噪声变化的连贯的一步续写，无论是对于单个块，还是在使用块因果变体逐块生成时均是如此。
AI.summary: 该论文针对扩散语言模型单步块生成缺乏连贯性的问题，提出了CONDOR方法。该方法通过耦合噪声蒸馏，使模型在注入高斯噪声的情况下，既能通过真实文本的最优噪声监督实现多样化续写，又能通过自我细化预测蒸馏出高质量的单步生成能力。
AI.keywords: 扩散语言模型, 单步生成, 噪声蒸馏, 文本块生成, 语言模型优化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的耦合噪声蒸馏方法（CONDOR），解决了扩散语言模型在单步生成时缺乏块内连贯性的问题。其创新之处在于不需要自回归教师模型，而是通过多噪声采样、最优拟合监督以及自蒸馏来实现单步高质量块生成。

title: Expressive power of one-shot control operators and coroutines
comments: 82 pages, 17 figures. Extended version of a paper presented at APLAS 2025 (LNCS 16201, pp. 88-106, https://doi.org/10.1007/978-981-95-3585-9_5, full version: arXiv:2509.11901)
summary: Control operators, such as exceptions and effect handlers, provide a means of representing computational effects in programs abstractly and modularly. While most theoretical studies have focused on multi-shot control operators, one-shot control operators---which restrict the use of captured continuations to at most once---are gaining attention for their balance between expressiveness and efficiency. This study aims to fill the gap. We present a mathematically rigorous comparison of the expressive power among one-shot control operators, including effect handlers, delimited continuations, and even asymmetric coroutines. Following previous studies on multi-shot control operators, we adopt Felleisen's macro-expressiveness as our measure of expressiveness. We verify the folklore that one-shot effect handlers and one-shot delimited-control operators can be macro-expressed by asymmetric coroutines, but not vice versa. We explain why a previous informal argument fails, and how to revise it to make a valid macro-translation.
comment: 82 pages, 17 figures. Extended version of a paper presented at APLAS 2025 (LNCS 16201, pp. 88-106, https://doi.org/10.1007/978-981-95-3585-9_5, full version: arXiv:2509.11901)

AI.title_translation: 单次控制操作符与协程的表达力
AI.tldr: 通过宏表达能力分析，证明了非对称协程比单次控制操作符（如效果处理器和定界连续性）具有更强的表达力。
AI.motivation: 尽管单次控制操作符因在表达力和效率之间取得良好平衡而受到关注，但此前缺乏对其表达力的严格数学比较，且先前关于协程与控制操作符关系的非正式论证存在瑕疵，因此本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用Felleisen的宏表达能力（macro-expressiveness）作为度量标准，对单次效果处理器、定界连续操作符和非对称协程进行数学严谨的比较。
AI.result: 验证了单次效果处理器和单次定界控制操作符可以被非对称协程宏表达，但反之则不能，同时指出了先前非正式论证失败的原因并给出了修正方案。
AI.conclusion: 单次控制操作符可以被非对称协程宏表达，但反之不然，这确立了非对称协程在单次控制机制中更强的表达能力。
AI.translation: 控制操作符（如异常和效果处理器）提供了一种抽象且模块化表示程序中计算效果的方法。虽然大多数理论研究集中于多次控制操作符，但由于单次控制操作符（将捕获的续延限制至多使用一次）在表达力和效率之间取得了良好平衡，因而正受到越来越多的关注。本研究旨在填补这一空白。我们对单次控制操作符（包括效果处理器、定界连续性甚至非对称协程）之间的表达力进行了数学严谨的比较。遵循以往对多次控制操作符的研究，我们采用Felleisen的宏表达能力作为表达力的度量标准。我们验证了单次效果处理器和单次定界控制操作符可以被非对称协程宏表达，但反之则不然的民间传说（folklore）。我们解释了先前非对称论证失败的原因，以及如何对其进行修正以实现有效的宏转换。
AI.summary: 该论文运用Felleisen的宏表达能力理论，对单次控制操作符（如效果处理器和定界连续性）与非对称协程的表达力进行了严谨的数学比较，证明了协程能够宏表达单次控制操作符，而反之则不成立。
AI.keywords: 控制操作符, 协程, 效果处理器, 宏表达能力, 定界连续性
AI.comments: 该论文通过Felleisen的宏表达能力理论，对单次控制操作符和协程的表达力进行了严格的数学比较，纠正了以往非正式论证的错误，具有较高的理论价值。

title: ForgeStencil: Automating Per-Case Stencil Specialization from Kernels to 100+ Real Applications
summary: Industrial and scientific computing rests on a few core kernels, and the stencil is among the most widely used: weather and climate models, seismic imaging, fluid dynamics, and image processing all run on it. No single stencil implementation is fastest: the optimal kernel changes qualitatively with stencil shape, grid shape, precision, and host application. For two decades the field has answered with general methods (DSLs, code generators, autotuners), because specialized solutions were too expensive to build per case, so all reuse one human-authored recipe. That reuse costs performance; we call the cost the generality tax. This premise no longer holds: code-synthesis agents now build a correct, specialized solution per case at acceptable cost. ForgeStencil automates this. A Kernel Agent synthesizes CUDA and forges a per-configuration map of specialized operators, removing the tax case by case. On an A100 the map beats the strongest public baseline in 37 of 37 cases: geometric mean 2.35x against same-precision f32 baselines and 1.95x for fp16, each reported under its own precision. The same change reaches end-to-end application performance. A generic operator library is tuned once for its own general case and reused across applications, so its shapes, layouts, and launch boundaries are optimal for none of them: using it is the application-level form of the tax. An App Agent instead forges a specialized solution per application, locating hotspots, rewriting application structure, and validating and integrating each change. Across 100 real industrial and scientific codes the end-to-end median speedup is 1.41x against each application's own GPU baseline. To our knowledge this is the first demonstration that per-case synthesis carries from a kernel library to complete applications at this breadth, and evidence that reuse is no longer the default in a domain built on it for two decades.

AI.title_translation: ForgeStencil：从内核到 100+ 真实应用自动化实现逐案模板特化
AI.tldr: 利用代码合成智能体针对不同模板内核与 100 多个真实应用进行自动化逐案特化，大幅超越了传统通用方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 由于不同网格形状、精度和宿主应用下最优的模板内核各不相同，传统方法被迫使用单一的人工编写通用配方（导致性能损失，称为“通用性税收”）。随着代码合成智能体的发展，按需构建特化解决方案的成本已可接受，因此需要自动化这一过程。
AI.method: 提出了 ForgeStencil，包含两个核心智能体：Kernel Agent 用于合成 CUDA 并为每个配置生成特化算子映射；App Agent 用于定位热点、重写应用结构、验证并整合变更，实现跨 100 多个真实应用的端到端特化。
AI.result: 在 A100 上，Kernel Agent 的特化映射在 37 个测试用例中全部击败最强公开基线（f32 平均加速 2.35 倍，fp16 平均加速 1.95 倍）；在 100 个真实工科代码中，App Agent 实现了端到端的中位数 1.41 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: ForgeStencil 证明了利用代码合成智能体实现逐案模板特化是可行的，能够在内核和完整应用层面全面超越传统的通用基线，彻底改变了依赖人工通用配方的传统模式。
AI.translation: 工业和科学计算依赖于少数核心内核，其中模板（stencil）是最广泛使用的内核之一：天气和气候模型、地震成像、流体动力学和图像处理都运行在其之上。没有单一的模板实现是最快的：最优内核会随模板形状、网格形状、精度和宿主应用而发生性质上的改变。二十年来，该领域一直用通用方法（DSLs、代码生成器、自动调优器）来回答这个问题，因为针对每个案例构建专门的解决方案成本太高，因此所有案例都重复使用一个人工编写的配方。这种重复使用会牺牲性能；我们将这种代价称为通用性税收（generativity tax）。这一前提已不再成立：代码-合成智能体现在能够以可接受的成本为每个案例构建正确且专门的解决方案。ForgeStencil 实现了这一自动化。Kernel Agent 综合生成 CUDA 并构建每个配置的专门算子映射，逐案消除税收。在 A100 上，该映射在 37 个案例中的 37 个案例中均击败了最强的公共基线：同精度 f32 基线的几何平均加速为 2.35 倍，fp16 为 1.95 倍，均在各自精度下报告。同样的变革也延伸到了端到端的应用性能。通用的算子库为其自身的通用情况调优一次，并在各个应用中重复使用，因此其形状、布局和启动边界对任何一个应用都不是最优的：使用它就是应用级别的税收形式。相反，App Agent 为每个应用程序构建一个专门的解决方案，定位热点、重写应用程序结构，并验证和集成每个更改。在 100 个真实的工业和科学代码中，针对每个应用程序自身的 GPU 基线，端到端的中位加速比为 1.41 倍。据我们所知，这是首次证明逐案合成能够以这种广度从内核库推广到完整应用，也是证明在以此为基础构建了二十年的领域中，代码复用不再是默认选择的证据。
AI.summary: ForgeStencil 引入了一种基于代码合成智能体的自动化方法，通过 Kernel Agent 和 App Agent 分别针对模板内核和 100 多个真实应用进行逐案特化，成功去除了传统通用方法的“通用性税收”，实现了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: Stencil Specialization, Code-Synthesis Agents, GPU Acceleration, Domain-Specific Computing, Automated Optimization
AI.comments: 该论文展示了利用代码合成智能体消除科学计算中“通用性税收”（generative tax）的创新路径，突破了传统领域长达二十年依赖通用代码生成器和自动调优器的局限，首次在大规模真实应用中证明了逐案定制化合成的高效性与可行性。

title: A visual large language foundational model for medical image recognition using clinician-contributed online resources
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across diverse domains, showing considerable potential in medicine. However, their application in medical settings remains limited by the scarcity of visual question answering (VQA) datasets that capture clinical reasoning and explicit image-text alignment. Here, we leverage de-identified medical images and expert commentaries shared through clinician-oriented online resources. By combining an advanced LLM with clinician-in-the-loop verification, we established a rigorous pipeline to construct ThoughtMed-1M, a long-form medical VQA dataset containing over one million VQA pairs and designed to capture structured clinical reasoning and medical image-text alignment. To demonstrate its utility, we developed a FOundational LLM Trained on ThoughtMed-1M (FOLTMed). FOLTMed achieved state-of-the-art performance across 42 medical VQA benchmark datasets, with a macro accuracy of 85.4 percent. It also generated more clinically coherent responses on the ThoughtMed-1M test set, outperforming state-of-the-art models by 3 to 5 percent across factuality and similarity metrics, highlighting a scalable paradigm for advancing research on clinically grounded multimodal LLMs.

AI.title_translation: 使用临床医生贡献的在线资源构建用于医学图像识别的视觉大语言基础模型
AI.tldr: 论文通过利用临床在线资源构建了百万级医疗VQA数据集ThoughtMed-1M，并训练了表现优异的基础大模型FOLTMed。
AI.motivation: 目前大语言模型在医疗领域的应用受限于缺乏能够捕获临床推理和显式图像-文本对齐的视觉问答（VQA）数据集。
AI.method: 结合先进的大语言模型与临床医生在环验证，建立严格的流水线构建ThoughtMed-1M数据集，并基于此训练了基础大模型FOLTMed。
AI.result: FOLTMed在42个医疗VQA基准数据集上取得了85.4%的宏平均准确率的SOTA性能，并在事实性和相似性指标上超越现有SOTA模型3%至5%。
AI.conclusion: 利用临床在线资源构建大规模、高质量的医疗VQA数据集和基础大模型是可行且高效的，FOLTMed展现了卓越的临床推理能力和广阔的应用前景。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）在多个领域展现出强大的能力，在医学领域也显示出巨大的潜力。然而，它们在医疗场景中的应用仍然受到缺乏视觉问答（VQA）数据集的限制，这些数据集需能够捕捉临床推理和显式的图像-文本对齐。在此，我们利用通过面向临床医生的在线资源共享的去标识化医学图像和专家评论。通过将先进的LLM与临床医生参与的验证相结合，我们建立了一个严谨的流水线来构建ThoughtMed-1M，这是一个包含超过一百万个VQA对的长文本医疗VQA数据集，旨在捕捉结构化的临床推理和医学图像-文本对齐。为了证明其效用，我们开发了基于ThoughtMed-1M训练的基础LLM（FOLTMed）。FOLTMed在42个医疗VQA基准数据集上实现了最先进的性能，宏准确率达到85.4%。它还在ThoughtMed-1M测试集上生成了更具临床连贯性的响应，在事实性和相似性指标上比现有最先进模型高出3%到5%，突显了推进临床扎实的多模态LLM研究的可扩展范式。
AI.summary: 论文开发了一个名为ThoughtMed-1M的包含超百万对数据的长文本医疗视觉问答数据集，该数据集基于临床医生在线资源构建并经专家验证。基于此训练的基础大模型FOLTMed在各项医疗VQA基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 医疗大语言模型, 视觉问答, 临床推理, 图像-文本对齐, 基础模型
AI.comments: 该论文通过利用临床医生贡献的在线资源，构建了一个大规模、高质量的长文本医疗视觉问答数据集ThoughtMed-1M，并训练了开源基础大模型FOLTMed，在多项基准测试中取得了SOTA性能，为医疗多模态大模型的发展提供了一个可扩展的新范式。

title: Adaptive Complementarity in Human-AI Systems: Architecture as a State-Shaping Choice
summary: Human-AI interaction can improve current performance while changing the capabilities and relationships on which future performance depends. We develop adaptive complementarity, a framework for choosing interaction architecture with these state consequences in view. Access, information exposure, task allocation, timing, and communication can alter which arrangement will be valuable later; their settings can often be reset faster than the capabilities, search patterns, or conventions they create. Three mechanisms organize the argument: information exposure and collective search, delegation and capability evolution, and strategic interdependence and information governance. Their integration yields cross-mechanism implications, including conditions under which a loss of expertise heterogeneity increases the information differentiation required to preserve independent search. We distinguish strong human-AI complementarity from advantage over another workflow and from advantage over an evolving reference policy. A computational illustration examines scarce human review in a workflow whose success requires several specialized stages. Review develops human expertise and AI capabilities, changing where subsequent review is most valuable. Adaptive allocation improves net output over untailored procedures and the optimal predetermined calendar. An understandable priority rule derived from the adaptive solution retains essentially all of its gain: the procedure stays fixed while assignments respond to the capabilities that interaction creates. The framework directs evaluation toward the states present interaction creates, their consequences for later architectural fit, and the conditions under which observing and responding to them is worthwhile.

AI.title_translation: 人机系统中的适应性互补：作为状态塑造选择的架构
AI.tldr: 论文提出“适应性互补”框架，强调人机交互架构不仅影响当前表现，还会塑造未来性能所需的能力和状态，动态调整机制能够显著提升长期协同效率。
AI.motivation: 现有人机交互研究多关注即时性能提升，忽视了当前交互会改变未来性能所依赖的能力和关系这一动态状态后果。
AI.method: 开发了一个名为适应性互补的理论框架，通过三个核心机制进行论证，并利用计算实例考察了稀缺人工审核在多阶段工作流中的应用。
AI.result: 计算实例表明，适应性任务分配能够提高未加调整的程序及最优预定日历下的净产出，且从适应性方案中推导出的可理解优先级规则能够保留绝大部分收益。
AI.conclusion: 适应性互补框架能够有效指导人机交互架构的选择与评估，通过关注当前交互对未来状态的塑造作用，实现长期净产出的最大化。
AI.translation: 人机交互可以改善当前性能，同时改变未来性能所依赖的能力和关系。我们开发了适应性互补框架，用于在考虑这些状态后果的情况下选择交互架构。访问权限、信息暴露、任务分配、时机和沟通可以改变未来何种安排更有价值；它们的设置通常比它们所创造的能力、搜索模式或惯例更新得更快。三个机制组织了这一论点：信息暴露与集体搜索、委托与能力演化、战略相互依赖与信息治理。它们的整合产生了跨机制的影响，包括专业知识异质性丧失会增加保持独立搜索所需的信息分化条件的结论。我们将强人机互补性与相对于另一种工作流的优势以及相对于不断演化的参考策略的优势进行了区分。一个计算实例考察了在成功需要几个专门阶段的工作流中稀缺的人工审查。审查培养了人类的专家知识和人工智能的能力，从而改变了后续审查最有价值的地方。适应性分配提高了未量身定制的程序和最优预定日历之上的净产出。从适应性解决方案中得出的可理解的优先级规则保留了其几乎所有的收益：程序保持固定，而分配则响应交互所创造的能力。该框架将评估引导至当前交互所创造的状态、它们对未来架构契合度的影响，以及观察和响应这些状态的条件值得进行的场景。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了“适应性互补”框架，用于研究人机交互架构选择中的状态塑造后果。通过信息暴露、任务委托和战略相互依赖三个机制，结合计算实例展示了动态调整人机交互分配方案如何能够显著改善长期净产出。
AI.keywords: 人机交互, 适应性互补, 架构设计, 状态塑造, 演化博弈
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将动态系统视角引入人机交互架构设计中，强调当前交互对未来能力、搜索模式及惯例的状态塑造作用，对于理解长期人机协同演化具有重要理论和实践意义。

title: Staying on the Attack Path: Structured State for Long-Horizon Automated Penetration Testing
summary: Large language model (LLM) based agents are increasingly applied to cybersecurity tasks such as vulnerability discovery and automated penetration testing. On long-horizon security tasks, however, such agents remain limited by context forgetting and intent drift: early critical facts and causal reasoning chains are lost over extended interactions, and the agent falls into aimless, repetitive exploration. This paper proposes Intentest, an intent-graph-guided automated penetration testing agent that externalizes long-horizon state from the LLM's context window onto a persistent fact-intent directed acyclic graph (DAG), thereby substantially reducing invalid transitions. We evaluate Intentest on automated penetration testing of web applications, a representative long-tail task in cybersecurity. In the DAG, verified network states are stored as immutable fact nodes, and exploration directions are constrained as intent edges bounded by predecessor facts. The system adopts a three-layer architecture, in which the fact-intent mapping layer maintains the global state, the task scheduling and allocation layer ensures execution stability through two-phase degradation recovery and multi-dimensional adaptive load balancing, and the intent retrieval and prediction layer provides tactical priors through a top-down five-stage filtering algorithm. On a benchmark of real CTF challenges covering more than ten vulnerability types across three difficulty levels, Intentest achieves an overall success rate of 88.2% and a success rate of 75.0% on hard tasks, improving over the baseline by approximately 44 and 50 percentage points. Ablation experiments further show that the intent retrieval and prediction reduce the average number of rounds on successful medium and hard tasks by about 33% and 48%, respectively, without changing the set of solvable tasks.

AI.title_translation: 保持攻击路径：用于长视界自动化渗透测试的结构化状态
AI.tldr: 本文提出了Intentest，一种利用事实-意图DAG来解决大模型在自动化渗透测试中上下文遗忘和意图漂移问题的代理，大幅提升了长期安全任务的成功率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型驱动的代理在处理长期网络安全任务时，常常受限于上下文遗忘和意图漂移，导致早期关键事实和因果推理链丢失，从而陷入盲目、重复的探索。
AI.method: 提出Intentest代理，采用三层架构（包含事实-意图映射层、任务调度与分配层、意图检索与预测层），利用持久化的事实-意图有向无环图（DAG）外化长期状态，约束探索方向。
AI.result: 在真实CTF挑战基准测试中，Intentest取得了88.2%的总体成功率和75.0%的困难任务成功率，比基线分别提升了约44和50个百分点；消融实验表明意图检索与预测显著减少了中高难度任务的平均交互轮次。
AI.conclusion: Intentest通过结构化状态管理和三层架构设计，有效解决了长期自动化渗透测试中的上下文遗忘与意图漂移问题，在真实CTF挑战基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的代理越来越多地被应用于漏洞发现和自动化渗透测试等网络安全任务中。然而，在长视界安全任务中，这类代理仍然受到上下文遗忘和意图漂移的限制：早期关键事实和因果推理链在扩展的交互过程中丢失，导致代理陷入漫无目的、重复的探索。本文提出了Intentest，这是一种由意图图引导的自动化渗透测试代理，它将长期状态从LLM的上下文窗口外化到一个持久的事实-意图有向无环图（DAG）上，从而大幅减少了无效转换。我们在Web应用程序的自动化渗透测试（网络安全中具有代表性的长尾任务）上评估了Intentest。在DAG中，已验证的网络状态被存储为不可变的事实节点，探索方向则被约束为由前置事实界定的意图边。系统采用三层架构：事实-意图映射层维护全局状态，任务调度与分配层通过两阶段降级恢复和多维自适应负载均衡确保执行稳定性，意图检索与预测层通过自顶向下的五阶段过滤算法提供战术先验。在涵盖三个难度级别十多种漏洞类型的真实CTF挑战基准测试中，Intentest实现了88.2%的总体成功率和75.0%的困难任务成功率，比基线分别提高了约44个和50个百分点。消融实验进一步表明，在不改变可解任务集合的情况下，意图检索和预测使成功的中等和困难任务的平均轮次分别减少了约33%和48%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Intentest，一个基于意图图引导的自动化渗透测试代理。它通过将长期状态外化为持久化的事实-意图有向无环图（DAG），并结合三层架构，成功解决了大模型在长期安全任务中的上下文遗忘与意图漂移问题，大幅提升了渗透测试的成功率和效率。
AI.keywords: 自动化渗透测试, 大语言模型, 意图图, 长期任务, 漏洞挖掘
AI.comments: 该论文针对大模型在长期网络安全任务中常见的上下文遗忘和意图漂移问题，创新性地提出了基于事实-意图有向无环图（DAG）的Intentest代理，显著提升了自动化渗透测试的成功率和效率。具有很高的实用价值和学术启发性。

title: Fine PT-PT Web: A High-Quality 41 Billion Tokens Data Collection of the European Portuguese Web
summary: Curating Web corpora for regional language variants like European Portuguese (PT-PT) is heavily bottlenecked by dialectal overlap (mainly with PT-BR) and data processing scale. This paper presents an efficient pipeline to curate a production-ready PT-PT corpus from the Portuguese Web, spanning 411 TB of raw data from Arquivo.pt. We introduce a novel post-scraping block that removes boilerplate and line duplicates prior to filtering. This early-stage intervention increases final document yield by 19.04% by rescuing valid text that standard heuristic filters prematurely discard. Integrated with rigorous language identification, weighted fuzzy deduplication, and neural quality classification, our pipeline offers a scalable framework and a clean, representative corpus optimized for LLM pre-training.

AI.title_translation: Fine PT-PT Web：一个包含410亿Token的欧洲葡萄牙语网络高质量数据集合
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的数据处理管道，并构建了包含410亿Token的高质量欧洲葡萄牙语（PT-PT）网络语料库，有效解决了方言重叠和文本丢失问题。
AI.motivation: 为区域语言变体（如欧洲葡萄牙语PT-PT）构建网络语料库时，面临着方言重叠（主要是与PT-BR重叠）和数据处理规模的严重瓶颈，现有的标准启发式过滤器常过早丢弃有效文本。
AI.method: 提出了一套高效的语料处理管道，包含一个新颖的抓取后处理模块（在过滤前移除样板文件和行级重复）、严格的语言识别、加权模糊去重以及神经质量分类。
AI.result: 从Arquivo.pt的411 TB原始数据中成功清洗并构建了包含410亿Token的高质量PT-PT语料库，早期干预阶段使最终文档产出率提升了19.04%。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的高效数据清洗管道和高质410亿Token数据集（Fine PT-PT Web），为欧洲葡萄牙语大语言模型的预训练奠定了坚实的基础，并为其他区域语言的数据收集提供了可扩展的框架。
AI.translation: 为欧洲葡萄牙语（PT-PT）等区域语言变体策划网络语料库，主要受到方言重叠（主要是与PT-BR）和数据处理规模的瓶颈制约。本文提出了一种高效的管道，用于从葡萄牙网络（Arquivo.pt的411 TB原始数据）中策划生产就绪的PT-PT语料库。我们引入了一种新颖的抓取后处理块，在过滤之前去除样板文件和行重复。这种早期干预通过挽救标准启发式过滤器过早丢弃的有效文本，使最终文档产出率提高了19.04%。结合严格的语言识别、加权模糊去重和神经质量分类，我们的管道为大模型预训练提供了一个可扩展的框架和一个干净、具有代表性的语料库。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Fine PT-PT Web，这是一个包含410亿Token的高质量欧洲葡萄牙语网络语料库。作者开发了一个高效的管道，通过引入前置的样板文件和重复行移除模块，有效解决了方言重叠和数据丢失问题，显著提升了语料质量与产量，非常适合用于大语言模型的预训练。
AI.keywords: 欧洲葡萄牙语, 网络语料库, 大语言模型, 数据清洗, 方言识别
AI.comments: 该论文针对欧洲葡萄牙语（PT-PT）这一特定区域语言变体，解决由于方言重叠（主要是PT-BR）和大规数据处理带来的挑战。其核心创新在于引入了一种新的抓取后处理模块（在过滤前移除样板文件和行级重复），成功挽救了被传统启发式过滤器过早丢弃的有效文本，显著提升了文档产出率。这对于低资源或方言大模型的数据准备具有重要的参考价值。

title: Attributing Cohen's d: Training Data Attribution for Disease-Related Effects in Normative Age Biomarkers
summary: Normative age models are trained to predict chronological age in a nominally healthy cohort. Applied to patients, they deviate, and the gap between predicted and chronological age is read as disease risk. Here, we attribute the disease-related effect size of the age gap directly to individual training samples, rather than using a prediction-level loss as the attribution target. For Cohen's $d$, the resulting closed-form influence functional, validated against leave-one-out retraining, ranks training samples by their effect on held-out case-control separation. Across four diseases and two biomarker modalities in UK Biobank, removing the 10% most influential training samples raises held-out disease-related effect size in every seed. It more than doubles the metabolomic-age effect for type-2 diabetes and raises the brain-age effect for multiple sclerosis by roughly a third. Random removal leaves effect size flat even at 50% removal, confirming the gain comes from which samples are removed, not how many. Flagged subjects carry subclinical cardiometabolic burden that diagnosis-based exclusion misses, on markers the model never sees. For type-2 diabetes, where the method gains most, the marker recovered is HbA1c, the standard measure of blood sugar control. We release pyinfluence, our influence-function package, for reproducibility and reuse.

AI.title_translation: 归因Cohen's d：规范年龄生物标志物中疾病相关效应的训练数据归因
AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对规范年龄模型中病理效应量（Cohen's d）的训练数据归因方法，通过剔除最具影响力的10%训练样本，显著提升了疾病生物标志物的效应量并揭示了亚临床负担。
AI.motivation: 传统的训练数据归因通常使用预测层面的损失作为目标，而规范年龄模型中，年龄差（预测年龄与实际年龄之差）被视为疾病风险。为了直接评估训练样本对疾病相关效应量（如Cohen's d）的影响，需要开发一种新的数据归因方法。
AI.method: 针对Cohen's d开发了闭式影响泛函（closed-form influence functional），通过直接将疾病相关的效应量归因到单个训练样本，并利用留一法重新训练进行验证，以此对训练样本按其对保持病例对照分离的影响进行排序和筛选。
AI.result: 在UK Biobank的四种疾病和两种生物标志物模态中，移除最具影响力的10%训练样本提升了所有种子实验中的疾病相关效应量；例如，2型糖尿病的代谢年龄效应增加了一倍以上，多发性硬化的脑年龄效应提升了约三分之一，且该方法成功恢复了未在模型中显式使用的关键生物标志物（如HbA1c）。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的直接归因Cohen's d的方法能够有效识别并剔除对疾病生物标志物有害的训练样本，从而显著提升泛化能力并揭示未被注意的亚临床疾病特征。
AI.translation: 规范年龄模型被训练用来预测名义健康队列的实际年龄。应用于患者时，模型会产生偏差，预测年龄与实际年龄之间的差距被解读为疾病风险。在此，我们直接将年龄差距的疾病相关效应大小归因于单个训练样本，而不是使用预测层面的损失作为归因目标。对于Cohen's d，由此产生的闭式影响泛函（经留一法重新训练验证）根据训练样本对保留的病例对照分离的影响对其进行排序。在UK Biobank的四种疾病和两种生物标志物模态中，移除前10%最具影响力的训练样本在每个随机种子下都提高了保留的疾病相关效应大小。它使2型糖尿病的代谢年龄效应增加了一倍以上，并将多发性硬化的脑年龄效应提高了大约三分之一。随机移除即使在移除50%时也使效应大小保持平稳，这证实了增益来自于移除哪些样本，而不是移除了多少样本。被标记的受试者带有基于诊断的排除所遗漏的亚临床心脏代谢负担，这些负担体现在模型从未见过的标志物上。对于方法收益最大的2型糖尿病，恢复的标志物是HbA1c（血糖控制的标准测量指标）。我们发布了影响力函数包pyinfluence，以保证可重复性和重用性。
AI.summary: 该论文开发了一种针对规范年龄模型中疾病相关效应量（Cohen's d）的训练数据归因方法。通过计算闭式影响泛函，该方法能够对训练样本根据其对病例对照分离的影响进行排序。实验表明，剔除一小部分高影响力样本能够显著提升多种疾病的生物标志物效应量，并能识别出传统诊断遗漏的亚临床负担。
AI.keywords: 训练数据归因, 规范年龄模型, 效应量, Cohen's d, 生物标志物
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种直接针对病理效应量（Cohen's d）而非预测损失的训练数据归因方法。通过闭式影响泛函，不仅能够有效识别并剔除损害病例对照分离的训练样本，还能反向揭示隐匿的临床风险因素，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Certified Topological Interaction in Neural Representations: Exact Tests and the Statistic They Require
comments: 36 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Code and measurement records: https://github.com/sushovan4/disentanglement
summary: Class disentanglement--the separation of a representation's class-conditional point clouds along depth and over training--is measured by descriptive curves: the sentence such a study wants to write, layer l+1 is more disentangled than layer l, is an eyeball judgement with no null. We supply the inferential layer for a topological measurement of class overlap, the Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile: the Euler characteristic of the overlap of the clouds' ball unions as a function of scale, from one Alpha-complex sweep with no boundary-matrix reduction. Every number carries a test--exact permutation tests in both directions, a guarded separation certificate the invariant requires, and a paired sign-flip test for comparative claims. Building that test taught a lesson outliving this invariant: its statistic must be scale-free. On the raw profile mass, which has units of feature length, 12,375 paired tests return 5,633 significant steps of which every one at the first epoch points the wrong way, certifying feature-norm dynamics as disentanglement; the dimensionless statistic returns 2,707, with 2,026 decreases. Across 111 networks and 52,650 measurements, disentanglement is depth-graded and early, and interaction quotients rank class pairs by confusability (rho=0.83), on par with cheap separability statistics. In a 96-model factorial, augmentation is the one training choice that separates classes relative to chance; weight decay compresses the overlap without separating. Only a k-fold statistic can pose the structural question: the joint entanglement of a class triple sits below its strongest pair in 97% of triple-layer cells and 99.5% of deep cells, at median ratios far below a measured null floor, in vision encoders and frozen language models--a regularity, not a law. The unnormalized mass predicts test accuracy (R^2=0.94), the quotient does not, and neither beats a linear probe.
comment: 36 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Code and measurement records: https://github.com/sushovan4/disentanglement

AI.title_translation: 神经表征中的认证拓扑交互：精确检验与其所需的统计量
AI.tldr: 该论文引入了基于交集欧拉示性数的严格统计检验框架，用于测量神经网络的类解耦与拓扑交互，证明了无量纲统计量在消除特征范数干扰方面的必要性，并揭示了网络深度、数据增强和高阶纠缠对表征的深远影响。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经网络类解耦研究依赖于描述性曲线和主观目测判断，缺乏严格的统计原假设检验（null）。为了解决这一问题，需要为拓扑测量提供一个严谨的推断层，并确定其所需的统计量特性。
AI.method: 提出交集欧拉示性数剖面（Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile），通过单次Alpha复形扫描（无需边界矩阵约简）计算类条件点云球体并集的重叠欧拉示性数；设计了精确的置换检验、带保护的分离证书以及配对符号翻转检验，并强调并采用无量纲统计量。
AI.result: 在111个网络和52,650次测量中发现解耦是深度分级的且发生得很早；数据增强是唯一能使类相对于机会分离的训练选择，而权重 decay 则在不分离的情况下压缩重叠；三元组的联合纠缠低于其最强对；未归一化的质量可以预测测试准确率（R^2=0.94）。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入交集欧拉示性数剖面及其无量纲统计量，该研究为神经网络表征的类解耦和拓扑交互提供了严格的统计检验框架，揭示了深度、数据增强、权重衰减在表征分离中的具体作用及高阶纠缠的普适规律。
AI.translation: 类解耦——表征的类条件点云沿深度和训练过程的分离——是通过描述性曲线来测量的：诸如“层 l+1 比层 l 更解耦”这样的研究结论，是一种没有原假设的主观目测判断。我们为类重叠的拓扑测量提供了推断层，即交集欧拉示性数剖面：作为尺度函数的云的球体并集重叠的欧拉示性数，来自一次没有边界矩阵约简的Alpha复形扫描。每一个数字都带有检验——双向的精确置换检验、该不变式所需的带保护分离证书，以及用于比较性声明的配对符号翻转检验。构建该检验教给我们一个超越这个不变式的教训：其统计量必须是无量纲的。在具有特征长度单位的原始剖面质量上，12,375次配对检验返回了5,633个显著步长，其中在第一个时期的每一个步长都指向错误的方向，将特征范数动力学认证为解耦；无量纲统计量返回了2,707个，其中2,026个是减少的。在111个网络和52,650次测量中，解耦是深度分级的且发生得很早，交互商根据混淆性对类对进行排序（rho=0.83），与廉价的可分性统计量相当。在一个96模型的析因设计中，数据增强是唯一使类相对于机会发生分离的选择；权重衰减在不分离的情况下压缩了重叠。只有k折统计量才能提出结构性问题：在视觉编码器和冻结语言模型中，类三元组的联合纠缠在其最强对之下的比例在97%的三元组层单元和99.5%的深度单元中，其中心位数远低于测得的原假设底线——这是一种规律，而不是定律。未归一化的质量预测了测试准确率（R^2=0.94），而商则没有，且两者均不比线性探针更好。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一个基于交集欧拉示性数剖面的严格统计框架，用于测量神经网络表征中的类解耦和拓扑交互。通过引入无量纲统计量和精确检验方法，研究人员对大量网络进行了测试，揭示了解耦、数据增强、权重衰减以及高阶联合纠缠的内在规律。
AI.keywords: 拓扑交互, 神经表征, 类解耦, 欧拉示性数, 置换检验
AI.comments: 该论文为神经表征中的类解耦（class disentanglement）提供了一个严谨的拓扑测量推断层，引入了交集欧拉示性数剖面（Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile）及其所需的无量纲统计量，并通过精确置换检验和符号翻转检验克服了以往主观目测的局限。研究规模宏大，分析了大量网络和模型，揭示了深度、数据增强和权重衰减对表征的影响，并对高阶联合纠缠进行了深入探讨。

title: Do New Attention Mechanisms Actually Fix Attention Sinks at Million-Token Context?
comments: Experimental study of attention sinks, long-context recall, and million-token context behavior. Code and measurement protocol are available at https://github.com/sararizwan7/Attention-Mechanisms-in-1M-Context-Window
summary: Long context language models now advertise windows of one million tokens, but two habits limit how much of that window is used. Attention heads with nothing useful to read still spend their budget on the first token, which is called the attention sink, and where a fact sits in the context changes whether the model finds it. Gated attention cut first token attention from 46.7 percent to 4.8 percent at NeurIPS 2025, and Kimi K3 pairs that idea with Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals behind a one million token window, eight times past the range where these diagnostics have been reported. This paper asks whether the fix survives that jump. We build SinkProbe, a suite that measures sink mass, massive activation, position resolved recall and the recency gap, and apply it to four small models that differ only in how they mix tokens and depth. Three results follow. The training objective produces the sink, not the architecture. Gating did not reproduce its published effect at our scale. Sink mass, activations and position bias moved independently. Code, data and the measurement protocol are released at https://github.com/sararizwan7/Attention-Mechanisms-in-1M-Context-Window
comment: Experimental study of attention sinks, long-context recall, and million-token context behavior. Code and measurement protocol are available at https://github.com/sararizwan7/Attention-Mechanisms-in-1M-Context-Window

AI.title_translation: 新型注意力机制真的能在百万级上下文下解决注意力汇聚问题吗？
AI.tldr: 新型注意力机制在百万级上下文窗口下未能有效解决注意力汇聚问题，汇聚现象实由训练目标决定。
AI.motivation: 探究新型注意力机制（如门控注意力、Kimi Delta Attention和Attention Residuals）在扩展到百万级上下文窗口时，是否能够真正解决注意力汇聚（Attention Sinks）问题。
AI.method: 构建了SinkProbe测试套件，用以测量汇聚质量、大规模激活、位置解析召回率和近因差距，并将其应用于四个仅在Token与深度混合方式上有差异的小型模型中。
AI.result: 1. 注意力汇聚是由训练目标产生的，而不是由架构决定的；2. 门控机制在百万级上下文规模下未能重现其已发表的效果；3. 汇聚质量、激活和位置偏置是独立变化的。
AI.conclusion: 在百万级上下文窗口下，现有的注意力机制修复方法（如门控注意力）未能达到预期的效果，且注意力汇聚现象是由训练目标而非网络架构决定的。
AI.translation: 长上下文语言模型现在宣传拥有100万个token的窗口，但有两个习惯限制了该窗口的使用程度。没有有用内容可读的注意力head仍然将其注意力预算花在第一个token上（被称为注意力汇聚），并且事实在上下文中的位置会影响模型是否能找到它。在NeurIPS 2025上，门控注意力将首个token的注意力从46.7%降至4.8%，而Kimi K3将该理念与Kimi Delta Attention和Attention Residuals结合在100万个token的窗口中，达到了这些诊断指标以往报告范围的八倍。本文探讨了这种修复方法在扩展到该规模时是否依然有效。我们构建了SinkProbe（一个测量汇聚质量、大规模激活、位置解析召回率和近因差距的套件），并将其应用于四个仅在token与深度混合方式上有所不同的模型。得出了三个结果：训练目标（而非架构）产生了汇聚；门控并未在我们所测试的规模下重现其已发表的效果；汇聚质量、激活和位置偏置是独立变化的。代码、数据和测量协议已在 https://github.com/sararizwan7/Attention-Mechanisms-in-1M-Context-Window 发布。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了新型注意力机制在百万级上下文窗口下解决注意力汇聚（Attention Sinks）问题的有效性。通过开发SinkProbe评估套件并测试四个不同模型，作者发现注意力汇聚源于训练目标而非架构，门控机制在超长上下文中未能复现原有效果，且相关指标呈现独立变化。
AI.keywords: Attention Sinks, Million-Token Context, Gated Attention, SinkProbe, Language Models
AI.comments: 这篇论文对百万级上下文语言模型中的注意力汇聚（Attention Sinks）问题进行了深入的实证研究。通过提出SinkProbe测试套件，作者发现注意力汇聚是由训练目标而非架构引起的，且现有的门控机制在百万级上下文中未能重现预期的效果。该研究对于理解超长上下文模型的内部机制具有重要的参考价值。

title: EFQ-Softmax: Exp-Free Quantization for Softmax
summary: Low-bit attention accelerates Transformer inference by moving the $QK^\top$ and $PV$ matrix multiplications to FP8 or FP4 matrix engines. However, the softmax path often evaluates shifted-score exponentials in higher precision, forms a temporary probability block, and quantizes it before low-bit $PV$ multiplication. This exp-then-quantize path creates a mismatch between a high-precision probability producer and a low-bit matrix consumer. We propose EFQ-Softmax (Exp-Free Quantization for Softmax), a low-bit probability-generation method that directly maps shifted attention scores to block-scaled E2M1 operands. For each microscaling block, EFQ-Softmax selects an exponent-only scale from the local maximum, maps the shifted scores to a normalized residual domain, and generates nonnegative E2M1 probability codes using a single affine rule. The resulting operand is used consistently in both the $\widetilde{P}V$ numerator update and the $\widetilde{P}\mathbf{1}$ denominator update. The FlashAttention-style row-maximum update, historical rescaling, high-precision accumulation, and final normalization remain unchanged. We evaluate end-to-end quality on Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and WAN2.2-TI2V-5B, and separately measure kernel-level performance on the A5 vector unit. EFQ-Softmax improves the Qwen3-8B seven-task mean from 0.6749 with MXFP4 to 0.6773 and the Qwen3-VL nine-task mean from 0.7826 to 0.8000. On WAN2.2, it maintains temporal consistency and visual quality comparable to the FP16 and MXFP4 baselines under VBench. On the A5 vector unit, EFQ-Softmax reduces the vector-stage latency of the fused probability-generation kernel by 40.33% on average across sequence lengths from 16K to 128K. These results show that direct low-bit probability generation can replace the conventional exp-then-quantize path while preserving end-to-end model quality.

AI.title_translation: EFQ-Softmax：Softmax的无指数量化
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为EFQ-Softmax的无指数低比特概率生成方法，解决了Transformer推理中Softmax路径的高精度指数与低比特量化的不匹配问题，在保证模型质量的同时大幅降低了内核延迟。
AI.motivation: 传统的Transformer低比特注意力机制中，Softmax路径通常在高精度下评估平移分数指数，形成临时概率块，然后再进行量化，这导致了高精度概率生产者与低比特矩阵消费者之间的不匹配，从而影响推理效率和性能。
AI.method: 提出了EFQ-Softmax方法，通过为每个微缩放块选择仅包含指数的缩放因子、将偏移得分映射到归一化残差域，并使用单一仿射规则直接生成非负E2M1概率码，实现直接的低比特概率生成。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上提升了多任务平均准确率；在WAN2.2上保持了与FP16和MXFP4基线相当的时间一致性和视觉质量；在A5向量单元上，将融合概率生成内核的向量阶段延迟平均降低了40.33%（针对16K至128K的序列长度）。
AI.conclusion: EFQ-Softmax能够有效取代传统的“先指数后量化”路径，直接生成低比特概率，在保持甚至提升端到端模型质量的同时，显著降低了向量阶段的内核延迟。
AI.translation: 低比特注意力通过将 $QK^\top$ 和 $PV$ 矩阵乘法转移到 FP8 或 FP4 矩阵引擎来加速 Transformer 推理。然而，softmax 路径通常在高精度下评估平移分数指数，形成临时概率块，并在低比特 $PV$ 乘法之前对其进行量化。这种先指数后量化的路径造成了高精度概率生产者与低比特矩阵消费者之间的不匹配。我们提出了 EFQ-Softmax（Softmax 的无指数量化），这是一种低比特概率生成方法，它直接将平移后的注意力得分映射到块缩放的 E2M1 操作数。对于每个微缩放块，EFQ-Softmax 从局部最大值中选择一个仅包含指数的缩放因子，将平移后的分数映射到归一化残差域，并使用单一仿射规则生成非负 E2M1 概率码。所产生的操作数在 $\widetilde{P}V$ 分子更新和 $\widetilde{P}\mathbf{1}$ 分母更新中均一致使用。FlashAttention 风格的行最大值更新、历史重新缩放、高精度累加和最终归一化保持不变。我们在 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 和 WAN2.2-TI2V-5B 上评估了端到端质量，并在 A5 向量单元上单独测量了内核级性能。EFQ-Softmax 将 Qwen3-8B 的七任务均值从 MXFP4 的 0.6749 提高到 0.6773，将 Qwen3-VL 的九任务均值从 0.7826 提高到 0.8000。在 WAN2.2 上，它在 VBench 下保持了与 FP16 和 MXFP4 基线相当的时间一致性和视觉质量。在 A5 向量单元上，在 16K 到 128K 的序列长度范围内，EFQ-Softmax 将融合概率生成内核的向量阶段延迟平均降低了 40.33%。这些结果表明，直接低比特概率生成可以取代传统的先指数后量化路径，同时保留端到端模型质量。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了EFQ-Softmax，一种用于Softmax的无指数低比特概率生成方法。它通过直接将平移后的注意力得分映射到块缩放的E2M1操作数，消除了传统“先指数后量化”路径带来的不匹配问题，在保证端到端模型质量的同时显著提升了内核性能。
AI.keywords: Transformer推理, 低比特注意力, Softmax量化, EFQ-Softmax, 块缩放E2M1
AI.comments: 该论文针对Transformer推理中Softmax计算路径的高精度指数运算与低比特矩阵乘法之间的不匹配问题，创新性地提出了EFQ-Softmax方法。通过直接将偏移后的注意力得分映射为块缩放的E2M1操作数，避免了传统的“先指数后量化”过程，不仅在多个大型模型（如Qwen3、WAN2.2）上保持或提升了端到端质量，还在向量单元上实现了显著的延迟降低。该研究对低比特注意力加速具有重要的实用价值。

title: HBFSim: Fast and Faithful Simulation of High-Bandwidth Flash Under Real GPU Execution
summary:
High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) places high-capacity NAND beside HBM to relieve the memory-capacity bottleneck of LLM inference, yet its system-level behavior cannot be evaluated before hardware becomes available. Cycle-level GPU simulators are too slow for production-scale models. Trace replay has a further shortcoming: it cannot capture the allocation, migration, and execution changes induced by different HBM-HBF configurations. Our key insight is that HBF need not be evaluated by simulating the GPU: only the program-visible effects of HBF need to be modeled. And only a real LLM workload running on real hardware can answer the arguments about HBF. Hence the modeled service has to be injected into that running program, and the injection must not destroy the GPU concurrency that would hide the original I/O latency.
  We present HBFSim, an open-source HBF simulator that executes LLM workloads on a real GPU while modeling HBF timing, thermal, and other behaviors online. HBFSim rewrites the PTX of the workload's kernels and routes accesses inside a registered address range into the HBF simulator. It supports asynchronous TMA transfers and capacities beyond physical GPU memory. HBFSim leaves the model's run unaffected across ordinary-memory, TMA, and capacity-mode tests. The delay it injects matches the delay requested to within 0.152%. We also design a coupled thermal module that puts HBF, HBM, and the GPU in one advanced package, which is important for answering how severe the hot throttling problem becomes after HBF runs for a long time. Experiments with Qwen3-30B show how package heating, HBM-HBF allocation, and shared MoE demand jointly constrain the design space of future HBF accelerators.

AI.title_translation: HBFSim：在真实GPU执行下对高带宽闪存进行快速且高保真的仿真
AI.tldr: HBFSim是一个新型的高带宽闪存（HBF）仿真器，能够在真实GPU运行大语言模型时快速且高保真地在线模拟HBF的时序和热行为。
AI.motivation: 高带宽闪存（HBF）旨在缓解大语言模型推理的内存容量瓶颈，但在硬件可用之前，其系统级行为无法评估；现有的周期级GPU模拟器速度太慢无法适应生产级模型，而轨迹回放（trace replay）又无法捕获不同HBM-HBF配置引起的分配、迁移和执行变化。
AI.method: 提出了开源仿真器 HBFSim，通过重写工作负载内核的 PTX 并将特定地址范围内的访问路由到 HBF 仿真器中，支持异步 TMA 传输和超出物理 GPU 内存的容量，并设计了耦合的热模块来模拟封装内的温度变化。
AI.result: HBFSim注入的延迟与请求延迟的匹配误差在0.152%以内，且能在不破坏GPU并发性的前提下，成功结合Qwen3-30B模型揭示了封装加热、HBM-HBF分配和共享MoE需求对未来HBF加速器设计空间的共同约束。
AI.conclusion: HBFSim能够快速且高保真地仿真高带宽闪存（HBF），在真实GPU上运行大语言模型工作负载的同时在线建模HBF的时序、热学等行为，为未来HBF加速器的设计空间探索提供了有力工具。
AI.translation:
高带宽闪存（HBF）将大容量 NAND 放置在 HBM 旁边，以缓解大语言模型推理的内存容量瓶颈，但在硬件可用之前，其系统级行为无法进行评估。周期级 GPU 模拟器对于生产级模型来说速度太慢。轨迹回放还有一个缺点：它无法捕获由不同 HBM-HBF 配置引起的分配、迁移和执行变化。我们的核心观点是，评估 HBF 不需要模拟 GPU：只需要对 HBF 的程序可见效应进行建模。而且只有在真实硬件上运行的真实大语言模型工作负载才能回答关于 HBF 的论点。因此，被建模的服务必须注入到该运行程序中，并且注入操作绝不能破坏会掩盖原始 I/O 延迟的 GPU 并发性。
我们提出了 HBFSim，这是一个开源的 HBF 模拟器，它在真实 GPU 上执行大语言模型工作负载，同时在线对 HBF 的时序、热学和其他行为进行建模。HBFSim 重写工作负载内核的 PTX，并将注册地址范围内的访问路由到 HBF 模拟器中。它支持异步 TMA 传输以及超出物理 GPU 内存的容量。在普通内存、TMA 和容量模式测试中，HBFSim 保持模型运行不受影响。其注入的延迟与请求的延迟匹配误差在 0.152% 以内。我们还设计了一个耦合的热模块，将 HBF、HBM 和 GPU 放在一个先进封装中，这对于回答 HBF 长期运行后热节流问题变得多严重至关重要。使用 Qwen3-30B 的实验表明了封装发热、HBM-HBF 分配和共享 MoE 需求如何共同约束未来 HBF 加速器的设计空间。
AI.summary: HBFSim是一个开源的高带宽闪存（HBF）仿真器，它通过在真实GPU上运行大语言模型工作负载，在线对HBF的时序和热学行为进行建模。通过PTX代码重写和地址重定向，HBFSim能够在保持GPU并发性的同时，以极高精度模拟HBF的延迟和热特性，填补了硬件缺失时的系统级评估空白。
AI.keywords: High-Bandwidth Flash, LLM inference, GPU simulation, PTX rewriting, thermal modeling
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的在线仿真方法（HBFSim），通过在真实GPU执行中注入虚拟的时序和热模拟，解决了高带宽闪存（HBF）在硬件不可用且传统仿真器速度极慢情况下的系统级评估难题。其核心创新在于通过PTX重写和异步注入，在保持GPU硬件并发的前提下精确建模HBF行为。

title: Understanding the Security Boundary of Obfuscation-based On-Device LLM Protection
comments: 16 pages. Accepted to ACM CCS 2026 (Cycle B)
summary: Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) offer a promising mechanism for safeguarding the intellectual property of on-device Large Language Models (LLMs). To overcome the inherent computational bottlenecks of TEEs, existing TEE-Shielded LLM Partition (TSLP) methods apply efficient obfuscation schemes to computationally intensive layers, offloading them to external GPUs while retaining only lightweight operations within the TEE. Although a growing body of TSLP-based approaches has emerged, these defense mechanisms remain largely heuristic. Consequently, some methods are proven vulnerable to certain specialized adversarial attacks designed to exploit their specific architectural implementations. To overcome the limitations of these heuristic designs, this paper addresses a fundamental research question: can we establish common primitives to unify representative prior methodologies, characterize the security boundary of their compositions, and systematically extend them? To this end, we formalize a set of obfuscation primitives, defined as dual-tuples of linear computations satisfying specific algebraic properties. We demonstrate that the matrix-level weight transformations of several representative efficient TSLP frameworks can be expressed as compositions of these primitives; consequently, the canonical form of these primitive compositions, denoted as \priorboundary, defines the security boundary of this primitive family. We then expose the vulnerabilities of \priorboundary through a novel primitive-guided attack methodology, \sysattack, demonstrating a shared vulnerability in several prominent TSLP methods published in top-tier venues, such as ArrowCloak (Security'25), TSQP (S\&P'25), and LoRO (NeurIPS'25). Finally, we introduce two novel obfuscation primitives and integrate them with existing constructs to formulate \sysdefense, extending the prior security boundary \priorboundary.
comment: 16 pages. Accepted to ACM CCS 2026 (Cycle B)

AI.title_translation: 理解基于混淆的端侧大语言模型保护的安全边界
AI.tldr: 本文形式化了端侧大语言模型混淆保护的原语，揭示了现有顶会方案的安全漏洞，并提出了扩展安全边界的新防御机制。
AI.motivation: 现有的TSLP（TEE-Shielded LLM Partition）防御机制多具启发式，缺乏统一的理论框架，容易受到专门对抗攻击的威胁，因此需要建立通用原语来刻画其安全边界并进行系统性扩展。
AI.method: 形式化定义了一组满足特定代数特性的线性计算双元组混淆原语，将现有框架的矩阵级权重变换表示为原语的组合，定义了安全边界，并提出了原语引导的攻击方法及包含新原语的防御方案。
AI.result: 揭示了多篇顶级会议论文（如 ArrowCloak, TSQP, LoRO）中采用的TSLP方法的共享漏洞，并成功引入两个新混淆原语扩展了安全边界，推出了更具鲁棒性的防御机制。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过形式化混淆原语成功界定了现有TSLP方法的安全边界，暴露了其共同漏洞，并提出了扩展安全边界的新防御机制。
AI.translation: 可信执行环境（TEE）为保护端侧大语言模型（LLM）的知识产权提供了一种有前景的机制。为了克服TEE固有的计算瓶颈，现有的TEE屏蔽大语言模型分区（TSLP）方法将高效的混淆方案应用于计算密集型层，将其卸载到外部GPU，而仅在TEE内部保留轻量级操作。尽管基于TSLP的方法不断涌现，但这些防御机制在很大程度上仍然是启发式的。因此，一些方法被证明容易受到针对其特定架构实现的某些专用对抗攻击的破坏。为了克服这些启发式设计的局限性，本文探讨了一个根本性的研究问题：我们能否建立共同的原语来统一代表性的先前方法，描述其组合的安全边界，并系统地扩展它们？为此，我们将一组混淆原语形式化为满足特定代数特性的线性计算双元组。我们证明了几个具有代表性的高效TSLP框架的矩阵级权重变换可以表示为这些原语的组合；因此，这些原语组合的规范形式（记为 \priorboundary）定义了该原语系列的安全边界。然后，我们通过一种新颖的原语引导攻击方法（\sysattack）暴露了 \priorboundary 的漏洞，证明了发表在顶级会议上的几个著名TSLP方法（如 ArrowCloak (Security'25)、TSQP (S&P'25) 和 LoRO (NeurIPS'25)）中存在的共享漏洞。最后，我们引入了两个新的混淆原语，并将它们与现有结构相结合以构建 \sysdefense，从而扩展了先前的安全边界 \priorboundary。
AI.summary: 本文针对端侧大语言模型保护中基于混淆的TEE分区方法（TSLP）缺乏统一安全边界的问题，通过形式化一组线性计算混淆原语，统一并刻画了现有代表性方法的安全边界。研究不仅通过一种新颖的原语引导攻击揭示了多个顶会知名TSLP方案的共同漏洞，还通过引入新混淆原语提出了扩展安全边界的防御策略。
AI.keywords: 端侧大语言模型, 可信执行环境, 模型混淆, 安全边界, 对抗攻击
AI.comments: 该论文系统性地研究了基于混淆的端侧大语言模型保护方案的安全边界，通过形式化定义混淆原语，揭示了多个顶会工作的共同漏洞，并提出了更强大的防御方案，对端侧模型安全具有重要意义。

title: AnimateCanvas: Learning Implicit Motion Planning from Composable Kinematic Cues
comments: This paper was posted before completion of the required internal review and approval process. It is being withdrawn pending approval for public release
summary: Professional character animation requires both natural motion and precise, versatile control. For example, creators often define the timing of a specified action, control the motion range of the character's arm swing, or specify the route the character walks through--effectively placing various kinematic cues on a motion canvas. This motivates us to propose AnimateCanvas, a model that supports cue-conditioned implicit motion planning to faithfully and coherently connect all cues, dense or sparse, full or partial, into one full-body motion sequence. Specifically, AnimateCanvas represents heterogeneous kinematic cues on a shared motion canvas, where position and rotation values are specified across body joints and time. A shared flow-matching model generates motion conditioned on this canvas, with optional language and input motion; cue imputation keeps the specified canvas values fixed in both training and sampling. To learn coherent completion across different cue sets, we train with a compositional cue sampler that varies the timing of cue application, the positions or rotations specified, and how they are combined. Together, these designs enable a single generator to integrate heterogeneous kinematic cues into coherent full-body actions, giving creators fine-grained control over selected frames, joints, and position or rotation channels. We evaluate this planning ability on temporal, root, and body-part cues--alone and combined--as well as language-guided editing, and naturally extend it to sequential generation and motion repair. AnimateCanvas achieves state-of-the-art results in temporal completion, spatial control, sequential generation, language-guided editing, and motion repair, while retaining strong text-to-motion capability.
