title: Ischemic Stroke Segmentation and Net Water Uptake Quantification on Multicenter Non-Contrast CT Using Supervised Target-Domain Adaptation
summary:
Objectives: Quantitative assessment of infarct hypodensity on non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT), including net water uptake (NWU), requires manual or semi-manual lesion delineation, often guided by CT perfusion or diffusion-weighted MRI, limiting clinical applicability. Automated segmentation on NCCT could enable efficient biomarker extraction such as NWU but remains challenging across heterogeneous multicenter data. This study aimed to develop and externally test a domain-aware deep learning framework for ischemic stroke segmentation on NCCT and assess its suitability for NWU quantification.
  Materials & Methods: In this retrospective multicenter study of 801 patients from four datasets, an nnU-Net-based model was trained on NCCT scans from the University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf and the Acute Ischemic Stroke Dataset. To adapt to new domains, the model was fine-tuned on target-domain subsets from Boston (n=11) and ISLES (n=75), with evaluation on held-out cases not used for fine-tuning. Automated segmentations and NWU values were compared with expert references.
  Results: For lesions $\geq$ 30 mL, median Dice was 0.68 (Boston) and 0.56 (ISLES). Including smaller lesions, which predominated in ISLES, median Dice was 0.54 (interquartile range [IQR] 0.30-0.70) for acute lesion segmentation (Boston dataset) and 0.20 (IQR 0.03-0.41) for NCCT lesion segmentations when compared to post-treatment infarct (primary target of the ISLES challenge). Automated NWU mean absolute error was 1.37 percentage points (SD 1.61, Boston).
  Conclusion: Target-domain adaptation supported NCCT-only infarct segmentation across heterogeneous external cohorts, although performance varied across domains. The approach enabled low-error NWU quantification from baseline NCCT without advanced imaging, supporting further prospective clinical evaluation.

title: Small Enough to Know Everything: The Fully-Enumerable Transformer as an Instrument for the Science of Delayed Generalization
comments: 10 pages, 2 figures. v2 narrows the central claim: the study scales the model while every task stays enumerable, so it shows that enumerated task-side quantities keep predicting once the model outgrows the instrument's regime, not that they survive the loss of enumerability. The weight-decay relationship is demoted; data and figures are unchanged
summary: Tiny transformers trained on fully-enumerable tasks occupy an unusual position in the study of grokking: every input can be evaluated, every generalization ceiling can be computed exactly, and hundreds of seeds cost minutes. We argue this regime is a scientific instrument with four capabilities that approximate settings cannot offer: (a) exact, falsifiable generalization ceilings; (b) task surgery that manipulates one structural variable while provably fixing all others; (c) direct observation of every weight; and (d) survival-time statistics over many seeds that recast "does not grok" as a censored observation. The obvious objection is that laws characterized at 10^4 parameters may not mean anything beyond them. We answer it with a preregistered conservation study: three task-side laws established at 12K parameters -- a recoverability-ceiling law, a role-conflict delay law, and a weight-decay response law -- are re-measured under an identical from-scratch protocol at 12K, 1M, and 50M parameters (a 4,000x span; 360 runs plus a 44-run control arm). The ceiling law and the delay law are conserved (0/144 Holm-corrected ceiling violations; Spearman rho >= 0.75 at every scale, permutation p < 1e-4), while the weight-decay law deforms systematically, steepening with scale. Preregistered controls show the 50M role-conflict deficit survives learning-rate adjustment and a tripled budget. Conservation was tested against criteria frozen before data collection, and the third relationship fails that test even at the original scale, which is what tells us the test could have failed. The series scales the model while the tasks stay enumerable, so what it licenses is specific: the quantities this regime computes from a task keep predicting once the model has outgrown the regime itself.

AI.title_translation: 小到无所不知：全可枚举Transformer作为延迟泛化科学研究的工具
AI.tldr: 本文提出利用全可枚举微型Transformer作为研究延迟泛化的严格科学仪器，并通过预注册实验证明在12K参数下发现的泛化上限与延迟定律能够跨越4000倍参数规模（扩展至50M）保持守恒。
AI.motivation: 延迟泛化（grokking）研究缺乏精确可控、可完全评估且计算成本极低的科学研究工具；同时，学界普遍质疑在极小模型（~10^4参数）上发现的训练与泛化规律是否能够适用于更大规模的模型。
AI.method: 提出了利用全可枚举任务微型Transformer作为实验仪器的研究范式（具备精确泛化上限、单变量任务手术、权重全直接观察、生存时间统计四大特性）；采用预注册守恒性研究方案，将在12K参数下建立的三条任务侧定律（可恢复性上限、角色冲突延迟、权重衰减响应），在12K、1M和50M参数规模（跨越4000倍规模，共360次从头训练加44次对照）下依据预先冻结的标准进行跨尺度验证。
AI.result: 泛化上限规律和角色冲突延迟规律在跨越4000倍参数扩展后依然守恒（Holm校正违例为0/144，各规模下Spearman相关系数rho >= 0.75，p < 1e-4）；权重衰减规律发生系统性形变，随规模扩大而变陡；预注册对照表明50M模型下的角色冲突缺陷在调整学习率并增加3倍训练预算后依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 全可枚举微型模型体系能够提炼出跨模型规模依然有效的规律：由该体系从任务中计算得出的特征度量，在模型参数规模大幅超越该微型体系本身后，依然具备可靠的预测能力。
AI.translation: 在完全可枚举任务上训练的微型Transformer在延迟泛化（grokking）研究中占据着独特的地位：每个输入都可以被精确评估，每个泛化上限都能被精确计算，且运行数百个随机种子仅耗时数分钟。我们认为这种机制构成了一种科学仪器，具备近似设定无法提供的四种能力：(a) 精确、可证伪的泛化上限；(b) 能够在可证明地固定所有其他变量的同时操纵单一结构变量的任务手术；(c) 对每个权重的直接观察；以及 (d) 基于大量种子的生存时间统计，将“未能泛化”重新定义为截尾观测。对此显而易见的质疑在于，在10^4参数级别表征的规律在更大规模下可能失去意义。我们通过一项预注册守恒性研究回应了该质疑：将在12K参数下建立的三条任务侧定律——可恢复性上限规律、角色冲突延迟规律以及权重衰减响应规律——在12K、1M和50M参数规模（跨度达4000倍；包含360次运行及44次对照实验）下，采用相同的从头训练协议重新测定。结果表明，上限规律和延迟规律保持守恒（在Holm校正后违例为0/144；各规模下Spearman rho >= 0.75，置换检验 p < 1e-4），而权重衰减规律则发生系统性形变，随规模扩大而变陡。预注册对照实验表明，50M参数下的角色冲突缺陷在调整学习率并给予三倍预算后依然存在。守恒性测试基于数据收集前冻结的标准进行，第三条规律甚至在原始规模下就未能通过测试，这证明了该测试具有真正的可证伪性。该系列实验在保持任务可枚举的同时扩展了模型，其证明的结论是明确的：该机制从任务中计算出的度量量，在模型规模超出该机制本身后依然具有预测性。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了利用全可枚举任务训练的微型Transformer作为研究延迟泛化（grokking）的精确科学工具。针对小模型规律无法外推的质疑，作者开展了一项预注册守恒性研究，将在12K参数下总结的三条定律在12K、1M和50M参数规模下进行重新测定。实验证实泛化上限规律和角色冲突延迟规律跨越4000倍参数规模依然守恒，证明该极小模型体系能够为更大规模下的泛化行为提供可靠的预测依据。
AI.keywords: 延迟泛化 (Grokking), 全可枚举任务 (Fully-Enumerable Tasks), 守恒性研究 (Conservation Study), 尺度扩展 (Scale Invariance), Transformer
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将完全可枚举任务上的微型Transformer确立为一种可精确度量、具备证伪能力的科学分析仪器，并采用了极其严谨的预注册实验设计与统计学方法（如生存时间分析、Holm校正、置换检验），正面验证了微型模型规律向大模型（扩展4000倍至50M）外推的守恒性。其局限性在于，虽然模型规模得到了有效扩展，但研究仍局限于“全可枚举”的任务范畴，这些定律能否直接适用于自然语言等非枚举的开放域复杂真实任务仍有待检验。

title: Exact fast factorizations of the AR(1) Karhunen-Loeve transform
summary: We derive a fast factorization of the exact Karhunen--Loève transform (KLT) of an AR(1) source by mapping it onto the Discrete Cosine Transform. For even $N$ and every $ρ\in(0,1)$, the KLT factors exactly into Chen's fast DCT-II structure---butterfly plus fixed half-size DCT-II and DCT-IV cores---completed by two orthogonal corrections: eigenvector matrices of diagonal-plus-rank-one matrices carrying the entire $ρ$-dependence. Fast DCT factorizations are reused unchanged; as $ρ\to1$ the corrections become identities, recovering Chen's algorithm. At short lengths the design is explicit: at $N=4$ the transform is one butterfly and two rotations with $\tan2ψ_s=-2/(1-ρ)$, $\tan2ψ_a=2/(1+ρ)$; at $N=8$ every correction entry is in radicals, via one quartic serving both branches, and factors into six Givens rotations. Complete and scaled realizations run the exact 8-point KLT in 32 and 24 multiplications, about twice the fixed DCT-II; at $N=4$, a single extra multiplication. At large $N$, fast-multipole application of the corrections yields the exact KLT in $O(N\log N)$ operations to prescribed accuracy; this overhead thus peaks at intermediate sizes and vanishes in both limits.

AI.title_translation: AR(1) Karhunen-Loève变换的精确快速因式分解
AI.tldr: 本文提出将AR(1)过程的精确KLT分解为Chen氏DCT-II快速结构与承载参数ρ的正交修正矩阵，实现了小点数显式旋转与大点数O(N log N)的快速精确计算。
AI.motivation: 为了克服AR(1)信源精确Karhunen--Loève变换（KLT）通常缺乏统一快速算法的局限，将其与现有的离散余弦变换（DCT）快速算法建立精确映射以降低计算复杂度。
AI.method: 通过将AR(1)信源的精确KLT映射到离散余弦变换（DCT）上，对于偶数长N，将其精确分解为Chen氏快速DCT-II结构（蝶形运算与半尺寸DCT-II及DCT-IV核心），外加两个承载全部相关系数ρ依赖的对角加秩一矩阵特征向量正交修正；短序列下显式构建旋转因式，大序列下结合快速多极子算法应用修正项。
AI.result: 在ρ趋近于1时修正项退化为单位阵从而恢复为Chen氏DCT算法；在N=4时仅需一个蝶形和两个平面旋转（仅多一次乘法）；在N=8时修正矩阵元素可用根式显式表达并分解为6个Givens旋转，完全实现仅需32或24次乘法；大尺寸N下运算复杂度达到给定精度下的O(N log N)。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为任意相关系数下的AR(1)过程提供了一种精确且计算高效的KLT实现框架，不仅在小点数下具备显式低复杂度结构，而且在大规模情形下具有近线性计算复杂度。
AI.translation: 我们通过将AR(1)信源的精确Karhunen--Loève变换（KLT）映射到离散余弦变换（DCT）上，推导出了该变换的一种快速因式分解。对于偶数N以及每个相关系数ρ∈(0,1)，KLT可精确分解为Chen氏快速DCT-II结构——即蝶形运算加上固定的半尺寸DCT-II和DCT-IV核心——并辅以两个正交修正矩阵：承载全部ρ相关性的对角加秩一矩阵的特征向量矩阵。快速DCT因式分解得以原样复用；当ρ趋近于1时，修正矩阵变为单位矩阵，从而恢复出Chen氏算法。在短序列长度下，其设计是显式的：在N=4时，该变换为一个蝶形与两个满足tan 2ψ_s=-2/(1-ρ)、tan 2ψ_a=2/(1+ρ)的旋转；在N=8时，每个修正矩阵元素均可用根式表达（通过一个服务于两个分支的四次方程），并可因式分解为六个Givens旋转。完全实现与尺度化实现分别以32次和24次乘法运行精确的8点KLT，大约是固定DCT-II的两倍；在N=4时仅多出一次乘法。在长序列N时，修正矩阵的快速多极子应用能够在预设精度下以O(N log N)的运算量实现精确KLT；因此，该计算开销在中间尺寸达到峰值，并在两个极限情况下趋于零。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种将AR(1)信源的精确Karhunen--Loève变换（KLT）映射至离散余弦变换（DCT）的快速精确因式分解方法。对于偶数点数N，该方法将KLT分解为不变的Chen氏DCT结构与两个携带参数ρ的正交修正项；小点数可获得极低乘法复杂度的显式旋转实现，大点数借助快速多极子达到O(N log N)复杂度。
AI.keywords: Karhunen--Loève变换, 离散余弦变换, AR(1)过程, 快速因式分解, Givens旋转
AI.comments: 该研究在理论和实用性上具有重要创新，首次建立了AR(1)信源的精确KLT与标准快速DCT之间的显式因式分解关联。其重要性在于直接复用了高度优化的DCT硬件/软件核心，仅需极少的参数化正交旋转作为修正，兼具极高的计算效率与解析精确性。局限性在于当前显式解析表达式仅详细给出了偶数且较小点数（如N=4, 8）的形式，更大尺寸则需依赖数值算法或快速多极子方法。

title: NeuSOGA3D: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Explainable 3D Geometric Reconstruction
comments: Preprint. Community feedback and comments are welcome
summary:
Three-dimensional reconstruction from unorganized point clouds remains a challenging problem in computer vision, geometric modeling, and computer-aided design. While neural implicit methods achieve impressive reconstruction accuracy, geometry is typically encoded in latent representations that limit interpretability and reuse within engineering workflows.
  We present NeuSOGA3D (Neuro-Symbolic Observation-Guided Geometric Abstraction in 3D), a hybrid framework that combines learned perceptual priors inherited from NeuSOGA with explicit symbolic geometric reasoning. The method projects point clouds onto principal orthographic planes, constructs symbolic implicit spline representations from the resulting observations, and fuses them through shape-preserving constructive solid geometry operations to generate a coarse visual hull. Additional geometric detail is recovered through cross-sectional decomposition and volumetric reconstruction using Partial Shape-Preserving Splines.
  Unlike conventional neural implicit approaches, NeuSOGA3D progressively transforms observations into explicit symbolic entities, including control polygons, implicit spline fields, cross-sections, and volumetric lofts. Experiments on all forty categories of the ModelNet40 benchmark demonstrate the ability of the framework to recover structurally meaningful and CAD-compatible geometric representations from diverse point-cloud observations. The results highlight the potential of combining learned perception with symbolic geometric reasoning for explainable geometric intelligence.
comment: Preprint. Community feedback and comments are welcome

AI.title_translation: NeuSOGA3D：一个可解释的3D几何重建神经符号框架
AI.tldr: NeuSOGA3D是一个神经符号框架，通过结合学习到的感知先验和显式符号几何推理，从无组织点云中重建可解释且CAD兼容的3D几何模型，解决了传统神经隐式方法解释性差的问题。
AI.motivation: 从无组织点云进行三维重建是一个挑战性问题。虽然神经隐式方法在重建精度上表现出色，但几何信息通常编码在潜在表示中，限制了解释性和在工程工作流中的重用性。
AI.method: NeuSOGA3D是一个混合框架，结合了NeuSOGA的感知先验和显式符号几何推理。该方法将点云投影到主正交平面上，从观测结果构建符号隐式样条表示，并通过保形构造实体几何操作融合它们以生成粗略的视觉包络。额外的几何细节通过横截面分解和使用部分保形样条进行体积重建来恢复。
AI.result: 在ModelNet40基准测试的所有四十个类别上进行的实验表明，该框架能够从各种点云观测中恢复具有结构意义且与CAD兼容的几何表示。
AI.conclusion: 结合学习到的感知和符号几何推理，可以实现可解释的几何智能。
AI.translation:
从无组织点云进行三维重建仍然是计算机视觉、几何建模和计算机辅助设计中的一个挑战性问题。虽然神经隐式方法取得了令人印象深刻的重建精度，但几何形状通常编码在潜在表示中，这限制了解释性和在工程工作流中的重用性。
我们提出了NeuSOGA3D（3D中基于观测引导的神经符号几何抽象），这是一个混合框架，结合了从NeuSOGA继承的学习到的感知先验和显式符号几何推理。该方法将点云投影到主正交平面上，从结果观测中构建符号隐式样条表示，并通过保形构造实体几何操作融合它们以生成粗略的视觉包络。额外的几何细节通过横截面分解和使用部分保形样条进行体积重建来恢复。
与传统的神经隐式方法不同，NeuSOGA3D逐步将观测结果转换为显式符号实体，包括控制多边形、隐式样条场、横截面和体积放样。在ModelNet40基准测试的所有四十个类别上进行的实验表明，该框架能够从各种点云观测中恢复具有结构意义且与CAD兼容的几何表示。结果突出了将学习到的感知与符号几何推理相结合以实现可解释几何智能的潜力。
AI.summary: NeuSOGA3D是一个神经符号框架，旨在解决传统神经隐式方法在3D重建中解释性差和CAD兼容性不足的问题。它通过将点云投影到正交平面，构建符号隐式样条表示，并结合构造实体几何操作和体积重建来生成可解释的、CAD兼容的3D几何模型。实验证明，该方法能从多样化的点云中恢复结构有意义的几何表示。
AI.keywords: 神经符号框架, 3D几何重建, 可解释性, 点云, CAD兼容
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的神经符号混合框架，有效结合了深度学习的感知能力和符号几何推理的解释性。其主要创新点在于将隐式的几何信息逐步转化为显式的符号实体，从而提高了模型的透明度和与CAD工作流的兼容性。这对于需要高精度、可解释和可重用几何模型的工程领域具有重要意义。

title: RoboFind: Multi-Agent Personalized Object Search for People Who Are Blind or Have Low Vision
summary: Blind and low-vision users often need to locate a specific personal object rather than an arbitrary instance of the same category. The task calls for a robot that can move through the space and reach viewpoints the user cannot, and for an accessible interface where the user says which object is meant and learns whether the right one was found. We present RoboFind, a multi-agent framework in which a smartphone teaches the target and a quadruped robot carries out the search. A Target Teaching Agent converts guided smartphone recordings into a semantic target profile and a reusable multi-view reference bank through an accessible capture flow with AR guidance, speech and haptic feedback, and screen-reader support, so later missions refer to a stored object without repeating the teaching process. At runtime, a Navigation Agent explores the environment and proposes candidate targets, a Verification Agent checks each candidate against the stored references, and a Coordination and Recovery Agent completes the mission or triggers recovery and continued search. Across 32 real-robot missions, RoboFind reaches 85.0% success against 25.0% for a reconstructed sequential first-stop baseline over 20 trials with ten targets, and reduces false success from 75.0% to 5.0%. On six shared targets it succeeds in 10/12 trials, against 5/12 for 12 independently executed GPT-6 Astra-only trials. These results show that the multi-agent design fits the demands of personalized object search, where verifying object identity before declaring completion is what makes the outcome something a user can rely on.

AI.title_translation: RoboFind：面向盲人和低视力人群的多智能体个性化物体搜索
AI.tldr: RoboFind是一个多智能体框架，利用智能手机教学和四足机器人搜索，帮助盲人和低视力用户找到特定的个人物品，显著提高了搜索成功率并减少了错误。
AI.motivation: 盲人和低视力用户经常需要找到特定的个人物品，而不是同一类别的任意实例。这项任务需要一个机器人能够移动到用户无法到达的视角，并提供一个可访问的界面，让用户指定目标物品并确认是否找到正确的物品。
AI.method: RoboFind是一个多智能体框架，其中智能手机负责教学目标物品，四足机器人执行搜索。目标教学智能体通过可访问的捕获流程（AR指导、语音和触觉反馈、屏幕阅读器支持）将引导式智能手机录音转换为语义目标配置文件和可重用的多视图参考库。运行时，导航智能体探索环境并提出候选目标，验证智能体根据存储的参考检查每个候选目标，协调与恢复智能体完成任务或触发恢复并继续搜索。
AI.result: 在32次真实机器人任务中，RoboFind的成功率达到85.0%，而重建的顺序首次停止基线在20次试验中针对10个目标只有25.0%的成功率，并将虚假成功率从75.0%降低到5.0%。在六个共享目标上，RoboFind在12次试验中成功了10次，而12次独立执行的GPT-6 Astra-only试验中成功了5次。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体设计符合个性化物体搜索的需求，在宣布完成之前验证物体身份是用户可以信赖结果的关键。

AI.keywords: 个性化物体搜索, 多智能体系统, 盲人和低视力, 四足机器人, RoboFind
AI.comments: RoboFind的创新之处在于其多智能体协同框架，特别是结合了智能手机的用户友好教学与机器人的物理搜索能力，以解决盲人和低视力人群的实际需求。通过强调“个性化”和“验证物体身份”，该系统不仅提高了搜索效率，更重要的是增强了用户对搜索结果的信任度，这对于辅助技术而言至关重要。

title: Navi-Agent: Unlocalized Monocular Navigation Agent
summary: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to execute long-horizon instructions in unknown environments. Existing zero-shot VLN-CE systems typically maintain spatial states through geometric localization or coordinate-based representations. Recent geometry-constrained navigation removes depth and globally consistent coordinates, but maintaining persistent spatial awareness for place confirmation, progress verification, and recovery remains challenging. We present Navi-Agent, a zero-shot VLN-CE agent that constructs a coordinate-free spatial state from visual observations and executed motion histories. Navi-Agent organizes this state as a navigation topology, where nodes represent visual places and edges represent motion transitions. This representation enables observation-based approximate self-localization, task progress verification, and visual revisitation-based recovery. Navi-Agent performs closed-loop navigation by decomposing instructions into sub-goals, executing local visual navigation, and verifying visited places through the constructed spatial state. Experiments on zero-shot VLN-CE benchmark and real-world robot platforms show that Navi-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance among geometry-constrained methods while remaining competitive with approaches relying on geometric localization.

AI.title_translation: Navi-Agent：无全局定位的单目导航智能体
AI.tldr: Navi-Agent 提出了一种无需全局坐标和深度信息的零样本单目导航智能体，通过构建拓扑空间状态实现了几何受限条件下的 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 现存零样本连续环境视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）高度依赖几何定位或坐标表示，而在缺乏深度和全局一致坐标的几何受限场景下，难以维持持久的空间感知以实现地点确认、进度验证和故障恢复。
AI.method: 提出了 Navi-Agent 框架，利用视觉观测和运动历史构建无坐标的导航拓扑图（节点为视觉地点，边为运动转移），以此进行近似自定位、任务进度验证和视觉重访恢复；通过分解子目标、执行局部视觉导航和验证已访问地点完成闭环导航。
AI.result: 在零样本 VLN-CE 基准测试及真实机器人平台上的实验表明，Navi-Agent 在几何受限方法中取得了最优性能（SOTA），并能与依赖全局几何定位的方法相媲美。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过结合视觉地点与运动历史的无坐标拓扑表示，智能体无需依赖深度与全局几何定位即可实现鲁棒、闭环的零样本连续视觉语言导航。
AI.translation: 连续环境中的视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）要求具身智能体在未知环境中执行长程指令。现有的零样本 VLN-CE 系统通常通过几何定位或基于坐标的表示来维护空间状态。近期的几何受限导航去除了深度信息和全局一致的坐标，但在地点确认、进度验证和恢复方面维持持久的空间感知仍面临挑战。我们提出了 Navi-Agent，一种零样本 VLN-CE 智能体，它仅利用视觉观测和执行的运动历史构建无坐标的空间状态。Navi-Agent 将该状态组织为一个导航拓扑结构，其中节点代表视觉地点，边代表运动转移。这种表示能够实现基于观测的近似自定位、任务进度验证以及基于视觉重访的恢复。Navi-Agent 通过将指令分解为子目标、执行局部视觉导航并通过所构建的空间状态验证访问地点来执行闭环导航。在零样本 VLN-CE 基准测试和真实世界机器人平台上的实验表明，Navi-Agent 在几何受限方法中达到了最先进的性能，同时仍可与依赖几何定位的方法相媲美。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种无全局坐标定位的单目视觉语言导航智能体 Navi-Agent。它通过视觉感知和运动历史构建拓扑状态图，实现了近似自定位、进度验证与纠错恢复，在无深度信息且受限几何条件下实现了领先的零样本导航性能。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言导航, 零样本导航, 单目视觉, 拓扑地图, 具身智能
AI.comments: 该论文的重要创新在于摆脱了对昂贵深度传感器和全局绝对坐标定位的依赖，创新性地使用视觉观测与动作历史构建无坐标的拓扑图，有效解决了受限单目场景下空间感知、验证与恢复的难题，大幅降低了硬件门槛并提升了在低成本具身机器人上的泛化部署潜力。

title: Parallelism, critical windows, and separations among diffusion language models
comments: 90 pages, v2: previous uploaded version was out-of-date
summary:
A popular selling point of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is their capacity for parallelism: the ability to generate sequences of text far more efficiently than autoregressive models, which require one forward pass per token. Yet among the many competing paradigms for dLLMs, from masked to uniform to Gaussian diffusion, principled understanding of how these different proposals compare in parallelism remains limited. In this work, we initiate a fine-grained comparison of the capacity for parallelism among these three leading approaches and prove the following:
  - Uniform and Gaussian diffusion can sample in a number of forward passes which scales with the dual total correlation of the underlying distribution, a measure of intrinsic complexity which can be much smaller than the context length. Previously, it was only known how to achieve this using masked diffusion.
  - For a certain family of random empirical measures, we show that $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{d})$ forward passes are necessary and sufficient to sample using uniform or Gaussian diffusion, yet there exist approximate score oracles for which $\widetildeΩ(d)$ forward passes are needed for masked diffusion. This establishes the first provable separation in parallelism between the three prevailing dLLM paradigms.
  Contrary to popular intuition that masked diffusions are harder to parallelize because they must commit to token values, the latter separation instead comes from the fact that the critical windows in masked diffusion sampling are asymptotically narrower than those in uniform and Gaussian diffusion sampling.

AI.title_translation: 扩散语言模型中的并行性、关键窗口和分离
AI.tldr: 本文对掩码、均匀和高斯扩散语言模型在并行性方面进行了细致比较，首次证明了它们之间的并行性分离，并揭示了掩码扩散的关键窗口更窄是导致分离的关键原因。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的并行性是其重要优势，但对于不同dLLM范式（掩码、均匀、高斯扩散）在并行性上的表现缺乏原理性理解。本文旨在弥补这一空白，对这些模型的并行能力进行细致比较。
AI.method: 本文通过细致的理论比较和数学证明，对三种主要的扩散大语言模型（掩码、均匀、高斯扩散）的并行性能力进行了分析。
AI.result:
1. 均匀和高斯扩散模型进行采样所需的正向传播次数与底层分布的双重总相关性（一种内在复杂性度量，可能远小于上下文长度）成比例；此前仅知掩码扩散能实现。
2. 对于某些随机经验测度，均匀或高斯扩散模型采样需要$\widetilde{\Theta}(\sqrt{d})$次正向传播，而掩码扩散模型需要$\widetilde{\Omega}(d)$次正向传播（对于近似分数预言机）。
3. 这建立了三种主流dLLM范式在并行性方面的首次可证明分离。
4. 与流行直觉相反，掩码扩散的并行化难度并非因为需要提交token值，而是因为其采样中的关键窗口渐进地比均匀和高斯扩散采样中的关键窗口更窄。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次通过理论证明揭示了掩码、均匀和高斯扩散语言模型在并行性能力上的显著分离，并纠正了关于掩码扩散并行化难度的流行直觉，指出关键窗口宽度是其核心原因。
AI.translation:
扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的一个流行卖点是它们的并行能力：能够比自回归模型更有效地生成文本序列，而自回归模型每个token需要一次前向传播。然而，在众多相互竞争的dLLM范式中，从掩码到均匀再到高斯扩散，对于这些不同提议在并行性方面如何比较的原理性理解仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们对这三种主要方法的并行能力进行了细致的比较，并证明了以下几点：
- 均匀和高斯扩散可以在正向传播次数与底层分布的双重总相关性（一种内在复杂性度量，可能远小于上下文长度）成比例的次数下进行采样。此前，仅知掩码扩散能够实现这一点。
- 对于某些随机经验测度，我们证明了使用均匀或高斯扩散进行采样需要$\widetilde{\Theta}(\sqrt{d})$次正向传播是必要且充分的，然而对于近似分数预言机，掩码扩散需要$\widetilde{\Omega}(d)$次正向传播。这建立了三种主流dLLM范式在并行性方面的首次可证明分离。
与流行直觉（即掩码扩散更难并行化，因为它必须提交token值）相反，后者的分离反而是由于掩码扩散采样中的关键窗口渐进地比均匀和高斯扩散采样中的关键窗口更窄。
AI.summary: 本文对掩码、均匀和高斯扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的并行性能力进行了深入比较。研究发现，均匀和高斯扩散模型可以以与内在复杂性相关的正向传播次数进行采样，并且在特定条件下，它们比掩码扩散模型在并行性上表现出显著优势。本文首次证明了这三种dLLM范式之间的并行性分离，并指出这种分离并非源于掩码扩散必须提交token值，而是由于其采样过程中关键窗口的宽度差异。
AI.keywords: 扩散语言模型, 并行性, 掩码扩散, 均匀扩散, 高斯扩散, 关键窗口
AI.comments: 这项工作通过严谨的理论分析，首次揭示了不同扩散语言模型范式在并行性方面的本质差异，纠正了现有的一些直觉性认知。其创新性在于为理解和设计更高效的并行化扩散模型提供了新的理论基础，特别是在“关键窗口”概念上的洞察具有重要意义。

title: What Does Privileged Information Add to On-Policy Self-Distillation?
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) lets a language model learn from a frozen copy of itself that sees an answer or a worked solution. Giving the teacher this extra information seems to offer the student more to learn, but how much does it add beyond distillation itself? To isolate that contribution, we construct AMPLE-Math, a reusable suite of 5,319 mathematical problems with six reasoning views that share the same answer, and compare each view with matched reference-free distillation. With a thinking-enabled teacher supervising direct-response rollouts, reference-free distillation accounts for much of Qwen3-1.7B's improvement under thinking-enabled evaluation, both in domain and on external benchmarks. Evidence for an additional reference benefit is modest in Qwen, strongest for a polished solution, whereas complete traces add two percentage points in SmolLM3-3B at step 50. These benefits depend on the student being trained. At the same checkpoint, replacing short direct-response rollouts with long thinking-enabled rollouts turns gains into losses in both families while the problems, references, and evaluation stay fixed. Teacher profiles and matched loss interventions in Qwen further show that changing token-level supervision can leave student behavior largely unchanged. Together, these findings suggest that OPSD can improve access to existing reasoning capabilities through parameters shared by direct-response and thinking-enabled inference. The value of a privileged reference is what it adds to this cross-mode transfer, not how much of the solution it reveals.

AI.title_translation: 特权信息对策略自蒸馏有何作用？
AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中特权信息（如答案或完整解决方案）对语言模型学习的额外贡献。通过构建AMPLE-Math数据集并与无参考蒸馏进行比较，发现OPSD的主要收益来自对现有推理能力的访问，而非特权信息本身；特权信息仅带来适度增益，且效果取决于学生模型和训练方式。
AI.motivation: 策略自蒸馏（OPSD）允许语言模型从其自身的冻结副本中学习，而该副本可以看到答案或已解决的方案。作者想探究这种额外的特权信息除了蒸馏本身之外，还能为学生模型带来多少额外的学习收益。
AI.method: 研究构建了一个名为AMPLE-Math的包含5,319个数学问题的可重用数据集，每个问题有六种共享相同答案的推理视角。通过将每种视角与匹配的无参考蒸馏进行比较，并使用一个支持思考的教师模型来监督直接响应的输出，评估了特权信息的贡献。此外，还通过教师配置文件和匹配的损失干预来分析Qwen模型中不同级别监督的影响。
AI.result:
1. 在Qwen3-1.7B模型中，无参考蒸馏解释了大部分在思考能力评估下的改进，无论是在领域内还是在外部基准上。
2. 在Qwen模型中，额外参考信息带来的益处不大，对完善解决方案的效果最强，而完整的痕迹在SmolLM3-3B模型中在第50步增加了两个百分点。
3. 这些益处取决于受训的学生模型。
4. 在相同的检查点，用长思考型输出替换短直接响应输出会导致两种模型家族的收益转为损失，而问题、参考和评估保持不变。
5. Qwen中的教师配置文件和匹配的损失干预表明，改变token级别的监督可能不会显著改变学生模型的行为。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现，OPSD主要通过直接响应和支持思考的推理共享的参数，来提高对现有推理能力的访问。特权信息的价值在于它对这种跨模式迁移的贡献，而不是它揭示了多少解决方案。
AI.translation: 策略自蒸馏（OPSD）使语言模型能够从其自身的冻结副本中学习，该副本可以看到答案或已解决的方案。给教师提供这种额外信息似乎能让学生学到更多，但除了蒸馏本身，它究竟增加了多少？为了分离出这种贡献，我们构建了AMPLE-Math，一个包含5,319个数学问题的可重用套件，具有六种共享相同答案的推理视角，并将每种视角与匹配的无参考蒸馏进行比较。在一个支持思考的教师监督直接响应输出的情况下，无参考蒸馏解释了Qwen3-1.7B模型在思考能力评估下的大部分改进，无论是在领域内还是在外部基准上。在Qwen模型中，额外参考益处的证据不明显，对完善解决方案的效果最强，而完整的痕迹在SmolLM3-3B模型中在第50步增加了两个百分点。这些益处取决于受训的学生模型。在相同的检查点，用长思考型输出替换短直接响应输出会导致两种模型家族的收益转为损失，而问题、参考和评估保持不变。Qwen中的教师配置文件和匹配的损失干预进一步表明，改变token级别的监督可能不会显著改变学生模型的行为。总而言之，这些发现表明OPSD可以通过直接响应和支持思考的推理共享的参数，来提高对现有推理能力的访问。特权信息的价值在于它对这种跨模式迁移的贡献，而不是它揭示了多少解决方案。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中特权信息（如答案或完整解决方案）的实际贡献。通过构建AMPLE-Math数据集并与无参考蒸馏进行对比，发现OPSD的主要收益在于提高语言模型对现有推理能力的访问，而不是特权信息本身。结果表明，在Qwen3-1.7B模型中，无参考蒸馏已能解释大部分性能提升，而特权信息（尤其是完整解决方案）仅带来适度的额外增益，且其效果高度依赖于学生模型和训练配置。研究强调了特权信息的价值在于促进跨模式迁移，而非简单地揭示解决方案。
AI.keywords: 策略自蒸馏, 特权信息, 语言模型, 数学推理, 知识蒸馏
AI.comments: 这项研究深入探讨了策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中特权信息的真正价值，挑战了直观的假设，即更多信息总是更好。其创新之处在于通过精心设计的AMPLE-Math数据集和严格的比较实验，量化了特权信息与无参考蒸馏各自的贡献。论文揭示了OPSD的主要效益可能在于优化模型对现有推理能力的访问，而非简单地注入新知识。这一发现对未来设计更高效的自蒸馏策略具有重要指导意义，可以促使研究者重新思考在知识蒸馏中如何平衡信息量和信息类型。局限性可能在于其结论主要基于特定的语言模型（Qwen和SmolLM）和数学推理任务，其普适性可能需要在更广泛的任务和模型上进行验证。

title: SmellDiffusion: Diffusion-Based Quadruped Navigation with Olfactory Scene Graphs
summary: A robot sent to a named gas leak must preserve gas identity, estimate the source, and navigate to the resulting goal. We present SmellDiffusion, a simulation pipeline that represents species-specific gas zones in an open-vocabulary olfactory scene graph and shares the selected goal between classical and diffusion planners. Its key components are a peak-local geometric gate for selective source correction and diffusion-based, gas-guided trajectory generation. Among 424 unique source-wind configurations in solved flow, 28 have a concentration peak displaced more than 0.5m from the source. A source-independent geometric gate, calibrated only on the training split and evaluated at the observed peak, detects 9 of 10 held-out displacements at 0.64 precision. Gating a precomputed forward-matching correction reduces mean error on the displaced cases from 1.468m to 0.592m (60%), using matching for only 14/204 cases. All-case mean error falls from 0.205m to 0.180m. All planners receive the same scene-graph source estimate as their goal. In a controlled comparison, best-of-ten diffusion achieves mean gas exposure comparable to gas-guided A* (0.0476 versus 0.0455). A single diffusion proposal takes 41.7ms, compared with 72.3ms for gas-guided A*, although best-of-ten sequential sampling increases total runtime. Plain A* also reaches the same goal and remains the fastest and shortest-path method. Six matched Gazebo runs give mean robot-to-source errors of 0.39m for A* and 0.31m for diffusion.

AI.title_translation: SmellDiffusion：基于扩散与嗅觉场景图的四足机器人导航
AI.tldr: SmellDiffusion 结合了嗅觉场景图和扩散模型，实现了四足机器人在复杂气体泄漏环境中的高效气源估计与导航。
AI.motivation: 针对派遣机器人去寻找具名气体泄漏的任务，需要其保持气体特征、估计气源并导航至目标的问题，现有的规划和定位方法在处理浓度峰值与源位置偏移时存在局限，需要更高效鲁棒的导航方案。
AI.method: 提出 SmellDiffusion 仿真流水线，使用开放词汇的嗅觉场景图表示特定气体的区域，并包含用于选择性源校正的峰值局部几何门控以及基于扩散的气体引导轨迹生成。
AI.result: 几何门控显著减少了浓度峰值偏移情况下的源估计误差（从 1.468m 降至 0.592m），扩散规划在 Gazebo 仿真中实现了 0.31m 的平均机器人到气源误差，且单次扩散提议耗时 41.7ms，优于传统气导 A* 算法。
AI.conclusion: SmellDiffusion 通过开放词汇的嗅觉场景图与扩散规划器，成功实现了气源定位与鲁棒的四足机器人导航，在复杂气流环境下表现优异。
AI.translation: 被派往特定气体泄漏点的机器人必须保持气体身份、估计源头并导航至相应目标。我们提出了 SmellDiffusion，这是一个模拟流水线，它在开放词汇的嗅觉场景图中表示特定物种的气体区域，并在经典规划器和扩散规划器之间共享选定的目标。其核心组件是用于选择性源校正的峰值局部几何门控以及基于扩散的气体引导轨迹生成。在解算流场的 424 种独特源-风配置中，有 28 种的浓度峰值距离源头超过 0.5 米。在训练集上校准并在观察到的峰值处评估的与源无关的几何门控，以 0.64 的精确度检测出了 10 个保留位移中的 9 个。使用预计算的前向匹配校正进行门控，使位移情况下的平均误差从 1.468 米降低到 0.592 米（降低了 60%），在 204 种情况中仅有 14 种使用了匹配。所有情况的平均误差从 0.205 米下降到 0.180 米。所有规划器都接收相同的场景图源估计作为其目标。在对照比较中，十选最优的扩散方法实现了与气体引导 A* 可比的平均气体暴露量（0.0476 对比 0.0455）。单个扩散提议耗时 41.7ms，而气体引导 A* 为 72.3ms，尽管十选最优的顺序采样增加了总运行时间。普通 A* 也到达了同一目标，并且仍然是最快和最短路径的方法。六次匹配的 Gazebo 运行给出的平均机器人到源误差为：A* 为 0.39m，扩散方法为 0.31m。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 SmellDiffusion，一种用于四足机器人的扩散基导航方法，它利用开放词汇的嗅觉场景图和峰值局部几何门控进行准确的气源估计，并通过气体引导的扩散规划器生成高效导航轨迹。
AI.keywords: 四足机器人导航, 扩散模型, 嗅觉场景图, 气体泄漏源定位
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种基于扩散模型和嗅觉场景图的四足机器人导航系统 SmellDiffusion，创新性地结合了几何门控与扩散规划器，有效解决了气体泄漏源定位与导航问题，展现出良好的精度与效率。

title: SkipVLA: Skipping VLA Steps with Classical Planning for Fast Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a class of generalist robot policies that map camera images and language instructions directly to robot actions. While promising, these models remain slow at test time, particularly for long-horizon tasks that require many queries to the policy. Recent efforts reduce VLA latency by distilling smaller models, overlapping asynchronous action chunks, or pairing the VLA with a fast low-level policy, but still run a learned policy for the entire task. In contrast to VLA, classical motion planners quickly find collision-free motions, but require an explicit goal and have no semantic understanding of the task. In this work, we present SkipVLA, a hybrid policy that combines a pretrained VLA with a classical motion planner, using the planner for free-space motion and querying the VLA only for contact-rich skills such as grasping and placing. SkipVLA reuses the frozen vision-language backbone of the VLA to predict a target pose for each planned motion, and learns this predictor without additional demonstrations introduced into the system by using what was already learnt by the large VLA. We evaluate SkipVLA with three VLAs on 13 LIBERO tasks in simulation and three pick-and-place tasks on a physical 6-DoF YAM arm, demonstrating up to 2.5x faster task completion and significantly lower energy consumption while achieving the same task success rate.

title: DexTouch-WM: Learning Action-Conditioned Tactile World Models from Human Touch for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
comments: Accept to IROS 2026 Workshop RoBoWoMo (Lightning Talk)
summary: Learning predictive models of contact-rich dexterous manipulation requires dense tactile interaction, but such data are costly to scale on real robots and remain tied to embodiment-specific sensors. We introduce DexTouch-WM, an action-conditioned world model that learns from scalable human touch to jointly predict future RGB observations and bilateral tactile dynamics. Our insight is that human and robot manipulation share transferable contact dynamics when their tactile observations and action spaces are made compatible. We deploy flexible piezoresistive arrays with a shared sensing layout on both human and dexterous robot hands, and retarget human motion into the robot action space so that human interaction can supervise the same dynamics model used for real-robot prediction. DexTouch-WM couples a pretrained video expert with a lightweight tactile expert using anatomy-aware tactile tokens and aligned action conditioning. In human-to-robot scaling experiments, we keep five hours of real-robot supervision fixed while increasing human interaction from 0 to 100 hours, and observe substantial improvements in held-out robot-domain visual, geometric, and contact prediction despite disjoint human and robot task sets. Beyond prediction, we evaluate the world models as surrogate environments for policy evaluation and as generators of synthetic trajectories for real-robot policy learning, showing that scalable human interaction provides a complementary data axis for learning dexterous robot world models.

title: Multi-Objective Hyperparameter Search via Damped Gauss--Newton Optimization
summary: We study hyperparameter optimization (HPO) from a numerical-optimization perspective and propose a multi-objective damped Newton--Gauss--Newton search method. Rather than perturbing each hyperparameter separately or treating model evaluations as independent trials, the method uses performance changes between successive full hyperparameter vectors to construct an iterative secant approximation of the local sensitivity matrix. Each iteration therefore requires only one new full-vector model evaluation while jointly updating all optimized hyperparameters. A Tikhonov-regularized Gauss--Newton system stabilizes the update when the number of hyperparameters exceeds the number of performance objectives. The search is initialized from readily available empirical/default settings of the underlying learner, without requiring a separate initialization search. We evaluate four-dimensional XGBoost HPO on three public classification datasets against exhaustive grid search, random search, and tree-structured Parzen estimator (TPE) optimization. On Breast Cancer Wisconsin, the proposed method matches the best validation accuracy of a 320-configuration grid search with slightly better log loss and ROC--AUC. Across three datasets and three seeds, predictive performance remains competitive with random search and TPE while using substantially fewer search iterations. A supplementary proprietary eight-dimensional threshold-optimization case study further demonstrates joint multi-parameter optimization under competing performance targets and reveals non-monotonic, oscillatory trajectories that motivate damping and best-iterate selection. Overall, the results establish iterative secant sensitivity as an evaluation-efficient local alternative to exhaustive HPO.

title: Loops, Inverse Limits and Non-Determinism
summary: We introduce an operator on problems in Weihrauch complexity, which we call the infinite loop or inverse limit, and which corresponds to an infinite compositional product. This operation arises naturally whenever one implements algorithms that produce a sequence of results in an infinite loop, using some fixed subroutine. We prove that the corresponding operator is monotone with respect to (strong) Weihrauch reducibility but that it is not a closure operator. One of our findings is that weak Kőnig's lemma is closed under infinite loops, which implies that the class of non-deterministically computable problems is also closed under this operation. Consequently, this class allows for a high degree of flexibility in programming. As our main technical tools, we present an injective version of the recursion theorem and an infinitary version of the so-called independent choice theorem. We also show that, in general, the infinite loop operator is more powerful than the composition of the diamond operator followed by the parallelization operator. However, in many practical scenarios, these compositions yield a result, which coincides with the application of the infinite loop operator. Finally, we discuss the special situation of loops for single-valued problems and for problems on Turing degrees.

title: From In Silico to In Vitro: A Comprehensive Guide to Validating Bioinformatics Findings
comments: 12 pages. Published version. Revised to match the version of record; title, author list, abstract, and text updated
summary: Translating computational predictions into experimentally validated biological knowledge remains one of the central challenges in modern bioinformatics. This review critically examines how in silico findings can be prioritized, tested, and interpreted through experimental validation. We organize the validation process around three recurring challenges: the specificity gap between genome-wide computational predictions and single-target experimental assays; the reproducibility-translatability tension, in which results validated in one model system may not generalize to another; and the scale-depth trade-off between high-throughput candidate discovery and the low-throughput nature of mechanistic validation. Rather than presenting an encyclopedic catalogue of techniques, we compare the strengths, limitations, and common failure modes of major validation approaches, including qPCR, RNA-seq, Western blotting, co-immunoprecipitation, luciferase reporter assays, CRISPR perturbation, and functional phenotypic assays. We also provide structured comparison tables for gene expression, protein-protein interaction, non-coding RNA, regulatory element, and pathway validation, together with decision-making frameworks to guide method selection according to prediction type, biological context, evidence stringency, throughput, and resource constraints. Case studies from cancer genomics, drug target discovery, miRNA regulation, and neurological disease illustrate how multi-step validation workflows can strengthen causal inference and reduce false-positive interpretation. Finally, we discuss how emerging technologies, including CRISPR screens, single-cell and spatial multi-omics, and AI-assisted experimental design, may reshape validation practice by improving scalability, context specificity, and reproducibility.

title: Physically Grounded Monocular Depth via Nanophotonic Wavefront Encoding
summary: Depth foundation models (DFMs) offer strong learned priors for 3D perception from single RGB images but lack physical depth cues, leading to ambiguities in metric scale. We introduce metalenses, an emerging class of ultrathin planar optical elements, as a solution to physically encode missing metric depth cues via nanophotonics. In this paper, we bridge the gap between metalens and DFMs to achieve accurate metric monocular depth sensing. In a single monocular shot, our metalens embeds depth-dependent positional shifts into two polarized optical wavefronts. With an input adaptation strategty, we enable direct fine-tuning that aligns a pretrained DFM with the optical signals. To scale the training data, we further develop a comprehensive simulation pipeline that synthesizes metalens responses from RGB-D datasets, incorporating physical factors to minimize the sim-to-real gap. Experiments demonstrate that this approach outperforms both monocular metric depth estimation and depth-from-defocus baselines, showing an effective pathway for accurate monocular metric depth sensing.

title: Ranking Quantilized Mean-Field Games with an Application to Early-Stage Venture Investments
summary: Quantilized mean-field game models involve quantiles of the population's distribution. We study a class of such games with a capacity for ranking games, where the performance of each agent is evaluated based on its terminal state relative to the population's $α$-quantile value, $α\in (0,1)$. This evaluation criterion is designed to select the top $(1-α)\%$ performing agents. We provide two formulations for this competition: a target-based formulation and a threshold-based formulation. In the former and latter formulations, to satisfy the selection condition, each agent aims for its terminal state to be exactly equal and at least equal to the population's $α$-quantile value, respectively. For the target-based formulation, we obtain an analytic solution and demonstrate the $ε$-Nash property for the asymptotic best-response strategies in the $N$-player game. Specifically, the quantilized mean-field consistency condition is expressed as a set of forward-backward ordinary differential equations, characterizing the $α$-quantile value at equilibrium. For the threshold-based formulation, we obtain a semi-explicit solution and numerically solve the resulting quantilized mean-field consistency condition. Subsequently, we propose a new application in the context of early-stage venture investments, where a venture capital firm financially supports a group of start-up companies engaged in a competition over a finite time horizon, with the goal of selecting a percentage of top-ranking ones to receive the next round of funding at the end of the time horizon. We present the results and interpretations of a set of numerical experiments for both formulations discussed in this context, which illustrate that the target-based formulation closely approximates the threshold-based formulation in the scenarios considered.

title: Robust Mixture Models for Algorithmic Fairness Under Latent Heterogeneity
summary: Machine learning models optimized for average performance can perform poorly on vulnerable subpopulations. Existing approaches often rely on groups specified in advance, yet fairness-relevant subgroup structure may be latent, intersectional, and driven by complex interactions among continuous and discrete attributes. We introduce \textbf{ROME} (\textbf{\underline{RO}}bust \textbf{\underline{M}}ixture \textbf{\underline{E}}nsemble), a framework that learns latent group structure while optimizing worst-group predictive performance. ROME connects latent-variable modeling with distributionally robust optimization (DRO) through two complementary approaches: an Expectation-Maximization formulation with robust aggregation for linear models and a neural Mixture-of-Experts formulation for nonlinear settings. Across simulations and three real-world regression datasets, ROME improves worst-group performance while maintaining competitive overall accuracy, including in comparisons with established group-aware and group-label-free robust learning methods. ROME provides a flexible approach to robust prediction when fairness-relevant attributes are available for subgroup discovery but their direct use in group-specific outcome models is restricted.

title: A regret minimization approach to fixed-point iterations
summary: We propose a conversion scheme that turns regret minimizing algorithms into fixed point iterations, with convergence guarantees following from regret bounds. The resulting iterations can be seen as a grand extension of the classical Krasnoselskii--Mann iterations, as the latter are recovered by converting the Online Gradient Descent algorithm. This approach yields new simple iterations for finding fixed points of non-self operators. We also focus on converting algorithms from the AdaGrad family of regret minimizers, and thus obtain fixed point iterations with adaptive guarantees of a new kind. Numerical experiments on various problems demonstrate faster convergence of AdaGrad-based fixed point iterations over Krasnoselskii--Mann iterations.

title: Deep Learning-Enhanced Real-Time Wi-Fi Sensing Through Single Transceiver Pair
summary: The advancement of next-generation Wi-Fi technology heavily relies on sensing capabilities, which play a pivotal role in enabling sophisticated applications. In response to the growing demand for large-scale deployments, contemporary Wi-Fi sensing systems strive to achieve high-precision perception while maintaining minimal bandwidth consumption and antenna count requirements. Remarkably, various deep learning-driven perception technologies have demonstrated the ability to surpass conventional resolution limits. However, the theoretical underpinnings of this phenomenon have not been thoroughly investigated in existing research. We find that under hardware-constrained conditions, the performance gains of deep learning in Wi-Fi sensing primarily originate from two aspects: prior information and temporal correlation, which act as specific forms of side information that reduce the estimation error bound. We construct a deep learning-based Wi-Fi sensing system using only a single transceiver pair and design experiments to validate these gains. The system achieves an average human pose estimation error of 0.2189 m and an average localization error of 0.6124 m, while operating in real time at 42 fps on commodity hardware.

title: Understanding Structural Representation in Foundation Models for Polymers
summary: From the relative scarcity of training data to the lack of standardized benchmarks, the creation of effective foundation models for polymers faces significant and multi-faceted challenges. At the core, many of these issues are tied directly to the structural representation of polymers. Here, we present a chemical language foundation model built on using a SMILES-based polymer graph representation (CPG) that incorporates polymer architectural features and connectivity that are often missing in other line notations. This foundation model exhibited excellent performance on 30 different polymer property benchmark datasets. Critical evaluation of the developed representation against other variations in control experiments reveals this approach to be a robust method of representing polymers in language-based foundation models. These experiments also reveal a strong invariance of structural representations to small perturbations, with many variations of structural representation exceeding or equaling state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Surprisingly, SMILES representations which are chemically or semantically invalid also provided near or SOTA performance in several instances--underscoring an unexamined blind spot in the development of chemistry language models. Examination of error sources and attention maps for the evaluated structural representations corroborate the findings of the control experiments, highlighting the ability of the model to interpolate SMILES sequence space in a manner that is loosely congruent to chemical and architectural space for polymers. Overall, this work highlights the surprising robustness of chemistry language models to structural representation perturbations and identifies the conditions under which CPG representation provides meaningful advantages.

title: Boltzmann generators for amorphous particle systems
comments: 30 pages, 10 figures. V2 considerably expands the results compared to v1. V3 accepted for publications in J. Chem. Phys
summary: Sampling configurations in thermodynamic equilibrium is a long-standing challenge in statistical physics. Boltzmann generators address this problem by employing generative models to propose independent configurations, which are then reweighted via importance sampling using exact likelihood evaluations. Recent Boltzmann Generators based on continuous normalizing flows and flow matching have achieved significant success for particle systems and biomolecules. However, these approaches have not been extended to amorphous materials (glasses), for which equilibrium sampling is notoriously slow. Because of their disordered structure, the invariances and geometrical constraints of amorphous materials differ from those of crystals and biomolecules, preventing the direct use of existing generative models. Here, we develop Boltzmann Generators tailored to amorphous materials by building the required equivariances directly into Riemannian stochastic interpolants. Our framework incorporates periodic boundary conditions and particle symmetries using equivariant graph neural networks. Numerical experiments demonstrate that enforcing physical symmetries significantly improves the accuracy of Boltzmann Generators, but also reveal an intrinsic limitation of the continuous-flow formulation: accumulated numerical errors during likelihood integration break time-reversibility, compromising exact thermodynamic reweighting. These results reveal a fundamental challenge for continuous-flow generative models in statistical mechanics and call for alternative approaches that preserve exact thermodynamic consistency.

title: Channel Estimation in MIMO Systems Aided by Microwave Linear Analog Computers (MiLACs)
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Wireless Communications Letters
summary: Microwave linear analog computers (MiLACs) have recently emerged as a promising solution for future gigantic multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, enabling beamforming with greatly reduced hardware and computational cost. However, channel estimation for MiLAC-aided systems remains an open problem. Conventional least squares (LS) and minimum mean square error (MMSE) estimation rely on intensive digital computation, which undermines the computational advantage offered by MiLACs. In this letter, we propose efficient LS and MMSE channel estimation schemes for MiLAC-aided MIMO systems. By designing the training precoder and combiner implemented by lossless and reciprocal MiLACs, the proposed schemes perform LS and MMSE estimation in the analog domain, leaving only simple digital scaling. They achieve identical estimation performance to their digital counterparts while significantly reducing computational complexity. Numerical results verify the effectiveness of the proposed schemes.

title: Cross-Country Learning for National Infectious Disease Forecasting Using European Data
comments: 7 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables, Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC 2026), Toronto, Canada
summary: Accurate forecasting of infectious disease incidence is critical for public health planning and timely intervention. While most data-driven forecasting approaches rely primarily on historical data from a single country, such data are often limited in length and variability, restricting the performance of machine learning (ML) models. In this work, we investigate a cross-country learning approach for infectious disease forecasting, in which a single model is trained on time series data from multiple countries and evaluated on a country of interest. This setting enables the model to exploit shared epidemic dynamics across countries and to benefit from an enlarged training set. We examine this approach through a case study on COVID-19 case forecasting in Cyprus, using surveillance data of European countries. We evaluate multiple models and analyse the impact of the lookback window length and cross-country 'data augmentation' on multi-step forecasting performance. The results show that combining data from other countries can lead to consistent improvements over models trained solely on national data. Although the focus is on Cyprus and COVID-19, the framework and findings provide promising insights for infectious disease forecasting in settings with limited national data.

title: Near-Universal Multiplicative Updates for Nonnegative Einsum Factorization
summary: Despite the ubiquity of multiway data across scientific domains, there are few performant and user-friendly methods that fit non-standard nonnegative tensor factorization models tailored to the data at-hand. Researchers may use gradient-based automatic differentiation, which often struggles under nonnegative constraints, choose between a limited set of methods with mature implementations, or implement their own model from scratch. As an alternative, we introduce NNEinFact, an einsum-based multiplicative update algorithm that fits any nonnegative tensor factorization expressible as a tensor contraction by minimizing one of many user-specified loss functions, including the $(α,β)$-divergence. To use NNEinFact, the researcher specifies their model with a string. NNEinFact converges to a stationary point of the loss, supports missing data, and fits to tensors with hundreds of millions of entries in seconds. Empirically, NNEinFact fits custom models which outperform standard ones in prediction tasks on real-world tensor data by over $37\%$ and attains less than half the test loss of gradient-based methods while converging up to 90 times faster. Software is publicly available at https://github.com/jhood3/einfact.

title: Neural ensemble Kalman filter: Data assimilation for compressible flows with shocks
summary: Data assimilation (DA) for compressible flows with shocks is challenging because many classical DA methods generate spurious oscillations and nonphysical features near uncertain shocks. We focus here on the ensemble Kalman filter (EnKF). We show that the poor performance of the EnKF may be attributed to the bimodal forecast distribution that can arise in the vicinity of an uncertain shock location; this violates the assumptions underpinning the EnKF, which assume a forecast which is close to Gaussian. To address this issue we introduce the new neural EnKF. The basic idea is to systematically embed neural function approximations within ensemble DA by mapping the forecast ensemble of shocked flows to the parameter space (weights and biases) of a deep neural network (NN) and to subsequently perform DA in that space. The nonlinear mapping encodes sharp and smooth flow features in an ensemble of NN parameters. Neural EnKF updates are therefore well-behaved only if the NN parameters vary smoothly within the neural representation of the forecast ensemble. We show that such a smooth variation of network parameters can be enforced via physics-informed transfer learning, and demonstrate that in so-doing the neural EnKF avoids the spurious oscillations and nonphysical features that plague the EnKF. The applicability of the neural EnKF is demonstrated through a series of systematic numerical experiments with the inviscid Burgers' equation, the Sod shock tube, and a two-dimensional blast wave.

title: VideoPulse: Neonatal heart rate and peripheral capillary oxygen saturation (SpO2) estimation from contact free video
authors: Udaya S. K. P. Miriya Thanthrige
comments: Revised manuscript with updated methodology, figures, evaluation details, references, ethics and data availability statements. The manuscript has been aligned with the version being prepared for submission to an IEEE Journal
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables contact free monitoring of vital signs and is especially valuable for neonates, since conventional methods often require sustained skin contact with adhesive probes that can irritate fragile skin and increase infection control burden. We present VideoPulse, a neonatal dataset and an end to end pipeline that estimates neonatal heart rate and peripheral capillary oxygen saturation (SpO2) from facial video. VideoPulse contains 157 recordings totaling 2.6 hours from 52 neonates with diverse face orientations. Our pipeline performs face alignment and artifact aware supervision using denoised pulse oximeter signals, then applies 3D CNN backbones for heart rate and SpO2 regression with label distribution smoothing and weighted regression for SpO2. Predictions are produced in 2 second windows. On the NBHR neonatal dataset, we obtain heart rate MAE 2.97 bpm using 2 second windows (2.80 bpm at 6 second windows) and SpO2 MAE 1.69 percent. Under cross dataset evaluation, the NBHR trained heart rate model attains 5.34 bpm MAE on VideoPulse, and fine tuning an NBHR pretrained SpO2 model on VideoPulse yields MAE 1.68 percent. These results indicate that short unaligned neonatal video segments can support accurate heart rate and SpO2 estimation, enabling low cost non invasive monitoring in neonatal intensive care.

title: Transcriptomic Models for Immunotherapy Response Prediction Show Limited Cross-cohort Generalisability
summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have transformed cancer therapy; yet substantial proportion of patients exhibit intrinsic or acquired resistance, making accurate pre-treatment response prediction a critical unmet need. Transcriptomics-based biomarkers derived from bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) offer a promising avenue for capturing tumour-immune interactions, yet the cross-cohort generalisability of existing prediction models remains unclear.We systematically benchmark nine state-of-the-art transcriptomic ICI response predictors, five bulk RNA-seq-based models (COMPASS, IRNet, NetBio, IKCScore, and TNBC-ICI) and four scRNA-seq-based models (PRECISE, DeepGeneX, Tres and scCURE), using publicly available independent datasets unseen during model development. Overall, predictive performance was modest: bulk RNA-seq models performed at or near chance level across most cohorts, while scRNA-seq models showed only marginal improvements. Pathway-level analyses revealed sparse and inconsistent biomarker signals across models. Although scRNA-seq-based predictors converged on immune-related programs such as allograft rejection, bulk RNA-seq-based models exhibited little reproducible overlap. PRECISE and NetBio identified the most coherent immune-related themes, whereas IRNet predominantly captured metabolic pathways weakly aligned with ICI biology. Together, these findings demonstrate the limited cross-cohort robustness and biological consistency of current transcriptomic ICI prediction models, underscoring the need for improved domain adaptation, standardised preprocessing, and biologically grounded model design.

title: Amortized Filtering and Smoothing with Conditional Normalizing Flows
summary: Bayesian filtering and smoothing are central to data assimilation in nonlinear dynamical systems. Recent advances in deep generative models provide flexible approximations of the associated non-Gaussian posterior distributions. However, several existing approaches require the score to be re-estimated or a transport map to be constructed at each assimilation step. We propose an amortized framework for filtering and smoothing that reuses trained conditional models across observation sequences and assimilation times. The framework jointly learns a shared recurrent summary network and two conditional normalizing flows from simulated state and observation trajectories. The recurrent network represents each observation history by a fixed-dimensional summary that conditions the filtering approximation and, together with the next state, the backward transition approximation. An information-theoretic analysis shows that, under the Markov assumption, a summary sufficient for filtering is also sufficient for the backward kernel. Combining the terminal filtering approximation with the backward kernels yields an approximate joint smoothing distribution. Numerical experiments on advection-diffusion, Burgers, and Lorenz systems demonstrate the accuracy of the proposed filtering and smoothing approximations and characterize the evolution of their errors beyond the training horizon.

AI.result: 在平流-扩散、Burgers和Lorenz系统上的数值实验表明，该方法在过滤和向后平滑近似方面具有准确性，并能表征训练范围之外的误差演变。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的摊销框架能够有效地进行过滤和向后平滑处理，其准确性在多个动力学系统中得到了验证，并且能够超越训练范围进行误差演变分析。
AI.translation: 贝叶斯滤波和平滑是处理非线性动力学系统数据同化的核心。深度生成模型的最新进展为此类非高斯后验分布提供了灵活的近似方法。然而，现有的几种方法需要在每次同化步骤中重新估计分数或构建传输映射。我们提出了一种用于滤波和平滑的摊销框架，该框架可以跨观测序列和同化时间重复使用训练好的条件模型。该框架联合学习一个共享的循环摘要网络和两个条件归一化流，以模拟的状态和观测轨迹为基础。该循环网络将每个观测历史表示为一个固定维度的摘要，该摘要对滤波近似进行条件化，并与下一个状态一起对向后转移近似进行条件化。信息论分析表明，在马尔可夫假设下，对滤波过程充分的摘要也对向后核充分。将末端滤波近似与向后核结合，可以得到一个近似的联合平滑分布。在平流-扩散、Burgers和Lorenz系统上的数值实验证明了所提出的滤波和平滑近似的准确性，并表征了它们在训练范围之外的误差演变。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于非线性动力学系统数据同化的摊销滤波与平滑框架。该框架利用条件归一化流和循环摘要网络，能够跨序列和时间重复使用训练模型，有效近似非高斯后验分布，并实现了高效准确的滤波和向后平滑处理。
AI.keywords: 摊销滤波, 摊销平滑, 条件归一化流, 数据同化, 循环摘要网络
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的摊销方法，用于解决贝叶斯滤波和平滑中的计算挑战。通过重复使用训练好的模型，该方法有望显著提高数据同化的效率。信息论分析为框架的理论基础提供了支持。然而，实际应用中模型的训练复杂度和对模拟数据的依赖性可能是需要进一步研究的方面。

title: Incentive Design without Hypergradients: A Social-Gradient Method
summary: In incentive design problems, a system planner seeks to steer self-interested agents toward a socially optimal Nash equilibrium by issuing incentives in the presence of information asymmetry, that is, uncertainty about the agents' cost functions. A common approach formulates the problem as a Mathematical Program with Equilibrium Constraints and optimizes incentives using hypergradients-the total derivatives of the planner's objective with respect to incentives. However, computing the hypergradient typically requires full or partial knowledge of equilibrium sensitivities to incentives, which is generally unavailable under information asymmetry. In this paper, we propose a hypergradient-free incentive law, called the social-gradient flow, for incentive design when the social cost depends on the agents' joint action. We prove that the social cost gradient is a descent direction for the planner's objective, irrespective of the agent cost landscape. In the idealized setting where equilibrium responses are observable, the social-gradient flow converges to the unique socially optimal incentive. When equilibria are not directly observable, the social-gradient flow emerges as the slow-timescale limit of a two-timescale interaction, in which agents' strategies evolve on a faster timescale. We establish that the joint strategy-incentive dynamics converge to the social optimum for any agent learning rule that asymptotically tracks the equilibrium. Finally, we validate theoretical results via numerical experiments.

AI.title_translation: 无超梯度激励设计：一种社会梯度方法
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为“社会梯度流”的无超梯度激励设计方法，用于在信息不对称的情况下引导自利代理人达到社会最优纳什均衡。该方法通过代理人的联合行动来计算社会成本梯度，并证明其是优化器目标函数的下降方向，无需了解均衡对激励的敏感性。在理想情况下，该方法可收敛于唯一的社会最优激励；在无法直接观察均衡的情况下，该方法是双时间尺度交互的慢时间尺度极限，并可与任何渐近跟踪均衡的代理学习规则一起收敛到社会最优。
AI.motivation: 在激励设计问题中，系统规划者希望通过在信息不对称（即代理人成本函数不确定）的情况下发放激励，来引导自利代理人达到社会最优纳什均衡。然而，计算超梯度通常需要了解均衡对激励的敏感性，而在信息不对称的情况下，这通常是不可用的。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“社会梯度流”的无超梯度激励设计方法。该方法计算社会成本梯度，并证明它是规划者目标函数的下降方向，无需了解均衡对激励的敏感性。在无法直接观察均衡的情况下，该方法是双时间尺度交互的慢时间尺度极限，其中代理人的策略在更快的时标上演化。
AI.result: 证明了社会成本梯度是规划者目标函数的下降方向，并且在理想情况下（可观察均衡响应）收敛于唯一的社会最优激励。在无法直接观察均衡的情况下，该方法作为双时间尺度交互的慢时间尺度极限，与任何渐近跟踪均衡的代理学习规则一起收敛到社会最优。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的社会梯度流方法提供了一种在信息不对称情况下进行激励设计的新途径，无需计算超梯度，并能在不同可观察性假设下收敛到社会最优。
AI.translation: 在激励设计问题中，系统规划者希望通过在信息不对称（即代理人成本函数不确定）的情况下发放激励，来引导自利代理人达到社会最优纳什均衡。一种常见的方法是将问题构建为具有均衡约束的数学程序，并使用超梯度（规划者目标函数相对于激励的总导数）来优化激励。然而，计算超梯度通常需要了解均衡对激励的完全或部分敏感性，而在信息不对称的情况下，这通常是不可用的。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于激励设计的无超梯度激励法则，称为社会梯度流，当社会成本取决于代理人的联合行动时。我们证明了社会成本梯度是规划者目标函数的下降方向，与代理人成本格局无关。在可以观察到均衡响应的理想化设置中，社会梯度流收敛于唯一的社会最优激励。当均衡不能直接观察时，社会梯度流作为双时间尺度交互的慢时间尺度极限出现，其中代理人的策略在更快的时标上演化。我们证明，对于任何渐近跟踪均衡的代理学习规则，联合策略-激励动力学都收敛于社会最优。最后，我们通过数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“社会梯度流”的激励设计方法，用于解决信息不对称下引导自利代理人达到社会最优纳什均衡的问题。该方法避免了计算复杂的超梯度，而是利用社会成本梯度作为优化方向，并证明了其有效性。研究表明，该方法在理想情况下能收敛到最优激励，在更现实的场景下，通过与代理学习规则相结合，也能实现社会最优。
AI.keywords: 激励设计, 社会梯度流, 信息不对称, 纳什均衡, 无超梯度
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的激励设计方法，解决了传统方法在信息不对称下计算超梯度的难题。其理论分析严谨，并得到了数值实验的验证，具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，该方法在实际应用中的可扩展性和计算效率仍需进一步研究。

title: On quantum functionals for higher-order tensors
comments: 28 pages; v2 shows new obstructions to asymptotic restrictions beyond previously known spectral points
summary:
Upper and lower quantum functionals, introduced by Christandl, Vrana and Zuiddam (STOC 2018, J. Amer. Math. Soc. 2023), are families of monotone functions of tensors indexed by a weighting on the set of subsets of the tensor legs. Inspired by quantum information theory, they were crafted as obstructions to asymptotic tensor transformations, relevant in algebraic complexity theory. For tensors of order three, and more generally for weightings on singletons for higher-order tensors, the upper and lower quantum functionals coincide and are spectral points in Strassen's asymptotic spectrum. Moreover, the singleton quantum functionals characterize the asymptotic slice rank, whereas general weightings provide upper bounds on asymptotic partition rank. It has been an open question whether the upper and lower quantum functionals also coincide for other cases, or more generally, how to construct further spectral points, especially for higher-order tensors.
  In this work, we show that upper and lower quantum functionals generally do not coincide, but that they anchor new spectral points. With this we mean that there exist new spectral points, which equal the quantum functionals on the set of tensors on which upper and lower coincide. The set is shown to include embedded three-tensors and W-like states and concerns all laminar weightings, significantly extending the singleton case. Moreover, it is shown that these spectral points provide obstructions to asymptotic restriction beyond the previously known spectral points.
comment: 28 pages; v2 shows new obstructions to asymptotic restrictions beyond previously known spectral points

AI.title_translation: 关于高阶张量的量子泛函
AI.tldr: 论文证明了高阶张量的上下量子泛函通常不重合，但它们能够锚定新的谱点，从而为渐近张量变换提供了更强的限制。
AI.motivation: 解决关于高阶张量的上下量子泛函是否在其他情况下重合，以及如何为高阶张量构建更多谱点的长期公开问题。
AI.method: 通过理论分析研究高阶张量的上下量子泛函，检验其在一般情况下的重合性，并探索基于层状权重的广义子集上的谱点构造。
AI.result: 证明了上下量子泛函在一般情况下并不重合，但它们锚定了新的谱点；该结论适用于嵌入的三阶张量、W类状态以及所有层状权重，且这些新谱点提供了更强的渐近限制障碍。
AI.conclusion: 高阶张量的上下量子泛函通常不重合，但它们能锚定新的谱点，从而提供了超越以往的渐近限制障碍。
AI.translation:
由Christandl、Vrana和Zuiddam（STOC 2018，J. Amer. Math. Soc. 2023）引入的上、下量子泛函，是一类由张量腿子集上的权重索引的张量单调函数族。受量子信息论的启发，它们被设计为渐近张量变换的阻碍，这在代数复杂性理论中是相关的。对于三阶张量，以及更一般的高阶张量上的单元素权重，上、下量子泛函是一致的，并且是施特拉森（Strassen）渐近谱中的谱点。此外，单元素量子泛函表征了渐近切片秩，而一般的权重则提供了渐近分划秩的上界。上、下量子泛函在其他情况下是否也一致，或者更一般地，如何构建进一步的谱点，特别是对于高阶张量，一直是一个公开问题。
在这项工作中，我们表明上、下量子泛函通常不一致，但它们锚定了新的谱点。我们的意思是存在新的谱点，它们在上、下量子泛函一致的张量集上等于这些量子泛函。该集合被证明包括嵌入的三维张量和类W状态，并涉及所有层状权重，显著扩展了单元素情况。此外，结果表明这些谱点提供了超越先前已知谱点的渐近限制阻碍。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了高阶张量的量子泛函，证明了上下量子泛函在一般情况下不重合，但能够锚定新的谱点，从而扩展了对渐近张量变换的理解并提供了更强的复杂性理论障碍。
AI.keywords: 量子泛函, 高阶张量, 渐近谱点, 代数复杂性理论, 渐近限制障碍
AI.comments: 该论文解决了量子泛函理论中的一个长期公开问题，证明了高阶张量的高阶权重上下量子泛函通常不重合，并成功构建了新的谱点，为代数复杂性理论中的渐近张量变换研究提供了强有力的工具。

title: Tree-independence number of $P_5$-free graphs with no large bicliques
comments: An abridged version of this manuscript was published at the European Symposium on Algorithms (ESA 2026)
summary: The tree-independence number of a graph is the minimum, over all tree-decompositions of the graph, of the maximum size of an independent set contained in a bag. Graph classes of bounded tree-independence number have strong structural and algorithmic properties; however, the parameter can be unbounded even in quite restricted classes. In particular, the presence of an induced biclique $K_{\ell,\ell}$ forces tree-independence number at least $\ell$. This leads to the question whether large induced bicliques are the only obstruction to bounded tree-independence number in natural hereditary classes. A conjecture of Dallard, Krnc, Kwon, Milanič, Munaro, Štorgel, and Wiederrecht states that for all positive integers $t$ and $\ell$, ${\{P_t,K_{\ell,\ell}\}}$-free graphs have bounded tree-independence number. We prove this conjecture for ${t=5}$ by showing that every ${\{P_5,K_{\ell,\ell}\}}$-free graph has tree-independence number at most ${4\ell-4}$. We also obtain related bounds for the weaker parameter of $α$-degeneracy and answer a question of Hilaire, Milanič, and Vasić whether tree-independence number of ${\{P_5,K_{\ell,\ell}\}}$-free graphs exceeds $\ell$ by at most an additive constant.
comment: An abridged version of this manuscript was published at the European Symposium on Algorithms (ESA 2026)

AI.title_translation: 无大双团的P5-free图的树独立数
AI.tldr: 本文证明了无P5且无大双团(K_{l,l})的图具有有界的树独立数（至多为4l-4），验证了一个著名的图论猜想。
AI.motivation: 探索图类中限制树独立数有界的阻碍因素，验证Dallard等人的猜想：即对于所有的正整数t和l，{P_t, K_{l,l}}-free图是否具有有界的树独立数。
AI.method: 通过理论证明方法，展示了每个{P5, K_{l,l}}-free图的树独立数至多为4l-4，并给出了关于\alpha-退化性的相关界限。
AI.result: 证明了对于t=5的情况，每个{P5, K_{l,l}}-free图的树独立数至多为4l-4，并解答了关于树独立数是否仅超出一个加性常数的问题。
AI.conclusion: 证明了所有{P5, K_{l,l}}-free图的树独立数是有界的，上限至多为4l-4，从而证实了相关猜想，并回答了关于加性常数的问题。
AI.translation: 图的树独立数是指在图的所有树分解中，包中所含独立集的最大大小的最小值。树独立数有界的图类具有很强的结构和算法性质；然而，即使在相当受限的图类中，该参数也可能是无界的。特别是，导出双团 $K_{\ell,\ell}$ 的存在迫使树独立数至少为 $\ell$。这引发了一个问题：大导出双团是否是自然遗传类中限制树独立数有界的唯一障碍。Dallard、Krnc、Kwon、Milanič、Munaro、Štorgel和Wiederrecht的一个猜想表明，对于所有正 integers $t$ 和 $\ell$，${\{P_t,K_{\ell,\ell}\}}$-free 图具有有界的树独立数。我们通过证明每个 ${\{P_5,K_{\ell,\ell}\}}$-free 图的树独立数至多为 ${4\ell-4}$，证明了该猜想在 ${t=5}$ 时的成立。我们还获得了关于较弱参数 $\alpha$-退化性的相关界限，并回答了 Hilaire、Milanič 和 Vasić 关于 ${\{P_5,K_{\ell,\ell}\}}$-free 图的树独立数是否最多超过 $\ell$ 一个加性常数的问题。
AI.summary: 本文研究了无P5且无大双团图的树独立数，成功证明了当t=5时，{P5, K_{l,l}}-free图的树独立数是有界的，上限为4l-4，从而验证了Dallard等人的猜想。
AI.keywords: 树独立数, P5-free图, 双团, 图论, 猜想证明
AI.comments: 该论文成功证明了一个关于无P5且无大双团图的树独立数有界性的重要猜想，对结构图论和图算法的研究具有重要推动作用。

title: The critical slowing down in training diffusion models
summary: Computational sampling has been central to the sciences since the mid-20th century. While machine-learning-based approaches have recently enabled major advances, their behavior remains poorly understood, with limited theoretical control over when and why they succeed. Here we provide such insight for diffusion models---a class of generative schemes highly effective in practice---by analyzing their application to the $O(n)$ model of statistical field theory in the Gaussian limit $n \to \infty$. In this analytically tractable setting, we show that training a score model with a one-layer network architecture matching the exact solution exhibits a form of critical slowing down in parameter learning. This slowing down also impacts the generation process, indicating that the well-known difficulties of sampling near criticality persist even for learned generative models. To overcome this bottleneck, we consider the power of architectural depth. We find that using a two-layer architecture drastically reduces the critical slowing down, with the training time scaling logarithmically rather than quadratically with system size. Using a Fourier implementation of the architecture, we further show that this acceleration in training time can be achieved without drastically increasing operational complexity. Taken together, these results demonstrate that diffusion models can overcome the critical slowing down through appropriate architectural design, and establish a controlled framework for understanding and improving learned sampling methods in statistical physics and beyond.

AI.title_translation: 扩散模型训练中的临界变慢现象
AI.tldr: 本文通过理论分析发现扩散模型在训练中存在临界变慢现象，并证明采用深层架构能够显著加速训练，克服这一计算瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于机器学习的生成方法（如扩散模型）在实践中非常成功，但对其行为的理论理解仍然有限，特别是缺乏对其成功条件和局限性的理论控制。本文旨在通过解析可控的统计物理模型，深入理解扩散模型在临界点附近的训练与采样行为。
AI.method: 通过在 $n \to \infty$ 的高斯极限下分析统计场论的 $O(n)$ 模型，研究单层和双层神经网络架构下得分模型（score model）的训练动力学与生成过程。
AI.result: 单层网络架构在参数学习中表现出临界变慢现象，且该现象会延续至生成过程；而采用两层架构可以显著减少临界变慢，使训练时间随系统大小呈对数级而非平方级扩展，结合傅里叶实现还可避免大幅增加运算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 通过适当的架构设计（如增加深度），扩散模型可以有效克服临界变慢问题，这为统计物理学及其他领域的机器学习采样方法提供了理论支撑与改进框架。
AI.translation: 自20世纪中叶以来，计算采样一直是科学的核心。虽然基于机器学习的方法最近取得了重大进展，但其行为仍然知之甚少，对其何时以及为何成功的理论控制有限。在这里，我们通过分析扩散模型在统计场论的 $O(n)$ 模型（在高斯极限 $n \to \infty$ 下）中的应用，为扩散模型（一类在实践中非常高效的生成方案）提供了这种洞察。在这个可解析处理的设定中，我们表明，使用与精确解相匹配的一层网络架构来训练得分模型，在参数学习中表现出一种临界变慢的现象。这种变慢也会影响生成过程，这表明在临界点附近采样的众所周知的困难即使对于学习到的生成模型仍然存在。为了克服这一瓶颈，我们考虑了架构深度的威力。我们发现，使用两层架构可以大大减少临界变慢，训练时间随系统大小呈对数级扩展，而不是二次方级。通过使用该架构的傅里叶实现，我们进一步表明，这种训练时间的加速可以在不大幅增加操作复杂度的情况下实现。综上所述，这些结果表明扩散模型可以通过适当的架构设计克服临界变慢，并为理解和改进统计物理学及其他领域的学习采样方法建立了一个可控的框架。
AI.summary: 本文通过在统计场论的极限下分析扩散模型，揭示了其在训练和生成过程中面临的临界变慢问题，并证明了通过引入深度架构（如两层网络和傅里叶实现）能够有效克服这一计算瓶颈，从而为理解和改进生成式采样方法提供了可控的理论框架。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 临界变慢, 统计场论, 架构深度, 生成式模型
AI.comments: 该论文通过研究统计场论中的 $O(n)$ 模型（在 $n \to \infty$ 的高斯极限下），为扩散模型的训练动力学和临界变慢现象提供了宝贵的理论洞察。其创新点在于证明了深度架构（如两层网络）可以有效缓解临界变慢问题，将训练时间从系统大小的平方级缩减至对数级，为理解和优化生成式模型的架构设计奠定了坚实的理论基础。

title: ISOMORPH: A Supply Chain Digital Twin for Simulation, Dataset Generation, and Forecasting Benchmarks
summary: Open time-series forecasting (TSF) benchmarks cover retail, energy, weather, and traffic, but supply-chain logistics remains underserved. We introduce ISOMORPH, the first public digital twin of a multi-echelon logistics network with interpretable, user-configurable parameters and modular topology, demand, and control rules. The simulator advances a directed routing graph in discrete time: demand is served from inventory or recorded as backlog and triggers replenishment throughout the network. The state tracks inventory, outstanding orders, in-transit shipments, and a smoothed demand estimate, yielding Markovian dynamics on a tractable state space. The released data reproduces the bullwhip effect at empirically consistent magnitudes, while three conservation laws provide verification tools for simulator extensions. We release datasets at two catalogue scales ($C=50$ and $C=200$), with a 33-rollout scenario library at $C=50$. These datasets exhibit dynamics largely absent from fixed TSF benchmarks, including variance amplification, cascading bottlenecks, regime shifts, and cross-channel coupling through shared macro shocks. Zero-shot evaluation of three foundation models (Chronos, Moirai, TimesFM) against three in-domain-trained baselines (ARIMA, ETS, PatchTST) spans four targets: demand, backlog, fill rate, and edge utilization. Comparison with ETTh1, Electricity, and Weather shows that ISOMORPH introduces forecasting regimes that differ from standard real-world TSF benchmarks, positioning it as a complementary, regenerable logistics-domain benchmark. The same pairing produces forecast confidence bands across scenario configurations, providing forward UQ from parameter uncertainty and demonstrating foundation models as fast surrogates for digital-twin-based UQ. Code (MIT): https://github.com/tuhinsahai/ISOMORPH. Interactive demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/HyeminGu/ISOMORPH-demo.

AI.title_translation: ISOMORPH：用于模拟、数据集生成和预测基准测试的供应链数字孪生
AI.tldr: ISOMORPH是首个开源的供应链物流数字孪生，能够生成具有真实复杂动力学（如牛鞭效应）的时间序列数据集，并为预测模型和不确定性量化提供新的基准。
AI.motivation: 现有的开源时间序列预测（TSF）基准涵盖了零售、能源、weather和交通，但供应链物流领域仍显不足，缺乏能够复现复杂供应链动力学（如牛鞭效应、级联瓶颈和跨渠道耦合）的公共数字孪生和预测基准。
AI.method: 引入ISOMORPH，即首个多级物流网络公共数字孪生。该模拟器在离散时间内推进有向路由图，通过可解释、用户可配置的参数以及模块化的拓扑、需求和控制规则来跟踪库存、订单、在途运货和需求估计，形成马尔可夫动力学。同时发布了两个目录规模的数据集和一个场景库，并对三种基础模型和三种域内训练基线进行了零样本评估。
AI.result: 发布的数据成功以经验一致的幅度重现了牛鞭效应；展示了传统TSF基准中缺少的动态特征（如方差放大、级联瓶颈等）；零样本评估表明ISOMORPH引入了不同于标准真实世界TSF基准的新预测机制，并证明了基础模型可作为数字孪生不确定性量化（UQ）的快速替代品。
AI.conclusion: ISOMORPH作为一个开源供应链数字孪生和模拟器，成功填补了物流领域时间序列预测基准的空白，能够有效复现复杂的供应链动力学，并为基础模型在不确定性量化（UQ）方面的应用提供支持。
AI.translation: 开放的时间序列预测（TSF）基准涵盖了零售、能源、气象和交通，但供应链物流领域仍未得到充分服务。我们介绍了ISOMORPH，这是第一个多级物流网络的公共数字孪生，具有可解释的、用户可配置的参数以及模块化的拓扑、需求和控制规则。该模拟器在离散时间内推进有向路由图：从库存中满足需求或记录为积压，并在整个网络中触发补货。状态跟踪库存、未完成订单、在途货运和平滑的需求估计，在可处理的状态空间上产生马尔可夫动力学。发布的数据以经验一致的幅度再现了牛鞭效应，而三个守恒定律为模拟器扩展提供了验证工具。我们发布了两种目录规模（$C=50$和$C=200$）的数据集，以及在$C=50$下的33个运行场景库。这些数据集表现出固定TSF基准中很大程度上缺失的动态，包括方差放大、级联瓶颈、机制转变以及通过共享宏观冲击实现的跨通道耦合。对三个基础模型（Chronos、Moirai、TimesFM）与三个域内训练基线（ARIMA、ETS、PatchTST）的零样本评估跨越四个目标：需求、积压、满足率和边缘利用率。与ETTh1、Electricity和Weather的对比表明，ISOMORPH引入了不同于标准真实世界TSF基准的预测机制，将其定位为互补的可再生物流领域基准。相同的配对跨场景配置生成了预测置信区间，为参数不确定性提供了前向UQ，并证明了基础模型作为基于数字孪生的UQ的快速替代品。代码（MIT）：https://github.com/tuhinsahai/ISOMORPH。交互式演示：https://huggingface.co/spaces/HyeminGu/ISOMORPH-demo。
AI.summary: ISOMORPH是首个用于模拟、数据集生成和预测基准测试的多级供应链物流数字孪生。它通过模块化的拓扑和控制规则模拟复杂的物流网络动力学（如牛鞭效应），发布了包含不同规模的丰富数据集和场景库，并评估了多种时序预测基础模型和传统基线，为物流领域的时间序列预测与不确定性量化提供了重要的互补基准。
