title: Structured Channel Parameter Estimation for RIS-Assisted MIMO Systems via Kronecker and Tensor Factorizations
summary: This paper proposes structured channel-parameter estimators for reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems employing uniform rectangular arrays under line-of-sight propagation. By exploiting the Kronecker and multilinear structures of the cascaded channel, we introduce the Successive Kronecker Factorization (SKF) alongside two Third-Order Tensor Parameter Estimation (TOPE) methods: TOPE-ALS and TOPE-HOSVD. These estimators recover spatial signatures from the pilot-filtered signal matrix, and then decouple the corresponding horizontal and vertical spatial frequencies. This structured formulation achieves benchmark estimation accuracy while reducing computational complexity, offering a efficient solution for RIS-aided systems.

AI.title_translation: 基于克罗内克和张量分解的RIS辅助MIMO系统结构化信道参数估计
AI.tldr: 提出基于克罗内克和张量分解的信道估计算法，大幅降低RIS辅助MIMO系统的计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 为了解决可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助的多输入多输出（MIMO）系统中信道参数估计的计算复杂度高的问题，提出利用结构化信道参数估计器来降低复杂度并保证精度。
AI.method: 利用级联信道的克罗内克结构和多线性结构，提出了连续克罗内克分解（SKF）以及两种三阶张量参数估计方法（TOPE-ALS和TOPE-HOSVD），从导频滤波信号矩阵中恢复空间特征并解耦水平与垂直空间频率。
AI.result: 所提出的结构化估计算法在视距传播环境下，能够在保持基准估计精度的同时显著降低计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于克罗内克和张量分解的信道参数估计器能够有效且准确地恢复视距传播下的空间特征与频率，实现了计算复杂度与估计精度的良好平衡。
AI.translation: 本文针对采用均匀矩形阵列并在视距传播下工作的可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助多输入多输出（MIMO）系统，提出了结构化信道参数估计器。通过利用级联信道的克罗内克结构和多线性结构，我们引入了连续克罗内克分解（SKF）以及两种三阶张量参数估计（TOPE）方法：TOPE-ALS和TOPE-HOSVD。这些估计器从导频滤波信号矩阵中恢复空间特征，然后解耦相应的水平和垂直空间频率。这种结构化公式在实现基准估计精度的同时降低了计算复杂度，为RIS辅助系统提供了一种高效的解决方案。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了RIS辅助MIMO系统中的信道参数估计问题，提出利用克罗内克积和张量分解（SKF、TOPE-ALS、TOPE-HOSVD）来解耦空间频率，在保证精度的同时大幅降低计算复杂度。
AI.keywords: 智能反射面, 多输入多输出, 克罗内克分解, 张量分解, 信道估计
AI.comments: 该论文针对RIS辅助的MIMO系统，创新性地结合了克罗内克积和张量分解技术（如SKF和TOPE方法），有效降低了信道参数估计的计算复杂度，同时保持了极高的估计精度，对未来智能反射面系统的实际部署具有重要意义。

title: All I Hear is Noise: Investigating Clever Hans Effects in Clinical Speech Datasets
summary: Recent work revealed a striking Clever Hans effect in the Pitt dataset, where Alzheimer's detection achieved nearly 100% accuracy using only silent audio segments. This raises serious concerns about hidden confounding factors in speech-based health datasets. We systematically investigate whether similar biases exist across five widely used clinical speech corpora: DAIC-WoZ (depression), TORGO (dysarthria), Neurovoz (PD), MDVR-KCL (PD), and UCLASS (stuttering). For each dataset, we compare classification using the first second of audio, silent segments, and full recordings, and evaluate both raw and denoised signals. Across all datasets, silence-only classification frequently matched or exceeded full-audio performance, suggesting that classification performance may be influenced by dataset-specific confounds in addition to disorder-related speech characteristics. These findings question the reliability and generalisability of speech-based biomarkers and call for stricter methodological reporting, preprocessing transparency, and bias mitigation.

AI.title_translation: 我听到的全是噪声：调查临床语音数据集中的“聪明的汉斯效应”
AI.tldr: 临床语音数据集中的疾病检测模型往往依赖于静音段等混杂噪声，而非真正的语音特征，这严重质疑了现有语音生物标志物的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 最近的研究发现在Pitt数据集中利用静音段即可实现近100%的阿尔茨海默病检测准确率（聪明的汉斯效应），这引发了对语音健康数据集中隐藏混杂因素的严重担忧，因此需要系统调查其他临床语音数据集中是否存在类似偏见。
AI.method: 系统性地对比了全音频、前一秒音频以及纯静音片段在五个临床语音数据集（DAIC-WoZ、TORGO、Neurovoz、MDVR-KCL、UCLASS）上的分类性能，并评估了原始信号与去噪信号。
AI.result: 在所有研究的数据集中，仅使用静音段的分类性能经常匹配甚至超过了全音频性能，表明分类性能受到数据集特定混杂因素的强烈影响。
AI.conclusion: 语音分类器在多个临床语音数据集中过度依赖混杂因素（如静音段），这严重威胁了语音生物标志物的可靠性与泛化能力，亟需改进方法学与预处理透明度。
AI.translation: 近期研究在Pitt数据集中揭示了一个显著的“聪明的汉斯效应”，即仅使用静音音频片段，阿尔茨海默病的检测准确率就接近100%。这引发了对基于语音的健康数据集中隐藏混杂因素的严重担忧。我们系统地调查了五个广泛使用的临床语音语料库中是否存在类似偏见：DAIC-WoZ（抑郁症）、TORGO（构音障碍）、Neurovoz（帕金森病）、MDVR-KCL（帕金森病）和UCLASS（口吃）。对于每个数据集，我们比较了使用前一秒音频、静音片段和完整录音的分类效果，并评估了原始信号和去噪信号。在所有数据集跨度中，仅静音分类往往匹配或超过了全音频性能，这表明分类性能除了受疾病相关的语音特征影响外，还可能受到数据集特定混杂因素的影响。这些发现对基于语音的生物标志物的可靠性和通用性提出了质疑，并呼吁更严格的方法学报告、预处理透明度和偏差缓解。
AI.summary: 本文系统调查了五个常用的临床语音数据集，发现仅凭静音段即可达到甚至超越全音频的分类性能，这证明了临床语音数据集中存在严重的“聪明的汉斯效应”与混杂偏见，挑战了现有语音生物标志物的可靠性。
AI.keywords: 聪明的汉斯效应, 临床语音数据集, 混杂因素, 语音生物标志物, 疾病检测
AI.comments: 该论文揭示了临床语音数据集中普遍存在的“聪明的汉斯效应”（即模型依赖背景噪声或静音片段的混杂因素而非真实病情进行预测），对医疗语音诊断领域的发展提出了重要警示。

title: HAMMER: Harmonic-Aware Parallel Context Modeling and Discriminator-Free Perceptual Optimization for Speech Enhancement
summary: Recent speech enhancement systems combine self-attention and Mamba to capture global interactions and long-range dependencies. Yet these hybrids usually operate as sequence mixers and do not explicitly exploit harmonic periodicity, a strong cue for preserving voiced speech under noise. Perceptual optimization poses another challenge. PESQ is non-differentiable, so many methods train auxiliary metric discriminators that increase complexity and introduce adversarial instability. We propose \ours, a harmonic-aware and discriminator-free speech enhancer built around two components. (i) The Time-Frequency Harmonic-aware Attention-Mamba (TF-HAM) block runs self-attention and bidirectional Mamba in parallel along both spectrogram axes, then applies a speech-adapted autocorrelation feed-forward network to encode local periodic structure. (ii) Metric-explicit perceptual refinement (MEPR) combines differentiable PESQ and log-likelihood-ratio losses to expose perceptual metric structure without a learned surrogate. On VoiceBank+DEMAND, \ours achieves 3.69 PESQ and 4.41 COVL with only 2.39\,M parameters, outperforming or matching discriminator-based systems. Inference-time perceptual contrast stretching further raises PESQ to 3.79 without retraining. The source code will be available at https://github.com/shangfuu/HAMMER.git.

AI.title_translation: HAMMER：用于语音增强的谐波感知并行上下文建模与无判别器感知优化
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为HAMMER的语音增强系统，它利用谐波感知并行上下文建模和无判别器的感知优化，在低参数量下取得了出色的语音质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的结合自注意力和Mamba的语音增强系统通常作为序列混合器，未显式利用语音中强有力的谐波周期性线索；同时，由于PESQ不可微，传统感知优化常采用会引入复杂性和对抗不稳定性的辅助度量判别器。
AI.method: 提出了HAMMER系统，包含两个核心组件：(i) 时频谐波感知注意力-Mamba (TF-HAM) 块，并行运行自attention和双向Mamba，并应用语音自适应自相关前馈网络编码局部周期结构；(ii) 指标显式感知求精 (MEPR)，结合可微分PESQ和对数似然比损失进行感知优化。
AI.result: 在VoiceBank+DEMAND数据集上，HAMMER仅用2.39M的参数量就达到了3.69的PESQ和4.41的COVL，推理时的感知对比度拉伸更将PESQ提升至3.79。
AI.conclusion: HAMMER通过结合谐波感知注意力-Mamba模块和指标显式的感知细化方法，在保持较低参数量（2.39M）的同时，取得了优异的语音增强效果，超越了许多基于判别器的系统。
AI.translation: 近期的语音增强系统结合了自注意力和Mamba来捕获全局交互和长距离依赖。然而，这些混合模型通常仅作为序列混合器，并未显式利用谐波周期性——这是在噪声下保留有声语音的强有力线索。感知优化带来了另一个挑战。由于PESQ是不可微的，许多方法会训练增加复杂性并引入对抗不稳定性的辅助度量判别器。我们提出了HAMMER，这是一个围绕两个组件构建的谐波感知且无判别器的语音增强器。(i) 时频谐波感知注意力-Mamba (TF-HAM) 块沿谱图两轴并行运行自注意力和双向Mamba，然后应用语音自适应自相关前馈网络来编码局部周期结构。(ii) 指标显式感知细化 (MEPR) 结合了可微分的PESQ和对数似然比损失，在没有学习型替代物的情况下暴露出感知度量结构。在VoiceBank+DEMAND数据集上，HAMMER以仅2.39M的参数量实现了3.69的PESQ和4.41的COVL，性能超越或匹配了基于判别器的系统。推理时的感知对比度拉伸在无需重新训练的情况下进一步将PESQ提升至3.79。源代码可在 https://github.com/shangfuu/HAMMER.git 获取。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为HAMMER的谐波感知、无判别器的语音增强系统，通过引入时频谐波感知注意力-Mamba块（TF-HAM）和度量显式感知细化（MEPR）模块，在低参数量下实现了卓越的语音增强性能。
AI.keywords: Speech enhancement, Self-attention, Mamba, Harmonic periodicity, Perceptual optimization
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地结合了自注意力机制、Mamba状态空间模型以及语音信号固有的谐波周期性，设计了TF-HAM模块；同时，在感知优化方面绕过了复杂的对抗性判别器，直接使用可微分的PESQ和LLR损失，实现了高效率和优异的语音增强性能。

title: Multimodal Learning for Beamforming Using Camera, LiDAR, and Radio-Frequency Pilots
summary: This paper proposes a multimodal learning framework that integrates camera images, LiDAR point clouds, and radio-frequency (RF) pilots to realize multi-user multiple-input single-output (MU-MISO) beamforming optimization in mixed line-of-sight (LoS) and non-line-of-sight (NLoS) environments. In LoS-dominant environments, beamforming can be designed by utilizing sensing information related to user locations. However, LoS paths cannot be guaranteed to exist for all users in realistic dynamic environments due to blockages. To characterize NLoS propagation, detailed three-dimensional (3D) information of surrounding obstacles is required. This paper integrates camera images and LiDAR points with RF pilots to capture detailed 3D geometric, object-class, and material information of users and surrounding objects. The obtained multimodal information provides useful cues for both direct LoS paths and reflected NLoS propagation, and provides rich channel-related information for beamforming design. Specifically, a bounding-box detection neural network is first used to extract two-dimensional spatial, object-class, and material information from camera images. The image-derived information then guides the selection of LiDAR points to obtain 3D geometric information of users and surrounding obstacles, and assigns object-class and material labels to the selected points. The image-guided LiDAR features, together with RF pilots, are jointly processed by a designed neural architecture to optimize the beamforming vectors. Simulation results show that the proposed method achieves a higher minimum rate than benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: 利用相机、激光雷达和射频导频进行波束成形的多模态学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合相机、激光雷达和RF导频的多模态学习框架，用于优化混合视距与非视距环境下的波束成形，有效提升了系统的最小速率。
AI.motivation: 在现实的动态环境中，由于遮挡的存在，无法保证所有用户都存在视距（LoS）路径。为了表征非视距（NLoS）传播并优化波束成形，需要周围障碍物的详细三维信息，因此本文旨在提出一种能够融合多种模态信息的学习框架。
AI.method: 首先使用边界框检测神经网络从相机图像中提取二维空间、对象类别和材质信息；然后利用图像导向的信息筛选激光雷达点云，以获取用户及周围障碍物的三维几何信息并赋予标签；最后将图像引导的激光雷达特征与RF导频共同输入到设计的神经网络架构中以优化波束成形向量。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，与基准方法相比，所提出的方法实现了更高的最小速率。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的多模态学习框架能够有效整合相机图像、激光雷达点云与RF导频信息，实现混合LoS/NLoS环境下的高效波束成形优化，仿真验证了其在最小速率性能上的优越性。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种多模态学习框架，集成相机图像、激光雷达点云和射频（RF）导频，以实现在混合视距（LoS）和非视距（NLoS）环境中的多用户多输入单输出（MU-MISO）波束成形优化。在LoS主导的环境中，可以通过利用与用户位置相关的传感信息来设计波束成形。然而，由于遮挡，在现实的动态环境中无法保证所有用户都存在LoS路径。为了表征NLoS传播，需要周围障碍物的详细三维（3D）信息。本文将相机图像和激光雷达点与RF导频相结合，以捕获用户和周围物体的详细3D几何、对象类别和材质信息。所获得的多模态信息为直接LoS路径和反射NLoS传播提供了有用的线索，并为波束成形设计提供了丰富的信道相关信息。具体而言，首先使用边界框检测神经网络从相机图像中提取二维空间、对象类别和材质信息。然后，图像导出的信息指导激光雷达点的选择，以获取用户和周围障碍物的3D几何信息，并为所选点分配对象类别和材质标签。图像引导的激光雷达特征与RF导频一起，由设计的神经网络架构进行联合处理，以优化波束成形向量。仿真结果表明，该方法实现了比基准更高的最小速率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种集成相机图像、激光雷达点云和射频导频的多模态学习框架，用于解决混合LoS/NLoS环境下的MU-MISO波束成形优化问题。该方法通过图像与激光雷达的融合获取丰富的3D几何、类别和材质信息，结合RF导频共同输入神经网络以优化波束成形向量，仿真证明其性能优于基准方法。
AI.keywords: 多模态学习, 波束成形, 激光雷达, 相机图像, 射频导频
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了多模态感知（相机、激光雷达）与射频信号，有效解决了多用户多输入单输出（MU-MISO）系统中视距（LoS）与非视距（NLoS）环境下的波束成形优化问题。通过图像引导激光雷达特征提取并融合RF导频，显著提升了复杂动态环境下的通信性能。

title: Rethinking Music Tokenization: A Semantic Codec toward High-Fidelity LLM Music Generation
summary: Discrete audio tokenization has become the critical interface between raw waveforms and autoregressive modeling in recent music generation. As a result, music tokenizers must simultaneously support high-fidelity reconstruction and produce discrete sequences that remain amenable to language modeling. Existing reconstruction-oriented tokenizers often mix musical structure with fine acoustic details, producing high-entropy tokens that are hard to model. In contrast, semantics-guided alternatives are designed for speech and do not fit music well, often hurting reconstruction quality. We address these trade-offs by rethinking music tokenization around a measurable notion of music semantic content grounded in downstream Music Information Retrieval tasks. Guided by this definition, we propose MuSeC, a music semantic codec that factorizes semantic and acoustic content directly from mixed signals without source separation. MuSeC preserves information required for high-fidelity reconstruction while producing more LM-friendly discrete units. Empirically, it improves reconstruction quality and yields more predictable token sequences, providing a practical foundation toward high-fidelity LLM music generation. Demos are available at https://longwaytog0.github.io/MuSeC/.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考音乐符号化：面向高保真LLM音乐生成的语义编解码器
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为MuSeC的音乐语义编解码器，解决了音乐大模型生成中音频高保真重建与语言模型可建模性难以兼顾的难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的面向重建的音频符号化器会产生难以建模的高熵标记，而基于语义的方法多针对语音设计且重建质量差。为了解决音乐高保真重建与语言模型可建模性之间的权衡，需要重新思考音乐符号化方法。
AI.method: 提出了MuSeC（Music Semantic Codec），在无需源分离的情况下，直接从混合信号中分解出语义和声学内容，从而在保留高保真重建所需信息的同时生成更适合语言模型的离散单元。
AI.result: 实验表明，MuSeC不仅提升了音乐的重建质量，还生成了更具可预测性的标记序列，有利于提高大语言模型音乐生成的性能。
AI.conclusion: MuSeC有效地平衡了音乐高保真重建与语言模型可建模性之间的权衡，为高质量音乐大模型生成奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 离散音频符号化已成为原始波形与自回归建模在现代音乐生成中的关键接口。因此，音乐符号化器必须同时支持高保真重建，并产生适合语言建模的离散序列。现有的面向重建的符号化器通常将音乐结构与精细的声学细节混合在一起，产生难以建模的高熵标记。相比之下，受语义启发的替代方案是为语音设计的，不太适合音乐，往往会损害重建质量。我们通过围绕植根于下游音乐信息检索任务的音乐语义内容的可测量概念来重新思考音乐符号化，从而解决这些权衡。在此定义的指导下，我们提出了MuSeC，一种直接从混合信号中分解语义和声学内容而无需源分离的音乐语义编解码器。MuSeC保留了高保真重建所需的信息，同时产生了更对语言模型（LM）友好的离散单元。从经验来看，它提高了重建质量并产生了更可预测的标记序列，为高保真LLM音乐生成提供了切实的基础。演示可在 https://longwaytog0.github.io/MuSeC/ 获取。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了MuSeC（一种音乐语义编解码器），旨在解决音乐大语言模型生成中高保真重建与标记可建模性之间的矛盾。该方法无需源分离，直接从混合信号中解耦语义与声学特征，在保证音频重建质量的同时生成对语言模型友好的离散单元。
AI.keywords: 音乐符号化, 语义编解码器, 高保真音乐生成, 大语言模型, 音乐信息检索
AI.comments: 该论文针对音乐大模型生成中音频符号化（Tokenization）的痛点，提出了MuSeC，通过解耦语义和声学内容，在保证高保真重建的同时降低了生成难度，对未来音乐生成领域具有重要意义。

title: CGaLore: Curvature-Guided GaLore for Memory-Efficient Continual Adaptation of ASR Foundation Models
summary: Automatic speech recognition models suffer from catastrophic forgetting when adapted to new domains, accents, or downstream tasks. This problem becomes increasingly important with the growing use of speech foundation models, where adaptation should be both memory-efficient and safe, preserving the broad capabilities learned during pretraining. Gradient Low-Rank Projection (GaLore) has recently been proposed as a memory-efficient fine-tuning method that keeps model parameters full-rank while reducing the optimizer memory through low-rank gradient projection. However, GaLore does not account for catastrophic forgetting. We propose Curvature-Guided GaLore (CGaLore), which incorporates old-task curvature information when selecting the low-rank projection bases. Specifically, CGaLore filters current-task gradients using Kronecker-factored approximate curvature from previous tasks before computing the gradient subspace. Our experiments show that CGaLore enables effective adaptation while alleviating forgetting, outperforming state-of-the-art continual learning baselines. Extensive ablation studies confirm the practical applicability of CGaLore.

AI.title_translation: CGaLore：用于自动语音识别基础模型内存高效持续自适应的曲率引导 GaLore
AI.tldr: CGaLore 结合了曲率引导与低秩梯度投影，有效解决了语音基础模型持续微调中的灾难性遗忘和显存受限问题。
AI.motivation: 自动语音识别模型在适应新领域时容易发生灾难性遗忘，而现有的显存高效微调方法（如 GaLore）未能解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出曲率引导的 GaLore（CGaLore）方法，在选择低秩投影基底时结合来自旧任务的 Kronecker 分解近似曲率信息，对当前任务的梯度进行过滤。
AI.result: 实验表明，CGaLore 能够进行有效的模型适应并减轻遗忘，超越了当前的先进持续学习基线方法。
AI.conclusion: CGaLore 成功实现了语音基础模型的高效且安全的持续自适应，在减轻遗忘的同时展现出优于现有基线的性能。
AI.translation: 自动语音识别模型在适应新领域、口音或下游任务时，会遭受灾难性遗忘。随着语音基础模型的广泛使用，这个问题变得日益重要，因为模型适应应当既节省内存又安全，同时保留预训练期间学习到的广泛能力。梯度低秩投影（GaLore）最近被提出作为一种内存高效的微调方法，它通过低秩梯度投影减少优化器内存，同时保持模型参数全秩。然而，GaLore 没有考虑灾难性遗忘。我们提出了曲率引导 GaLore（CGaLore），它在选择低秩投影基底时结合了旧任务的曲率信息。具体而言，CGaLore 在计算梯度子空间之前，使用来自先前任务的 Kronecker 分解近似曲率来过滤当前任务的梯度。我们的实验表明，CGaLore 能够在有效适应的同时减轻遗忘，其性能优于最先进的持续学习基线。大量的消融研究证实了 CGaLore 的实际应用价值。
AI.summary: 论文提出了 CGaLore 方法，通过在低秩梯度投影中引入旧任务的曲率信息，解决了语音基础模型在持续适应中的灾难性遗忘和显存开销问题。
AI.keywords: 自动语音识别, 持续自适应, 灾难性遗忘, 显存优化, 低秩梯度投影
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将曲率信息与低 rank 梯度投影方法（GaLore）结合，解决了语音基础模型在持续适应过程中的显存效率与灾难性遗忘冲突问题，具有很高的实用价值。

title: The Impact of the Cauchy Interlace Theorem on the Convergence of the RLS Algorithm
comments: Keywords: RLS algorithm, RLS convergence, Cauchy Interlace Theorem (CIT), settling time, Sherman Morrison Woodbury formula
summary: In this paper, we revisit the convergence of the RLS algorithm in view of the Cauchy Interlace Theorem. It states that the eigenvalues of a Hermitian matrix $A$ and of the rank one updated matrix $\hat{A} = A + u\,u^H$ interlace. We analyze the impact of this theorem on the convergence of the RLS algorithm and its suitable initialization. The results suggest an improved initialization for speeding up the convergence time. Moreover, a novel proof of the theorem is given based on the Sherman Morrison Woodbury formula.
comment: Keywords: RLS algorithm, RLS convergence, Cauchy Interlace Theorem (CIT), settling time, Sherman Morrison Woodbury formula

AI.title_translation: 柯西交织定理对RLS算法收敛性的影响
AI.tldr: 本文运用柯西交织定理分析了RLS算法的收敛性，提出了可加速收敛的新初始化方法，并给出了定理的新证明。
AI.motivation: 重新审视RLS算法的收敛性，并探究厄米特矩阵及其秩一更新矩阵的特征值交织性质（柯西交织定理）对RLS算法收敛过程及合适初始化的影响。
AI.method: 利用柯西交织定理分析RLS算法的收敛性与初始化问题，并基于Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury公式给出了该定理的一个新证明。
AI.result: 研究结果表明柯西交织定理对RLS算法的收敛有重要影响，并据此提出了一种能够加速收敛时间的新型初始化方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用柯西交织定理能够深入理解RLS算法的收敛行为，并据此提出的改进初始化策略可有效加速收敛。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们从柯西交织定理的角度重新审视了RLS算法的收敛性。该定理指出，厄米特矩阵 $A$ 与秩一更新矩阵 $\hat{A} = A + u\,u^H$ 的特征值是交织的。我们分析了该定理对外推RLS算法收敛性及其合适初始化的影响。结果表明，改进的初始化方法可以加快收敛速度。此外，基于Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury公式，给出了该定理的一个新证明。
AI.summary: 本文研究了柯西交织定理对递归最小二乘（RLS）算法收敛性的影响。通过分析厄米特矩阵及其秩一更新矩阵特征值之间的交织关系，作者为RLS算法提出了旨在加速收敛的改进初始化方法，并借助Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury公式提供了该定理的新证明。
AI.keywords: RLS算法, 柯西交织定理, 收敛性, 初始化, 矩阵更新
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入柯西交织定理重新审视了RLS算法的收敛性，不仅理论推导新颖，还给出了加速算法收敛的改进初始化方法以及基于Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury公式的新证明。

title: WiFi based Multi user Activity Recognition via User Conditioned Spatial Attention
summary: WiFi-based human activity recognition has achieved high accuracy under the single-user scene. Recognizing activities performed by multiple concurrent users remains challenging, because their body-reflected propagation paths superimpose in the channel state information (CSI) measurement. Existing multi-user methods either decompose the signal before classification, suffering from error propagation, or predict activities jointly without reliably associating each prediction with the correct user. Moreover, attention mechanisms that have proven effective for single-user sensing compute a single user-agnostic attention map, blending patterns from different users and providing no mechanism to associate features with specific user slots. This paper proposes a user-conditioned spatial attention (UCSA) module that generates per-user spatial attention maps by conditioning multi-scale spatial attention on learnable user-ID embeddings via feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM). UCSA creates a deep coupling between spatial feature enhancement and user differentiation: the attention module itself becomes user-aware, producing distinct attention maps for each user slot rather than relying on a late-fusion embedding addition. Combined with a shareable multi-semantic spatial attention (SMSA) module for multi-scale spatial enhancement, the proposed framework addresses both feature quality and user differentiation in a unified architecture. Experiments on the WiMANS benchmark across three indoor environments and up to five concurrent users show that the proposed method outperforms nine baselines in all settings, achieving an average accuracy of over 93\% across three environments even with five users. Ablation studies confirm that both SMSA and UCSA contribute substantially to recognition accuracy, with UCSA providing the critical link between shared features and per-user predictions.

AI.title_translation: 基于用户条件空间注意力的WiFi多用户活动识别
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于WiFi的多用户活动识别方法，利用用户条件空间注意力（UCSA）模块解决了多用户并发时的特征混淆问题，在各项基准测试中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于WiFi的多用户活动识别方法难以有效分离信号或将预测结果与正确用户关联，且传统的注意力机制无法区分不同用户的特征模式，为此需要设计一种能够实现空间特征增强与用户微分深度耦合的机制。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合用户条件空间注意力（UCSA）模块和可共享多语义空间注意力（SMSA）模块的统一框架，利用可学习的用户ID嵌入通过特征线性调制（FiLM）生成每个用户的空间注意力图。
AI.result: 在WiMANS基准测试（涵盖3个室内环境和最多5个并发用户）上的实验表明，该方法在所有设置下均优于9种基准方法，在5个用户的场景下平均准确率仍超过93%。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出的基于用户条件空间注意力（UCSA）和多语义空间注意力（SMSA）的框架，有效解决了WiFi多用户活动识别中的特征混淆与用户关联难题，实验证明其在多用户场景下具有极高的准确率和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 基于WiFi的人体活动识别在单用户场景下已经取得了很高的准确率。然而，识别多个并发用户执行的活动仍然具有挑战性，因为他们的身体反射传播路径在信道状态信息（CSI）测量中会发生叠加。现有的多用户方法要么在分类前对信号进行分解，容易受到错误传播的影响；要么联合预测活动，但无法可靠地将每个预测与正确的用户关联起来。此外，已被证明对单用户传感有效的注意力机制通常计算单一的、与用户无关的注意力图，这会混合来自不同用户的模式，且没有提供将特征与特定用户槽关联的机制。本文提出了一个用户条件空间注意力（UCSA）模块，它通过特征线性调制（FiLM），将多尺度空间注意力与可学习的用户ID嵌入进行条件化结合，从而生成每个用户的空间注意力图。UCSA在空间特征增强和用户微分之间创造了深层耦合：注意力模块本身变得具有用户感知能力，为每个用户槽生成不同的注意力图，而不是依赖于后期的特征融合加法。结合用于多尺度空间增强的可共享多语义空间注意力（SMSA）模块，所提出的框架在一个统一的架构中同时解决了特征质量和用户微分的问题。在涵盖三个室内环境和最多五个并发用户的WiMANS基准测试上的实验表明，所提出的方法在所有设置下均优于九个基线方法，即使在五个用户的情况下，在三个环境中也能实现超过93%的平均准确率。消融实验证实，SMSA和UCSA都对识别准确率做出了重大贡献，其中UCSA提供了共享特征与每个用户预测之间的关键联系。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于WiFi的多用户活动识别框架，引入了用户条件空间注意力（UCSA）和多语义空间注意力（SMSA）模块，通过将空间特征增强与用户ID嵌入深度耦合，有效提升了多用户场景下的活动识别准确率。
AI.keywords: WiFi Sensing, Multi-user Activity Recognition, Spatial Attention, Channel State Information, Feature-wise Linear Modulation
AI.comments: 该论文针对基于WiFi的多用户活动识别这一挑战性问题，创新性地提出了用户条件空间注意力（UCSA）模块，通过学习用户ID嵌入来生成特定于用户的空间注意力图，有效解决了多用户信号叠加和特征混淆的难题，在各项基准测试中表现优异。

title: Design Space Exploration of In-Memory Computing Implementations for Discrete Fourier Transform
summary: Although memristor-based in-memory computing (IMC) has been widely investigated for brain-inspired neuromorphic workloads, systematic evaluations of its energy, latency, and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) trade-offs across diverse system parameters remain scarce for classical digital signal processing (DSP). To address this gap, this paper introduces a comprehensive hardware-aware design framework for systematically mapping algorithmic workloads onto IMC architectures, using the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) as a case study. Tailored to the stringent performance requirements of a DFT accelerator for 5G orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) systems, we propose a novel mapping scheme that reduces energy consumption per computation by 53% compared with conventional mapping techniques. Additionally, we present a comparative study of resistive random-access memory (RRAM) and ferroelectric tunnel junction (FTJ) technologies with identical numbers of programmable states but distinct conductance ranges, demonstrating the importance of device-informed architectural co-design. By bridging the gap between emerging IMC architectures and rigid DSP constraints, this work provides a pathway toward energy-efficient edge accelerators for future wireless communication systems.

AI.title_translation: 离散傅里叶变换内存计算实现的设计空间探索
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于离散傅里叶变换（DFT）的内存计算设计框架与新颖映射方案，将计算能耗降低了53%，并对比了RRAM与FTJ器件在无线通信加速器中的应用。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于忆阻器的内存计算（IMC）在类脑神经形态工作负载中得到了广泛研究，但对于经典数字信号处理（DSP）中，跨越多样化系统参数的能耗、延迟和信噪比（SNR）权衡的系统性评估仍然匮乏。
AI.method: 引入了一个全面的硬件感知设计框架，用于将算法工作负载系统地映射到IMC架构中，并以离散傅里叶变换（DFT）为案例研究；提出了一种针对5G OFDM系统DFT加速器性能要求定制的新颖映射方案；进行了RRAM和FTJ技术的比较研究。
AI.result: 与传统映射技术相比，所提出的映射方案将每次计算的能耗降低了53%；此外，通过对具有相同编程状态数但电导范围不同的RRAM和FTJ技术的对比研究，证明了器件感知架构协同设计的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过提出面向DFT的全面硬件感知设计框架和新颖映射方案，成功弥合了新兴IMC架构与严格DSP约束之间的差距，为未来无线通信系统的高能效边缘加速器铺平了道路。
AI.translation: 尽管基于忆阻器的内存计算（IMC）已被广泛研究用于类脑神经形态工作负载，但对于经典数字信号处理（DSP）而言，跨越多样化系统参数的能耗、延迟和信噪比（SNR）权衡的系统性评估仍然匮乏。为了填补这一空白，本文引入了一个全面的硬件感知设计框架，用于将算法工作负载系统地映射到IMC架构中，并以离散傅里叶变换（DFT）作为案例研究。针对5G正交频分复用（OFDM）系统DFT加速器的严格性能要求，我们提出了一种新颖的映射方案，与传统映射技术相比，该方案将每项计算的能耗降低了53%。此外，我们对具有相同编程状态数但电导范围不同的电阻式随机存取内存（RRAM）和铁电隧穿结（FTJ）技术进行了比较研究，证明了器件感知架构协同设计的重要性。通过弥合新兴IMC架构与严格DSP constraints（DSP约束）之间的差距，这项工作为未来无线通信系统的高能效边缘加速器提供了一条途径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种全面的硬件感知设计框架，用于在内存计算架构上实现离散傅里叶变换（DFT），以满足5G OFDM系统的严格性能要求。研究引入了一种新颖的映射方案，将能耗降低了53%，并对比了RRAM和FTJ两种存储技术，突出了器件与架构协同设计在能量高效的无线通信边缘加速器中的重要性。
AI.keywords: 内存计算, 离散傅里叶变换, 忆阻器, 硬件感知设计, 5G OFDM
AI.comments: 该论文针对经典数字信号处理（DSP）中的离散傅里叶变换（DFT），系统地探讨了基于忆阻器的内存计算（IMC）架构的设计空间。通过提出创新的映射方案和对比不同器件技术（RRAM与FTJ），在能效和信噪比之间取得了良好的权衡，为5G及未来无线通信中的边缘加速器设计提供了重要参考。

title: Towards Zero-Shot Attribution of Synthetic Speech via Audio-Text Contrastive Retrieval
comments: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE Spoken Language Technology Workshop (SLT 2026)
summary: Audio deepfake forensics is moving beyond a simple real-or-fake verdict toward attribution: which system generated the audio clip? Most source-attribution methods cast this as closed-set classification, so they cannot name a generator that was absent from training, a gap that widens with every newly released text-to-speech (TTS) system. We instead frame attribution as cross-modal retrieval: each generator is described in natural language, and a clip is attributed by retrieving the description closest to it in a shared audio-text embedding space. Adding a new system then takes nothing more than writing its description, with no retraining and no new classifier head. Our model couples a frozen Wav2Vec2-BERT audio encoder with a frozen E5 text encoder and aligns them through small trainable projection heads, using a contrastive objective that combines a cross-modal supervised-contrastive loss with intra-modal terms. We evaluate on MLAAD v9 (140 TTS models, 51 languages) under 10-fold leave-models-out cross-validation. For generators it has never encountered before, the model reaches a model-level mean reciprocal rank (MRR) of 58.4%. Even when the correct model is not identified, the audio clip is often matched to systems that share the true generator's vocoder, acoustic model, or architecture. Because the same embedding space also answers natural-language attribute queries, one set of descriptions covers both open-set attribution and attribute-level forensic profiling.
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE Spoken Language Technology Workshop (SLT 2026)

AI.title_translation: 通过音频-文本对比检索实现合成语音的零样本归属
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于音频-文本对比检索的零样本合成语音源归属方法，无需重新训练即可识别未见过的语音生成系统。
AI.motivation: 现有的音频深度伪造源属性归属方法多采用闭集分类，无法识别训练中未出现过的新文本到语音（TTS）系统，且随着新TTS系统的不断发布，这一局限性愈发明显。因此，需要一种能够进行零样本归属的方法。
AI.method: 将语音归属构建为跨模态检索任务，使用自然语言描述生成器；模型结合了冻结的Wav2Vec2-BERT音频编码器和冻结的E5文本编码器，通过小型可训练的投影头进行对齐，采用结合了跨模态监督对比损失与模态内项的对比目标函数进行训练。
AI.result: 在包含140个TTS模型和51种语言的MLAAD v9数据集上进行10折留出模型交叉验证，模型在未见过的生成器上达到了58.4%的模型级平均倒数排名（MRR）；当未能识别出正确模型时，通常也能匹配到共享相同声码器、声学模型或架构的系统。
AI.conclusion: 通过基于音频-文本对比检索的框架，本研究成功实现了零样本的合成语音源归属和属性级取证，有效解决了传统闭集分类方法无法识别未见生成器的问题。
AI.translation: 音频深度伪造取证正在从简单的真假判定转向归属判定：哪种系统生成了音频剪辑？大多数源归属方法将其视为闭集分类，因此它们无法命名训练中不存在的生成器，随着新文本到语音（TTS）系统的不断发布，这一差距正在拉大。我们转而将归属框定为跨模态检索：每个生成器都用自然语言描述，通过检索共享音频-文本嵌入空间中最接近其描述的音频剪辑来进行归属。添加一个新系统只需编写其描述，无需重新训练，也无需新的分类头。我们的模型将冻结的Wav2Vec2-BERT音频编码器与冻结的E5 text编码器相结合，通过小型可训练投影头将它们对齐，并使用结合了跨模态监督对比损失和模态内项的对比目标。我们在MLAAD v9（140个TTS模型，51种语言）下进行了10折留出模型交叉验证。对于它从未遇到过的生成器，模型达到了58.4%的模型级平均倒数排名（MRR）。即使没有识别出正确的模型，音频剪辑也经常与共享真实生成器的声码器、声学模型或架构的系统相匹配。由于相同的嵌入空间也可以回答自然语言属性查询，因此一套描述既涵盖了开放集归属，又涵盖了属性级取证分析。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通过音频-文本对比检索来实现合成语音零样本源归属的方法。该方法将生成器描述为自然语言，利用共享的音频-文本嵌入空间进行跨模态检索，无需重新训练即可添加新的生成系统，同时支持开放式归属和属性级取证分析。
AI.keywords: Audio Deepfake, Zero-Shot Attribution, Contrastive Retrieval, Audio-Text Embedding, Forensic Profiling
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将语音生成源属性归属问题转化为跨模态文本检索任务，巧妙地利用了冻结的音频和文本编码器，通过对比学习实现零样本（Zero-Shot）扩展，极大地提升了面对新TTS系统时的泛化能力和可解释性。

title: SARAMS: Split-Aware Joint Resource Allocation for Multi-Monostatic Sensing
comments: 7 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for Publication in the IEEE GLOBECOM 2026 Conference
summary: Cooperative multi-monostatic sensing enables sub-meter passive localization in integrated sensing and communication~(ISAC) networks by fusing base station~(BS) observations at a central unit~(CU). Existing studies, however, treat the fused data as ideally available at the CU, overlooking how the per-BS 3GPP functional split jointly constrains fronthaul bitrate, computational load, and whether coherent or non-coherent fusion is feasible at the CU. We propose the \textit{Split-Aware Joint Resource Allocation for Multi-Monostatic Sensing}~(SARAMS) algorithm, which minimizes the worst-case multi-target squared position error bound~(SPEB) by jointly optimizing per-BS power, bandwidth, and observation time under fronthaul, computational, and power constraints. A split-dependent coefficient embeds the feasible fusion type into the Fisher information matrix~(FIM), casting SPEB minimization as a mixed-integer nonlinear program (MINLP) solved via a semidefinite program for power allocation and block coordinate descent (BCD) over a dominance-pruned configuration set. Simulation results demonstrate that SARAMS reduces the 90th-percentile worst-case SPEB by $65.7\%$ over equal power allocation while attaining an $8.7\%$ optimality gap relative to exhaustive search.
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for Publication in the IEEE GLOBECOM 2026 Conference

AI.title_translation: SARAMS：面向多单基地感知的划分感知联合资源分配
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为SARAMS的划分感知联合资源分配算法，通过综合考虑3GPP功能划分和资源限制，显著提升了集成传感与通信网络中的多单基地定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的多单基地感测研究通常假设融合数据在中央单元（CU）理想可用，忽略了每个基站的3GPP功能划分如何共同约束前传比特率、计算负载以及在CU处进行相干或非相干融合的可行性。
AI.method: 提出SARAMS算法，通过引入划分相关系数将可行融合类型嵌入FIM中，将SPEB最小化建模为混合整数非线性规划（MINLP）问题，并通过用于功率分配的半定规划和支配剪枝配置集上的块坐标下降（BCD）法进行求解。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，与平均功率分配相比，SARAMS将90%最坏情况下的SPEB降低了65.7%，同时相对于穷举搜索实现了8.7%的最优性间隙。
AI.conclusion: 提出的SARAMS算法能够有效解决多单基地感知中的划分感知联合资源分配问题，在保证前传和计算约束的前提下大幅降低了定位误差。
AI.translation: 协作式多单基地感知通过在中央单元（CU）处融合基站（BS）的观测数据，能够在集成传感与通信（ISAC）网络中实现亚米级被动定位。然而，现有研究将融合数据视为在CU处理想可用，忽视了每个BS的3GPP功能划分如何共同约束前传比特率、计算负载以及在CU处可行的是相干还是非相干融合。我们提出了“面向多单基地感知的划分感知联合资源分配”（SARAMS）算法，该算法通过在前传、计算和功率约束下联合优化每个BS的功率、带宽和观测时间，最小化最坏情况下的多目标平方位置误差边界（SPEB）。划分相关的系数将可行的融合类型嵌入到Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）中，将SPEB最小化转化为混合整数非线性规划（MINLP）问题，并通过用于功率分配的半定程序和在支配剪枝配置集上的块坐标下降（BCD）来求解。仿真结果表明，与均等功率分配相比，SARAMS将90%最坏情况下的SPEB降低了65.7%，同时相对于穷举搜索实现了8.7%的最优性间隙。
AI.summary: 本文针对集成传感与通信网络中的多单基地感知，提出了一种考虑3GPP功能划分的联合资源分配算法（SARAMS），通过优化功率、带宽和观测时间来最小化最坏情况下的定位误差边界，并在前传与计算约束下取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 集成传感与通信, 多单基地感测, 资源分配, 功能划分, 鱼信息矩阵
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将3GPP功能划分与ISAC中的多单基地感知资源分配相结合，提出了一种名为SARAMS的联合资源分配算法，通过将融合类型嵌入FIM中并解决了复杂的MINLP问题，显著提升了被动定位精度，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Confidence-Guided Markov Weighting for Semi-Supervised Tabla Stroke Transcription
summary: Tabla Stroke Transcription (TST) converts tabla audio into symbolic stroke sequences, but the scarcity of annotated recordings makes fully supervised training challenging. We propose a semi-supervised framework that uses sequence-level labelled and unlabelled tabla recordings. A teacher model generates pseudo-label sequences, while a Stroke-Level Confidence Estimation Model (S-CEM) estimates confidence for each predicted stroke. To improve training with uncertain pseudo-labels, we propose Confidence-Guided Markov Weighted Alternative Temporal Classification (CMW-ATC), which weights candidate sequences within uncertain spans using learned stroke transitions and reliable neighbouring strokes. Experiments across three TST evaluation settings show consistent improvements over conventional teacher--student training and Alternative Temporal Classification in its replacement form (ATC-R). Ablation studies further show the contributions of S-CEM, Markov transition weighting, and the use of reliable strokes on both sides of uncertain spans.

AI.title_translation: 置信度引导马尔可夫加权半监督塔布拉鼓击转录
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于塔布拉鼓击转录的半监督框架，利用置信度和马尔可夫加权改进了伪标签的训练过程，实验表现优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 塔布拉鼓击转录（TST）任务面临标注录音稀缺的挑战，完全监督训练较为困难，因此需要开发有效的半监督学习方法来利用未标记的录音。
AI.method: 提出一个半监督框架，包含一个生成伪标签的教师模型、一个评估每个预测击打置信度的Stroke-Level Confidence Estimation Model (S-CEM)，以及用于优化不确定伪标签训练的Confidence-Guided Markov Weighted Alternative Temporal Classification (CMW-ATC)方法。
AI.result: 在三个TST评估设置上的实验表明，该方法相比传统的师生训练和ATC-R方法取得了持续的性能提升。消融实验验证了S-CEM、马尔可夫转移加权以及可靠邻近击打的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，提出的置信度引导马尔可夫加权半监督框架在塔布拉鼓击转录任务中显著优于传统的师生训练和ATC-R方法。
AI.translation: 塔布拉鼓击转录（TST）将塔布拉鼓音频转换为符号击打序列，但由于注释录音的稀缺，完全监督训练面临挑战。我们提出了一个半监督框架，使用序列级标记和未标记的塔布拉鼓录音。教师模型生成伪标签序列，而击打级置信度估计模型（S-CEM）则估计每个预测击打的置信度。为了改进对不确定伪标签的训练，我们提出了置信度引导马尔可夫加权替代时间分类（CMW-ATC），它使用学到的击打转换和可靠的相邻击打来加权不确定跨度内的候选序列。在三个TST评估设置上的实验表明，该方法比传统的师生训练和替代时间分类替代形式（ATC-R）取得了持续的改进。消融实验进一步展示了S-CEM、马尔可夫转移加权以及在不确定跨度两侧使用可靠击打的作用。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种针对半监督塔布拉鼓击转录的置信度引导马尔可夫加权框架。通过结合教师模型、Stroke-Level Confidence Estimation Model (S-CEM)以及CMW-ATC方法，有效利用未标记数据中的伪标签并克服不确定性，在实验中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 塔布拉鼓击转录, 半监督学习, 伪标签, 马尔可夫加权, 置信度估计
AI.comments: 该论文针对塔布拉鼓击转录（TST）中注释数据稀缺的问题，提出了一种新颖的半监督框架。核心创新在于置信度引导的马尔可夫加权替代时间分类（CMW-ATC），它利用了stroke级别的置信度和马尔可夫转移概率来有效处理伪标签的不确定性，提升了半监督学习的性能。

title: Adaptive Antenna Element Activation for Multiuser Uniform Spherical Arrays
summary: Uniform spherical arrays provide full-space coverage. However, owing to directional element patterns, full-array transmission activates many elements that contribute little to a given user, resulting in increased system overhead and inefficient power allocation. To address this issue, this letter proposes an adaptive element activation strategy for multiuser uniform spherical arrays that reduces the number of physically active elements while satisfying individual user rate requirements. The proposed strategy constructs a user-specific candidate sequence according to the angle between each element boresight and the user direction. At each iteration, it selects, among the unsatisfied users, the user-element connection that provides the largest improvement in the aggregate rate deficit. Simulation results show that fewer than half of the elements are sufficient for a single user to achieve 80% of its full-array rate, while fewer than 70% are sufficient to achieve the full-array rates of all users in multiuser scenarios. Moreover, the proposed strategy consistently requires a lower active-element ratio than the baseline methods across all tested configurations.

AI.title_translation: 多用户均匀球面阵列的自适应天线单元激活
AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对多用户均匀球面阵列的自适应天线激活策略，在满足速率需求的同时大幅减少了活跃天线数量并降低了系统开销。
AI.motivation: 均匀球面阵列虽然能提供全空间覆盖，但由于方向性天线图的存在，全阵列传输会激活许多对特定用户贡献很小的天线，导致系统开销增加和功率分配低效。
AI.method: 提出了一种自适应天线激活策略，根据每个天线视轴与用户方向之间的夹角构建用户特定的候选序列，并在每次迭代中选择对聚合速率差改善最大的用户-天线连接。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，单用户场景下少于一半的天线即可达到全阵列速率的80%，多用户场景下少于70%的天线即可达到所有用户的全阵列速率，且该策略在所有测试配置下均比基线方法需要更低的活跃天线比例。
AI.conclusion: 自适应天线单元激活策略能够在满足多用户速率需求的前提下，显著减少均匀球面阵列中活跃天线的数量，降低系统开销和功率分配的低效性。
AI.translation: 均匀球面阵列提供了全空间覆盖。然而，由于方向性天线图的存在，全阵列传输会激活许多对特定用户贡献很小的天线，从而导致系统开销增加和功率分配低效。为了解决这个问题，本文针对多用户均匀球面阵列提出了一种自适应天线激活策略，在满足单个用户速率需求的同时减少物理活跃天线的数量。所提出的策略根据每个天线视轴与用户方向之间的夹角构建用户特定的候选序列。在每次迭代中，它在未满足需求的用户中选择能为聚合速率差带来最大改善的用户-天线连接。仿真结果表明，在单用户场景下，少于一半的天线就足以使单个用户达到其全阵列速率的80%，而在多用户场景下，少于70%的天线就足以达到所有用户的全阵列速率。此外，在所有测试配置下，所提出的策略始终比基线方法需要更低的活跃天线比例。
AI.summary: 本文针对多用户均匀球面阵列提出了一种自适应天线单元激活策略，通过构建候选序列和迭代选择最优用户-天线连接，在满足用户速率需求的同时显著减少了活跃天线数量并降低了系统开销。
AI.keywords: 均匀球面阵列, 自适应天线激活, 多用户通信, 系统开销, 功率分配
AI.comments: 该论文针对多用户均匀球面阵列提出了一种自适应天线单元激活策略，有效降低了系统开销和不必要的功率分配，创新点在于利用基于角度的候选序列和基于速率差的迭代选择机制，在满足用户速率需求的同时大幅减少了活跃天线数量。

title: Towards Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Stiff Guitar String Vibrations
summary: Modeling stiff string vibrations is challenging due to their dispersive and high-frequency characteristics. This study investigates the effectiveness of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) in simulating the transverse vibration of a one-dimensional linear stiff string with sharp initial conditions induced by plucking. The governing Partial Differential Equation (PDE), along with the associated initial and boundary conditions, is incorporated directly into the loss function of the neural network. For the reference measurements, a wire-breaking experiment was performed to excite the string, and its vibration response was captured using a laser profiler. The comparison between experimental measurements, finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations, and PINN-based simulations shows good overall agreement, highlighting the potential of PINNs for modeling stiff-string vibrations.

AI.title_translation: 迈向用于刚性吉他弦振动的物理信息神经网络
AI.tldr: 本研究证明了物理信息神经网络（PINN）在模拟具有色散和高频特征的刚性吉他弦振动方面具有很大潜力。
AI.motivation: 由于刚性琴弦的振动具有色散和高频特性，传统的建模方法面临挑战，因此本研究旨在探讨物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在模拟这种复杂振动时的有效性。
AI.method: 将控制偏微分方程以及相关的初始和边界条件直接纳入神经网络的损失函数中，并利用激光轮廓仪采集的 wire-breaking 实验数据以及有限差分时域（FDTD）仿真结果进行对比验证。
AI.result: 实验测量、有限差分时域（FDTD）仿真与基于PINN的仿真之间表现出良好的总体一致性。
AI.conclusion: PINN能够有效模拟刚性琴弦的横向振动，与实验测量和传统FDTD仿真具有良好的一致性，展现了其在弦乐器振动建模中的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 由于刚性琴弦振动具有色散和高频特征，对其进行建模极具挑战性。本研究探讨了物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在模拟由拨弦引起的具有尖锐初始条件的一维线性刚性琴弦横向振动方面的有效性。控制偏微分方程（PDE）以及相关的初始和边界条件被直接纳入神经网络的损失函数中。对于参考测量，进行了断丝实验来激发琴弦，并使用激光 profiler 捕获其振动响应。实验测量、有限差分时域（FDTD）仿真和基于PINN的仿真之间的比较显示出良好的总体一致性，突出了PINN在刚性琴弦振动建模方面的潜力。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了利用物理信息神经网络（PINN）模拟一维线性刚性琴弦横向振动的方法，通过将控制偏微分方程嵌入损失函数，并与实验及FDTD仿真结果对比，证明了PINN在刚性琴弦振动建模中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN), 刚性琴弦振动, 偏微分方程, 有限差分时域法 (FDTD), 声学模拟
AI.comments: 该论文探讨了物理信息神经网络（PINN）在模拟刚性吉他弦振动方面的有效性，创新点在于将包含色散和高频特征的偏微分方程及初始边界条件直接融入神经网络损失函数中，并通过真实实验数据进行验证，展示了PINN在解决复杂声学模拟问题上的潜力。

title: Partial Accent-Control Editing in Frozen Speech Representations for Accent Conversion
summary: Accent conversion is the task of modifying a speech recording so that it sounds closer to a target accent while preserving linguistic content and other speaker-related characteristics. Most accent conversion systems use trained, generative models. Although they can induce target-accented speech, the strength of accent modification is not controllable at inference time, making it difficult to analyse how the strength of accent conversion affects source preservation. We propose Partial Accent-Control Editing (PACE), an accent conversion framework based upon the editing of frozen WavLM representations without the training of an accent-conditioned generator. A constrained edit is first applied to source WavLM features, which are then fused with target-accent reference features retrieved from non-parallel accent examples. Fusion weights are used to control the trade-off between accent conversion strength and the degradation of other source attributes. Using a suite of five metrics, and with the cost of accent-entangled speaker similarity, we show that PACE is substantially superior to a pair of competitive baselines in terms of both accent conversion and source preservation.

AI.title_translation: 用于口音转换的冻结语音表征中的局部口音控制编辑
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为PACE的创新口音转换方法，无需训练生成器，通过编辑和融合冻结的WavLM特征，实现了推理时口音强度的精确控制并平衡了源特征的保持。
AI.motivation: 大多数现有的口音转换系统依赖于训练好的生成模型，虽然能够生成目标口音的语音，但在推理时无法控制口音修改的强度，这使得难以分析口音转换强度如何影响源语言特征的保持。
AI.method: 提出Partial Accent-Control Editing (PACE)框架，无需训练口音条件生成器，而是直接对冻结的WavLM特征应用受约束的编辑，并将其与从非平行口音样本中检索到的目标口音参考特征进行融合，利用融合权重控制转换强度。
AI.result: 使用五个指标进行评估，结果表明PACE在口音转换和源属性保持方面均显著优于两个具有竞争力的基线方法，代价是存在口音纠缠的说话人相似度。
AI.conclusion: PACE框架通过直接编辑冻结的语音表征，有效实现了可控的口音转换，在口音转换效果和源属性保持方面均显著优于传统基线方法。
AI.translation: 口音转换是一项修改语音录音的任务，使其听起来更接近目标口音，同时保留语言内容和其他与说话人相关的特征。大多数口音转换系统使用经过训练的生成模型。尽管它们可以引导目标口音的语音，但口音修改的强度在推理时是不可控的，这使得难以分析口音转换的强度如何影响源特征的保持。我们提出了部分口音控制编辑（PACE），这是一种基于编辑冻结的WavLM表征的口音转换框架，无需训练口音条件生成器。首先对源WavLM特征应用受约束的编辑，然后将其与从非平行口音样本中检索到的目标口音参考特征进行融合。融合权重用于控制口音转换强度与其它源属性退化之间的权衡。通过使用一组五个指标，并且以口音纠缠的说话人相似度为代价，我们证明了PACE在口音转换和源保持方面都明显优于两个竞争基线。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为PACE的口音转换框架，通过直接编辑和融合冻结的WavLM表征，实现了在推理时对口音转换强度的精确控制，并在口音修改与源属性保持之间取得了优异的平衡。
AI.keywords: 口音转换, 语音表征, 特征编辑, 可控生成, WavLM
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种无需训练条件生成器的口音转换方法，通过在冻结的WavLM特征空间中进行受约束的编辑与融合，实现了对口音转换强度的精细控制。这不仅克服了传统方法无法在推理时调节口音强度的限制，还为分析口音修改对源语言保持的影响提供了有效手段。

title: Model-Based Iterative Reconstruction with View-Dependent Detector Displacements for Cone-Beam CT
summary: Detector shifting is used in industrial cone-beam computed tomography to reduce ring artifacts, but the resulting detector motion can vary nonuniformly across projection views and produce detector positions that cannot be represented by fixed offsets. Although analytical reconstruction can accommodate this motion, approaches that use projection interpolation or rebinning may limit spatial resolution and introduce artifacts. MBIR provides an alternative by representing the acquisition geometry explicitly within the reconstruction model. Existing separable distance-driven MBIR formulations assume fixed detector geometry across projection views and therefore cannot directly represent nonuniform motion in both detector dimensions, as this motion changes the voxel-to-detector mapping. We extend the separable distance-driven MBIR model to incorporate recorded horizontal and vertical detector displacements into the distance-driven overlap computation while leaving measured projections unchanged. Forward-projection validation achieved an NRMSE of 0.0338 across 1080 views. The proposed model achieved a 3D SSIM of 0.9404 and NRMSE of 0.0406, compared with 0.5396 and 0.1740 for fixed-detector MBIR. A second industrial dataset showed reduced structured artifacts compared with FDK.

AI.title_translation: 面向锥束CT的具有视点相关探测器位移的模型基迭代重建方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将视点相关的探测器位移整合到MBIR中的新方法，显著提升了存在非均匀探测器运动的锥束CT图像重建质量。
AI.motivation: 工业锥束CT中为了减少环形伪影会采用探测器移动，但由此产生的探测器运动在不同投影视图间存在非均匀变化，传统固定几何假设的MBIR方法无法直接处理这种复杂的体素到探测器的映射变化。
AI.method: 扩展了可分离的距离-驱动MBIR模型，将记录的水平和垂直探测器位移并入距离-驱动重叠计算中，而无需改变测量投影。
AI.result: 前向投影验证在1080个视图下达到了0.0338的NRMSE；所提模型的3D SSIM达到0.9404，NRMSE为0.0406（固定探测器MBIR分别为0.5396和0.1740）；在工业数据集上展示出比FDK更少的结构化伪影。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功将探测器非均匀运动建模引入MBIR的前向和反向投影计算中，显著提升了存在探测器位移的锥束CT成像质量，优于传统的固定探测器MBIR和FDK算法。
AI.translation: 在工业锥束计算机断层扫描中，探测器移动常被用于减少环形伪影，但由此产生的探测器运动在各个投影视图之间可能会出现非均匀变化，从而产生无法用固定偏移量表示的探测器位置。尽管解析重建可以适应这种运动，但使用投影插值或重新分箱的方法可能会限制空间分辨率并引入伪影。MBIR通过在重建模型中显式表示采集几何形状，提供了一种替代方案。现有的可分离距离驱动MBIR公式假设各个投影视图的探测器几何形状是固定的，因此无法直接表示两个探测器维度中的非均匀运动，因为这种运动会改变体素到探测器的映射。我们扩展了可分离距离驱动MBIR模型，将记录的水平和垂直探测器位移纳入距离驱动重叠计算中，同时保持测量的投影不变。前向投影验证在1080个视图中实现了0.0338的NRMSE。所提出的模型实现了0.9404的3D SSIM和0.0406的NRMSE，而固定探测器MBIR分别为0.5396和0.1740。第二个工业数据集显示，与FDK相比，结构化伪影有所减少。
AI.summary: 该论文针对工业锥束CT中非均匀探测器位移的问题，提出了一种改进的基于模型的迭代重建（MBIR）方法。通过将视点相关的水平和垂直探测器位移显式纳入距离-驱动的投影模型中，该方法在不插值投影的前提下显著提高了重建图像的质量，减少了伪影。
AI.keywords: 锥束CT, 模型基迭代重建, 探测器位移, 距离驱动模型
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种将视点相关探测器位移整合到基于模型的迭代重建（MBIR）中的新方法，有效解决了工业锥束CT中非均匀探测器运动带来的伪影问题，在空间分辨率和图像质量上有显著提升。

title: Making Latent Evolution Explicit: Operator-Structured Transitions for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot policies by predicting how task-relevant scene states may evolve under interaction. Recent WAMs increasingly perform such prediction in latent representation spaces, avoiding full appearance-level generation while preserving control-relevant information. Yet latent transitions are commonly realized with Transformer-based predictors whose inductive structure is centered on token interaction rather than temporal evolution. We study transition realization as an architectural choice distinct from predictive representation and prediction-policy coupling. We introduce the Latent Evolution Operator Network (LEON), which models latent evolution in a learned observable space through context-modulated operator-based propagation and additive forcing. Grounded in the controlled Koopman generator view of evolution, LEON organizes context-dependent transition variation around a shared evolution-operator structure while retaining a complementary path for additive change. Controlled dynamical systems verify the resulting evolution-specific inductive bias and the complementary roles of operator propagation and forcing. Across two WAM formulations that integrate latent prediction into the policy differently, LEON improves closed-loop performance and robustness while remaining effective under full transition replacement. These results establish transition realization as a consequential architectural choice in latent WAMs.

AI.title_translation: 使隐式演化显式化：世界动作模型的算子结构化过渡
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为LEON的隐空间演化算子网络，通过引入受Koopman生成器启发的算子结构化过渡，显著提升了世界动作模型（WAMs）在机器人控制中的性能与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 当前世界动作模型（WAMs）常采用基于Transformer的预测器进行隐空间状态演化预测，其归纳偏置集中于Token交互而非时间演化。为了将过渡实现与预测表征区分开并提供更好的演化归纳偏置，需要一种专门针对隐空间演化的算子结构。
AI.method: 引入了潜在演化算子网络（LEON），在学习到的可观测空间中通过上下文调制的基于算子的传播和加法强迫来建模潜在演化，其设计根植于受控Koopman生成器视图。
AI.result: 在受控动力学系统上验证了所提演化特定归纳偏置的有效性；在两种集成隐空间预测的WAM公式中，LEON均提高了闭环性能和鲁棒性，并在完全替换过渡时依然有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过将过渡实现视为一种独立的架构选择，并引入受控Koopman生成器视角的LEON网络，论文验证了演化特定归纳偏置的有效性，显著提升了机器人在闭环控制中的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过预测任务相关场景状态在交互下的演化来增强机器人策略。最近的WAMs越来越多地在潜在表征空间中执行这种预测，在保留控制相关信息的同时避免了全外观级别的生成。然而，潜在过渡通常由基于Transformer的预测器实现，其归纳结构侧重于Token交互而非时间演化。我们将过渡实现研究为一种与预测表征和预测策略耦合不同的架构选择。我们引入了潜在演化算子网络（LEON），它通过上下文调制的基于算子的传播和加法强迫，在学习到的可观测空间中对潜在演化进行建模。基于演化的受控Koopman生成器观点，LEON围绕共享的演化算子结构组织上下文相关的过渡变化，同时保留了用于加法变化的互补路径。受控动力学系统验证了所产生的演化特定归纳偏置以及算子传播和强迫的互补作用。在将潜在预测以不同方式集成到策略中的两种WAM公式中，LEON改善了闭环性能和鲁棒性，同时在完全过渡替换下仍然有效。这些结果确立了过渡实现作为潜在WAM中一个重要的架构选择。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了世界动作模型（WAMs）中隐空间过渡实现的架构选择问题，并提出了基于受控Koopman生成器的Latent Evolution Operator Network (LEON)。通过引入算子结构化传播与加法强迫，LEON增强了隐空间演化的归纳偏置，从而显著提升了机器人策略的闭环性能与鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: World Action Models, Latent Evolution, Koopman Generator, Operator Network, Robot Policies
AI.comments: 该论文聚焦于世界动作模型（WAMs）中的隐空间演化建模，提出了一种受Koopman生成器启发的算子结构化过渡网络（LEON），明确区分了表征与演化算子架构，为机器人策略学习中的状态预测提供了更具归纳偏置且鲁棒的新方案。

title: RTLViT: real-time lensless reconstruction with a lightweight vision transformer
summary: Mask-based lensless imagers capture measurements using simple, compact hardware and recover images using a reconstruction algorithm. The reconstruction algorithm affects the image quality, inference speed, and computational requirements of the imaging system, often trading off image quality against computational efficiency. Advancing toward integrated lensless imagers, where encoding and reconstruction occur within a single device (e.g., a mobile phone), requires a fast, high-quality, and practical reconstruction method. We introduce the Real-Time Lensless Vision Transformer (RTLViT), a lightweight, purely data-driven reconstruction architecture for high-quality and real-time lensless reconstruction. With only 1.09 million learnable parameters, RTLViT provides higher-quality reconstructions than both real-time baselines and substantially larger attention-based architectures, including improvements of up to 3.46 dB in peak signal-to-noise ratio over architectures with $15 \times$ more learnable parameters. We demonstrate that RTLViT maintains high-quality reconstructions across a wide range of training dataset sizes and two different mask designs (lenslets and a diffuser). Finally, we implement real-time reconstruction with RTLViT on laptops and smartphones, supporting future integrated lensless imagers for real-time applications.

AI.title_translation: RTLViT：基于轻量级视觉Transformer的实时无透镜重建
AI.tldr: RTLViT 是一种轻量级视觉 Transformer，仅用 109 万参数便实现了无透镜成像的实时、高质量重建，并成功在手机端部署。
AI.motivation: 基于掩模的无透镜成像系统需要快速、高质量且实用的重建方法，以推动编码和重建集成在单个设备（如手机）中的集成式无透镜成像仪的发展，但现有的重建算法往往在图像质量和计算效率之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 RTLViT（Real-Time Lensless Vision Transformer）的轻量级、纯数据驱动的重建架构，包含 1.090 万个可学习参数，并在笔记本电脑和智能手机上进行了实时重建实现。
AI.result: RTLViT 仅有 109 万个参数，在峰值信噪比（PSNR）上比参数多 15 倍的架构高出多达 3.46 dB，并能在不同的训练数据集大小和两种掩模设计（微透镜和漫射器）下保持高质量重建，同时支持笔记本电脑和智能手机上的实时重建。
AI.conclusion: RTLViT 作为一个轻量级、纯数据驱动的视觉 Transformer，成功实现了无透镜成像的高质量实时重建，并在笔记本电脑和智能手机上得到验证，为未来集成式无透镜成像设备的实际应用奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 基于掩模的无透镜成像仪使用简单、紧凑的硬件捕获测量值，并使用重建算法恢复图像。重建算法会影响成像系统的图像质量、推理速度和计算需求，往往需要在图像质量和计算效率之间进行权衡。为了推进编码和重建在单个设备（例如手机）中进行的集成无透镜成像仪的发展，需要一种快速、高质量且实用的重建方法。我们引入了实时无透镜视觉 Transformer（RTLViT），这是一种用于高质量和实时无透镜重建的轻量级、纯数据驱动的重建架构。RTLViT 仅拥有 109 万个可学习参数，其提供的重建质量不仅高于实时基线，也高于明显更大的基于注意力的架构，在峰值信噪比上比参数多 15 倍的架构提升高达 3.46 dB。我们证明了 RTLViT 在各种训练数据集规模和两种不同的掩模设计（微透镜和漫射器）下都能保持高质量的重建。最后，我们在笔记本电脑和智能手机上实现了使用 RTLViT 的实时重建，为未来用于实时应用的集成无透镜成像仪提供了支持。
AI.summary: RTLViT 是一种用于无透镜成像重建的轻量级、纯数据驱动的视觉 Transformer 架构。它在保持极少参数量的同时，实现了超越现有基线和更大模型的重建质量，并成功在手机和笔记本上完成了实时部署。
AI.keywords: 无透镜成像, 图像重建, 视觉 Transformer, 实时处理, 轻量级架构
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种名为 RTLViT 的轻量级视觉 Transformer 架构，实现了无透镜成像的实时、高质量重建。其创新之处在于仅用极少的参数量（1.09M）就超越了现有的大型架构，并且成功部署在手机等边缘设备上，对推动集成式无透镜成像系统的发展具有重要意义。

title: Extracting Physiological Numeric Values from French Pediatric ICU Notes: A Multi-Objective Representation Learning Approach
comments: Submitted and currently under review at IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering
summary: Numeric values in clinical narratives, such as heart rate, oxygen saturation, and pressure gradients, carry diagnostic meaning that Transformer models trained on generic text do not capture. Objective: We categorize numerical values in French pediatric intensive care unit (PICU) notes into eight physiological categories using CamemBERT-bio, under two constraints that make large-scale LLMs impractical: only 1,072 real, annotated clinical samples are available for this rare, single-site condition, and training must run on GPUs shared concurrently with other hospital workloads rather than a dedicated cluster. Methods: We compare fine-tuning CamemBERT-bio with Label Embedding for Self-Attention (LESA) against combining LESA with Xval, a magnitude-aware number embedding, under a multi-objective training loss. Results: Standard fine-tuning did not improve F1 score, but CamemBERT-bio + LESA raised it by over 13%, and adding Xval matched this gain while approaching GPT-4's performance. Conclusion: LESA and Xval let a compact encoder achieve reliable physiological value extraction under limited real data and shared hospital compute, offering a practical alternative to large-scale LLMs. Significance: Under limited-data and shared-compute constraints, this compact BERT-based language model remains effective without the resource trade-offs of trillion-parameter LLMs.
comment: Submitted and currently under review at IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering

AI.title_translation: 从法语儿科ICU病历中提取生理数值：一种多目标表征学习方法
AI.tldr: 在数据稀缺和算力受限的医院环境中，基于CamemBERT-bio结合LESA和Xval的方法能够高效且准确地从法语儿科ICU病历中提取生理数值。
AI.motivation: 临床叙述中的数字具有重要的诊断意义，但基于通用文本训练的Transformer模型无法捕捉。此外，面对罕见的单中心病例，真实标注样本极少，且无法使用专用集群，只能在与其他医院工作负载共享的GPU上运行，使得大规模LLM不切实际。
AI.method: 将CamemBERT-bio与自注意力标签嵌入（LESA）以及幅度感知数字嵌入（Xval）相结合，并在多目标训练损失下进行微调。
AI.result: 标准微调没有提高F1分数，但CamemBERT-bio + LESA使其提高了13%以上，加入Xval后也达到了这一增益，同时接近了GPT-4的性能。
AI.conclusion: LESA和Xval使紧凑型编码器能够在有限的真实数据和共享的医院计算资源下，实现可靠的生理数值提取，为大规模LLM提供了一个实用的替代方案。
AI.translation: 临床叙述中的数字，如心率、血氧饱和度和压力梯度，具有通用文本训练的Transformer模型无法捕捉的诊断意义。目标：我们在CamemBERT-bio的基础上，将法国儿科重症监护室（PICU）病历中的数值归类为八个生理类别，需满足两个限制大语言模型（LLM）大规模应用的约束：针对这种罕见的单中心疾病，只有1,072个真实标注的临床样本可用，且训练必须在与医院其他工作负载共享的GPU上运行，而不是专用集群。方法：我们比较了将CamemBERT-bio与自注意力标签嵌入（LESA）进行微调，以及将LESA与幅度感知数字嵌入Xval结合并在多目标训练损失下的表现。结果：标准的微调没有提高F1分数，但CamemBERT-bio + LESA使其提高了13%以上，加入Xval后也达到了这一增益，同时接近了GPT-4的性能。结论：LESA和Xval使紧凑型编码器能够在有限的真实数据和共享的医院计算资源下，实现可靠的生理数值提取，为大规模LLM提供了一个实用的替代方案。意义：在有限数据和共享计算的约束下，这种紧凑的基于BERT的语言模型仍然有效，且没有万亿参数LLM的资源权衡问题。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种多目标表征学习方法，利用CamemBERT-bio结合LESA和Xval，在法语儿科ICU病历中提取生理数值，克服了数据稀缺和算力受限的挑战，取得了接近GPT-4的性能。
AI.keywords: 生理数值提取, 多目标表征学习, 法语儿科ICU病历, CamemBERT-bio, 临床自然语言处理
AI.comments: 该论文针对医疗文本中生理数值提取任务，巧妙地结合了LESA和Xval嵌入方法，在数据量极少且算力受限的医院环境下，使紧凑型BERT模型达到了接近GPT-4的性能，具有很高的临床应用实用价值。

title: Multi-Carrier Rydberg Atomic Quantum Receivers with Enhanced Bandwidth Feature for Communication and Sensing
summary: Rydberg atomic quantum receivers (RAQRs) have attracted significant attention in recent years due to their ultra-high sensitivity. Although capable of precisely detecting the amplitude and phase of weak signals, conventional RAQRs face inherent limitations in accurately receiving wideband RF signals, due to the discrete nature of atomic energy levels and their intrinsic instantaneous bandwidth constraints. These limitations hinder their direct application to multi-carrier communication and sensing. To address this issue, this paper proposes a multi-carrier Rydberg atomic quantum receiver (MC-RAQR) structure with five energy levels. We derive the amplitude and phase of the MC-RAQR and extract the baseband electrical signal for signal processing. In terms of multi-carrier communication and sensing, we analyze the channel capacity and accuracy of angle of arrival (AoA) and distance parameters, respectively. Numerical results validate our proposed model, showing that the MC-RAQR can achieve up to a bandwidth of 11.7 MHz, which is 17-fold larger than the conventional RAQRs. As a result, the channel capacity and the resolution for multi-target sensing are improved significantly. Specifically, the channel capacity of MC-RAQR is 110-fold and 2.8-fold larger than the classical RF receivers and RAQRs, respectively. For sensing performance, the RMSE of AoA estimation for MC-RAQR exhibits 7.6-fold reduction, compared with the conventional RAQRs. Furthermore, the RMSE of distance estimation is $634$-fold smaller than that of the root-CRB of classical RF receivers, showing the superior performance of the MC-RAQR. This demonstrates its compatibility with waveforms such as orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) and its significant advantages for multi-carrier signal reception.

AI.title_translation: 具有增强带宽特性的多载波里德堡原子量子接收器用于通信与传感
AI.tldr: 提出了一种带宽增强的多载波里德堡原子量子接收器，大幅提升了通信信道容量和传感精度。
AI.motivation: 传统的里德堡原子量子接收器（RAQRs）由于原子能级的离散性和固有的瞬时带宽限制，难以准确接收宽带射频信号，从而限制了其在多载波通信和传感领域的直接应用。
AI.method: 提出了一种包含五个能级的多载波里德堡原子量子接收器（MC-RAQR）结构，推导了其幅度和相位以提取基带电信号进行信号处理，并对其通信信道容量以及到达角（AoA）和距离估计的精度进行了分析与数值验证。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，MC-RAQR的带宽达到了11.7 MHz，是传统RAQR的17倍。其信道容量分别是经典射频接收器和传统RAQR的110倍和2.8倍。在感知性能方面，AoA估计的均方根误差（RMSE）较传统RAQR降低了7.6倍，距离估计的RMSE比经典射频接收器的root-CRB小634倍。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的多载波里德堡原子量子接收器（MC-RAQR）有效克服了传统原子接收器带宽受限的缺点，在多载波通信和多目标传感方面展现出显著的性能提升，具有极大的应用潜力。
AI.translation: 近年来，里德堡原子量子接收器（RAQRs）因其超高灵敏度而备受关注。尽管能够精确检测弱信号的幅度和相位，但由于原子能级的离散性质及其固有的瞬时带宽限制，传统的RAQRs在准确接收宽带射频信号方面面临固有局限性。这些局限性阻碍了它们在多载波通信和传感中的直接应用。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种具有五个能级的多载波里德堡原子量子接收器（MC-RAQR）结构。我们推导了MC-RAQR的幅度和相位，并提取基带电信号进行信号处理。在多载波通信和传感方面，我们分别分析了信道容量以及到达角（AoA）和距离参数的精度。数值结果验证了我们提出的模型，表明MC-RAQR可以实现高达11.7 MHz的带宽，比传统RAQR大17倍。因此，信道容量和多目标感知的分辨率显著提高。具体而言，MC-RAQR的信道容量分别比经典射频接收器和传统RAQR大110倍和2.8倍。在传感性能方面，与传统RAQR相比，MC-RAQR的AoA估计RMSE降低了7.6倍。此外，距离估计的RMSE比经典射频接收器的root-CRB小634倍，显示出MC-RAQR的优越性能。这证明了其与正交频分复用（OFDM）等波形的兼容性，以及其在多载波信号接收方面的显著优势。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种具有五个能级的多载波里德堡原子量子接收器（MC-RAQR）结构，以解决传统里德堡原子接收器带宽受限的问题。研究表明，该接收器不仅将带宽提升了17倍，还大幅增强了多载波通信的信道容量以及到达角和距离估计的传感精度。
AI.keywords: 里德堡原子量子接收器, 多载波通信, 带宽增强, 信道容量, 目标感知
AI.comments: 该论文针对传统里德堡原子量子接收器瞬时带宽受限的问题，创新性地提出了一种基于五能级系统的多载波里德堡原子量子接收器（MC-RAQR）结构。通过理论推导与数值验证，该方法显著提升了带宽、通信信道容量以及多目标感知（如到达角和距离估计）的精度，为里德堡原子接收器在复杂射频环境中的应用提供了重要支撑。

title: Dipole-lets: a new multiscale decomposition for MR phase and quantitative susceptibility mapping
summary: Nondipolar phase contributions can generate severe streaking artifacts during quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM) inversion. We propose Dipole-lets, a dipole-adapted multiscale decomposition designed to identify phase components associated with streaking artifacts before and during susceptibility inversion. Dipole- lets combine an undecimated radial decomposition with an angular partition based on proximity to the magic cone. The resulting coefficients emphasize phase components near the magic cone, where nondipolar contributions may become relatively prominent. This information was incorporated into QSM reconstruction through a data- driven fidelity weight and a Dipole-let-based regularizer that models an additional nondipolar phase component. The methods were evaluated using modified simulated QSM data and an in vivo dataset. The data-driven weighting reduced streaking artifacts while preserving anatomical detail and improved quantitative reconstruction metrics compared with magnitude-weighted TV. The Dipole-let regularizer achieved streaking suppression comparable to L1-QSM and lower reconstruction error in the modified simulated dataset. In vivo experiments further demonstrated the applicability of the proposed approach to data with strong susceptibility-induced phase perturbations. Dipole-lets provide a multiscale representation for characterizing phase components associated with streaking artifacts and incorporating this information into QSM reconstruction, reducing streaking while preserving relevant susceptibility structures, and providing a flexible basis for future QSM reconstruction methods.

title: AFDM: Evolving OFDM Towards 6G+
comments: Accepted for publication at the IEEE OJCOMS
summary: As sixth generation (6G) standardization accelerates, there is growing consensus in favor of evolutionary waveforms that add new capabilities while preserving compatibility with the orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) core of 4G and 5G. This article positions affine frequency division multiplexing (AFDM) as such a candidate, providing structural robustness for high-mobility communications and integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) over doubly dispersive channels while remaining backward-compatible with the legacy OFDM air interface. We first develop a generalized fractional-delay-fractional-Doppler (FDFD) channel model that accounts for practical pulse-shaping filters and the resulting inter-sample coupling. Building on this model, we show that the AFDM transceiver reuses nearly the entire OFDM chain, adding only lightweight digital pre- and post-processing. We then analyze the impact of hardware impairments such as phase noise and carrier frequency offset, and examine the advanced functionalities enabled by the chirp-parameter domain, including index modulation and physical-layer security. Assessing reusability across the radio-frequency, physical, and higher layers, we conclude that AFDM offers an efficient path toward high-fidelity later versions of 6G and beyond (6G+) communications.
comment: Accepted for publication at the IEEE OJCOMS

title: Joint Subcarrier Phase Recovery for Nonlinearity Mitigation
summary: We propose a low-complexity phase recovery scheme that simultaneously mitigates laser phase noise and fiber nonlinearity across several subcarriers. In a long single-span link with Raman amplification, the scheme achieves 0.9 dB gain with 99 real multiplications per complex symbol.

title: LLMs and Speech: Integration vs. Combination
summary: In this work, we study different approaches to utilize large language models (LLMs) for automatic speech recognition (ASR). Specifically, we compare the tight integration of an acoustic model (AM) with the LLM ("speech LLM") to the traditional way of combining AM and LLM via shallow fusion and provide ablations on the effect of different label units and LLM sizes. For tight integration, we further examine the effect of attention interfaces, encoder downsampling, and length normalization. Furthermore, we investigate joint recognition with a CTC model to mitigate hallucinations of speech LLMs and present effective optimizations. We train and evaluate on LibriSpeech and Loquacious and additionally evaluate on the HuggingFace ASR leaderboard. Across model sizes, we find that shallow fusion consistently outperforms tight integration of AM and LLM on in-domain data, highlighting the importance of strong shallow-fusion baselines when evaluating speech LLMs for ASR. On the more heterogeneous HuggingFace ASR leaderboard, however, the integrated prefix LLM achieves lower average WER than shallow fusion, with gains concentrated on out-of-domain corpora.

title: Quantization-Aware EE Optimization and SE-EE Tradeoff for MiLAC-Aided MU-MISO Beamforming
comments: This paper has been accepted by the IEEE TSP
summary: In large antenna arrays, hardware power consumption becomes a dominant design constraint, making energy efficiency (EE) a first-class objective alongside spectral efficiency (SE). Microwave linear analog computer (MiLAC)-aided beamforming, whose front end is a passive reciprocal stream-to-antenna network, addresses this tension by reducing the active radio-frequency chain count to the stream number, at a moderate SE cost. Despite this promise, no EE optimization framework has been established for MiLAC-aided beamforming that accounts for digital-to-analog converter quantization noise and post-quantized transmit power. We fill this gap for downlink multiuser multiple-input single-output (MU-MISO) systems by formulating quantization-aware EE maximization over the MiLAC-feasible beamformer and characterizing the resulting SE-EE tradeoff. Three contributions follow. First, we prove a row-space optimality property of the effective MiLAC-aided beamformer, yielding an equivalent reduced-dimension reformulation whose complexity scales with the stream number rather than the antenna number. Second, we develop a low-complexity Dinkelbach-weighted minimum mean-square error algorithm aided by projected gradient descent that is guaranteed to converge to a stationary point. Third, we cast the SE-EE tradeoff as a multi-objective problem and trace its Pareto boundary via a weighted-sum method that combines an alternative reduced-dimension coordinate with auxiliary-variable successive convex approximation, yielding convex per-iteration subproblems with guaranteed convergence. Numerical results on a DeepMIMO v4 deployment show MiLAC-aided beamforming substantially improves EE over digital and hybrid benchmarks at a moderate SE cost and significantly expands the achievable SE-EE operating region.

title: Vaani Benchmark V1.0: An Inclusive Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for Hindi
summary: Benchmarking is critical for the systematic evaluation of machine learning systems. While several open-source datasets are available for Hindi, existing benchmarks remain limited in terms of modality, geographic diversity, demographic representation, and transcription robustness. We introduce an inclusive, multimodal Hindi benchmark dataset collected from 102 districts across India. The dataset consists of spontaneous speech elicited using image prompts and recorded under real-world acoustic conditions across diverse demographic groups. Each audio segment is associated with the image prompt that elicited it and is annotated with three independent transcriptions, enabling multi-reference evaluation that accounts for permissible orthographic and lexical variations. We show that single-reference evaluation overstates errors, while multi-reference evaluation provides a more robust, inclusive, and realistic assessment of automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. The pairing of each utterance with its eliciting image further enables image retrieval evaluation using both speech and text queries. We evaluate multiple multimodal embedding models for image retrieval and report their performance on the combined speech--image and text--image retrieval tasks. The results reveal a performance gap between text-based and audio-based retrieval, with text-based retrieval consistently achieving higher performance.

title: Symbol-Level Precoding for Continuous-Aperture ISAC Systems
summary: Continuous-aperture arrays (CAPAs) offer rich electromagnetic degrees of freedom for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), but optimizing continuous current distributions leads to challenging infinite-dimensional problems. This paper investigates a CAPA-enabled downlink ISAC system with symbol-level precoding and receive polarization combining. The transmit current is optimized to maximize weighted target-illumination power while enforcing constructive-interference constraints for communication users. To address the resulting infinite-dimensional nonconvex problem, we establish that the optimal current distribution lies in a finite-dimensional subspace spanned by the communication and sensing electromagnetic responses. This result yields an exact, structure-preserving reformulation in terms of finite-dimensional coefficients. A penalty projected-gradient algorithm is then developed to jointly optimize the current coefficients and polarization combiners. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves higher sensing utility and improved communication reliability than conventional Fourier-basis CAPA and spatially discrete array baselines.

title: Consensus-Guided Shared-Specific Tri-View Learning for Speech Emotion Recognition
comments: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Speech emotion recognition (SER) benefits from heterogeneous acoustic representations, but views derived from the same utterance contain both overlapping emotional evidence and representation-dependent cues. Direct fusion may therefore propagate redundant information or obscure complementary details. To address this issue, we propose Tri-view Consensus-Guided Fusion (TriCGF) for jointly modeling spectrogram, Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients, and HuBERT representations. TriCGF organizes each view into common and view-specific components before fusion. Cross-view Consensus Learning aggregates the common components into a global reference, while View-wise Gated Integration adaptively combines this reference with each view-specific component. A soft difference regularizer further discourages excessive information overlap. Under speaker-independent evaluation, TriCGF achieves 74.19% weighted accuracy (WA) and 75.17% unweighted accuracy (UA) on IEMOCAP, and 94.36% WA and 94.28% UA on EmoDB, outperforming representative SER methods on both datasets.

title: Synthetic Fingerprints for Children Under Four: Generation and Biometric Evaluation
comments: Accepted at IEEE Ubiquitous Computing, Electronics, and Mobile Communication (UEMCON), 2026
summary: Fingerprint recognition in children under four is of interest for longitudinal identity applications, but research in this age range is constrained by the limited availability and sensitivity of real fingerprint data. Synthetic data may provide a useful complementary resource if generated samples are carefully evaluated for biometric quality, similarity to the real training data, and identity diversity. This paper presents an evaluation and selection protocol for synthetic fingerprints generated from a small pediatric dataset. The protocol was applied to 32,000 candidates produced by an age-conditioned generator fine-tuned with 205 fingerprints from nine children. Candidates were evaluated using NFIQ 2, NBIS minutiae extrac-tion and matching, fingerprint-pattern classification, similarity to the complete real reference set, and pairwise similarity among retained synthetic samples. After candidate filtering and a final symmetric pairwise verification, 1,985 synthetic fingerprints remained. The youngest age group continued to produce retained samples within the sampling budget, whereas the oldest original age group produced 24 retained prints. A data-derived two-group age representation improved pattern-distribution agreement for the younger group. Repeated renderings of fixed synthetic iden-tities produced minutiae-based mated scores comparable to the real mated scores, although a DINOv2 texture representation showed substantially greater within-generator similarity. The results indicate that synthetic pediatric fingerprints can support controlled research use, but their evaluation should include both real-to-synthetic similarity and synthetic-to-synthetic diversity, and conclusions should remain specific to the matchers and measurements used.

title: A Probabilistic Modeling Framework for Transient Debris Outcomes in Low Lunar Orbits
summary: This work presents a novel probabilistic framework for the assessment of orbital debris fragment outcomes in the low lunar orbit (LLO) regime over time horizons ranging from a few hours to a hundred days after a debris generation event. The framework develops continuous distributions for the probability of sinking (lunar collision) and non-sinking over these transient time horizons, building upon NASA's Standard Breakup Model to provide insights into the variations in the likelihood of debris outcomes across the LLO regime and offering an alternative to computationally expensive Monte Carlo simulations. The effects of perturbative forces such as solar radiation pressure are used to assess the realization of debris outcomes over varying time horizons, providing an analytical framework that bounds the likelihood of each outcome. Results indicate variations in the probability of sinking over short time horizons depending on the originating location of the debris generation event, as well as a link between the physical characteristics of fragments and their likelihood of sinking over longer time horizons. The future incorporation of this framework into broader-scale orbital environment models, mission risk assessment procedures, and policy development are briefly discussed.

title: Robust tests for log-normal lifetimes under cyclic-stress accelerated tests and interval monitoring
summary: Some products are, by nature, designed to operate under stress conditions that repeatedly cycle between two levels, such as batteries undergoing repeated charge and discharge, or components exposed to recurring thermal or pressure cycles. When such products are tested under accelerated conditions, the applied stress is naturally elevated in the same cyclic manner rather than held constant or increased in a single step. Cyclic-stress accelerated life testing (CyALT) reflects this by alternating the applied stress between specified levels. Units are often inspected only at fixed times, so the data consist of interval failure counts rather than exact lifetimes. Hypothesis testing plays a crucial role in this setting. It can assess whether the applied stress significantly affects lifetime, or validate the parameter values used to design the experiment. Classical tests rely on the maximum likelihood estimator, which is highly sensitive to contamination. Since interval probabilities are estimated jointly across stress conditions, a single anomalous failure count can distort the entire parameter vector and severely affect the test's significance level and power. This paper develops Wald-type and Rao-type test statistics for log-normal CyALT lifetimes under interval monitoring, based on the weighted minimum density power divergence estimator. Both tests are derived for simple and composite null hypotheses. A Monte Carlo study shows that classical tests lose control of the significance level rapidly under contamination, while the robust tests stay close to nominal with only a modest loss of power under clean data. An application to air-conditioner evaporator lifetime data further illustrates the proposed tests.

title: Testing Conditional Stochastic Dominance via Copula Derivatives
summary: Comparing two populations at the same physical covariate value requires more than conditional means or isolated target-point decisions: researchers may need evidence about an entire conditional-distribution ordering over a continuum, even when covariate margins differ. This paper makes that common-value comparison estimable under an explicit structure--flexibility tradeoff and turns the resulting surface into simultaneous evidence for first-order stochastic dominance. Population-specific margins map the common covariate value into each group, while a fitted copula-derivative representation links conditional distributions across the region. Uniform inference propagates uncertainty from both the margins and dependence model through a one-sided statistic with unknown binding locations. Under correct specification within a finite copula class, smoothness and trimming conditions, and a uniquely best candidate family, the procedure admits uniform control and consistent calibration. Simulations show increasing rejection as alternatives become more distinguishable, alongside model-selection sensitivity and small-sample size distortion. In a descriptive PSID application, the high--low parental-education comparison satisfies the two-direction criterion after multiplicity adjustment, whereas adjacent education-group comparisons remain inconclusive. The framework therefore supports region-wide distributional comparison while making its structural and inferential boundaries explicit.

title: Match forecasts in UEFA club competitions: Elo ratings versus Transfermarkt valuations
summary: The pre-season strengths of European football clubs are usually measured by two proxies in the literature. Football Club Elo Ratings provide strictly performance-based Elo ratings from the early days of the European Cups, while Transfermarkt valuations are crowd-based estimates of squad market values. This paper compares them by evaluating their ability to forecast the results of matches played in the UEFA Champions League and the UEFA Europa League between the seasons 2020/21 and 2024/25. The two indicators yield almost identical out-of-sample accuracy when used separately. Combining the two measures leads to a modest improvement, but the best aggregation procedure is sensitive to the forecast target. Our results suggest that seeding based on Elo ratings would be (closely) optimal.

title: Integrating Multivariate Adaptive Regression Splines into Small Area Estimation for Nonlinear Poverty Modeling in Java Island
summary: Small area estimation (SAE) modeling is often used to address the unreliability of estimates in areas with limited survey samples. However, standard SAE models (Fay-Herriot) can only accommodate linear patterns, whereas in real cases, including poverty, many patterns are nonlinear. This study proposes the implementation of a supervised learning model, multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS), integrated within the SAE framework (MARS-SAE) to address the challenge of unreliable direct estimation, particularly in nonlinear cases. The hyperparameter tuning results yielded the best model with the following hyperparameter combinations: maximum basis function (Max BF) = 10, maximum interaction (MI) = 2, minimum observation (MO) = 1, penalty = 3, with general cross validation (GCV) = 6.128. MARS-SAE demonstrated very strong performance; empirically, the model proved more efficient at reducing estimation error due to its higher relative efficiency (RE) compared to the SAE Fay-Herriot model, as well as better reduction of relative standard error (RSE) than the comparison model, and it yielded a lower relative root mean squared error (RRMSE) compared to the SAE Fay-Herriot model (13.64% vs. 13.75%). MARS-SAE has been proven to capture nonlinear patterns very well while still maintaining interpretability, making it an effective tool for the predictive and diagnostic analyses of phenomena. Thus, this research can serve as an important reference for readers regionally and in Southeast Asia, given that Java Island is a strategic region for Indonesia, the largest economic power in the ASEAN region.

title: A Novel Convolution-Based Stratified Attribute Estimator for QRE Determination in R&D Tax Credit Studies
summary: The One Big, Beautiful Bill Act reinstates immediate expensing of domestic research expenses, reducing the tax burden and incentivizing reinvestment in U.S.-based research and development including software development across a wide range of industries. In this context, accurate and defensible estimation of qualified research expenses (QREs) is of high importance. Statistical sampling provides a practical framework for estimating QREs for a well-defined population of business components (sampling frame) documented in accordance with Internal Revenue Code Section 41 (Form 6765). IRS Revenue Procedure 2011-42 permits both attribute and variable statistical methods, although the latter (stratified mean and difference estimators) are often regarded as the standard approach to QRE estimation. In this paper, we compare attribute and variable statistical methods within a simulation study and demonstrate that attribute methods offer several theoretical and practical advantages. A key concern with the simple attribute estimator is the possibility of upward bias in QRE determination arising from a preponderance of high potential QRE (pQRE), non-qualified projects in the sampling frame. We address this concern by introducing a stratified sampling design that ensures adequate representation of high pQRE projects in the sample. We demonstrate that a convolution-based stratified attribute estimator produces a valid one-sided 95% lower confidence bound on total QREs across a range of sampling frame structures.

title: Online activity prediction via generalized Indian buffet process models
comments: Accepted for publication in the Annals of Applied Statistics. This paper supersedes the technical reports arXiv:2401.14722 and arXiv:2402.03231 by the same authors
summary: Online A/B tests are the standard tool for data-driven decision-making at scale. Among the design choices with the largest impact on statistical power is the triggering mechanism: how many users to expose and for how long. This often requires forecasting user engagement, i.e., whether enough users will trigger, and when a target participation level will be reached, from limited pilot data. We introduce a Bayesian nonparametric model for predicting both new-user counts and total triggers, accommodating the heavy-tailed engagement patterns typical of web experiments. All predictive quantities can be computed without intensive numerical procedures such as Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) or variational inference. We evaluate on three public datasets (over 450 public benchmark evaluations) and a proprietary benchmark drawn from 759 production A/B tests comprising 1,774 arms. Across the benchmark analyses, our models are competitive and frequently improve accuracy in forecasting new users, total triggers, and time to reach a target sample size compared with state-of-the-art competitors, especially when only a few pilot days are observed.

title: Why is Regularization Underused? An Empirical Study on Trust and Adoption of Statistical Methods
summary: Statistical practice does not automatically follow methodological innovation. Regularization methods, widely advocated to reduce overfitting and stabilize inference, are readily available in modern software, but are not consistently used by data analysts. We investigate this implementation gap in a large-scale empirical study of trust in, and acceptance of, regularization techniques, based on $N = 606$ data analysts. Drawing on measurement frameworks from technology acceptance research, we survey practitioners and embed a randomized experiment to test whether written recommendation of regularization methods increases trust or intended use. We find no evidence of such an effect. Instead, adoption intentions are strongly associated with analysts' perceptions of ease of implementation and practical benefit, such as improved bias control or interpretability. Perceived social norms also emerge as a central driver. These results indicate that uptake of statistical methodology depends less on formal recommendations than on usability, perceived utility, and community practice.

title: Online Bayesian Model Averaging with Joint Uncertainty Quantification for Models and Regression Coefficients in Binary Regression
summary: Streaming binary response data arise in many applications, including virtual learning platforms where student responses are collected sequentially and estimated probabilities of correct responses may inform future question assignment. Logistic regression provides an interpretable framework for such analysis, but the data may support multiple plausible predictor subsets. Bayesian model averaging (BMA) accounts for such model uncertainty by averaging inference across competing models. Since repeatedly applying BMA to accumulating data can be computationally burdensome, we develop an online implementation based on renewable estimation. At each update, retained summaries and new observations are used to approximate the joint posterior of models and model-specific coefficients without revisiting historical data, enabling point and interval estimates that incorporate model uncertainty. Simulations show that online BMA closely approximates its offline counterpart in coefficient estimation, model and variable importance, prediction, and interval estimation of predictive probabilities, while substantially reducing computational cost. In a virtual learning application, we find substantial uncertainty across competing predictor subsets and large variability in credible interval widths across questions. Our method distinguishes questions with precise estimates from those with substantial uncertainty, providing information beyond point estimates for adaptive question assignment.
